Job.CustomJobTypeName: Loss Control Consultant, Risk Management / Loss Control
Job.JobDescription:
At Alexander & Schmidt, a Loss Control Field Representative performs on-site property, general liability and incidental auto inspections and prepares reports for insurance underwriting purposes. Insurance companies use the reports to properly insure commercial or residential buildings or properties for a new policy or renewal of a current policy.

Required Skills

  • A minimum of 3 – 5 years' experience with a commercial carrier or working as an independent contractor providing loss control services.
  • Understanding of commercial property and casualty lines including property, general liability, auto and workers compensation.
  • Solid communication skills—including exceptional writing ability, organizational skills, and computer skills
  • Excellent time management skills
  • Travel within a reasonable territory, 60 mile radius
  • Professional certifications CSP, OHST, ALCM and/or ARM are preferred, but not required.
  • Uploading completed reports, photos and diagrams through a special website or complete reports on web based systems

High-quality, accurate loss control surveys guide the underwriter in the selection of profitable business, and assist the insured in controlling losses through the demonstrated value of the loss control services provided.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Loss Control Consultant, Risk Management / Loss Control
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Las Vegas, NV
  • Experience: 10+ years

About this job

Senior Loss Control Consultant performs inspections and prepares detailed reports for insurance underwriting on commercial properties and business operations. The role covers property, liability, workers compensation, and specialty coverages across diverse industries including construction, retail, and manufacturing.

Good fit if you have 10+ years loss control experience with a major carrier, strong commercial property and casualty knowledge, and excellent writing skills.

Full job description

At Alexander & Schmidt, a Senior Loss Control Consultant performs inspections and prepares in-depth reports for insurance underwriting purposes. Insurance companies use the reports to properly insure a commercial building, or business operations, for a new policy or renewal of a current policy.

Required Skills

  • A Minimum 10 years' experience with a major carrier or working as an independent contractor providing loss control services.
  • Extensive understanding of commercial property and casualty lines.
    • Property assessments will potentially include the necessity to determine adequacy of sprinkler systems based on occupancy, commodities and racking systems.
    • Inland Marine coverages will include builders risk, contractor's equipment, motor truck cargo, WLL and MOLL and other specialty coverage's.
    • Commercial General Liability will include Premises, Operations, Products and Completed Operations.
    • Workers Compensation assessments for regulatory compliance and workplace safety.
    • Loss analysis involving identification of trends, root cause and appropriate corrective action.
    • Specialty fields such as Environmental and Professional Liability
  • Risk Improvement services including training, consulting, hazard analysis and regulatory assessments will also be conducted.
  • Solid communication skills—including exceptional writing ability, organizational skills, and computer skills
  • Excellent Time management skills
  • Professional certifications CSP, OHST, ALCM and/or ARM are preferred, but not required.
  • Uploading completed reports, photos and diagrams through a special website or complete reports on web based systems
  • Travel within a reasonable territory, 50 mile radius

This work will be challenging and covers everything from contractors to real estate to retail to warehouse and distribution to manufacturing.

High-quality, accurate loss control surveys guide the underwriter in the selection of profitable business, and assist the insured in controlling losses through the demonstrated value of the loss control services provided.

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: San Diego, CA

About this job

Associate Attorney handling moderately complex civil litigation and workers' compensation matters for Liberty Mutual Insurance. Primarily remote role in California, managing cases from inception through resolution with support from senior counsel.

Good fit if you have a California bar license, knowledge of insurance law, and can manage civil litigation cases under supervision.

Full job description


Description

This role is primarily remote in the state of California except for required appearances.

At Liberty Mutual, were committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders rights and positively impacting our business. As an Associate Attorney at Liberty Mutual, youll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligibleperformance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If yourelooking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where youll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual Insurance offers an engaging opportunity for an Associate Attorney to represent the company and its policyholders in routine civil litigation and workers' compensation matters involving moderately complex legal issues and claims for monetary damages or compensation related to personal injury or property damage. Under moderate supervision, you will manage cases from inception through resolution, applying your legal knowledge, research skills, and client relationship capabilities in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Execution: Manage all phases of litigation, including discovery, hearings, trials, mediations, and drafting legal documents such as pleadings and motions. Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide clear and reasoned legal opinions and strategic advice to Claims Representatives and insured clients. Develop and maintain strong client relationships through transparent and effective communication.
  • Technology Utilization: Utilize e-discovery and case management technologies to streamline legal processes, improve efficiency, and reduce operational costs. Demonstrate effective coordination with remote team members and proficiency in remote work settings.
  • Risk Evaluation and Case Resolution Facilitation: Identify, evaluate, and collaborate on strategies to mitigate legal risks, working closely with clients and senior counsel to facilitate effective resolutions.
  • Documentation Accuracy and Compliance: Ensure all legal documents, pleadings, and motions are meticulously prepared, accurate, and compliant with applicable standards and client expectations.
  • Timely Client Communication: Provide clear, consistent, and timely updates and recommendations to insured clients and claims professionals to maintain alignment with case objectives.
  • Contribution to Organizational Improvement: Participate in initiatives aimed at enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and best practices within Staff Legal and Global Legal & Compliance organizations.
  • Ethical Compliance Adherence: Uphold the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance, following legal regulations and licensing requirements and promoting a culture of integrity within the legal team.
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in Californiaand in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • General knowledge of insurance law, and as necessary, workers compensation
  • Proficient in e-discovery, case management systems, and basic legal analysis tools.
  • Strong analytical, research, and legal writing skills.
  • Basic knowledge of negotiation techniques including preparation, active listening, and problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cases from start to finish under supervision.
  • Effective communication and persuasion skills, both written and oral.
  • Ability to collaborate with clients, claims professionals, and senior attorneys.
  • Organized, process-oriented with strong time management skills.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

Description

This role is primarily remote in the state of California except for required appearances.

At Liberty Mutual, were committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders rights and positively impacting our business. As an Associate Attorney at Liberty Mutual, youll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligibleperformance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If yourelooking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where youll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual Insurance offers an engaging opportunity for an Associate Attorney to represent the company and its policyholders in routine civil litigation and workers' compensation matters involving moderately complex legal issues and claims for monetary damages or compensation related to personal injury or property damage. Under moderate supervision, you will manage cases from inception through resolution, applying your legal knowledge, research skills, and client relationship capabilities in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Execution: Manage all phases of litigation, including discovery, hearings, trials, mediations, and drafting legal documents such as pleadings and motions. Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide clear and reasoned legal opinions and strategic advice to Claims Representatives and insured clients. Develop and maintain strong client relationships through transparent and effective communication.
  • Technology Utilization: Utilize e-discovery and case management technologies to streamline legal processes, improve efficiency, and reduce operational costs. Demonstrate effective coordination with remote team members and proficiency in remote work settings.
  • Risk Evaluation and Case Resolution Facilitation: Identify, evaluate, and collaborate on strategies to mitigate legal risks, working closely with clients and senior counsel to facilitate effective resolutions.
  • Documentation Accuracy and Compliance: Ensure all legal documents, pleadings, and motions are meticulously prepared, accurate, and compliant with applicable standards and client expectations.
  • Timely Client Communication: Provide clear, consistent, and timely updates and recommendations to insured clients and claims professionals to maintain alignment with case objectives.
  • Contribution to Organizational Improvement: Participate in initiatives aimed at enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and best practices within Staff Legal and Global Legal & Compliance organizations.
  • Ethical Compliance Adherence: Uphold the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance, following legal regulations and licensing requirements and promoting a culture of integrity within the legal team.
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in Californiaand in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • General knowledge of insurance law, and as necessary, workers compensation
  • Proficient in e-discovery, case management systems, and basic legal analysis tools.
  • Strong analytical, research, and legal writing skills.
  • Basic knowledge of negotiation techniques including preparation, active listening, and problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cases from start to finish under supervision.
  • Effective communication and persuasion skills, both written and oral.
  • Ability to collaborate with clients, claims professionals, and senior attorneys.
  • Organized, process-oriented with strong time management skills.

About this job

Manages a team of Client Service Managers at Liberty Mutual's Chicago office, overseeing service delivery to customers and brokers. Responsibilities include team recruitment, training, and development, account management, and cross-functional collaboration with underwriting, claims, and field operations.

Good fit if you have 7+ years in commercial insurance with leadership experience and advanced knowledge of P&C insurance, risk management, and applicable regulations.

Full job description


Description

Manages a group of Client Service Managers (CSM) to deliver consistent and high-quality service to customers and brokers. Assists in recruiting, training, and developing team members. Responsible for developing annual objectives that support assigned account success, as well as accountable for team performance and development. Contributes to the development, implementation, and execution of the business plan and strategies. Resolves service-related issues with internal partners. Responsible for managing external relationships (clients, agents/brokers, industry associations, etc.) and issue resolution. Manage assigned accounts, handling servicing aspects of relationships.


Responsibilities
  • Effectively partners and manages relationships with key internal stakeholders for mutual success.
  • Establishes a leadership voice in the region by strengthening relationships across Field Ops, UW, Claims, Risk Control, and other key internal partners by sharing key service strategic initiatives and client updates.
  • Identify opportunities for direct and indirect reports to make additional contributions to ensure the overall success of GRS.
  • Assists Director of Client Service in the recruitment, hiring, training, and development of service team within region.
  • Assists Field Operations and Underwriting with key prospects and renewals.
  • Effectively leads, manages, and develops team to achieve organizational goals and deliver exceptional service to clients and brokers.
  • Completes performance evaluations and provides targeted feedback and coaching.
  • Drives GRS growth efforts by prospecting and developing relationships with select clients and their broker(s).
  • In partnership with Field Operations and Underwriting, aim to secure off-cycle meetings and solicit submissions that result in quotes and new business.
  • Drives partnership between key profit center(s) and Client Service by serving at the dedicated Service liaison.
  • Responsible for knowing and communicating key strategies, results, market trends, etc.)
  • Manages assigned accounts, handling servicing aspects of relationships.
  • Partners closely with Claims and Risk Control to ensure consistent protocols, delivery of services, and business practices.

The selected candidate will work a hybrid schedule with two days in the office/market. This policy is subject to change.

Qualifications
  • Advanced knowledge of commercial property/casualty insurance, risk management, and applicable state regulations
  • Knowledge of underwriting, plan construction, pricing, service contracts, and funding/financial security agreement
  • Ability to get work done through others (delegate), communicate effectively (including listening, making presentations, writing clearly, giving constructive feedback, etc.) get support from above, plan/organize work, analyze and solve problems, build relationships, and focus on the larger picture
  • Ability to prioritize the things that will make the difference operationally, use time effectively, and develop/engage employees as normally acquired through a related bachelor`s degree and 7 years of experience, some of which should be in a leadership capacity
  • A masters` degree, ARM designation or CPCU designation desired

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time

About this job

Liberty Mutual seeks a Claims Manager II to lead Commercial Casualty claims teams in an Excess Claims environment. You will direct claims handling operations, manage staff, and partner with internal and external stakeholders to achieve optimal claim outcomes using data analytics and established processes.

Good fit if you have 7+ years of commercial casualty claims experience, can direct teams, and hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent.

Full job description


Description

Liberty Mutual has an immediate opening for a Claims Manager II position for our Commercial Insurance Casualty leadership. The Claims Manager II plans, organizes, and directs the Commercial Casualty claims handling activities within an Excess Claims team. In this role, you will achieve superior claims outcomes through effective workforce management, quality service delivery, and the use of technology, data analytics, and processes/programs.

Please note we have in-office requirements of at least twice a month if you reside within a 50-mile radius of any of these Commercial Claims offices: Boston, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Plano, TX; Suwanee, GA; Westborough, MA; or Weatogue, CT. This requirement is subject to change.

Responsibilities

    • Manages team to ensure that adequate resources and technical skills exist to handle complex, high-exposure Excess claims in accordance with Company service standards and expectations.
    • Drive a culture of urgency, accountability, disciplined collaboration, and clear communication.
    • Partner effectively with internal and external stakeholders - including Underwriting, Legal, Reinsurance, Brokers, Insureds, Counsel - to align on claim strategy and achieve optimal outcomes.
    • Model strong leadership and decision-making in a dynamic environment where priorities, exposures, and stakeholders' needs can shift quickly.
    • Actively attracts, develops, and engages talented claims employees while simultaneously addressing employees who are not meeting expectations.
    • Focuses staff on continuous improvement, engaging in the transformation and sustainability efforts, looking for ways to build capabilities, and driving organizational effectiveness.
    • Participates in short to medium-term strategic business planning.
    • Reviews and approves, within assigned authority limits, claim expenses and settlements that exceed the claims employee's authority level appropriately refers claim expenses and settlements that exceed personal authority limits for approval.
    • Monitors and evaluates the claims reserve practices within the office and ensures that actual reserves are accurate and established promptly.
    • Prepares and distributes management reports analyzing and documenting office operations and performance identifies, analyzes and reports on claims processing trends and issues.
    • Maintains awareness of existing and proposed legislation, court decisions and emerging trends in claims litigation to monitor the company's compliance with state and federal legislation.
Qualifications
  • Advanced knowledge of Commercial Claims (Excess and Specialized, General Liability, Environmental, etc.), claims investigation, coverage evaluation, loss assessment, reserving, insurance legal & regulatory environment, claims processes, applications/systems and procedures, medical terminology, and finance
  • Demonstrated ability to direct the work of others, implement strategies and plans created by senior leaders, develop staff, and achieve goals/objectives the right way
  • Other skills required include: planning/organizing work, communication (listening, delivering complex messages, gaining support, promoting collaboration, etc.), diplomacy/tact, business/financial acumen, and adaptability
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent and 7+ years of progressively more responsible related work experience
  • Claims Management experience preferred.
  • Complex Commercial Casualty claims experience required.

Description

Liberty Mutual has an immediate opening for a Claims Manager II position for our Commercial Insurance Casualty leadership. The Claims Manager II plans, organizes, and directs the Commercial Casualty claims handling activities within an Excess Claims team. In this role, you will achieve superior claims outcomes through effective workforce management, quality service delivery, and the use of technology, data analytics, and processes/programs.

Please note we have in-office requirements of at least twice a month if you reside within a 50-mile radius of any of these Commercial Claims offices: Boston, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Plano, TX; Suwanee, GA; Westborough, MA; or Weatogue, CT. This requirement is subject to change.

Responsibilities

    • Manages team to ensure that adequate resources and technical skills exist to handle complex, high-exposure Excess claims in accordance with Company service standards and expectations.
    • Drive a culture of urgency, accountability, disciplined collaboration, and clear communication.
    • Partner effectively with internal and external stakeholders - including Underwriting, Legal, Reinsurance, Brokers, Insureds, Counsel - to align on claim strategy and achieve optimal outcomes.
    • Model strong leadership and decision-making in a dynamic environment where priorities, exposures, and stakeholders' needs can shift quickly.
    • Actively attracts, develops, and engages talented claims employees while simultaneously addressing employees who are not meeting expectations.
    • Focuses staff on continuous improvement, engaging in the transformation and sustainability efforts, looking for ways to build capabilities, and driving organizational effectiveness.
    • Participates in short to medium-term strategic business planning.
    • Reviews and approves, within assigned authority limits, claim expenses and settlements that exceed the claims employee's authority level appropriately refers claim expenses and settlements that exceed personal authority limits for approval.
    • Monitors and evaluates the claims reserve practices within the office and ensures that actual reserves are accurate and established promptly.
    • Prepares and distributes management reports analyzing and documenting office operations and performance identifies, analyzes and reports on claims processing trends and issues.
    • Maintains awareness of existing and proposed legislation, court decisions and emerging trends in claims litigation to monitor the company's compliance with state and federal legislation.
Qualifications
  • Advanced knowledge of Commercial Claims (Excess and Specialized, General Liability, Environmental, etc.), claims investigation, coverage evaluation, loss assessment, reserving, insurance legal & regulatory environment, claims processes, applications/systems and procedures, medical terminology, and finance
  • Demonstrated ability to direct the work of others, implement strategies and plans created by senior leaders, develop staff, and achieve goals/objectives the right way
  • Other skills required include: planning/organizing work, communication (listening, delivering complex messages, gaining support, promoting collaboration, etc.), diplomacy/tact, business/financial acumen, and adaptability
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent and 7+ years of progressively more responsible related work experience
  • Claims Management experience preferred.
  • Complex Commercial Casualty claims experience required.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Claims Specialist I, Workers Compensation - West Region
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Workers' Compensation Adjuster, Claims, Claims Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Are you looking for an opportunity to join a fast-growing company that consistently outpaces the industry in year-over-year growth? Liberty Mutual offers an exciting opening for a Senior Workers Compensation Claims Specialist within the West Region!

The Senior Claims Specialist works within a Claims Team, using the latest technology to review, analyze and process claims that are routinely characterized as moderately complex to complex within assigned authority limits. This includes making decisions about liability/compensability, evaluating losses, negotiating settlements and managing an inventory of commercial property/casualty claims involving bodily injury or property loss. The Senior Claims Specialist may also assist the Claims Team Manager with assigning new claims to team members, providing technical direction, and monitoring caseloads.

Depending on your overall skills and experience, you may be considered as a Senior Claims Specialist I, or Senior Claims Specialist II. The salary range posted reflects the varying pay scale across various locations.

Candidates must reside within 50 miles of Lake Oswego, OR; and Chandler, AZ; and will be required to work onsite twice a month. Candidates residing in CA and WA will be considered in all locations and may be eligible for 100% remote work. Please note that this policy is subject to change.

Responsibilities:

  • Plans and conducts investigations of claims (including such activities as interviewing insureds, witnesses and claimants, collecting and evaluating appropriate documentation and securing evidence and protecting the chain-of-custody) to analyze and confirm coverage and to determine liability, compensability and damages.
  • Determines need for, and engages independent adjusters, cause and origin experts and independent medical examiners.
  • Refers to claim to subrogation group or Special Investigations Unit as appropriate.
  • Assesses policy coverage for submitted claims and notifies the insured of any issues; determines and establishes reserve requirements, adjusting reserves, as necessary, during the processing of the claim.
  • Assesses actual damages associated with claims and conducts negotiations, within assigned authority limits, to settle claims.
  • Coordinates the litigation activities associated with assigned claims to ensure a timely and cost-effective resolution; attends trials as a representative of the company.
  • Acts as senior technical professional on team, assisting team members with escalated issues.
  • Mentors and trains new team members.
  • Participates in Quality Review process.
  • Participates in conducting Suit Committees, Roundtables, Arbitrations, Mediations, field investigations and may assist in conducting closed file reviews.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to communicate and negotiate with customers and conduct investigations required.
  • Leadership ability and demonstrated time management skills to delegate work appropriately and organize resources effectively.
  • Demonstrates an advanced knowledge of claims case handling practices, legal liability, general insurance policy coverage, and the state`s tort laws as normally acquired through a bachelor`s degree (or equivalent training) plus 3 to 5 years directly related work experience.
  • Required to obtain and maintain all applicable licenses.
About Us

The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Job.CustomJobTypeName: Workers' Compensation Adjuster, Claims, Claims Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chandler, AZ
  • Experience: 3 to 5 years

About this job

Senior Claims Specialist who reviews, analyzes and processes moderately complex to complex workers compensation claims using latest technology. Responsibilities include investigating claims, determining liability and compensability, negotiating settlements, coordinating litigation, and mentoring team members.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree or equivalent plus 3 to 5 years of claims handling experience, strong negotiation skills, and can reside within 50 miles of Chandler, AZ or Lake Oswego, OR.

Full job description


Description

Are you looking for an opportunity to join a fast-growing company that consistently outpaces the industry in year-over-year growth? Liberty Mutual offers an exciting opening for a Senior Workers Compensation Claims Specialist within the West Region!

The Senior Claims Specialist works within a Claims Team, using the latest technology to review, analyze and process claims that are routinely characterized as moderately complex to complex within assigned authority limits. This includes making decisions about liability/compensability, evaluating losses, negotiating settlements and managing an inventory of commercial property/casualty claims involving bodily injury or property loss. The Senior Claims Specialist may also assist the Claims Team Manager with assigning new claims to team members, providing technical direction, and monitoring caseloads.

Depending on your overall skills and experience, you may be considered as a Senior Claims Specialist I, or Senior Claims Specialist II. The salary range posted reflects the varying pay scale across various locations.

Candidates must reside within 50 miles of Lake Oswego, OR; and Chandler, AZ; and will be required to work onsite twice a month. Candidates residing in CA and WA will be considered in all locations and may be eligible for 100% remote work. Please note that this policy is subject to change.

Responsibilities:

  • Plans and conducts investigations of claims (including such activities as interviewing insureds, witnesses and claimants, collecting and evaluating appropriate documentation and securing evidence and protecting the chain-of-custody) to analyze and confirm coverage and to determine liability, compensability and damages.
  • Determines need for, and engages independent adjusters, cause and origin experts and independent medical examiners.
  • Refers to claim to subrogation group or Special Investigations Unit as appropriate.
  • Assesses policy coverage for submitted claims and notifies the insured of any issues; determines and establishes reserve requirements, adjusting reserves, as necessary, during the processing of the claim.
  • Assesses actual damages associated with claims and conducts negotiations, within assigned authority limits, to settle claims.
  • Coordinates the litigation activities associated with assigned claims to ensure a timely and cost-effective resolution; attends trials as a representative of the company.
  • Acts as senior technical professional on team, assisting team members with escalated issues.
  • Mentors and trains new team members.
  • Participates in Quality Review process.
  • Participates in conducting Suit Committees, Roundtables, Arbitrations, Mediations, field investigations and may assist in conducting closed file reviews.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to communicate and negotiate with customers and conduct investigations required.
  • Leadership ability and demonstrated time management skills to delegate work appropriately and organize resources effectively.
  • Demonstrates an advanced knowledge of claims case handling practices, legal liability, general insurance policy coverage, and the state`s tort laws as normally acquired through a bachelor`s degree (or equivalent training) plus 3 to 5 years directly related work experience.
  • Required to obtain and maintain all applicable licenses.

Executive Underwriter for Liberty Mutual's Wholesale Excess Casualty portfolio in the Central Region, focusing on primary general liability and excess casualty risks. Description

We are seeking an experienced Executive Underwriter to drive profitable growth within our Wholesale Excess Casualty portfolio across the Central Region. This role focuses on primary general liability and excess casualty risks within the E&S market, partnering closely with wholesale brokers to evaluate, price, and structure complex risks.

The successful candidate will operate with a high degree of autonomy, leveraging deep underwriting expertise, strong market relationships, and data-driven decision-making to underwrite sophisticated risks, often characterized by unique exposures, higher hazard profiles, or significant line sizes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Underwrite and price complex primary GL and excess casualty E&S risks within authority, using data-driven analysis and strong underwriting judgment.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Claims, Actuarial, UW Support, and leadership to support underwriting strategy and execution.
  • Provide mentorship to junior underwriters and contribute insights on portfolio trends, emerging risks, and product or process improvements.

  • Degree in Business or equivalent is typically required
  • A minimum of 5-10 years, typically 3 or more years, of progressive underwriting experience and/or other related experience
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge underwriting risks within scope of responsibility that includes competence with all phases and aspects of the underwriting process, and proficiency in the use of qualitative and quantitative tools and techniques
  • Must demonstrate comprehension of complex technical underwriting issues and be capable of defining and implementing necessary underwriting and administrative processes/workflows to properly manage or administer those issues
  • Proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable business

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Boston, MA
  • Experience: 5+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Support the daily business operations of Liberty Mutual's Corporate Strategy & Research group within the Enterprise Strategy & Innovation function. Responsibilities include performance scorecard reporting, department meeting coordination, vendor management, and culture initiatives for this Fortune 100 company's Boston headquarters.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in business operations or analysis, strong presentation skills, and experience with vendor management and metrics reporting.

Full job description


Description

This role will be based in our Boston MA headquarters office working a hybrid schedule

Enterprise Strategy & Innovation (ES&I) is a corporate organization that reports directly into Liberty Mutuals Executive Leadership Team within Liberty Mutual Insurance, a Fortune 100 company with 40,000 employees in 900 offices worldwide.

The function is comprised of five interrelated verticals: Libertys award winning in-house enterprise strategy / strategy consulting arm (Corporate Strategy & Research), a strategic alignment group (LMG Alignment), a global innovation incubator (Solaria Labs), an enterprise venture capital group (Liberty Mutual Strategic Ventures) that invests in early-stage startups to glean critical insights on emerging disruptive trends, and a dedicated business operations team (ES&I Operations) that orchestrates the overall operating model of the ES&I function driving strategic priority setting, cross-teams alignment, business operational effectiveness, financial & performance management, and supporting culture & team engagement initiatives.

ES&I Operations is currently searching for a Senior Business Analyst or Project Manager I to support the day-to-day business operations of our Corporate Strategy & Research (CS&R) group including management of key vendor relationships, leading the planning & execution of department meetings, targeted metrics reporting including overall performance scorecard, crystalizing insights into executive-level PowerPoint presentations and dashboards, and team culture building initiatives. This is an individual contributor role.

This is a great opportunity for an energetic individual to join a dynamic, tight-knit enterprise strategy and innovation community where you will lead key initiatives to enable a high-performance and vibrant team environment.

Responsibilities

  • Synthesize, monitor, and report on results of an annual, holistic CS&R Performance Scorecard with success metrics aligned with the overall purpose of the function and the strategic priorities of the company
  • Lead the planning and execution of CS&R monthly department meetings to promote a culture of knowledge sharing, ensuring work alignment & transparency, and building a more unified and connected team
  • Run standard and ad hoc department level metrics reporting related to talent portfolio mix, budget analyses, and consulting project work; storyboard and craft compelling presentations using standard tools (PowerPoint, Excel) and summary dashboards using Gen AI (Claude, GPT) shared with CS&R leadership team and/or ES&I leadership, as requested
  • Serve as the business operational liaison across our CS&R internal pillars supporting across Talent Attraction, Talent Development, Consulting Best Practices, Feedback & Performance, and Culture & Engagement (C&E) initiatives; serve as a standing team member of the C&E Pillar in a leadership capacity in advancing & orchestrating meaningful opportunities to drive employee engagement, culture of collaboration, and fostering team unity
  • Manage day-to-day CS&R vendor relationships & subscriptions; research & recommend new vendors for the group or vendors to de-commission; support contract negotiations. Own overall day-to-day enterprise-wide relationships with two industry leading consulting expert networks
  • Drive focus and discipline on expense management by supporting annual ES&I budget / planning process, serve as CS&R escalation path for expense inquiries, and coordinate timely CS&R payments (Ariba, Wire)
  • Drive operational excellence, with a focus on productivity, effectiveness, and continuous improvement opportunities within CS&R by serving as point of contact / escalation path for all technology & tools matters including administration (e.g., SharePoint, Teams, Gen AI access); ensure full execution of consulting project teams onboarding & offboarding process including knowledge management
  • Act as a trusted counterpart and sounding board to the VP & Head of Operations, Enterprise Strategy & Innovation
  • Independently lead special projects of varying scope and complexity as assigned and as needed; historical examples include quarterbacking an industry award submission which resulted in winning an eminence-building recognition, counseling other departments on operational best practices upon request, etc.

The actual internal level/grade for this role will depend on the candidates overall experience and skill level

  • Senior Business Analyst: $107,500- $138,000. Annual FTO days (Flexible Time Off): 20
  • Project Manager I: $120,000 - $150,000. Annual FTO days (Flexible Time Off): 20
Qualifications
  • Bachelors degree in Business Administration or other business-related field required with a demonstrated record of academic success; MBA a plus (or Masters degree in a business-related field)
  • Progressive experience in a business operational and/or similar environment with exposure to relevant areas such as external vendor management, metrics reporting, and project planning & coordination
  • Strong interpersonal skills, written and oral communication; proven ability to storyboard and craft compelling presentations to various audiences
  • Client-serving or business operations enabling background a plus
  • Natural curiosity and acumen with new business enabling tools (e.g., Gen AI such as Claude and GPT) & technology trends and application to team based, business setting
  • Proven negotiation skills and ability to influence others; analytical and problem-solving mindset
  • Ability to grasp new concepts and adapt to changes and demands in a fast-paced and dynamic environment; proven ability to fulfill ad hoc requests and produce deliverables on time and with high quality
  • Senior Business Analyst: Bachelors degree or equivalent experience in addition to 5+ years of relevant experience to include business operations/analysis work.
  • Project Manager I: Bachelors degree or equivalent experience in addition to 6+ years of relevant experience to include business operations/analysis work.

Full job description


Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you'll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed. No prior insurance experience required.

THIS POSITION HAS IN-OFFICE REQUIREMENTS.

This is a full-time, field-based employee position. Applicants must be able to travel within their local community to meet with customers and build relationships. Reliable transportation, such as a valid driver's license or another means of travel, is preferred.

What you'll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

Essential functions include: meeting with customers in the office and in the community, communicating by phone, email, and in person, traveling locally, and using a computer and sales software.

Day One Skills & Traits:

  • Self-motivated and accountable: you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive: you follow through and do what you say you'll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy: you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused: you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Strong communicator: you're comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Comfortable with technology: you can learn and use new software and digital tools with ease.
  • Composed and dependable: you stay organized and professional while managing multiple customer needs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

Job.JobTitle: Commercial Lines Customer Service Rep (CSR) - REMOTE
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Customer Service Representative, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Remote
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k)

About this job

Remote Commercial Lines Customer Service Representative role processing endorsements, cancellations, and policy documents for Property & Casualty brokers. Requires 10 years current Commercial Lines experience and familiarity with agency management systems like EPIC or AMS360.

Good fit if you have 10+ years of Commercial Lines P&C insurance experience and experience with independent agency management systems

Full job description

Put your Insurance Experience to work – FROM HOME!

At WAHVE, we value significant insurance experience and want to revolutionize the way people think about phasing into retirement by offering qualified candidates the opportunity to continue their career working from home. As we say – retire from the office but not from work. Our unique platform provides you with real work/life balance and allows you to choose a full or part-time work schedule while continuing to utilize your insurance expertise in a flexible, remote, long-term position which includes company benefits!

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WAHVE

We created a welcoming place to work with friendly and professional leadership. We are known for the great care we take with our staff and our clients. We are passionate and determined about delivering the best customer service, preserving insurance industry knowledge, and making a difference by the work that we do.

WHAT WE ARE SEEKING

We have assignments available to help our Property & Casualty independent retail broker clients in Commercial Lines Customer Service Representative (CSR) positions.  Responsibilities may include:

  • Process endorsements, cancellations, reinstatements, and audits in coordination with Account Managers.
  • Maintain accurate and complete client records in the agency management system.
  • Issue certificates of insurance, auto ID cards, evidence of insurance, and other routine documents.
  • Follow up with carriers on policy processing, billing discrepancies, and documentation.
  • Respond to routine client requests including policy questions, billing inquiries, and documentation needs.
  • Experience using ANY independent agency management system is preferred (high demand for EPIC and AMS360).

TO BECOME A WORK-AT-HOME VINTAGE EXPERT, WE REQUIRE

  • 25 years of full-time work experience
  • 10 most current years of Commercial Lines Property & Casualty insurance experience

BENEFITS OF BECOMING A WAHVE VINTAGE EXPERT

  • Health insurance based on eligibility.
  • 401(k) with a 4% match based on eligibility.
  • Voluntary Dental, Vision, Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D).
  • Retire from the office but not from work.
  • Eliminate the office stress and the commute.
  • Choose the work you would like to do now.
  • Available in either full or part-time schedules.
  • Utilize your years of insurance industry knowledge.
  • Be part of our dynamic yet virtual team environment and connect with other experienced insurance professionals like yourself!

HOW TO GET STARTED

Click APPLY NOW to complete our simple preliminary profile.  Be sure to include your preferred contact information as one of our Qualification Specialists will connect with you promptly.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO MEETING YOU!

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The hourly salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual hourly rate for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards. 

Salary Range

$25.00 - $26.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Are you curious by nature? Do you enjoy managing relationships and employing your critical thinking skills? Underwriters perform a critical function of evaluating the acceptability of risk and determining appropriate pricing of insurance products. The Underwriting Apprenticeship Program provides students with the amazing opportunity to gain exposure to this critical function at Travelers.

The semester long program provides qualified students with an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand insurance underwriting experience, receive valuable on-the-job training and learn more about the property & casualty insurance industry from industry professionals.

It is a potential pathway to our 12 month Underwriting Professional Development Program. The intent of this position is to provide students the ability to apply to our 2024 Underwriting Apprenticeship opportunities which start in January. Applications outside of this audience will not be considered at this time. However, for summer internship opportunities, we encourage anyone to apply to our current 2024 Underwriting Professional Development Program Internship roles in various locations.

What Will You Do?

  • Within your assigned business unit, each apprentice will be given a designated coach and be expected to:
  • Complete core assignments and training modules geared toward insurance and underwriting principles.
  • Participate and complete self-paced professional development courses in time management, presentation skills and other key areas.
  • Complete challenging and meaningful project work over the course of this program at the discretion of your manager. You may work independently or with other interns and will be asked to present your findings to local leadership. Sample projects include a territorial risk assessment to determine profitability and underwriting opportunities as well as a business process analysis to determine underwriting gaps.
  • Learn about other areas at Travelers such as Risk Control, Claims, and related Corporate functions. Interns may also engage in Agency visits with Account Executives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Because the Underwriting Apprenticeship Program is itself complex and dynamic, we welcome applicants that have a variety of majors, backgrounds, and experiences. We are most interested in students who are serious about entering the insurance industry and who are excited about the prospect of making underwriting their future career choice.
  • Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Legal eligibility to work in the United States.
  • Targeted Majors:
  • Business Administration
  • Economics
  • Finance
  • Liberal Arts (with business focus preferred)
  • Management
  • Marketing
  • Risk Management and Insurance

What is a Must Have?

  • Candidate must be pursuing an undergraduate degree.
  • Approximate work availability from January through May required.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

We are committed to providing accommodation to persons with disabilities. If you require accommodation during the recruitment or interview process we will work with you to accommodate your needs.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Quick facts

  • Pay: $106,600 to $175,900 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Hartford, CT
  • Education: Bachelor's degree
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off

About this job

Manager role conducting market research to inform Travelers' business strategy by synthesizing internal and external data, analyzing competitors, and identifying market opportunities. May include people leadership responsibilities.

Good fit if you have 3+ years of market research experience, a bachelor's degree in business/marketing/economics/math/psychology/anthropology, and intermediate secondary research knowledge.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$106,600.00 - $175,900.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

At Travelers, Market Researchers collaborate across the company to inform business decisions, drive winning go-to-market strategies and enable the business to capitalize on change. They provide strategic consulting and actionable insights; helping the business grow profitably, build the Travelers brand, and positively position the company in the marketplace. As a Market Research Manager, you conduct research that analyzes and synthesizes internal and external data to identify market and industry opportunities, understand competitors' actions, and monitor trends and their impacts to the business, today and tomorrow. You work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to ensure research projects are aligned with business objectives and provide valuable insights for decision-making. This role may have people leadership responsibilities.

What Will You Do?

  • Conduct secondary research projects by leveraging numerous sources and methodologies, working with complex and sometimes conflicting datasets. Recommend appropriate sources and/or methodologies to be used for each initiative.
  • Use a wide range of methodologies and sources to synthesize research findings into clear and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making; will present findings to internal partners.
  • Develop research projects and associated deliverables, including documentation such as proposals, project plans, data specs, and final reports.
  • Manage timelines and resources effectively, with some management support and oversight as necessary.
  • Assess accuracy, credibility, and appropriateness of data while ensuring quality standards are met.
  • May serve as a member of an Engagement Team for one or more businesses or corporate functions.
  • This position may manage other staff, which would include responsibility for monitoring the work quality of the team and providing coaching and performance management for those staff members.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 5 or more years of market research or related experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, economics, mathematics, psychology, anthropology or comparable analytical degree.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office products.
  • Self-motivated.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate information clearly and effectively, demonstrating an understanding of the audience.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within a team, and with vendor and business partners.
  • Able to create and cultivate relationships and use them to inform business outcomes.
  • Intermediate knowledge of business and/or insurance concepts.
  • Intermediate knowledge of and experience conducting secondary research including:
    • Market sizing
    • Competitive Intelligence
    • Trends Analysis
    • Economic/Financial Analysis
  • Intermediate ability to analyze disparate data sets to derive conclusions and/or research recommendations.

What is a Must Have?

  • 3 years of market research or related experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$87,800.00 - $144,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

As a Northland Claim Litigation Specialist, you will be responsible for managing and investigating moderate complexity injury and/or property damage claims including customer contact, determining coverage, evaluating liability, assessing damages, establishing timely reserves, and issue timely and accurate payments within appropriate authority and oversight.

In this technical role, you will leverage your expertise in claims management, investigative techniques, coverage evaluation, and settlement negotiation to ensure timely and fair resolution.

You will foster positive, professional relationships with customers and stakeholders on claims that may involve significant litigation or span extended periods.

You will provide guidance and mentorship to Claim Reps and Associate Claim Reps, sharing knowledge and best practices to support their development.

What Will You Do?

  • Independently manage an active caseload of injury and/or property damage claims and litigation from first notice of loss through resolution within level of authority. Typically, handles personal and/or business insurance high complexity liability claims which may include coverage disputes and contractual indemnity issues.
  • Gather and thoroughly investigate information by contacting all relevant parties to determine coverage, evaluate liability exposure, assess bodily injury and/or property damage, and establish appropriate reserves in accordance with policy terms and management guidance.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, representatives, opposing counsel, third-party vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Leverage resolution strategies and coordinate internal and external resources to conduct comprehensive claim investigations and evaluations.
  • Actively negotiate with multiple constituents (e.g., claimants, attorneys, contractors, representatives) and convey claim settlements within authority and issue payments timely and accurately.
  • Assist in coordinating with Counsel to support litigation management strategies.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Identify areas in which we can improve or enhance current best practices and offer creative solutions.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers' requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • May require travel, including overnight stays, to attend mediations, trials, arbitration, etc.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Three years of liability, bodily injury or comparable claim experience.
  • Two years of litigation claim experience.
  • Active adjuster license, where required by state law.
  • Experience with claims management systems, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to comprehend, synthesize, and clearly articulate complex information to multiple stakeholders.
  • Ability to analyze complex situations, exercise sound judgement, and make effective decisions independently.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers; ability to manage difficult conversations with empathy and professionalism.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills with the ability to manage a high-volume workload and prioritize effectively.
  • Proven conflict resolution and negotiation skills; ability to handle complex or disputed claims, negotiate settlements, and manage litigation.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Thorough understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations, fair claims practices, and legal requirements applicable to claim handling.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret, apply, and clearly articulate complex policy language, endorsements, exclusions to assess coverage and claim eligibility.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Two years of bodily injury liability, property damage liability, or comparable claim related experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Benefits That Go Beyond The Basics

We strive to be Above all in Service® to our customers—and to our employees. That's why Erie Insurance offers you an exceptional benefits package, including:

  • Premier health, prescription, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents. Coverage begins your first day of work.

Additional benefits that include company-paid basic life insurance; short-and long-term disability insurance; orthodontic coverage for children and adults; adoption assistance; fertility and infertility coverage; well-being programs; paid volunteer hours for service to your community; and dollar-for-dollar matching of your charitable gifts each year.

Position Summary

Exercises independent discretion or judgment in handling all types of property claims. Also assists or acts on behalf of the claims supervisor when required.

  • This is a remote, work from home position in Indiana
  • The selected candidate will ideally live in Hamilton County and/or surrounding areas.
  • The hiring manager will also consider candidates for Property Adjuster I. Level of position offered will be based upon the depth and breadth of selected candidate's experience and qualifications.
  • A company car and equipment to work from home will be provided
  • Good time management and organization skills preferred
  • Ability to drive/travel regularly within the assigned territory

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Conducts investigations, interviews, and inspects damage, driving to site of damage within assigned territory or other if required. Prepares estimates, makes recommendation, and handles coverage questions, and litigation.
  • Sets and maintains reserves, reviews reports and related materials, directs experts, determines coverage and claim value, issues or declines payment, and negotiates claims with plaintiff attorneys when necessary.
  • Documents claim files and submits report for closure.
  • Recognizes subrogation situations and initiates appropriate action.
  • Services assigned territory and brings assigned claims to conclusion.
  • Interacts with Agents and district sales managers on matters of mutual concern.
  • Assists claims supervisor or acts on his/her behalf, including representing the company at legal proceedings, as required.
  • Completes industry-related training programs and continues to attend training programs to remain informed on policy changes, interpretation or new legislation.
  • Assists in training of new claims adjusters.
  • Participates on Catastrophe Team when required.

Regular and predictable attendance is an essential job function. For certain positions at ERIE, including leadership roles, regular and predictable onsite presence may also be an essential job function based on business and operational needs.


This position description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the incumbent. Employees are required to follow any other job-related instruction and to perform any other duties as requested by their supervisor, or as become evident.

We are seeking a strategic and results‑oriented leader to head our Automotive Line of Business. This role leads a complex, fast‑evolving portfolio within the vehicle industry and is accountable for driving performance, profitable growth, and product strategy. Success in this role requires strong commercial acumen, deep market and network awareness, and the ability to translate industry trends into sustainable business results.

This is a high‑impact opportunity to shape the future of our automotive services while leading a growing business with significant revenue and profitability goals.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, and execute the AUTO LOB vision, growth strategy, product roadmap, operating plans, and financial plans.
  • Analyze vehicle market trends to forecast objectives and identify and size growth opportunities.
  • Own P&L accountability for the AUTO LOB, partnering with other countries, centers of excellence, and shared services to deliver results across local and enterprise targets.
  • Recommend and manage enterprise investments, operating expenses, and advertising and promotional spend for the LOB.
  • Provide direct oversight of AUTO business performance in Puerto Rico, including client results tracked through StoneEagle metrics.
  • Maintain accountability for the performance of all AUTO products.
  • Expand the business by identifying new opportunities through client engagement, channel partnerships, competitive analysis, and industry research.
  • Apply strong risk management expertise, monitoring trends and recommending changes as needed.
  • Build and develop a high‑performing team, strengthening people capabilities to deliver both short‑ and long‑term objectives.
  • Lead cross‑functional collaboration to scale the business.
  • Coordinate efforts at regional and corporate levels to ensure strategic alignment and effective product deployment.
  • Provide inspirational leadership to the AUTO team, fostering a culture of engagement, growth, accountability, and outperformance

​ Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in general management, business development, and services support.
  • Demonstrated P&L ownership, with accountability for revenue growth and profitability.
  • Strong capability to transfer business knowledge and best practices across teams, geographies, and functions.
  • Proven ability to build, develop, and lead high‑performing leadership teams.
  • Track record of fostering a culture of engagement, growth, accountability, and outperformance.
  • Candidate must reside in or relocate to Puerto Rico.

Other requirements :

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, preferably with a concentration in Finance, Accounting, or Marketing.
  • 10+ years of experience within the automotive ecosystem, including one or more of the following: Automotive OEM, Captive Finance Company, Automotive Third‑Party Administrator, Automotive Retail, Auto Lending, or Insurance.
  • Proven general management and negotiation experience in multi‑country or regional environments.
  • Deep knowledge of the Puerto Rico automotive market, including key players, dynamics, and regulatory considerations.
  • Basic working knowledge of Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance.
  • Fully bilingual (English and Spanish).

The Role at a Glance

The Lead Actuary on the Life Reinsurance team supports Lincoln's traditional and complex reinsurance initiatives across Life Solutions. The role combines Life product expertise with reinsurance structuring and analytics to manage existing inforce arrangements and to execute and implement new reinsurance solutions. The Lead Actuary partners with external reinsurers and internal stakeholders to develop cost-effective reinsurance programs aligned with Lincoln's reinsurance strategy.

What you'll be doing

Life Product Knowledge
•Partner with Pricing and Product Development to understand new product features and product changes and explain their reinsurance implications to reinsurers.
•Connect internal teams with reinsurer expertise on products emerging in the marketplace.


Reinsurance Modeling & Analysis
•Analyze reinsurance structures and retention usage to identify solutions that are cost-effective and consistent with Lincoln's reinsurance strategy.
•Develop and present recommendations to senior management and influence decisions on reinsurance solutions.
•Build and enhance reinsurance reporting and analytics using enterprise tools (Python, SAS, Oracle SQL, Tableau).


Actuarial / Technical Support
•Maintain actuarial models and analytical tools, ensuring accuracy, efficiency and documentation consistent with model governance standards.
•Identify improvement opportunities and develop tools for business relationship managers and other stakeholders.


Reinsurance Relationship Management
•Build and maintain trusted relationships with reinsurance partners on inforce arrangements and new business solutions.
•Respond to reinsurer inquiries and communicate product updates, using product knowledge and an understanding of risk from the reinsurer's perspective.

Collaboration & Leadership
•Serve as the reinsurance subject matter expert for internal stakeholders, helping them assess, select and recommend solutions that meet business goals.
•Lead cross-department reinsurance projects, managing scope, timelines and stakeholder communication.
•Review the work of, and mentor, other actuaries and analysts on the team.

What we're looking for

Must-haves


•5-7+ years of experience in actuarial science directly aligned with the responsibilities above.
•Actuarial credentials (FSA or ASA with additional years of experience)
•Bachelor's degree, or 4+ years of comparable work experience required.
•Proficiency in SAS, SQL, Excel VBA.
•Life product knowledge and reinsurance business knowledge.

Nice-to-haves


•Experience with Python, Tableau, Dataiku and Oracle SQL databases.
•Familiarity with reinsurance-related regulatory, reserving and capital frameworks.

The Role at a Glance

We are looking to add a Portfolio Management Associate Director to the Commercial Mortgage and Real Estate Investments team.


As a senior member of the Portfolio Management team, you will play a meaningful role in managing and overseeing the performance of a $17 billion commercial mortgage loan portfolio. Your primary focus is monitoring loan performance and mitigating risk and limiting loss across the portfolio. The ideal candidate is looking to grow their responsibilities in commercial real estate underwriting and credit analysis.

What you'll be doing

Portfolio Monitoring and Risk Management
•Performs in-depth reviews of property operating statements and identifies positive and/or negative trends.

Stakeholder Collaboration and Reporting

What we're looking for

Must-have experience:
•4 Year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of Bachelor's) – minimum required in Finance, Business Administration, or similar field.

•Knowledge of commercial real estate principles and valuation methods.
•Knowledge of national commercial real estate markets and macro-economic trends that affect those markets.
•Ability to understand and evaluate real estate financial statements including operating statements, balance sheets, and rent rolls.

•Experience with CoStar and Argus preferred.
•Strong attention to detail and ability to clearly and effectively communicate, in writing and verbally, complex loan and property operational concepts to senior management
•Travel 10% (intermittent)
