Endpoint Security Engineer role administering enterprise endpoint protection technologies including CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and BeyondTrust PAM across a global environment. Responsibilities include designing and optimizing endpoint security controls, evaluating new technologies, and automating security processes through scripting and API integrations.

Good fit if you have 3+ years cybersecurity experience, 1+ year with EDR solutions, proficiency in PowerShell or Python, and hands-on experience with incident response.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

We are seeking an Endpoint Security Engineer to join our team to help secure and manage enterprise endpoint protection technologies across a global environment. This role will serve as a key technical resource responsible for administering and enhancing endpoint security platforms including CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and BeyondTrust Privileged Access Management (PAM).

The Endpoint Security Engineer is responsible for the design, administration, optimization, and support of enterprise endpoint security platforms. This role partners closely with Cyber Operations, Infrastructure, Desktop Engineering, and Identity teams to protect endpoints, improve detection capabilities, automate security processes, and strengthen the organization's overall security posture.


The ideal candidate combines strong operational security experience with modern engineering and automation skills. They have hands-on experience with EDR, firewall management, device control, API management, and endpoint security operations, along with a solid understanding of incident response and threat detection. Comfortable administering CrowdStrike and Microsoft security platforms, they leverage scripting, API integrations, GitHub-based workflows, and emerging AI-driven security technologies to automate processes, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen security outcomes. Curious, proactive, and innovative, they continuously seek opportunities to enhance the organization's cyber security capabilities through automation and continuous improvement.

The internal job title for this is role is Security Engineer Senior Consultant II.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and optimize endpoint security controls.
  • Evaluate new endpoint security technologies.
  • Develop security baselines and endpoint hardening standards.
  • Provide technical guidance for endpoint-related security projects.
  • Understand system security vulnerabilities and associated threats, and assess the overall security risks to the system
  • Provide assistance to engineers to implement new security tools to feed our DevOps/SecOps processes, ensuring the solvency of computing resources
  • Participate as an active member of Design & Build IT projects, steering configurations and services towards industry-leading security practices within domain expertise
  • Work alongside Senior Security Engineers/Architects, and assist in Proof of Concepts and implementation of the security solution
  • Assist with security and compliance-based projects involving cloud, operating systems, applications, and database and security issues and requirements
  • Understand DevOps ideologies with the ability to drive and communicate change supporting DevOps/SecOps methodology within the organization
  • Understand software installations, systems monitoring and troubleshooting, account management, and overall efforts to minimize system

Essential Skills:

  • 3 years or more of professional experience in cybersecurity, endpoint security, or security engineering.
  • 1 year or more of professional experience administering Anti-Virus/Endpoint Detection Response solutions.
  • Experience investigating security events and supporting incident response activities.
  • 1 year or more of professional experience with PowerShell, Python, or similar scripting languages.(Or Equivalent)
  • Experience working with APIs and automation workflows.

Desirable Skills:

  • Experience with privileged access management platforms.
  • Familiarity with GitHub and version control best practices.
  • Experience with Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) platforms.
  • Experience with Microsoft Sentinel or other SIEM platforms.
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted security operations or security copilots.

Experience

  • 3 or more years of experience (Preferred)

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

Access Management, CrowdStrike Falcon, Cybersecurity, Endpoint Security, Incident Response, Information Security Engineering, IT Security Operations, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Risk Management, Scripting, Security Operations, Security Platforms, Security Technologies, Security Tools, SIEM Tools, Stakeholder Engagement, Threat Detection

Full-time remote insurance sales representative selling personal lines and property & casualty products to warm leads via phone, chat, and SMS. Base pay $18/hour plus uncapped performance incentives averaging $52,730-$76,480 annually.

Good fit if you have 1+ years sales or customer service experience, can obtain or hold an active insurance producer license, and are comfortable working evenings and weekends from home.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience

About this job

Direct Sales Agent Specialist selling auto, home, and accident and health insurance to local customers in person and by phone. Role involves generating new business, cross-selling, building community relationships, and maintaining a book of business.

Good fit if you have 0-2 years of experience and can obtain P&C licensing within 90 days, or already hold it

Full job description

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making a difference, then apply to join our team today!

As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

  • Achieve sales goals through new business, cross-sell, and retention

  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

What makes Direct Auto Insurance unique?

  • Ability to sell a multitude of industry-leading products through retail stores and phone

Job.JobTitle: Accounting Manager Corporate Benefits and Reporting
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $87,800 to $144,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Saint Paul, MN
  • Education: Bachelor's degree
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off

About this job

Accounting Manager role in Corporate Benefits and Reporting at Travelers Insurance in Saint Paul. Responsibilities include preparing journal entries, account reconciliations, financial analyses for SEC filings, and Department of Labor reports related to equity compensation and fringe benefits.

Good fit if you have three years of accounting or finance experience, a bachelor's degree in accounting or finance, and experience with benefit plan accounting.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$87,800.00 - $144,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Corporate Accounting and Reporting (CAR) is the GAAP and SEC accounting group that creates the Company's quarterly and annual SEC filings, as well as participating in the review of Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) reporting.

Benefits Accounting is the accounting group that is responsible for calculating, tracking, and reporting activity associated with the Company's equity compensation expense and fringe benefits.

This role, as Accounting Manager, Corporate Benefits, is responsible for the preparation of journal entries, account reconciliations, and payment requests. Additionally, this role is responsible for the preparation of schedules used in external reports for SEC filings as well as filings required by the Department of Labor. The position does not manage others but has the opportunity for growth.

What Will You Do?

  • Compile, review, and analyze complex financial data for variance analysis, reporting, and accuracy to interpret and understand trends.
  • Develop and validate financial analyses for key performance metrics.
  • Prepare and create components of overall business and financial plan, budget, and forecasts.
  • Conduct a review for accuracy and completeness and approve internal management based financial reporting, both routine and ad hoc for complete and consistent results with corporate policies and standards.
  • Conduct a review external for financial statements which may include ERISA (Employee Retirement Income Security Act), GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), SEC and STAT (Statutory Accounting Principles).
  • Perform and review financial controls in accordance with Sarbanes-Oxley requirements.
  • Prepare and review complex documentation to support internal and external audits with some interaction with internal auditors.
  • Maintain compliance with various financial external regulatory requirements and internal accounting policies.
  • Participate in projects that involve complex analysis and implementation of non-complex, routine business and financial regulatory changes relating to financial reporting, such as reorganizations, mergers and acquisitions, etc.
  • May provide coaching, training, and mentoring.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, and/or professional designations, such as CPA, CMA or comparable advanced professional education.
  • Experience with accounting for equity-based compensation, preferred.
  • Experience with accounting and reporting for benefit plans, strongly preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to consult on projects and present information effectively.
  • Ability to influence team members and management.
  • Strong data analysis skills with the ability to interpret trends and provide insights and recommendations to business partners.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously and follow through to ensure timely completion.
  • Ability to think strategically and use judgement to resolve issues as they arise.
  • Experience using Microsoft Office (e.g., Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint) and Financial Reporting Software (e.g., TM1, Essbase, Hyperion, etc.).
  • Ability to apply basic accounting and financial concepts to financial systems and processes.

What is a Must Have?

  • Three years of finance, accounting, financial planning, or related experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Job.JobTitle: Auto Claims Desk Adjuster Hybrid - Chandler, AZ
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Launch Your Auto Claims Career with a Fortune 100 Company!

No Claims Experience Needed, Paid Training & Licensing Included!

Location: Chandler AZ
Applicants must live within 50 miles of the office.

  • Minimum 2 in-office days per month
  • Additional in-person training during the first 6 months
  • Start Date: January 11, 2027

Career Opportunity:

Do you thrive in a high-volume, fast-paced environment? Do you enjoy the challenge of a role where no two days are alike? We are looking for positive, high-energy, passionate customer service professionals. Qualities like these cannot be taught, but they can be sharpened, strengthened and appropriately compensated when you join Liberty Mutual Insurance as an Auto Claims Representative.

As a licensed claims adjuster, you will be fulfilling the promise we made to our customers when they purchased their policy by working with those who have been in an auto accident and need our help. In this role, you will guide our insureds and claimants through the auto claims process from start to finish. There are many moving pieces you will manage. You need to have strong organizational skills and be a time management expert, love problem solving and helping others. Your job is speaking to and engaging customers who have just been in an accident and need your help, this is where the passion for service comes into play. We strive to treat our customers as we would want to be treated!

Learn more about this role:A Day in the Life of an Auto-Physical Claims Adjuster

Youd be a great fit if you are:

An Empathetic Service Professional:When a claim is received, you skillfully pick up the phone and use your customer centricity and problem-solving skills to confidently assure our customers that you are there to guide them through the process.

A Front Lines Liaison:You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in delivering on our promise.

A Reliable Teammate:Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules and the varying needs of our customers.

A Customer-Centric Claims Representative:Integrity is in your nature. That means you sincerely care that customers get exactly what they paid for and need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • An engaging, outgoing personality and passion for helping customers
  • Able to think critically, use resources and seek answers when needed in virtual environment
  • Excellent oral, written, decision-making and organizational skills
  • Strong typing and multi-tasking capabilities in a structured paperless work environment
  • Requires strong working knowledge and ability to utilize multiple systems during virtual training and to handle/process claims.
  • General understanding of overall claim operations and key stakeholders.
  • College degree preferred, and/or 1-3 years of related customer service experience or applicable insurance knowledge.
  • Only open to US based employees.

As part of the application process, you'll complete an assessment related to the skills needed for this role please allow approximately 35 minutes, although there is no time limit.

About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role isdeterminedbya number offactors including skills, experience, education,certificationsand location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market andprovidesan opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factorsset forth inthe compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Liberty Mutualisan equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discriminationon the basis ofrace, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal,stateor local law.

Fair Chance Notices

  • California
  • Los Angeles Incorporated
  • Los Angeles Unincorporated
  • Philadelphia
  • San Francisco

Launch Your Auto Claims Career with a Fortune 100 Company!

  • Minimum 2 in-office days per month

Career Opportunity:

Do you thrive in a high-volume, fast-paced environment? Do you enjoy the challenge of a role where no two days are alike? We are looking for positive, high-energy, passionate customer service professionals. Qualities like these cannot be taught, but they can be sharpened, strengthened and appropriately compensated when you join Liberty Mutual Insurance as an Auto Claims Representative.

As a licensed claims adjuster, you will be fulfilling the promise we made to our customers when they purchased their policy by working with those who have been in an auto accident and need our help. In this role, you will guide our insureds and claimants through the auto claims process from start to finish. There are many moving pieces you will manage. You need to have strong organizational skills and be a time management expert, love problem solving and helping others. Your job is speaking to and engaging customers who have just been in an accident and need your help, this is where the passion for service comes into play. We strive to treat our customers as we would want to be treated!

Learn more about this role:A Day in the Life of an Auto-Physical Claims Adjuster

Youd be a great fit if you are:

An Empathetic Service Professional:When a claim is received, you skillfully pick up the phone and use your customer centricity and problem-solving skills to confidently assure our customers that you are there to guide them through the process.

A Front Lines Liaison:You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in delivering on our promise.

A Reliable Teammate:Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules and the varying needs of our customers.

A Customer-Centric Claims Representative:Integrity is in your nature. That means you sincerely care that customers get exactly what they paid for and need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • An engaging, outgoing personality and passion for helping customers
  • Able to think critically, use resources and seek answers when needed in virtual environment
  • Excellent oral, written, decision-making and organizational skills
  • Strong typing and multi-tasking capabilities in a structured paperless work environment
  • Requires strong working knowledge and ability to utilize multiple systems during virtual training and to handle/process claims.
  • General understanding of overall claim operations and key stakeholders.
  • College degree preferred, and/or 1-3 years of related customer service experience or applicable insurance knowledge.
  • Only open to US based employees.

Job.JobTitle: US Retail Markets Claims Specialist Development Program-(January, June 2027)
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Indianapolis, IN
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Liberty Mutual seeks a Claims Specialist to manage, investigate, and resolve insurance claims while serving policyholders. This development program role involves evaluating coverage and liability, negotiating settlements, and identifying fraudulent claims.

Good fit if you have strong written and oral communication skills, analytical and investigative abilities, and hold a bachelor's degree.

Full job description


Description

Advance your career at Liberty Mutual - A Fortune 100 Company!

Manages, investigates and resolves claims assigned and assists in providing service to policyholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Manages, investigates, and resolves claims. Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles claims within prescribed authority levels.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Communicates with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims, refers tasks to auxiliary resources as necessary, and advise as to proper course of action. Responds to various written and telephone inquiries including status reports.
  • Ensures adequacy of reserves.
  • Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Makes effective use of loss management techniques. Negotiates settlements with attorneys, claimants, and/or co-defendants. Arranges for expert inspections involving third party or potential fraud actions as needed.
  • Updates files and provides comprehensive reports as required
Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • Strong written and oral communications skills required.
  • Good interpersonal, analytical, investigative, and negotiation skills required.
  • Customer service experience preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of legal liability, general insurance policy coverage and State Tort Law.
  • Bachelor's degree is required.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chandler, AZ

About this job

Liberty Mutual is hiring a Claims Resolution Specialist to investigate and resolve bodily injury claims with injured parties in Chandler, Arizona. No prior bodily injury experience required; role includes two days per month in office minimum after initial training, with a start date of February 8, 2027.

Good fit if you have strong communication and interpersonal skills, a growth mindset, and can obtain insurance licensing as required.

Full job description


Description

Advance your career with our Personal Lines Casualty Team!

No bodily injury claims experience required!

Take the next step in your development with meaningful work and clear growth path.

The Bodily Injury Claims Specialist will investigate, manage and resolve Bodily Injury claims assigned directly with injured parties, as well as assist in providing service to policyholders.

All qualified applicants will reside within a 50-mile radius of the Chandleroffice.

The start date for the role is February 8, 2027.

There may be several in-office days per month for the first few months following initial virtual training to support your learning and to build relationships with leaders and others in the department. This position requires a minimum of two days in office per month as the standard beyond the training period, with occasional additional days for special meetings a few times a year.

Training is a critical component to your success and that success starts with reliable attendance. Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory.


In a high performing culture,WEin PL Core:

  • Strive to be better tomorrow than today; little improvements lead to big ones!
  • Embrace change.We may need to let go of what's familiar in order to embrace and try something new.
  • Understandhow our individual work contributes to our teams, our organizations and the company
  • Are adaptable and resilient. Change is imperative to being better tomorrow and resiliency allows us to handle unexpected challenges
  • Are an exporter of Talent.We maintain a focus on development and growth.
  • Contribute positively; We come to work every day with the intent to make a positive impact on our work and on everyone around us. One positive interaction with you can turn someone's day around.

Responsibilities:

  • Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles Bodily Injury claims directly with injured parties, within prescribed authority levels.
  • Pursues proactive contact with injured parties through various creative means to connect, listen, empathize and make early settlement offers whenever appropriate to resolve injury claims.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Communicates with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims; refers tasks to auxiliary resources as necessary and advises as to proper course of action. Sends and responds to various written, telephone and SMS text inquiries to pursue resolution of the claim.
  • Ensures adequacy of reserves.
  • Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Makes effective use of loss management tools and techniques to ensure accuracy in decision making.
  • Keeps files updated with clear documentation for ease in understanding the status of investigations, evaluations and negotiations throughout the claim life cycle.
Qualifications
  • Strong written and oral communication skills required.
  • Good interpersonal, analytical, investigative, and negotiation skills required.
  • Customer service experience preferred.
  • Growth mindset; adapts well to change including new standard work and new tools
  • Basic knowledge of legal liability, general insurance policy coverage and State Tort Law preferred.
  • Liability experience or policy and claims knowledge preferred.
  • Bachelors degree preferred.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.

As part of the application process, you'll complete an assessment related to the skills needed for this role please allow approximately 35 minutes, although there is no time limit.

Associate Attorney representing Liberty Mutual and policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation and workers' compensation matters involving claims for monetary damages or personal injury and property damage. Role is primarily remote in New Jersey with required in-person appearances.

Good fit if you have a New Jersey bar license, knowledge of insurance law, and can manage litigation cases from inception through resolution.

Full job description


Description

This role is primarily remote in the state of New Jersey except for required appearances.

At Liberty Mutual, were committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders rights and positively impacting our business. As an Associate Attorney at Liberty Mutual, youll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligibleperformance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If yourelooking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where youll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual Insurance offers an engaging opportunity for an Associate Attorney to represent the company and its policyholders in routine civil litigation and workers' compensation matters involving moderately complex legal issues and claims for monetary damages or compensation related to personal injury or property damage. Under moderate supervision, you will manage cases from inception through resolution, applying your legal knowledge, research skills, and client relationship capabilities in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Execution: Manage all phases of litigation, including discovery, hearings, trials, mediations, and drafting legal documents such as pleadings and motions. Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide clear and reasoned legal opinions and strategic advice to Claims Representatives and insured clients. Develop and maintain strong client relationships through transparent and effective communication.
  • Technology Utilization: Utilize e-discovery and case management technologies to streamline legal processes, improve efficiency, and reduce operational costs. Demonstrate effective coordination with remote team members and proficiency in remote work settings.
  • Risk Evaluation and Case Resolution Facilitation: Identify, evaluate, and collaborate on strategies to mitigate legal risks, working closely with clients and senior counsel to facilitate effective resolutions.
  • Documentation Accuracy and Compliance: Ensure all legal documents, pleadings, and motions are meticulously prepared, accurate, and compliant with applicable standards and client expectations.
  • Timely Client Communication: Provide clear, consistent, and timely updates and recommendations to insured clients and claims professionals to maintain alignment with case objectives.
  • Contribution to Organizational Improvement: Participate in initiatives aimed at enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and best practices within Staff Legal and Global Legal & Compliance organizations.
  • Ethical Compliance Adherence: Uphold the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance, following legal regulations and licensing requirements and promoting a culture of integrity within the legal team.
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in New Jersey and in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • General knowledge of insurance law, and as necessary, workers compensation and/or No Fault law.
  • Proficient in e-discovery, case management systems, and basic legal analysis tools.
  • Strong analytical, research, and legal writing skills.
  • Basic knowledge of negotiation techniques including preparation, active listening, and problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cases from start to finish under supervision.
  • Effective communication and persuasion skills, both written and oral.
  • Ability to collaborate with clients, claims professionals, and senior attorneys.
  • Organized, process-oriented with strong time management skills.

Job.JobDescription:
Description

Ready to grow your career in a role that makes a meaningful impact? Liberty Mutual is hiring Workers' Compensation Claims Specialists in our Northeast Region to help injured workers navigate the claims process and return to work with confidence.

Were hiring across multiple levelsAssociate Claims Specialist, Claims Specialist I, and Claims Specialist IIdepending on your experience. The salary range posted reflects the varying pay scale across various locations.

In this role, youll manage a caseload of routine to moderately complex claims, making key decisions on compensability, evaluating losses, and negotiating fair outcomes. Youll collaborate closely with claimants, policyholders, attorneys, and partners throughout the claim lifecycle.

Training is a critical component of your success, and that success starts with reliable attendance and active engagement.Training will include 1 week of travel to our Plano, TX office in January.


This role is remote within the Northeast region. Candidates must reside in Connecticut, Delaware, Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, or Vermont.Candidates residing within 50 miles of our offices in Weatogue, Connecticut, or Westborough, Massachusetts, will be expected to work onsite up to two days per month.On-site expectations may evolve based on business needs.

Responsibilities

  • Manages an inventory of claims to evaluate compensability/liability.
  • Establishes action plans based on case facts, best practices, protocols, regulatory issues, and available resources.
  • Plans and conducts investigations of claims to confirm coverage and to determine liability, compensability, and damages.
  • Assesses policy coverage for submitted claims and notifies the insured of any issues; determines and establishes reserve requirements, adjusting reserves as necessary, during the processing of the claims, and refers claims to the subrogation group or Special Investigations Unit as appropriate.
  • Assesses actual damages associated with claims and conducts negotiations, within assigned authority limits, to settle claims.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
  • Effective interpersonal, analytical and negotiation abilities required
  • Ability to provide information in a clear, concise manner with an appropriate level of detail
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain effective relationships
  • Demonstrated success in a professional environment; success in a customer service/retail environment preferred
  • Effective analytical skills to gather information, analyze facts, and draw conclusions; as normally acquired through a bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Knowledge of legal liability, insurance coverage and medical terminology helpful, but not mandatory
  • Licensing may be required in some states

As part of the application process, you'll complete an assessment related to the skills needed for this role please allow approximately 35 minutes, although there is no time limit

About this job

Investigate and resolve bodily injury insurance claims directly with injured parties and policyholders. No prior bodily injury claims experience required; position based in Indianapolis with minimum two days in office per month after initial training.

Good fit if you have strong communication and interpersonal skills, can adapt to change, and prefer customer service or liability claims work.

Full job description


Description

Advance your career with our Personal Lines Casualty Team!

No bodily injury claims experience required!

Take the next step in your development with meaningful work and clear growth path.

The Bodily Injury Claims Specialist will investigate, manage and resolve Bodily Injury claims assigned directly with injured parties, as well as assist in providing service to policyholders.

All qualified applicants will reside within a 50-mile radius of the Indianapolis / Lake Mary / Suwanee office.

The start date for the role is February 8, 2027.

There may be several in-office days per month for the first few months following initial virtual training to support your learning and to build relationships with leaders and others in the department. This position requires a minimum of two days in office per month as the standard beyond the training period, with occasional additional days for special meetings a few times a year.

Training is a critical component to your success and that success starts with reliable attendance. Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory.


In a high performing culture,WEin PL Core:

  • Strive to be better tomorrow than today; little improvements lead to big ones!
  • Embrace change.We may need to let go of what's familiar in order to embrace and try something new.
  • Understandhow our individual work contributes to our teams, our organizations and the company
  • Are adaptable and resilient. Change is imperative to being better tomorrow and resiliency allows us to handle unexpected challenges
  • Are an exporter of Talent.We maintain a focus on development and growth.
  • Contribute positively; We come to work every day with the intent to make a positive impact on our work and on everyone around us. One positive interaction with you can turn someone's day around.

Responsibilities:

  • Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles Bodily Injury claims directly with injured parties, within prescribed authority levels.
  • Pursues proactive contact with injured parties through various creative means to connect, listen, empathize and make early settlement offers whenever appropriate to resolve injury claims.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Communicates with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims; refers tasks to auxiliary resources as necessary and advises as to proper course of action. Sends and responds to various written, telephone and SMS text inquiries to pursue resolution of the claim.
  • Ensures adequacy of reserves.
  • Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Makes effective use of loss management tools and techniques to ensure accuracy in decision making.
  • Keeps files updated with clear documentation for ease in understanding the status of investigations, evaluations and negotiations throughout the claim life cycle.
Qualifications
  • Strong written and oral communication skills required.
  • Good interpersonal, analytical, investigative, and negotiation skills required.
  • Customer service experience preferred.
  • Growth mindset; adapts well to change including new standard work and new tools
  • Basic knowledge of legal liability, general insurance policy coverage and State Tort Law preferred.
  • Liability experience or policy and claims knowledge preferred.
  • Bachelors degree preferred.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.

As part of the application process, you'll complete an assessment related to the skills needed for this role please allow approximately 35 minutes, although there is no time limit.

About this job

Senior Technical Claims Specialist managing complex environmental, pollution, and toxic tort claims for Liberty Mutual's Commercial Specialty Lines. Role includes full claim lifecycle ownership from coverage analysis through litigation management and settlement.

Good fit if you have 5-7 years commercial casualty claims experience including environmental or pollution claims and mass litigation or toxic tort background.

Full job description


Description

Join a Growing Team and Tackle Some of the Industry's Most Complex Environmental Claims

Liberty Mutual is expanding our Environmental Claims team and seeking an experienced Environmental Claims Professional to manage high-exposure environmental, pollution, toxic tort, and mass litigation claims within our Commercial Specialty Lines portfolio! This is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned claims professional who thrives in complex coverage and liability analysis, enjoys collaborating with legal and industry experts, and is looking to make a meaningful impact at a Fortune 100 carrier known for its financial strength, innovation, and commitment to customer advocacy. In this role of Senior Technical Claims Specialist, you will exercise significant judgment and ownership throughout the entire claim lifecycle, from coverage analysis and investigation through litigation management, negotiation, and resolution. You'll partner closely with policyholders, brokers, reinsurers, underwriting, and defense counsel while helping shape outcomes on some of our most challenging and technically sophisticated claims.

Why this role

Youll own complex environmental casualty claims from first notice through resolution, with real authority to decide coverage, set reserves, negotiate, and settle. This is not a hand-off role. Youll make the calls, direct the strategy, and be recognized internally as a subject matter expert on pollution and specialty coverage issues.

What youll do

  • Own the claim end to end. Determine coverage, investigate, assess liability, set and adjust reserves, evaluate exposure, negotiate settlements, and authorize payment. Youll also have the authority to deny claims when the facts and policy language support it.
  • Drive litigation strategy. Review pleadings, claim files, and investigation materials, then set the plan to resolve each suit, including coverage positions, amounts owed, discovery plans, and negotiation approach.
  • Build the right team for each matter. Based on the allegations, assemble the working group of Home Office Legal, defense counsel, and Home Office Claims, and bring in technical resources such as environmental consultants where needed.
  • Manage outside counsel. Oversee defense counsels strategy, practices, and billing so spend stays aligned with outcomes.
  • Protect the claim and the data. Maintain the integrity of financial processing and the security of confidential information in claim files.
  • Mentor and partner. Coach colleagues and serve as the claims liaison to Underwriting, Reinsurance, and other business partners.
  • Stay ahead of the law. Track legislation, court decisions, and trends affecting pollution and other specialty coverages, and advise Claims Management on any impact to claims policies and procedures.
  • Contribute beyond your desk. Participate in special projects that shape how the team works.

What we offer

  • Meaningful settlement authority and ownership of your files
  • Complex, high-impact work with direct access to Legal, Underwriting, and Reinsurance
  • Opportunities to mentor others and grow into subject matter expert or leadership roles
  • Flexible work arrangements. Liberty Mutual follows hybrid work arrangements and team members within a 50-mile radius of one of our hub offices (Westborough, MA; Boston, MA; Weatogue, CT; Suwanee, GA; Plano, TX; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Chandler, AZ) are expected to work from the office approximately two times per month. We will also consider highly qualified remote candidates who do not reside near a hub location.
Qualifications

What you bring

Required

  • 5-7 years of commercial casualty claims experience, including environmental or pollution claims handling
  • Proven ability to handle complex, litigated matters independently, including coverage analysis, reserving, and settlement negotiation
  • Strong command of environmental coverage issues, such as pollution legal liability, CGL pollution exclusions, and third-party bodily injury and property damage from contamination
  • Experience managing defense counsel and consultants
  • Excellent analytical, negotiation, and communication skills
  • Advanced Environmental Claims and/or Pollution Claims experience preferred
  • Experience with mass litigation and/or toxic tort required
  • Ability to obtain/maintain All-Lines Adjuster License

Nice to have

  • Experience with Superfund/CERCLA, remediation oversight, or environmental site claims
  • Background in law, environmental science, engineering, or a related field, or a professional designation (e.g., CPCU, AIC)
  • Experience handling construction defect, toxic tort, or other complex specialty lines

The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role.   • Mentor and partner. Coach colleagues and serve as the claims liaison to Underwriting, Reinsurance, and other business partners.
  • Stay ahead of the law. Track legislation, court decisions, and trends affecting pollution and other specialty coverages, and advise Claims Management on any impact to claims policies and procedures.
  • Contribute beyond your desk. Participate in special projects that shape how the team works.

What we offer

  • Meaningful settlement authority and ownership of your files
  • Complex, high-impact work with direct access to Legal, Underwriting, and Reinsurance
  • Opportunities to mentor others and grow into subject matter expert or leadership roles
  • Flexible work arrangements. Liberty Mutual follows hybrid work arrangements and team members within a 50-mile radius of one of our hub offices (Westborough, MA; Boston, MA; Weatogue, CT; Suwanee, GA; Plano, TX; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Chandler, AZ) are expected to work from the office approximately two times per month. We will also consider highly qualified remote candidates who do not reside near a hub location.
Qualifications

What you bring

Required

  • 5-7 years of commercial casualty claims experience, including environmental or pollution claims handling
  • Proven ability to handle complex, litigated matters independently, including coverage analysis, reserving, and settlement negotiation
  • Strong command of environmental coverage issues, such as pollution legal liability, CGL pollution exclusions, and third-party bodily injury and property damage from contamination
  • Experience managing defense counsel and consultants
  • Excellent analytical, negotiation, and communication skills
  • Advanced Environmental Claims and/or Pollution Claims experience preferred
  • Experience with mass litigation and/or toxic tort required
  • Ability to obtain/maintain All-Lines Adjuster License

Nice to have

  • Experience with Superfund/CERCLA, remediation oversight, or environmental site claims
  • Background in law, environmental science, engineering, or a related field, or a professional designation (e.g., CPCU, AIC)
  • Experience handling construction defect, toxic tort, or other complex specialty lines

Job.JobTitle: Senior Underwriter, Contractors Environmental & Professional Liability
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Philadelphia, PA
  • Experience: 3 to 5 years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Senior Underwriter role in Liberty Mutual's Environmental Construction Unit underwriting contractors pollution and professional liability policies. Responsibilities include reviewing submissions, analyzing exposures, pricing risk, managing broker relationships, and developing profitable business within underwriting authority.

Good fit if you have 3-5 years of contractors pollution or professional liability underwriting or brokerage experience and strong analytical skills.

Full job description


Description

Join a dynamic, collaborative team focused on helping contractors manage some of their most complex environmental and professional liability risks. In this role, youll evaluate unique exposures, develop thoughtful insurance solutions, and work closely with brokers, clients, claims partners, and internal stakeholders to deliver meaningful value. This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise with commercial judgment. Youll review submissions, analyze operations and contracts, assess pollution and professional liability exposures, evaluate loss history, and structure terms that support both customer needs and a strong, sustainable portfolio. Because every account is different, the work is varied and requires curiosity, creativity, and a willingness to think beyond standard solutions. Youll have the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals, contribute to important decisions, build trusted relationships while maintaining a strong focus on technical excellence and customer service.

The Environmental Division of Liberty Mutual is seeking a Sr. Underwriter to produce and maintain a profitable book of Contractors Environmental Legal Liability (CELL) and Designers & Contractors Professional Liability (DCPL) business in our Environmental Construction Unit (ECU). Responsibilities would include underwriting contractor pollution and professional policies within underwriting authority with limited guidance from leadership. As well as make decisions on whether to underwrite business by making analytical, data-driven decisions based on data and information provided, including pricing the risk.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leverage market presence and knowledge to develop and underwrite profitable business.
  • Handle a substantial environmental pollution book of business.
  • Gather underwriting information, review, analyze, price and document, new and assigned renewal Contractors Pollution Liability and combined form Pollution / Professional business subject to established Underwriting Guidelines.
  • Prepare quotes and binders and review policies and endorsements for accuracy.
  • Manage portfolio of brokers/agents and clients.
  • Develop and support marketing strategies to increase submission flow (will require limited travel)
  • Provide exceptional service to brokers by following workflow procedures on new and renewal business in order to achieve production goals and service goals (policy issuance and file documentation).
  • Drive new business submission and premium growth through strategic sales and marketing efforts with our broker partners and internal cross-sell initiatives with other profit centers

Qualifications
  • Bachelors degree required; environmental science or similar degree preferred
  • 3-5 years of Contractors Pollution Liability and combined form Pollution / Professional Liability underwriting experience with an environmental insurance company, or 3-5 years of brokerage experience placing Contractors Pollution Liability and combined form Pollution / Professional Liability policies.
  • Excellent analytical and quantitative skills.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Initiative and ability to work independently.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across teams, stakeholders, and partners.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Plano, TX
  • Benefits: 401(k), tuition assistance

About this job

Liberty Mutual's Claims Specialist Program develops entry-level professionals to investigate claims, review evidence, and resolve cases. The program includes comprehensive training, one-on-one mentoring, and a pay-for-performance structure at a Fortune 100 company.

Good fit if you have 0-2 years of professional experience, strong analytical and negotiation skills, and permanent work authorization in the US.

Full job description


Description

Claims Specialist Program


Are you looking to help people and make a difference in the world? Have you considered a position in the fast-paced, rewarding world of insurance? Yes, insurance!

Insurance brings peace of mind to almost everything we do in our livesfrom family trips to your first car to weddings and college graduations. As a valued member of our claims team, youll help our customers get back on their feet and restore their lives when catastrophe strikes.


The details

Whenyoure part of the Claims Specialist Program, youll acquire various investigative techniques and work with experts to determine what caused an accident and who is at fault.

Youll independently manage an inventory of claims, which may include conducting investigations, reviewing medical records, and evaluating damages to determine the severity of each case. Youllresolve cases by working with individuals or attorneys to settle on the value of each case.

You will have required comprehensive training, one-on-one mentoring, and a strong pay-for-performance compensation structure at a global Fortune 100 company. Make a difference in the world with Liberty Mutual.

Qualifications

What youve got

  • You have 0-2 years of professional experience.

  • A strong academic record with a cumulative 3.0 GPA preferred

  • You have an aptitude for providing information in a clear, concise manner with an appropriate level of detail, empathy, and professionalism.
  • You possess strong negotiation and analytical skills.
  • You are detail-oriented and thrive in a fast-paced work environment.
  • You must have permanent work authorization in the United States.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensationpackage
  • Pension and 401(k) savings plans
  • Comprehensive health and wellness plans
  • Dental, Vision, and Disability insurance
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Individualized career mobility and development plans
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Paid leave; maternity and paternity leaves
  • Commuter benefits, employee discounts, and more

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Sterling Heights, MI
  • Experience: 1+ year

About this job

Field Property Claims Adjuster for Liberty Mutual in Sterling Heights, Michigan. You will investigate property damage claims, meet customers on-site, prepare repair estimates, and manage claims from initial report to closure. Travel locally within assigned territory. Comprehensive 5-month training program provided.

Good fit if you have at least 1 year of claims handling experience, strong customer service skills, knowledge of building construction, and can live near Sterling Heights.

Full job description


Description

Join us as a Field Property Claims Adjuster where youll be responsible for helping our customers navigate the claims process and get back on their feet following damage to the homeowners property. This is a role where people who love every day to be new, different and exciting, can thrive youll be traveling on the road to meet customers in person, providing hands-on assessment of damage and empathetic support.

The Field Property Claims Adjuster will be traveling locally to insured homes within Sterling Heights, MI (48310) and surrounding areas. To be successful within the role, candidates should live within or near this area.

Sign-On Bonus Available! Were offering a sign-on bonus for experienced and actively licensed new hires.

What youll do

  • Investigate and evaluate onsite to resolve complex coverage and damage issues to include preparing complete estimates of repair for the covered damages. This may include accessing roofs by ladder, inspecting attics, crawl spaces and basements in search of damage.
  • Handle moderate to complex claims independently while managing your workload, from first notice of loss to final closure.
  • Be expected to work in a vehicle in the field daily while occasionally handling assignments from the desk.
  • Explain coverage of loss, assist policyholders with itemization of damages, emergency repairs and additional living arrangements.
  • Work with and coordinate a few vendor services such as contractors, emergency repair, cleaning services and various replacement services.
  • May be called upon for catastrophe duty.

Position details

  • Territory-based work:Most workdays will be spent in the field within your assigned local territory, giving you the opportunity to work directly with customers and gain hands-on experience.

  • Training & support:To set you up for success, youll participate in a comprehensive 5-month training program, which includes:
    • Primarily virtual and on-the-job learning.
    • Two short in-person training sessions (Weeks 4 and 7) at our Lewisville, TX office.
    • Limited overnight travel for training and team meetings (typically less than 10%).

  • Mileage Reimbursement:This role offers mileage reimbursement. You may qualify for a company-provided vehicle once mileage requirements are met. Additional details will be provided if you advance in the selection process.
Qualifications
  • Working knowledge of claims handling procedures and operations.
  • Proven ability to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Effective negotiation skills.
  • Ability to effectively and independently manage workload while exhibiting good judgment.
  • Strong written/oral communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Computer skills with the ability to work with multi-faceted systems.
  • The capabilities, skills and knowledge required through a bachelors degree or equivalent experience and at least 1 year of directly related experience.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.
  • The ability to handle multiple competing priorities and organize your day.
  • Strong time management and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated understanding of building construction principles.

About this job

Manager role in Tech & Ops Finance managing sourcing strategy, supplier relationships, and work order processes across assigned business lines. Responsibilities include vendor management, resource onboarding, risk monitoring, stakeholder engagement, and process optimization for Travelers' global sourcing portfolio.

Good fit if you have experience in sourcing, vendor management, supplier performance tracking, and cross-functional stakeholder coordination.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$101,600.00 - $167,600.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Member of the Sourcing and Supplier Management team within Tech & Ops Finance responsible for enterprise-wide sourcing and supplier strategies, governance, performance management, risk and operational processes for Travelers' global sourcing and supplier relationships.

As a Manager, Sourcing Strategy, Management and Governance, you will play a critical role in executing work order processes across assigned business lines and area-specific strategic sourcing strategies, including sourcing model design, supplier selection, and alignment of suppliers to business needs across our professional services and outsourcing partner portfolio. You will serve as a key point of contact on execution of sourcing strategy, workforce demand, and supplier performance across assigned lines, partnering closely with business stakeholders to track activity, resolve issues, and identify opportunities to improve how the team operates. This position does not manage others.

What Will You Do?

  • Work Order/Vendor Management and Sourcing Strategy: Manage a defined set of supplier work orders or portfolio activities across multiple assigned lines, including intake, modifications, closures, data-driven analysis, and process and tool optimization. Serve as a proactive sourcing advisor to LOB stakeholders, providing counsel on sourcing model selection, supplier performance, and workforce demand planning. Apply enterprise sourcing models and rate card structures to work being requested, advising stakeholders on right model, right supplier, right rate.*      
  • Onboarding and Team Support: Oversee resource onboarding and monitor engaged resources for quality, progress, and team dynamics. Own resource onboarding end-to-end, including understanding the skills required for the work being engaged, validating skill requirements with LOB stakeholders, and driving Technical Assessments. Cultivate ongoing, trusted relationships with the owners of the work, including engagement managers and LOB stakeholders, staying close enough to the business to anticipate needs, flag risks early, and bring forward solutions before issues escalate. Partner with Circle Leads on resource and team alignment needs.     
  • Proactivity and Risk Management: Monitor assigned vendor performance data and flag early indicators of risk or control gaps, addressing delivery issues as they arise and escalating when appropriate. Analyze work order data, supplier capability changes, and sourcing market conditions to identify business continuity risks, surface insights, and deliver proactive recommendations to leadership. Maintain deep understanding of assigned business lines to anticipate workforce needs, monitor internal demands, and inform sourcing strategy.    
  • Internal and External Stakeholder Engagement: Build and sustain trusted relationships with business stakeholders, finance partners, and assigned supplier contacts to surface risks, resolve delivery concerns and budget variances, and support governance interactions, performance discussions, and sourcing process coordination. Provide data and updates supporting ELT visibility for assigned lines on execution of sourcing strategy, workforce demand, and supplier performance.      
  • Work Transition and Migration: Own the operational execution of work transitions when sourcing decisions result in a change of supplier, sourcing model, or workforce composition. This includes coordinating the migration of work from internal resources to external suppliers, managing supplier transitions, supporting onboarding of new supplier teams, and ensuring continuity of delivery throughout the transition period. Partner closely with LOB stakeholders, DFRs, and the S&SM Strategy team to sequence and execute transitions in alignment with enterprise sourcing strategy and workforce plans.      
  • Process Optimization: Identify and implement process improvements and automation opportunities, including AI-enabled workflow enhancements. Optimize like work across assigned lines, standardizing repeatable processes, eliminating redundancy, and driving consistency across the Sourcing Delivery and Execution team. Champion the use of Travelers' AI tooling to streamline reporting, automate recurring workflows, and improve the quality and speed of work.      
  • Rate Card Adherence: Ensure compliance with established enterprise sourcing models and rate card structures. Partner with the S&SM Strategy team to validate that work being requested aligns to the appropriate rate card, role designation, and sourcing model, and assist stakeholders in understanding and adhering to rate card guidelines.
  • Track and report on sourcing footprint, role utilization, team composition, and premium role usage across assigned lines. 
  • Manage sourcing activity across multiple assigned lines or areas. Bring cross-line perspective to sourcing decisions, identify patterns and efficiencies across the portfolio, and ensure consistent application of enterprise sourcing strategy regardless of line-specific variation. 
  • Monitor work order alignment to budget; proactively flag variances and partner with DFRs to resolve. 
  • Contribute to the preparation of Business Review materials and Monthly Operating Review (MOR) data for assigned lines, supporting leadership visibility into supplier performance, workforce trends, and sourcing activity across the portfolio. 
  • Partner cross-functionally with LOB stakeholders, DFRs, and Procurement to support sourcing and contracting activity, ensure alignment on budget and resource plans, and facilitate resolution of issues that span organizational boundaries. 
  • Engage with and learn Travelers' AI tooling, applying these capabilities to improve the speed and quality of recurring work such as reporting, data analysis, and workflow management. 

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience required.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in sourcing, workforce strategy, supplier management, or a related field.
  • Experience with Fieldglass, ACS, and workforce planning tools strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting or managing work transitions, supplier migrations, or sourcing model changes preferred.
  • Familiarity with rate card structures, role modernization concepts, and supplier performance principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with senior LOB or technology leaders.
  • Experience identifying and implementing process improvements or automation opportunities.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered tools and large language models (e.g., Claude); demonstrated ability or willingness to integrate AI capabilities into day-to-day work processes preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, including Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Strong working knowledge of sourcing models: managed services, staff augmentation, GSO, POD/catalog models, and rate card structures.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, ambiguous situations and drive to resolution with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate sourcing data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable recommendations for business partners.
  • Process improvement and automation orientation, with experience identifying and implementing operational efficiencies.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, comfortable engaging with senior LOB leaders and building trusted advisor relationships.
  • Demonstrated initiative in identifying and adopting tools, technology, and process improvements that increase team efficiency and output quality, including AI-enabled solutions.
  • Demonstrated proficiency or willingness to actively develop proficiency with AI-powered tools, including large language models such as Claude; ability to apply these tools to sourcing workflows, reporting, and operational tasks to improve efficiency and output quality.
  • Ability to operate effectively through change and ambiguity, adapting approaches as the function evolves.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present information clearly to stakeholders at all levels.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and in a team environment.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, multiple workstreams, and deadlines simultaneously in a fast-moving environment.

What is a Must Have?

  • Four years of finance, financial planning, accounting, or related experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

What Is the Opportunity?

LOCATION REQUIREMENT: This field position services Insureds/Agents in the Pittsburgh, PA area. The selected candidate must reside in the assigned territory.
*You will be issued a company vehicle for this position.*

As a Claim Rep, General Liability, you will be responsible for managing and investigating low to moderate complexity injury and/or property damage claims including customer contact, in-person inspections, determining coverage, evaluating liability, assessing damages, establishing timely reserves, and issue timely and accurate payments. In this fast-paced, detail-oriented and customer-facing role, you will work closely with customers, claimants, attorneys, and other parties to ensure claims are resolved accurately and efficiently while maintaining a high level of professionalism, empathy, and service. Typically, this role services specialty accounts. You may provide training and coaching to less experienced claim professionals. This position is based remotely with work at residential and/or commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage an active caseload of injury and/or property damage claims from first notice of loss through resolution. Typically, handles low to moderately complex liability claims which may include coverage disputes and contractual indemnity issues. Typically, this role will service commercial specialty accounts.
  • Gather and thoroughly investigate information by contacting all relevant parties to determine coverage, evaluate liability exposure, assess bodily injury and/or property damage, and establish appropriate reserves in accordance with policy terms and management guidance. Leverage internal resources, as appropriate.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, opposing counsel, third-party vendors, internal stakeholders, and other parties.
  • Negotiate with multiple constituents (e.g., claimants, attorneys, representatives) and convey claim settlements within authority and issue payments timely and accurately.
  • May handle low complexity litigation.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers' requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Two years of property damage, bodily injury, or liability claim experience.
  • Active adjuster license, where required by state law.
  • Experience with claims management systems, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally to multiple stakeholders.
  • Ability to analyze situations, exercise sound judgement, make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers; ability to manage difficult conversations with empathy and professionalism.

  • Proven conflict resolution and negotiation skills; ability to handle complex or disputed claims and negotiate settlements.

Target Openings
