What Is the Opportunity?

LOCATION REQUIREMENT: This field position services Insureds/Agents in the Allegheny County/Pittsburgh, PA area. The selected candidate must reside in the assigned territory.
*You will be issued a company vehicle for this position.*

As an Associate Claim Rep, Outside Property, you will receive comprehensive training in claim handling, customer service, and policy interpretation while working alongside experienced claim professionals. This position focuses on developing your skills and knowledge to successfully manage 1st party property claims. This program is typically 9-12 months and upon successful completion of this program you will have the skills needed to handle claims independently and progress toward full claims handling responsibility. This position is based remotely with work at residential and commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

What Will You Do?

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.
  • Review, investigate, and document 1st party property claims under direct supervision.
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, witnesses, and third-party providers.
  • Learn to investigate and evaluate all relevant facts and information (including but not limited to analyzing leases, contracts, by-laws and other relevant documents which may have an impact). Determine and apply coverage for building damages per policy terms.
  • Establish accurate scope of damages for building and contents losses and utilizes as a basis for written estimates and/or computer assisted estimates.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, claimants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning, particularly in AI and digital transformation.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) and/or a UAS Remote Pilot Certification to comply with federal, state, and Travelers requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Assess and inspect all areas of a dwelling or structure, including roofs, attics, crawl spaces, and other confined areas. Ability to carry, set up, and climb ladders weighing approximately 38-49 pounds.
  • May require extensive travel, including overnight stays, to support customers across multiple locations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Previous internship or work experience in customer service or insurance.
  • Willingness to obtain an active adjuster license where required by state law.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); willingness to learn claims management and estimating software.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions within established authority.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for insureds and claimants.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills; willingness to learn techniques for facilitating productive discussions and negotiations.

Position Summary

With limited supervision, translates near-term and long-term business needs of moderate to high complexity into (technical) initiative solution options across multiple portfolios. Provides enterprise-level context to the architecture team to enable team members to focus, mature domains, and create future-state architectures. Provides leadership visibility on complex initiatives by facilitating discussions, leading conceptual and high level design sessions, capturing the results in artifacts, and ensuring the architectural design is realized through delivery for multiple enterprise stakeholders.


What You'll Do

As a Senior Solutions Architect – Data, you'll play a key role in shaping ERIE's enterprise data strategy. You'll design and implement scalable, modern data architectures that ensure accuracy, consistency, and accessibility across the organization. You'll collaborate closely with data engineering, analytics, and business partners to align data initiatives with enterprise goals and deliver trusted, high-quality data solutions that power decision-making.

Your expertise will guide the design and integration of enterprise data systems—connecting traditional on-premises environments with modern, cloud-based ecosystems that support ERIE.


Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing enterprise data architectures that promote data quality and consistency.
  • Proficiency with Master Data Management (MDM) tools such as Informatica MDM, Reltio, SAP MDG, or IBM InfoSphere.
  • Strong understanding of data integration, governance, metadata management, and data stewardship principles.
  • Experience with data modeling, APIs, ETL design, and modern cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, or similar).
  • Proven ability to collaborate across disciplines to define strategy and deliver scalable data solutions.
  • Familiarity with AWS services such as S3, Glue, or Redshift is a plus.


What Makes You Stand Out

You're a strategic thinker with a builder's mindset. You connect architecture vision with practical delivery—creating data systems that drive measurable business value. You balance innovation and structure, ensuring ERIE's data assets are both trusted and transformative.

You stand out because you:

  • Combine deep MDM expertise with practical cloud architecture experience.
  • Have a track record of integrating on-premises and cloud data environments.
  • Foster strong partnerships between IT and business, translating data strategy into real outcomes.
  • Bring curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset to every challenge.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serves as the single point of accountability for architecture function to portfolio owner customers and technology leadership.
  • Provides architectural guidance on initiatives of moderate to high complexity across multiple enterprise portfolios, while managing multiple customers with differing priorities on the organization's most strategic initiatives.
  • Provides full-stack architectural options that enable business objectives while ensuring long-term technology goals for all aspects of a solution.
  • Collaborates with team members for technical validation during design and planning phases.
  • Informs aspects of portfolio maturity regarding technology and ability to achieve target technology alignment, while facilitating a minimum viable architecture.
  • Monitors large-scale project execution and considers and interprets architectural tradeoffs occurring during delivery. Escalates for appropriate context sharing and decision making, as necessary.
  • Proactively enables portfolio owners to see technical debt clearly, provides appropriate context to inform plans to achieve elimination of technical debt in a comprehensive plan across multiple portfolios, delivery teams, programs, or projects.
  • Serves as a mentor for other members of the team, builds an environment for analysts, engineers, architects, and other technology leaders to grow and have high impact.
  • Directs and drives closure on investment decisions within the enterprise while also identifying cross-portfolio impacts on significant delivery initiatives.
  • Serves as a subject matter expert for multiple portfolios, providing actionable recommendations via consultation services, adapted to stakeholder context, to technology leadership and organizational stakeholders.
  • Collaborates with architects, portfolio owners, and other job families to achieve an enterprise view; provides project and program level views to project and program teams in context of enterprise strategies and directions with light supervision.
  • Supports business agility through agile engagement across multiple delivery operations.
  • Interprets business needs, assesses solution choices, applies technology, and provides project guidance within a long-term enterprise lens.

Responsibilities

The Litigation Specialist's job function includes efficiently and effectively handling advanced-level, primarily litigated, commercial third-party general liability losses in a “paperless” environment. An ability to communicate both verbally and in written form in a prompt, courteous and professional manner is essential.

This role can be located in our Scottsdale AZ office, or remotely for a highly qualified candidate.

  • Reviews and sets up new loss assignments in a timely manner in compliance with Department guidelines and best practices.
  • Establishes appropriate initial loss and expense reserves and continues to regularly evaluate the file for adequacy, accuracy and adherence to reserving guidelines.
  • Analyzes and interprets policy language in conjunction with specific loss facts to reach appropriate coverage decisions.
  • Drafts frequent and complex coverage correspondence, including reservation of rights and coverage disclaimers in compliance with various state statutes and regulations.
  • Composes a variety of other detailed correspondence to insureds, claimants, attorneys, agents and Regulatory agencies.
  • Proactively manages primarily litigated claim files from inception to closure, including identification and investigation of coverage, liability and damage issues, determination and efficient execution of an appropriate plan of action, and prompt, economical file resolution, in compliance with Department guidelines and best practices.
  • Appropriately and clearly documents all claim file activity, including current strategy, plan of action and exit plan in file notes.
  • Consistently demonstrates comprehensive coverage analysis, investigation, evaluation and negotiation skills at an advanced level.
  • Directs and controls the activities and costs of numerous outside vendors including defense counsel and coverage counsel, experts and independent adjusters.
  • Effectively presents and discusses loss facts and issues in roundtable discussions to peers and members of management at all levels.
  • Composes and transmits on a regular and timely basis frequent Large Loss Reports and other detailed reporting documents as appropriate.
  • Manages and monitors file caseload through the use of various resources.
  • Obtains all required state adjuster licenses and maintains them as required via compliance with mandatory continuing education requirements.
  • Other duties may be assigned.
  • Serves as a technical resource within the Department through mentoring and knowledge-sharing, whether one-on-one, in small groups, or presentations to larger groups.
  • Meets with intern personnel and others as needed to provide job function overview and/or specific subject-matter training.
  • Occasional participation in projects and initiatives led by other departments and/or W. R. Berkley companies, including audits, workshops, focus groups, task forces, etc.
  • Initiates appropriate communication with members of management and other Departments.
  • Attends internal and external seminars and other training events and provides feedback to peers and/or members of management.

Job Description

Executive Benefits Specialist - Nonqualified Deferred Compensation (NQDC)

Are you looking to join an industry-leading team and deliver high-quality service in a client-focused environment? If so, consider our Executive Benefits Specialist role.

Aon is seeking a detail-oriented benefits or financial services professional to support the administration of nonqualified deferred compensation (NQDC) plans and related executive benefit programs. You will work with corporate plan sponsors, executive-level participants, recordkeeping and administrative systems, and internal partners to deliver accurate, timely, and high-touch service.

The strongest candidates will have direct NQDC experience or transferable experience in retirement plan administration, pension administration, executive compensation, stock plan administration, trust or recordkeeping operations, payroll administration, or another regulated financial-services environment involving participant accounts, plan provisions, transactions, and reconciliations.

This hybrid position offers flexibility to work both virtually and from our Atlanta, GA, Dallas, TX, or Radnor, PA offices. Although we would prefer candidates to work hybrid in one of above offices, we would be willing to consider a virtual work arrangement for a strong candidate.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Administer recurring NQDC plan activities, including annual enrollment, deferral elections, company contributions, vesting, investment allocations, distributions, and participant data changes.
  • Interpret plan provisions and established administrative procedures to respond to plan sponsor and participant questions accurately.
  • Coordinate data and transaction activity with clients, payroll teams, recordkeepers, trustees, carriers, and internal partners.
  • Reconcile participant and plan-level data, investigate discrepancies, document findings, and drive issues to resolution.
  • Prepare client reports, participant communications, enrollment materials, transaction files, and administrative calendars.
  • Maintain accurate plan documentation, participant records, procedures, and audit support materials.
  • Use Excel and database tools to validate data, analyze activity, and support recurring and ad hoc reporting.
  • Manage multiple client deliverables and deadlines while maintaining strong quality controls and confidentiality.
  • Identify process improvements that strengthen accuracy, efficiency, consistency, and the client and participant experience.
  • Build knowledge of NQDC plan mechanics, Internal Revenue Code Section 409A, corporate-owned life insurance (COLI), and related executive benefit arrangements.

How this opportunity is different

Aon's Executive Benefits team specializes in programs designed for executives and other select employees. This role offers exposure to the administration, participant experience, financial data, and operational controls associated with nonqualified deferred compensation and related executive benefit programs. It is a focused opportunity for someone who wants to build deeper expertise in the retirement and executive compensation space rather than broad-based health and welfare benefits.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 2-5 years of experience in at least one of the following areas:
    • Nonqualified deferred compensation or executive benefit plan administration;
    • Qualified retirement or pension plan administration, recordkeeping, or participant services;
    • Executive compensation, equity or stock plan administration;
    • Trust, custody, payroll, accounting, or financial-services operations involving participant accounts, transactions, reconciliations, and plan or contract provisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with detailed plan, financial, payroll, or participant data and reconcile discrepancies.
  • Intermediate Excel capability, including formulas, lookups, filters, sorting, conditional logic, and data validation, or the ability to demonstrate comparable analytical skills.
  • Ability to read and apply plan provisions, procedures, or other technical documentation.
  • Strong client service, written communication, problem-solving, organization, and follow-through.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines and deliver accurate work in a controlled environment.

Preferred skills and experience:

  • Direct experience administering NQDC plans, 409A plans, SERPs, excess or restoration plans, or executive retirement arrangements.
  • Experience with annual enrollment, deferral elections, distributions, vesting, participant statements, payroll files, or plan-level reconciliation.
  • Familiarity with Section 409A, COLI, rabbi trusts, nonqualified plan recordkeeping, or executive benefit funding concepts.
  • Experience supporting corporate clients or executive-level participants in a consultative service environment.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities:

  • Excellent written communication skills – writes clearly; edits work for spelling and grammar; varies writing style to meet needs; presents numeric data effectively; able to read and interpret written information.

About this job

Lead a team of integration, data, and test engineers in LATAM, partnering with India teams to deliver IT solutions. Own end-to-end technology solutions that translate business needs into effective technical implementations across internal systems, integrations, and vendor platforms.

Good fit if you have 3+ years as a Solution Engineer with strong MuleSoft experience and can lead technical teams through influence.

Full job description

Farmers– where ambition meets opportunity.

Farmers is known for more than its unforgettable jingle – it's a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people's lives. Farmers employees deliver peace of mind when it matters most. The organization's results-driven, high-performance culture thrives on creativity, accountability and bold solutions. Here, growth isn't just a goal – it's a way of life for both the organization and every individual on the team. Farmers employees tackle challenges head-on, learn from every experience and measure their impact on the customers who trust them.

Join us and help power the success of Farmers. As a team member, you'll collaborate with Farmers' award-winning workforce, benefit from a culture of innovation and support and contribute to their mission of delivering protection and peace of mind to millions of U.S. customers.

Ready to make your mark? Discover Farmers' vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate.

Job Summary

This role will lead a team of Integration Engineers, Data Engineers, and Test Engineers in LATAM, partnering closely with the India team to provide continuity of IT delivery and support across locations. The role will serve as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, developing a strong understanding of business capabilities, priorities, processes, and outcomes and translating them into effective technology solutions. The individual will have end-to-end ownership of technology solutions supporting assigned business capabilities, including solutions delivered through vendor platforms, and will be accountable for ensuring they meet business needs, architectural direction, quality expectations, and operational requirements.

This leader is expected to operate independently, lead technical teams through influence, constructively challenge proposed solutions when appropriate, and drive decisions toward the best business and technology outcome. The role will also partner with technical leadership and functional Centers of Excellence (COEs) to ensure delivery teams consistently follow established engineering, architecture, integration, data, testing, security, and operational standards.

Essential Job Functions

Business & Solution Ownership

  • Develop a strong understanding of assigned business capabilities, processes, priorities, and outcomes, working closely with business stakeholders to translate business needs into effective technology solutions.
  • Act as the end-to-end technology owner for assigned business capabilities, maintaining accountability across solution design, integration, data, testing, implementation, production support, and ongoing evolution.
  • Ensure technology solutions address the underlying business need, rather than simply implementing individual requirements or vendor capabilities.
  • Maintain a holistic view of the solution across internal systems, integrations, data flows, vendor platforms, and operational processes.

Technical Leadership & Challenge

  • Provide technical leadership across delivery teams, ensuring proposed solutions are fit for purpose, scalable, supportable, secure, and aligned with enterprise technology direction.
  • Review and constructively challenge technical designs, estimates, vendor recommendations, implementation approaches, and delivery decisions when they do not sufficiently address business needs or established technical standards.
  • Lead technical teams through influence rather than organizational authority, creating alignment across engineering, data, integration, testing, architecture, operations, and vendor teams.
  • Drive technical decisions and facilitate resolution when multiple teams, technologies, or vendors are involved in delivering a business capability.

Vendor Solution Ownership

  • Own the overall solution outcome even when significant components are delivered by third-party vendors, ensuring accountability does not stop at the vendor or platform boundary.
  • Evaluate vendor solutions in the context of the broader business capability, including integration, data, security, supportability, resiliency, and operational impact.
  • Hold vendors and internal delivery teams accountable for meeting agreed technical standards, solution requirements, quality expectations, and delivery commitments.
  • Ensure vendor capabilities are appropriately integrated into the enterprise technology landscape rather than treated as standalone solutions.

COE & Engineering Standards

  • Partner with technical leadership and relevant Centers of Excellence (COEs) to understand established architecture, engineering, integration, data, testing, security, and operational standards.
  • Ensure delivery teams consistently apply COE standards, approved patterns, reusable components, and engineering practices.
  • Identify and escalate deviations from established standards, working with technical leadership to determine when exceptions are justified.
  • Provide feedback to COEs based on delivery experience to help evolve standards and practices where appropriate.

Delivery & Operational Accountability

  • Maintain end-to-end accountability from business need through design, build, testing, implementation, stabilization, and production support.
  • Proactively identify dependencies, technical risks, delivery constraints, and cross-team impacts and drive them to resolution.
  • Balance business priorities, technical quality, delivery timelines, cost, and operational risk when making or influencing solution decisions.
  • Ensure solutions transition effectively into production with appropriate documentation, controls, monitoring, support processes, and knowledge transfer.

Physical Actions

Physical Environment

High school diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent, relevant experience.

Experience Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience working as a Solution Engineer
  • Strong understanding of Mulesoft
  • Experience working with cloud environments like AWS
  • Experience working with Vendors managing integrations
  • Strong integration and data experience

Special Skill Requirement

Additional Qualification

  • Experience working with Dremio & CDGC

This position offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and work–life balance. While specific benefits may vary by country and employee level, offerings generally include competitive salary opportunities, performance-based bonuses, comprehensive benefits, and ongoing training and development resources.

Any ownership, partnership, directorship, or participation in other businesses or companies must be fully disclosed and formally reviewed in accordance with FBS internal conflict‑of‑interest and external engagement policies prior to the start date or as soon as such circumstances arise.

Failure to comply with these conditions may impact the hiring decision or employment continuation.

Job Summary

This position supports the growth of life insurance sales by leveraging data to make recommendations to agents that drive premium and profit objectives for an assigned territory. The position serves as a contact for district managers, agents and agency staff to strengthen relationships and promote life insurance products and the companys value proposition. This position is an individual contributor and performs work while receiving a moderate level of guidance and direction.

Essential Job Functions

  • Supports life insurance sales by conducting in-depth analysis of agency activity and premium under management within assigned agencies to identify trends, performance gaps, and growth opportunities.
  • Activates agents by using personal lines and business insurance data to generate quotes and referrals.
  • Generates data insights and shares findings with management and agency stakeholders to support optimization of life insurance sales outcomes.
  • Demonstrates working knowledge of life insurance products, marketing campaigns and services to assist agencies in understanding coverage options and providing appropriate life insurance solutions.
  • Acts as a contact for district managers, agents and agency staff on routine matters, coordinating with internal teams to address agency needs and ensure smooth operations.
  • Supports agencies virtually or in-person to provide data-driven insights and actionable recommendations that support sales outcomes.
  • Maintains agency relationships and provides training and ongoing education on products, services, marketing campaigns and technology.
  • Maintains accurate records of agency performance, sales activities, interactions, and competitor data in CRM and other systems.
  • Manages funnel entry, activation lists, and pipelines.
  • Prepares reports, monitors progress, and ensures up-to-date information is available for use by life insurance sales and analytics teams.
  • Assists with onboarding and mentoring new team members by sharing knowledge, providing training on tools and processes, and supporting professional development to enhance team capabilities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Education Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred.
  • Valid life insurance license required. Other preferred designations include Financial Services Certified Professional (FSCP), Chartered Life Underwriter (CLU), Chartered Financial Consultant (ChFC), or FINRA 6,63 licenses.

Experience Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience required in sales, account management, or agency operations preferably within the insurance industry.

Additional Qualification

  • Strong verbal communication and listening skills.
  • Demonstrated written communication skills.
  • Effective interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills.
  • Possesses strong product knowledge.
  • Working knowledge of life insurance products and services and solid understanding of company product offerings.
  • Possesses strong technical aptitude.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite.
  • Competent in CRM and similar systems.
  • Able to adapt quickly to new technology.

Workplace: Remote ( #LI-Remote )

Job Summary

This position supports the growth of life insurance sales by leveraging data to make recommendations to agents that drive premium and profit objectives for an assigned territory. The role takes ownership of sales outcomes through proactive engagement and solution-driven approaches. The position develops and implements business plans to enhance agency productivity and profitability, deepen relationships, and promote life insurance products and the companys value proposition. The position collaborates with internal teams, field leadership, and agency stakeholders to address complex or high-value challenges, implement life insurance sales initiatives, and achieve sales objectives. This position is an individual contributor and performs work independently while receiving minimal guidance and direction.

Essential Job Functions

  • Drives life insurance sales by consulting with agency owners to meet sales objectives across multiple product lines and on high-value and complex cases.
  • Takes ownership of sales outcomes by managing both assisted and unassisted sales activities.
  • Focuses on point-of-sale interactions to drive successful transactions and meet sales targets.
  • Promotes life insurance products and company value proposition.
  • Achieves activity targets and production goals by proactively engaging with district managers and agency owners to identify needs or opportunities and deliver tailored solutions, and continuously monitor outcomes.
  • Follows up on implemented strategies to assess effectiveness and pivots as needed when results do not meet expectations.
  • Develops and implements customized sales plans for assigned agency to drive sales growth and meet sales objectives, including quarterly and annual sales targets.
  • Aligns agency-specific sales plans with broader business objectives and leverages adjacent revenue stream opportunities to drive life sales.
  • Demonstrates strong knowledge of life insurance products and services to effectively compete in the marketplace.
  • Independently provides recommendations on product illustrations, case designs, and sales focus.
  • Acts as a liaison between internal teams, field leadership, and agency stakeholders on complex underwriting, commissions, customer service, licensing, and other issues.
  • Builds and maintains relationships with elite agents through targeted consultation, training, and education on products, services, marketing campaigns, technology, and advanced sales strategies.
  • Supports agency growth by assisting with producer recruitment and development, optimizing performance and profitability, and delivering guidance virtually or in-person.
  • Monitors agency performance through CRM systems and other tools.
  • Tracks sales activities, analyzes data and identifies trends or patterns, and provides actionable insights to help agencies address performance gaps and improve sales results.
  • Measures changes in agency performance resulting from the deployment of various tailored solutions.
  • Mentors, trains, and coaches less experienced team members or lower level life sales consultants to develop their skills and improve performance.
  • Provides ongoing support and feedback to support professional development and enhance team capabilities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Education Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Bachelors degree preferred.
  • Valid life insurance and FINRA 6, 63 licenses required.
  • Other preferred designations include Financial Services Certified Professional (FSCP), Chartered Life Underwriter (CLU), Chartered Financial Consultant (ChFC).

Experience Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in sales, account management, or agency operations, preferably within the insurance industry.
  • Experience required in direct point of sale, life insurance wholesale, and sales leadership.

Additional Qualification

Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Demonstrated written communication skills. Ability to influence internal and/or external constituents. Demonstrated analytical skills. Possesses strong product knowledge. In-depth knowledge of life insurance products and services and in-depth understanding of company product offerings. Possesses strong technical aptitude. Proficient in Microsoft Office suite. Strong proficiency in CRM and similar systems. Able to adapt quickly to new technology. Develops and delivers effective presentations. Possesses a high degree of initiative. Instills commitment to organizational goals. Effectively coaches and delivers constructive feedback.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. Job may include work performed at field locations. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Field work performed outdoors may include exposure to weather elements. Frequently sits or stands for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and places objects or materials weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Occasionally performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category may require regular travel between Farmers offices, alternative work locations, and/or field locations.

  • Demonstrates expertise of competitor product structure, underwriting rules, systems and quoting platforms. Provides direction and guidance on competitor research into compliance and regulatory changes.

  • Escalation owner for complex or high-impact product issues.
  • Review team recommendations and facilitate presentations with leaders and business partners regarding proposed product or underwriting rule changes.
  • Business owner of complex interactions and negotiation for proposed product or underwriting rule changes with departments of insurance and other regulatory entities.

  • Able to leverage extensive network with key internal business partners.

Job.JobTitle: Inside Auto Claims Adjuster - Hybrid (Uniondale, NY)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Inside Auto Claims Adjuster is responsible for investigating basic and occasionally moderately complex auto insurance claims. This role may handle non-represented claims and requires evaluating coverage, determining liability, and negotiating settlements. The adjuster works directly with claimants, insureds, and other involved parties to ensure timely, accurate, and customer-focused claim resolution.

Work Location & Schedule


Projected Start Date: January 11, 2027


During Training: IN OFFICE

  • Monday through Friday, 8am-4:45pm

After Training: HYBRID (IN OFFICE & REMOTE)

  • Hours: MondayFriday between 8:00 AM 5:30 PM, with occasional Saturday
  • Work Arrangement: Hybrid schedule 3 days in office (Tuesday-Thursday), 2 days remote (Monday, Friday)

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and company standards throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Investigate minor to moderately complex auto accidents and prepare clear, concise claim summaries.
  • Conduct recorded statements with claimants, insureds, and witnesses.
  • Evaluate auto claims to determine coverage, liability, and damages.
  • Negotiate and settle claims in alignment with established guidelines and best practices.
  • Maintain detailed and well-documented claim files, including notes, summaries, and decision rationale.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support efficient and customer-centric claim handling.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of prior claim handling experience preferred.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a demonstrated commitment to excellent customer service.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and operate in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail with solid critical-thinking and decision-making skills.
  • Comfortable using technology and learning claims-related software and tools.
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Washington, and Hawaii residents.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, you may be expected to obtain an adjusters license in multiple markets.
  • All required licenses must be obtained within 60 days of hire.
  • You must maintain all licensing required for your role. This includes any continuing education and/or other state-affiliated requirements for licensing renewal.
  • This role offers a $1,000 sign on bonus if you have an active adjuster license in TX, FL, or your resident state.
  • Current employees and former employees seeking rehire at Allstate or its affiliated companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

What You Need:

  • A dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.

What Allstate Provides:

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitor, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset a portion of your internet costs.

Allstate Benefits:

Allstate cares about you and your wellbeing. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that includes pay, benefits, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. You can choose whatever benefits are most important you. Here are some of our benefits:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Allstate pension plan and 401(k) savings plan
  • Ayco financial coaching
  • Spring Health mental and emotional wellbeing resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Adoption reimbursement
  • Paid time off
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Wellness incentives
  • Allstate Foundation donation match and grant opportunities

Skills

Liability Analysis

Compensation

Basecompensationoffered for this role is $50,000-$60,000 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chicago, IL
  • Experience: 4+ years

About this job

Digital Product Manager role at Allstate leading strategy and lifecycle management for billing and payments platform capabilities. Requires partnering across engineering, design, and business teams to drive customer-centric financial experiences and measurable outcomes.

Good fit if you have 4+ years managing technical products with strong billing or payments platform experience and ability to partner closely with engineering teams.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Technical Product Manager is responsible for defining product strategy, shaping vision, and driving measurable customer and business outcomes for one or more technical products within Allstates Billing and Payments ecosystem. This role owns the direction, prioritization, and lifecycle of complex platform capabilities that enable accurate, reliable, scalable, and customer-centric financial experiences.

This leader partners closely with engineering, design, architecture, data, finance, and business stakeholders to identify problems worth solving, validate opportunities through discovery, and translate strategy into a clear roadmap and prioritized backlog. Success in this role requires strong product judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to balance long-term platform health with near-term delivery and business value.

The ideal candidate is a strong product strategist with deep technical fluency, a data-driven mindset, and experience managing enterprise-scale billing, payments, or financial platforms.

Key responsibilities:

  • Define and evolve the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a technical product or platform within Billing and Payments.

  • Own product outcomes byestablishingsuccess measures, tracking performance, and using data to inform prioritization and strategic tradeoffs.

  • Lead discovery, framing, and test-and-learn activities tovalidatecustomer, business, and operational assumptions before scaling solutions.

  • Partner deeply with engineering to shape platform direction, evaluate architectural and operational tradeoffs, and prioritize work across features, defects, resiliency, and technical debt.

  • Translate complex business and customer problems into well-sequenced product investments with clear value, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.

  • Represent the voice of the customer, user, and enterprise by combining customer insight, market context, operational signals, and internal stakeholder needs.

  • Drive alignment across business, technology, design, and operational partners to deliver high-impact solutions and ensure successful adoption.

  • Manage and prioritize the backlog to support iterative delivery while preserving focus on strategic outcomes rather than output alone.

  • Author, refine, test, and accept stories as needed to enable effective execution by the product team.

  • Communicate product direction, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders and leadership.

Essential Skills:

  • A minimum of4 years of product management experience leading technical products, platforms, APIs, services, data products, or developer experiences.

  • Strong experience in billing, payments, or adjacent financial platforms, preferably within insurance or another highly regulated financial environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to partner closely with engineering and architecture teams on systems thinking, service design, integration patterns, data flows, reliability, and scalability.

  • Proventrack recordof defining strategy and using metrics to drive prioritization, decision-making, and measurable outcomes.

  • Experience leading discovery and experimentation tovalidateassumptions and improve product direction.

Desirable Skills:

  • Experience withcustomerfacing financial flows where accuracy, auditability, resiliency, and operational excellence are critical.

  • Experience using analytics, automation, or AI/ML in pragmatic product use cases such as anomaly detection, operational efficiency, explainability, or decision support.

  • Experience working across multiple teams or products in a complex enterprise platform environment.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This role does not have direct people-managementresponsibilities butenjoys the highest level of ownership and autonomy.

Skills

Business Case Analyses, Business Outcomes, Customer Insights, Digital Products, Product Development, Product Direction, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Management, Product Roadmapping, Product Vision, Software Product Management, Systems Thinking, Waterfall Model

Compensation offered for this role is 110,000.00 - 181,025.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: New York, NY
  • Experience: 3 to 5 years
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • License: Valid driver's license
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off, tuition assistance

About this job

Field-based auto damage appraiser for Allstate Insurance in Nassau County. You'll meet customers on-site to assess vehicle damage, write estimates, and guide them through the repair or total loss process using in-person visits, virtual inspections, and written communication.

Good fit if you have 3-5 years of auto collision estimating experience with CCC or Mitchell software and a valid driver's license.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Are you someone who enjoys being on the move, solving problems, and making a real impact for customers? As a Field Auto Appraiser, you'll be at the forefront of our claims processmeeting customers where they are, whether it's at their home, a repair shop, or a tow yard.

You'll take the lead in writing estimates and guiding customers through the repair or total loss process, using a mix of in-person visits, virtual inspections, and written communication. No two days are the samewhether you're evaluating damage on-site or collaborating with body shops and service providers, you'll enjoy a fast-paced, hands-on role that keeps you engaged and on your toes.

If you're looking for a career that blends technical know-how, customer service, and the freedom of field work, this is your chance to thrive in a role where your expertise truly matters.


Sign-On Bonus: A $5,000 sign-on bonus may be offered to qualified candidates who receive and accept an employment offer. Eligibility, payment timing, and conditions will be outlined in the official offer letter.


Preferred Qualifications

  • You have 3-5 years' experience in auto collision estimating using CCC or Mitchell
  • You have a High School Diploma or a GED
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with customers
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to write precise and comprehensive estimates
  • Comfortable with utilizing technology and various platforms for claims processing
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills to manage multiple assignments effectively
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements

A day in the life of the Field Auto Damage Appraiser, and what it takes to do the job!

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder Your Eye for Detail Keeps Everything on Track- In this role, youll ensure claims are documented accurately and in line with policy agreements. As you handle each case, youll maintain clear, timely records in our claims system (which well train you on). Your attention to detail helps keep the process smooth, organized, and transparent from start to finish.

Work Location

  • This position is a field-based role.To be eligible for this role, you must be located in the following locations: Nassau County - Long Island, NY

Company Car
Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.


Training:

The first approximately eight weeks of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.


Notice of Licensing Requirement

  • As a condition of employment, you may be expected to obtain an adjusters' and/or appraisers' license in multiple markets
  • All required licenses will need to be obtained within 60 days of hire
  • You must maintain all licensing required for your role. This includes any continuing education and/or other state-affiliated requirements for licensing renewal
  • This role offers a sign on bonus of $1,000 if you have an active appraiser license or active adjuster license in TX, FL, or your resident state (current employees and candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus)

Benefits

Allstate cares about you and your wellbeing. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that includes pay, benefits, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. You can choose whatever benefits are most important you. Here are some of our offerings:

  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Allstate pension plan and 401(k) savings plan
  • Ayco financial coaching
  • Spring Health mental and emotional wellbeing resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Adoption reimbursement
  • Paid time off
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Wellness incentives

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As a Senior Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of higher exposure cases and more complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim matters depending on line of business. You will deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers and will mentor less experienced attorneys.

What Will You Do?

  • In the independent handling of a caseload of higher exposure cases and most complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim depending on line of business, your responsibilities will include:
  • Leverage trial experience to apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct advanced legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft substantive pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other legal documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide in-depth, substantive case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and Claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Collaborates with expert witnesses and consultants to develop case strategies, evaluate technical matters, and prepare compelling testimony for litigation.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships, including independent responsibility for managing client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide internal and external training, seminars and legal updates to insured clients and Claim partners.
  • Provide leadership through mentoring other attorneys and legal support staff.
  • Initiate special projects and identifies other opportunities to support office goals/business needs.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 7+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Strong aptitude for trying cases to a jury; proven track record of litigating jury trials, with a history of successful courtroom outcomes
  • Demonstrates strong technical knowledge in the practice area(s) and the ability to effectively communicate complex information on litigated matters to diverse audiences.
  • Advanced oral and written advocacy skills, with a demonstrated track record of summary judgment and/or appellate successs.
  • Possesses in-depth knowledge of the bench, bar, local jurisdictional practices, adversaries.
  • Excels in fostering collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service
  • Demonstrates strong leadership through mentoring and influencing skills.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses advanced negotiation skills.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency & responsiveness.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 7 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

The investigator will conduct thorough and comprehensive investigations in a dynamic, fast paced environment.

About this job

Senior Network Engineer at Church Mutual Insurance in Merrill, Wisconsin. Provides technical leadership for enterprise network infrastructure across routing, switching, security, cloud, and communications, mentoring junior engineers while managing complex design, implementation, and incident response.

Good fit if you have 7-10+ years hands-on network engineering experience, advanced voice and collaboration expertise, and can lead technical initiatives and mentor others.

Full job description

BASIC PURPOSE:

The Senior Network Engineer provides technical leadership for enterprise network infrastructure, driving architecture standards, design improvements, and alignment with business objectives. This role leads complex network design, implementation, troubleshooting, and optimization across routing, switching, security, cloud, and enterprise connectivity (voice, data, wireless, and collaboration), while ensuring high availability through proactive monitoring, rapid incident response, and effective disaster recovery planning. The position also mentors junior engineers and requires deep cross-domain expertise with the ability to lead hands-on technical work and resolve complex incidents. Individuals unable to do so will not meet expectations.

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, implement, and support complex enterprise network and communications solutions (voice, data, video, wireless)
  • Lead complex troubleshooting efforts and root cause analysis for network, voice, and collaboration incidents
  • Oversee network operations and lead response to high-impact incidents, ensuring timely resolution and service restoration
  • Guide incident triage and escalation efforts, contributing to improvements in response processes
  • Architect and optimize multi-domain network solutions across routing, switching, security, cloud, and unified communications
  • Analyze network performance data (telemetry, logs, packet captures, VoIP metrics) to identify trends and drive improvements
  • Lead implementation and integration of new technologies across on-premises and cloud environments
  • Support and enhance network architecture standards, configurations, and documentation practices
  • Drive capacity planning, performance tuning, and lifecycle management to ensure scalability and reliability
  • Partner with vendors and stakeholders to design, implement, and improve network and communication solutions
  • Lead infrastructure-related projects, ensuring alignment with scope, timelines, and architectural standards
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to engineers, supporting skill development and problem resolution
  • Support IT service management processes, disaster recovery planning, and continuous improvement initiatives

 

Level Expectations (Performance and Scope Indicators)

The following outlines how performance is evaluated at this level. These are not additional job responsibilities, but indicators of scope, autonomy, impact, and influence expected of this role.

Scope: Leads major initiatives, projects, and engineering workstreams across multiple domains. Serves as subject-matter expert for technical architecture, and ensures alignment with enterprise standards, investigation methodology, and enterprise tooling.

Autonomy: Operates with high autonomy. Makes technical decisions, designs solutions, and resolves complex issues. Escalates only when strategic trade-offs or cross-team impacts arise.

Impact: Shapes network and telecommunications capabilities across the entire organization. Defines engineering patterns, raises maturity levels, and drives large-scale improvements that reduce risk and improve operational efficiency.

People Influence: Mentors less experienced team members. Leads technical project teams. Provides input into workforce capability development. Influences Architecture, Infrastructure, and Operations as a subject matter expert.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required

  • Degree in Computer Science, Networking, Telecommunications, Engineering, or related field; or equivalent work experience;7-10+ years hands-on experience.
  • Proven leadership in Network Engineering and architecture.
  • Ability to design and maintain enterprise systems and automation workflows.
  • Advanced experience with Networking, Voice Technologies and Collaboration systems at engineering depth.
  • Ability to act as escalation point for complex, multi-vector incidents.
  • Expertise across endpoint, cloud, network, and data security domains.

Technical Competencies

  • Capability to evaluate and improve network and voice architecture.
  • Ability to drive technical initiatives requiring cross-functional coordination.
  • Design and Implementation experience in voice, data communications, contact center technologies, and video conferencing.
  • Strong understanding of SIP, H.323, and other VoIP protocols.
  • In-depth understanding of communication protocols and routing protocols.
  • Solid background in network administration and architecture.

Preferred

  • Cisco CCNA or CCNP or CCDP – Voice/Collaboration certification a plus.
  • Experience influencing enterprise architecture and leadership decision-making.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Office

  • Professional office environment. Regularly uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.
  • Regularly required to communicate; sit; stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms.
  • Supervisory Responsibilities – None
  • CM Group Office – Hybrid

Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you'll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed. No prior insurance experience required.

We are looking for candidates living in: Newark, DE | Oxford, PA | Avondale, PA | West Grove, PA & Kennett Square, PA.

THIS POSITION HAS IN-OFFICE REQUIREMENTS.

This is a full-time, field-based employee position. Applicants must be able to travel within their local community to meet with customers and build relationships. Reliable transportation, such as a valid driver's license or another means of travel, is preferred.

What you'll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

Essential functions include: meeting with customers in the office and in the community, communicating by phone, email, and in person, traveling locally, and using a computer and sales software.

Qualifications

  • Self-motivated and accountable: you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive: you follow through and do what you say you'll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy: you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused: you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Strong communicator: you're comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Comfortable with technology: you can learn and use new software and digital tools with ease.

  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired (P&C and Life).

About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Manager, Insurance Sales, Insurance Sales Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, is seeking a Regional Small Commercial Sales Manager to lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team of small commercial producers. In this role, youll drive regional sales, retention, and customer satisfaction by developing agents, strengthening carrier partnerships, and promoting excellence across sales and service. Youll also have the opportunity to help shape Comparions growing small commercial business while advancing your leadership career.

Territory and travel
This role supports the Southeast region, covering Tennessee, South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Arkansas, Kentucky, Mississippi, Virginia, and West Virginia. Youll recruit, onboard, coach, and support commercial sales professionals across the region and help drive commercial growth.

The position involves approximately 60% travel within the territory. Travel may include visits to team locations, recruiting events, agent or client meetings, carrier partners, and regional business or community events. Candidates should be comfortable with frequent regional travel.

We are seeking candidates based in Tennessee, South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Arkansas, Kentucky, Mississippi, Virginia, or West Virginia.

The successful candidate will be eligible to earn variable compensation of up to 50% of base salary in 2026, contingent upon achieving designated key performance measures.

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of small commercial producers to meet or exceed new-business, retention, premium growth, and profitability goals.
  • Provide strategic guidance to expand and optimize the agency, identifying and evaluating new market and business opportunities
  • Support agents through the sales cycle: advise on policy types, effective coverage, renewals, policy changes, and complex submissions/renewals.
  • Drive new business development by coaching agents on lead follow-up, cross-selling, prospect cultivation, and referral strategies.
  • Act as a primary liaison among agents, clients, and internal teams to ensure clear communication and timely resolution of post-enrollment issues.
  • Maintain and strengthen carrier relationships in partnership with Relationship Managers to enhance product access and service.
  • Oversee local marketing and community networking initiatives to ensure strong market penetration.
  • Ensure high service levels (on-time renewals, prompt certificate issuance, timely responses to client inquiries) and instill accountability for SLAs across the team.
  • Recruit, staff, and manage personnel levels to align with business needs.
  • Monitor and analyze performance metrics (retention, premium growth, loss ratios, revenue per producer) to identify opportunities, trends, and obstacles; provide data-driven coaching and action plans.
  • Mentor, conduct performance reviews, and deliver ongoing feedback to support career development and goal attainment.
  • Stay current on small commercial industry trends, products, and regulatory changes affecting clients and carriers.

What we offer:

  • Competitive base salary with meaningful performance-based upside (variable compensation up to 50% of base salary).
  • Comprehensive benefits: medical, dental, vision; 401(k) with company match; paid time off
  • Eligibility for a company fleet vehicle for qualified employees
  • Professional development, ongoing training, and tuition assistance.
  • Employee assistance and wellness programs, employee discounts and other voluntary benefits.
  • Opportunity for career growth within Comparion and a collaborative, inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives.
  • A leadership role with visible impact, autonomy, and the ability to influence product, process and market strategy.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor`s degree or equivalent experience required.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of commercial lines products and services; proven success with prior sales or related experience required.
  • Must possess highly effective oral and written communication skills, including group and individual presentation, persuasion, negotiation and customer service skills.
  • Requires excellent organizational skills, effective time management, strong leadership, interpersonal and analytical skills.
  • Incumbents must have, or be able to secure, a current state license, in property, casualty and life insurance.
  • Prior supervisory experience helpful
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you'll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed. No prior insurance experience required.

THIS POSITION HAS IN-OFFICE REQUIREMENTS. Must reside in the state of Illinois.

This is a full-time, field-based employee position. Applicants must be able to travel within their local community to meet with customers and build relationships. Reliable transportation, such as a valid driver's license or another means of travel, is preferred.

Pay Details

  • The typical training salary is $55k - $65k
  • Through a combination of base, bonuses, and uncapped commissions, typical total first year compensation ranges from $55k - $75k
  • Potential for top performers to earn over $100k in their first year

  • Sell auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

Essential functions include: meeting with customers in the office and in the community, communicating by phone, email, and in person, traveling locally, and using a computer and sales software.

  • Self-motivated and accountable: you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive: you follow through and do what you say you'll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy: you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused: you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Strong communicator: you're comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Comfortable with technology: you can learn and use new software and digital tools with ease.
  • Composed and dependable: you stay organized and professional while managing multiple customer needs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

Licensing:

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired (P&C and Life).

We are looking for an Insurance Sales Associate to join our team in our Rochester, NY office. This position has IN OFFICE requirement.

Were Hiring Immediately!

As an Insurance Sales Associate, you will work alongside with and support a Comparion Insurance Sales Agent in profitable growth through new business sales and customer retention. Your ability to listen and empathize are key in being the initial contact for our customers. Success in this role will require building a strong local network and in-person relationship in the community.

Working for Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, means working for a company thats committed to advancing an inclusive environment. Ready to find out what it means to work for an agency that is backed by Liberty Mutuala Fortune 100 company thats committed to putting people first, acting responsibly and making things better?
