BASIC PURPOSE:

 

Support the development, configuration, implementation, and maintenance of commercial property and casualty insurance products through a blend of insurance expertise, product analysis, and technology-enabled solutions. Partner with underwriting, actuarial, compliance, product, and technology stakeholders to translate business requirements into configured product solutions that support profitability, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and speed to market.

Conduct research, analysis, product configuration, testing, and implementation activities within Guidewire PolicyCenter and related policy administration systems. Leverage commercial insurance knowledge and technical capabilities to optimize product performance, streamline workflows, improve data quality, and support strategic business initiatives.

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

 

  • Lead insurance product initiatives through research, analysis, no/low-code configuration, testing, implementation, and post-production validation activities.
  • Apply a strong understanding of commercial property and casualty insurance products, underwriting workflows, and policy lifecycle processes to support product development and operational effectiveness.
  • Partner with underwriting, product, actuarial, compliance, and technology teams to gather requirements and translate business needs into configurable product solutions.
  • Configure and maintain commercial insurance products within Guidewire PolicyCenter's no/low-code Advanced Product Designer application, including coverages, business rules, forms, workflows, and product attributes.
  • Support the development of business requirements, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and documentation that clearly communicate intended product behavior and system functionality.
  • Participate in testing activities, including functional testing, regression testing, product validation, rate verification, forms attachment testing, and integration testing.
  • Identify, analyze, and resolve product configuration, workflow, system, and data issues in partnership with business and technology teams.
  • Conduct competitor analysis, market research, rate analysis, and filing analysis to support product recommendations and business strategy.
  • Support development, submission, implementation, and maintenance of state filings in partnership with product, compliance, and actuarial teams.
  • Analyze data relationships, system integrations, workflow impacts, and operational requirements to support product enhancements and business initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline business processes, improve data quality, optimize workflows, and increase operational efficiency across highly configurable systems.
  • Communicate project status, technical issues, timelines, dependencies, risks, decisions, and business impacts to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain underwriting protocols, product documentation, and no/low-code configuration standards supporting consistent business practices and regulatory compliance.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree or comparable industry experience may be considered with a high school diploma or equivalent required.
  • CPCU, ARM, ASLI, or evidence of continuing and progressive insurance education preferred.
  • Five years or more of commercial property and casualty insurance experience in underwriting, product development, product management, configuration, actuarial, underwriting administration, business analysis, or related functions.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial property and casualty insurance products, underwriting operations, policy administration processes, and policy lifecycle activities.
  • Experience configuring products within Guidewire PolicyCenter or similar no/low-code configurable policy administration systems preferred.
  • Understanding of configurable business rules, product structures, workflows, data relationships, system integrations, and policy administration technology.
  • Working knowledge of XML, JSON, query tools, data structures, integrations, or related technologies preferred.
  • Experience conducting market analysis, competitor analysis, rate analysis, product analysis, or filing analysis to support business recommendations and implementation decisions.
  • Understanding of modern product development methodologies including business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, testing, defect resolution, and implementation practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills supporting the ability to develop, test, implement, and support solutions for complex business, product, and system issues.
  • Strong listening, written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Organized, analytical, self-motivated, and capable of managing multiple priorities and deadlines

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Professional office or home office environment.

NOTE: This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties performed by this employee.  Employees may be requested to perform jobrelated tasks other than those specifically presented in this job description.  The employer reserves the right to change or assign other duties to this position.

  • Self-motivated and accountable: you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive: you follow through and do what you say you'll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy: you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused: you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Strong communicator: you're comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.

Full job description


Description

Comparion is seeking a driven, customer-focused professional who can turn service interactions into opportunities to build trust, grow business, and strengthen customer loyalty. In this role, you will act as a consultative advisor to policyholders, helping identify coverage needs, presenting solutions, and supporting both retention and new business growth across a variety of insurance products, carriers, plans, and programs.

The ideal candidate is proactive, persuasive, and confident in handling complex customer conversations while uncovering opportunities to deepen relationships and expand existing accounts. Effective performance in this role requires strong communication, sales aptitude, and decision-making skills, coupled with the ability to balance multiple tasks and deliver outstanding service that contributes to measurable business outcomes.

YOU MUST HAVE AN ACTIVE PROPERTY & CASUALTY LICENSE

Paid Training

Mandatory attendance is critical to success and is required for the duration of training. Performance will be continually assessed throughout training.
Paid training is Monday through Friday, 9:00 am- 5:30 pm EST (40 hours per week). Training class begins on 12/14/2026.

Hours of Operation

Comparion Customer Support operates Monday through Friday from 8:00 am 8:00 pm ET.

Schedule Expectations

Workforce Management Team creates weekly schedules, which are accessed online. Schedules include an 8.5-hour workday with a half-hour lunch and scheduled break times.

Responsibilities

  • Develop deep expertise in products, procedures, systems, and underwriting guidelines to confidently support customers and retain or sell business.
  • Deliver timely, high-quality service while identifying sales opportunities during inbound calls primarily, outbound calls and written inquiries.
  • Build trust and rapport with each customer through strong listening skills, clear communication, empathy, and a consultative approach.
  • Confidently manage difficult conversations while guiding customers toward the best coverage solutions.
  • Interpret complex policy language and explain coverages, limits, and options in a way customers can understand.
  • Use independent judgment to research, resolve, and follow through on complex customer issues and complaints.
  • Identify customer needs and recommend products and services that improve retention, satisfaction, and long-term value.
  • Support growth by uncovering cross-sell and upsell opportunities, analyzing open leads, and converting opportunities into quoted and bound business.
  • Gather accurate risk information and apply carrier-specific underwriting guidelines to quote and bind new business.
  • Advise prospects and policyholders on coverage options, limits, and regulations to help them make informed purchasing decisions.
  • Strengthen existing relationships by educating customers on available products, services, and resources that may enhance their coverage.
  • Partner with regional and national teams to resolve complex issues and support broader sales and service goals.
  • Support sales initiatives by building customer confidence and assisting with relationship development.
  • Manage time and priorities effectively to meet service level expectations and business objectives.
  • Use online tools and reference materials to provide fast, accurate, and confident support.
  • Maintain required continuing education and licensing requirements, including Property and Casualty and any applicable state or province licenses.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.
Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Active Property and Casualty license required.
  • 35 years of customer service or sales experience in the insurance industry.
  • Bachelors degree or equivalent preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of insurance products, plans, and programs in a sales or customer-facing environment.
  • Ability to identify opportunities, influence decisions, and recommend solutions that drive retention and growth.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to organize and interpret written data from multiple sources.

We offer customers 50 insurance companies with product breadth including auto, home, life, pet, renters, umbrella, jewelry and much more. We use our scale to deliver a first-rate customer experience through consultative insurance experts located in their communities.

Our Leadership team has over 200 years of cumulative insurance experience. We are looking for a Sales Agent to join our team in the Galveston area. Success in this role will require a strong local network and in-person relationship building in the community. This is a field sales position.

To be considered, applicants must live in Texas, specifically in one of the following cities: Galveston, Texas City, La Marque, or Hitchcock *

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.

Day One Skills & Traits

Job.JobTitle: Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist - Northeast Region
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Grow Here. Go Further.

Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist - Northeast Region

At Liberty Mutual, we do more than offer a job in claims. We offer the opportunity to build a lasting career. Through ongoing development, coaching, technical training, mentoring, and internal mobility, we help high-performing and motivated claims professionals continue growing throughout their careers. Whether your long-term goals include people leadership, technical claims, litigation, specialty operations, quality, strategy, or another area of the business, we provide opportunities to expand your expertise and take on greater responsibility.

Trusted to Decide. Empowered to Lead.

Complex claims require experience, judgment, confidence, and the ability to make thoughtful decisions in uncertain and high-stakes situations. At Liberty Mutual, we trust our claims professionals to lead their work. In this role, you will be empowered to make timely decisions within your authority, while having access to experienced leaders, technical specialists, legal partners, and other resources when collaboration is needed.

About the Role

As a Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist, you will manage high-severity personal lines auto and homeowners liability claims involving significant injuries, complex liability questions, attorney representation, and litigation.

Responsibilities

  • Manages, investigates, and resolves claims. Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles claims within prescribed procedures and authority.
  • Recommends ultimate resolution on assigned cases in excess of their authority to local claims management and Home Office.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Prepares for and attends trials, hearings and conferences as required.
  • Communicates proactively and clearly with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims.
  • Responds to various written and telephone inquiries including status reports in a timely and professional manner.
  • Ensures adequacy of reserves. Recommends reserve increases on cases in excess of authority.
  • Contributes to a culture of innovation, positivity, and engagement through collaboration, continuous improvement, and active participation in team initiatives.
  • Effectively prepares and delivers presentations by gathering and organizing key information, identifying relevant facts and insights, tailoring content to the audience, and communicating information clearly, concisely, and professionally.
  • Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Responsible for managing the practices and billing activities of outside and in-house counsel.
  • May assist in the absence of the Claims Unit Manager, representing the company on matters involving state or federal regulatory agencies.
  • May be involved in special projects and/or mentoring at the direction of local management.

Ideal Experience Includes:

  • 5+ years managing complex and litigated casualty claims
  • Homeowners experience
  • Deep expertise handling severe to catastrophic injuries and fatalities
  • Strong analytical thinking, negotiation skills, and sound judgment
  • Ability to thrive in a fastpaced, highstakes environment
  • Professionalism, empathy, and exceptional communication skills

Competitive Bonus Opportunity

External candidates with an active FL or TX AllLines Adjuster License (CEs current) may qualify for a $2,500 signon bonus.

Where You Can Work:

If you live within 50 miles of one of our hub locations, the role is hybrid (2 days in office). Otherwise, it may be fully remote. Candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones would be most ideal as this position supports claims located in the Eastern Time Zones.

Hub Locations:


Chandler, AZ
Clifton Park, NY
Columbus, OH
Indianapolis, IN
Lake Mary, FL
Liberty Lake, WA
Marlton, NJ
Plano, TX
Suwanee, GA
Naperville, IL
Westborough, MA

Travel:10% for mediations, arbitrations, trials, or inperson events.

Your Expertise Opens Doors

Grow Here. Go Further.

Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist - Northeast Region

At Liberty Mutual, we do more than offer a job in claims. We offer the opportunity to build a lasting career. Trusted to Decide. Empowered to Lead.

Complex claims require experience, judgment, confidence, and the ability to make thoughtful decisions in uncertain and high-stakes situations. At Liberty Mutual, we trust our claims professionals to lead their work. In this role, you will be empowered to make timely decisions within your authority, while having access to experienced leaders, technical specialists, legal partners, and other resources when collaboration is needed.

About the Role

As a Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist, you will manage high-severity personal lines auto and homeowners liability claims involving significant injuries, complex liability questions, attorney representation, and litigation.

Responsibilities

  • Manages, investigates, and resolves claims. Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles claims within prescribed procedures and authority.
  • Recommends ultimate resolution on assigned cases in excess of their authority to local claims management and Home Office.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Prepares for and attends trials, hearings and conferences as required.
  • Communicates proactively and clearly with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims.
  • Responds to various written and telephone inquiries including status reports in a timely and professional manner.
  • Ensures adequacy of reserves. Recommends reserve increases on cases in excess of authority.
  • Contributes to a culture of innovation, positivity, and engagement through collaboration, continuous improvement, and active participation in team initiatives.
  • Effectively prepares and delivers presentations by gathering and organizing key information, identifying relevant facts and insights, tailoring content to the audience, and communicating information clearly, concisely, and professionally.
  • Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Responsible for managing the practices and billing activities of outside and in-house counsel.
  • May assist in the absence of the Claims Unit Manager, representing the company on matters involving state or federal regulatory agencies.
  • May be involved in special projects and/or mentoring at the direction of local management.

Ideal Experience Includes:

  • 5+ years managing complex and litigated casualty claims
  • Homeowners experience
  • Deep expertise handling severe to catastrophic injuries and fatalities
  • Strong analytical thinking, negotiation skills, and sound judgment
  • Ability to thrive in a fastpaced, highstakes environment
  • Professionalism, empathy, and exceptional communication skills

Competitive Bonus Opportunity

External candidates with an active FL or TX AllLines Adjuster License (CEs current) may qualify for a $2,500 signon bonus.

Where You Can Work:

If you live within 50 miles of one of our hub locations, the role is hybrid (2 days in office). Otherwise, it may be fully remote. Candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones would be most ideal as this position supports claims located in the Eastern Time Zones.

Description

At Liberty Mutual, we do more than offer a job in claims. We offer the opportunity to build a lasting career. Through ongoing development, coaching, technical training, mentoring, and internal mobility, we help high-performing and motivated claims professionals continue growing throughout their careers. Whether your long-term goals include people leadership, technical claims, litigation, specialty operations, quality, strategy, or another area of the business, we provide opportunities to expand your expertise and take on greater responsibility.

Trusted to Decide. Empowered to Lead.

Complex claims require experience, judgment, confidence, and the ability to make thoughtful decisions in uncertain and high-stakes situations. At Liberty Mutual, we trust our claims professionals to lead their work. In this role, you will be empowered to make timely decisions within your authority, while having access to experienced leaders, technical specialists, legal partners, and other resources when collaboration is needed.

About the Role

As a Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist, you will manage high-severity personal lines auto and homeowners liability claims involving significant injuries, complex liability questions, attorney representation, and litigation.

Responsibilities

  • Manages, investigates, and resolves claims. Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles claims within prescribed procedures and authority.
  • Recommends ultimate resolution on assigned cases in excess of their authority to local claims management and Home Office.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Prepares for and attends trials, hearings and conferences as required.
  • Communicates proactively and clearly with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims.
  • Responds to various written and telephone inquiries including status reports in a timely and professional manner.
  • Ensures adequacy of reserves. Recommends reserve increases on cases in excess of authority.
  • Contributes to a culture of innovation, positivity, and engagement through collaboration, continuous improvement, and active participation in team initiatives.
  • Effectively prepares and delivers presentations by gathering and organizing key information, identifying relevant facts and insights, tailoring content to the audience, and communicating information clearly, concisely, and professionally.
  • Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Responsible for managing the practices and billing activities of outside and in-house counsel.
  • May assist in the absence of the Claims Unit Manager, representing the company on matters involving state or federal regulatory agencies.
  • May be involved in special projects and/or mentoring at the direction of local management.

Ideal Experience Includes:

  • 5+ years managing complex and litigated casualty claims
  • Homeowners experience
  • Deep expertise handling severe to catastrophic injuries and fatalities
  • Strong analytical thinking, negotiation skills, and sound judgment
  • Ability to thrive in a fastpaced, highstakes environment

Description

Do You Thrive in a Fast-Paced Environment Where No Two Days Are Alike?

Join Our Auto Damage Appraisal Team.

We are looking for positive, high-energy, passionate auto damage appraisal professionals.

As a Desk or Hybrid Auto Damage Appraiser, you will be completing quality appraisals of damaged vehicles either virtually with reference to photos or occasionally in-person, to help our customers restore vehicles to their pre-loss condition. You will complete moderate to higher complexity claims within assigned authority limits. Daily expectations include explaining the repair process and damage details to our customers, writing original and supplemental damage estimates, making total loss determinations and valuations, negotiating with auto body shops on repair strategies and costs, and occasionally conducting independent adjuster appraisal re-inspections. You will provide best-in-class service to our internal and external customers and need to have strong analytical, organizational and multi-tasking skills, and be a time management expert. We look for people who are creative, love problem solving, and have a passion for helping others. Your job involves speaking to and engaging with customers who have just been in an accident and need your help and this is where the passion for service comes into play. We strive to treat our customers as we would want to be treated!

Location:

  • With ample growth opportunities, you are in-charge of your future. If you are selected for one of our Desk Appraisal roles, the position will offer a hybrid at-home and in-office work schedule in one of our hub office locations, including Liberty Lake, WA, Chandler, AZ, Naperville, IL, or Plano, TX.
  • If you are selected for a Hybrid Appraisal role, you may be based near one of those office locations or in a remote location where we have need for in-person Appraisal support.

Training:

  • Training is a critical component to your success and that success starts with reliable attendance.
  • Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory.

Responsibilities:

  • An Empathetic Service Professional: When a claim is received, you skillfully use your customer centricity skills to confidently assure our customers that you are there to guide them through the process.
  • A Front Lines Liaison: You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in delivering on our promise.
  • A Reliable Teammate: Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules and the varying needs of our customers.
  • A Problem Solver: Integrity is in your nature and critical thinking is part of your decision-making process. That means you sincerely care that customers get exactly what they paid for and need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.
  • Using multiple software systems and claims best practices, you will prepare itemized appraisals indicating costs of parts, materials and labor necessary to restore damaged vehicles to their pre-damage condition.
  • You will provide technical advice on vehicle repair, parts costs, garage expertise and opinions on specific damages.
  • You will complete auto body shop, independent re-inspections, and supplements as warranted to verify damage or confirm repairs are completed.
  • You will resolve disagreements and negotiate with auto body shops, Independent Adjusters, claimants and policyholders and assist claims management in the resolution of complaints and evaluate claims for potential fraud or subrogation.
  • May be called upon for catastrophe duty.
Qualifications

Qualifications

  • An engaging, outgoing personality, a passion for helping customers, and demonstrated ability to effectively communicate in both written and verbal form.
  • Extensive knowledge of automobile parts and repair techniques, terminology and vehicle construction.
  • Prior experience using auto estimating software, CCC Pathways, Audatex, Mitchell, etc.
  • Requires strong negotiation, analytical, decision-making, organizational and computer skills, as well as the ability to work with multi-faceted systems.
  • A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and 1-3 years of directly related experience.
  • Auto Damage Appraisal Licensing and certification are required.
  • Varying conditions may be encountered while inspecting vehicles.
  • Must be able to work outside in inclement weather conditions and drive substantial distances.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be required to complete inspections of damaged vehicles which will include but not be limited to inspecting the underside of and around vehicles, inspecting vehicles in tight quarters at body shops and salvage yards, etc.

About this job

Complete auto damage appraisals for insurance claims, working virtually with photos or occasionally in-person. Responsibilities include writing repair estimates, determining total loss valuations, and negotiating with auto body shops.

Good fit if you have auto damage appraisal licensing, 1-3 years of related experience, and knowledge of estimating software like CCC Pathways or Mitchell.

Full job description


Description

Do You Thrive in a Fast-Paced Environment Where No Two Days Are Alike?

Join Our Auto Damage Appraisal Team.

We are looking for positive, high-energy, passionate auto damage appraisal professionals.

As a Desk or Hybrid Auto Damage Appraiser, you will be completing quality appraisals of damaged vehicles either virtually with reference to photos or occasionally in-person, to help our customers restore vehicles to their pre-loss condition. You will complete moderate to higher complexity claims within assigned authority limits. Daily expectations include explaining the repair process and damage details to our customers, writing original and supplemental damage estimates, making total loss determinations and valuations, negotiating with auto body shops on repair strategies and costs, and occasionally conducting independent adjuster appraisal re-inspections. You will provide best-in-class service to our internal and external customers and need to have strong analytical, organizational and multi-tasking skills, and be a time management expert. We look for people who are creative, love problem solving, and have a passion for helping others. Your job involves speaking to and engaging with customers who have just been in an accident and need your help and this is where the passion for service comes into play. We strive to treat our customers as we would want to be treated!

Location:

  • With ample growth opportunities, you are in-charge of your future. If you are selected for one of our Desk Appraisal roles, the position will offer a hybrid at-home and in-office work schedule in one of our hub office locations, including Liberty Lake, WA, Chandler, AZ, Naperville, IL, or Plano, TX.
  • If you are selected for a Hybrid Appraisal role, you may be based near one of those office locations or in a remote location where we have need for in-person Appraisal support.

Training:

  • Training is a critical component to your success and that success starts with reliable attendance.
  • Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory.

Responsibilities:

  • An Empathetic Service Professional: When a claim is received, you skillfully use your customer centricity skills to confidently assure our customers that you are there to guide them through the process.
  • A Front Lines Liaison: You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in delivering on our promise.
  • A Reliable Teammate: Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules and the varying needs of our customers.
  • A Problem Solver: Integrity is in your nature and critical thinking is part of your decision-making process. That means you sincerely care that customers get exactly what they paid for and need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.
  • Using multiple software systems and claims best practices, you will prepare itemized appraisals indicating costs of parts, materials and labor necessary to restore damaged vehicles to their pre-damage condition.
  • You will provide technical advice on vehicle repair, parts costs, garage expertise and opinions on specific damages.
  • You will complete auto body shop, independent re-inspections, and supplements as warranted to verify damage or confirm repairs are completed.
  • You will resolve disagreements and negotiate with auto body shops, Independent Adjusters, claimants and policyholders and assist claims management in the resolution of complaints and evaluate claims for potential fraud or subrogation.
  • May be called upon for catastrophe duty.
Qualifications

Qualifications

  • An engaging, outgoing personality, a passion for helping customers, and demonstrated ability to effectively communicate in both written and verbal form.
  • Extensive knowledge of automobile parts and repair techniques, terminology and vehicle construction.
  • Prior experience using auto estimating software, CCC Pathways, Audatex, Mitchell, etc.
  • Requires strong negotiation, analytical, decision-making, organizational and computer skills, as well as the ability to work with multi-faceted systems.
  • A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and 1-3 years of directly related experience.
  • Auto Damage Appraisal Licensing and certification are required.
  • Varying conditions may be encountered while inspecting vehicles.
  • Must be able to work outside in inclement weather conditions and drive substantial distances.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be required to complete inspections of damaged vehicles which will include but not be limited to inspecting the underside of and around vehicles, inspecting vehicles in tight quarters at body shops and salvage yards, etc.

SAP Configuration Engineer supporting general ledger configuration and maintenance for Liberty Mutual's OneGL finance environment. Good fit if you have 2-3+ years of SAP Finance experience with 1-2+ years of hands-on general ledger configuration and at least one implementation project.

Full job description


Description

We deliver our customers peace of mind every day by helping them protect what they value most. Our passion for placing the customer at the center of everything we do is driving a transformational shift at Liberty Mutual. Job Introduction:

The Global Finance Technology organization is looking to hire a SAP Configuration Engineer to join the OneGL team, supporting the OneGL BAU, US2.2, and LII releases. The primary focus of this role will be supporting the SAP general ledger, with opportunities to learn and support other SAP FICO areas, including Fixed Assets (FA) and Reporting, as well as related areas such as SAP Master Data Governance (MDG). Under supervision, this individual would be responsible for analyzing, developing, and configuring new business requirements and enhancements in the SAP general ledger. This role would entail supporting production users and configuration/testing/training to support maintenance and enhancement of the OneGL finance environment supporting the financial month-end close process.

About the job:

  • Maps business requirements to SAP system capabilities to support functional and technical solutions.
  • Configures SAP general ledger system settings and options (such as company codes, chart of accounts, ledgers, account determination, and posting rules), and over time, settings in other FICO areas such as FA and Reporting, executes unit and integration testing, and documents functional and technical specifications.
  • Develops and maintains an understanding of the integrations related to the general ledger, including upstream source systems and subledger feeds, downstream reporting and consolidation, and the interfaces, data mappings, and reconciliation points between them.
  • Supports the monthly financial close by monitoring close activities, responding to production issues during close windows, and configuring period-end settings such as posting periods, accruals, foreign currency valuation, and intercompany processing.
  • Develops understanding of current business processes and system practices to support ongoing configuration and enhancement activities.
  • Performs troubleshooting and resolves defect issues, including posting errors, reconciliation breaks, and close-blocking issues, and traces issues across integrated systems to identify root cause, in collaboration with senior team members and subject matter experts.
  • Identifies test scenarios and cases with product owners, executes test cases (including end-to-end integration scenarios), documents test results and test scripts, and provides quality assurance results to the business.
  • Supports pieces of the implementation process such as post-implementation support, cutover activities, and documentation.
  • Participates in team discussions around system optimization and efficiency opportunities, including opportunities to streamline the close process.

In Addition to the Qualifications Listed Below, the Ideal Candidate Will Also Have:

  • Working understanding of financial transactional flow and SAP general ledger concepts such as company codes, chart of accounts, ledgers, coding blocks, profit centers, cost centers, and currencies.
  • Familiarity with how data flows into and out of the general ledger, such as subledger postings, interface files, and reporting extracts, and an interest in learning the integrations that support it.
  • Foundational understanding of month-end close processes, including accruals, foreign currency valuation, intercompany, and reconciliation, and a willingness to support the close calendar, including occasional extended hours during peak close periods.
  • Exposure to, or interest in learning, other SAP FICO areas such as Fixed Assets, and financial reporting, as well as master data governance concepts (such as SAP MDG).
  • Demonstrated curiosity and eagerness to deepen technical and functional expertise within the SAP Finance space and broader finance technology landscape.
  • Good communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to work with ambiguous and incomplete information.
  • Working knowledge of agile software development concepts including backlog tracking, participation in scrum ceremonies, and incremental delivery.
  • A growth mindset with a desire to develop within the SAP Finance configuration job family, taking on increasing responsibility over time as expertise and confidence grow.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor degree in technical or business discipline or equivalent experience
  • Minimum 2-3+ years of technical/functional SAP Finance experience.
  • Minimum 1-2+ years of hands-on experience with SAP general ledger configuration, including involvement in at least one implementation or system enhancement.
  • The ideal candidate will have the ability to quickly learn new technical concepts and have strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Suwanee, GA

About this job

Liberty Mutual seeks a Claims Resolution Specialist to investigate, evaluate, and settle bodily injury claims directly with injured parties. No prior bodily injury claims experience required; position offers clear growth path with two days in-office monthly minimum after training.

Good fit if you have strong communication and negotiation skills, customer service experience, and can obtain proper licensing as required.

Full job description


Description

Advance your career with our Personal Lines Casualty Team!

No bodily injury claims experience required!

Take the next step in your development with meaningful work and clear growth path.

The Bodily Injury Claims Specialist will investigate, manage and resolve Bodily Injury claims assigned directly with injured parties, as well as assist in providing service to policyholders.

All qualified applicants will reside within a 50-mile radius of the Indianapolis / Lake Mary / Suwanee office.

The start date for the role is February 8, 2027.

There may be several in-office days per month for the first few months following initial virtual training to support your learning and to build relationships with leaders and others in the department. This position requires a minimum of two days in office per month as the standard beyond the training period, with occasional additional days for special meetings a few times a year.

Training is a critical component to your success and that success starts with reliable attendance. Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory.


In a high performing culture,WEin PL Core:

  • Strive to be better tomorrow than today; little improvements lead to big ones!
  • Embrace change.We may need to let go of what's familiar in order to embrace and try something new.
  • Understandhow our individual work contributes to our teams, our organizations and the company
  • Are adaptable and resilient. Change is imperative to being better tomorrow and resiliency allows us to handle unexpected challenges
  • Are an exporter of Talent.We maintain a focus on development and growth.
  • Contribute positively; We come to work every day with the intent to make a positive impact on our work and on everyone around us. One positive interaction with you can turn someone's day around.

Responsibilities:

  • Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles Bodily Injury claims directly with injured parties, within prescribed authority levels.
  • Pursues proactive contact with injured parties through various creative means to connect, listen, empathize and make early settlement offers whenever appropriate to resolve injury claims.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Communicates with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims; refers tasks to auxiliary resources as necessary and advises as to proper course of action. Sends and responds to various written, telephone and SMS text inquiries to pursue resolution of the claim.
  • Ensures adequacy of reserves.
  • Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Makes effective use of loss management tools and techniques to ensure accuracy in decision making.
  • Keeps files updated with clear documentation for ease in understanding the status of investigations, evaluations and negotiations throughout the claim life cycle.
Qualifications
  • Strong written and oral communication skills required.
  • Good interpersonal, analytical, investigative, and negotiation skills required.
  • Customer service experience preferred.
  • Growth mindset; adapts well to change including new standard work and new tools
  • Basic knowledge of legal liability, general insurance policy coverage and State Tort Law preferred.
  • Liability experience or policy and claims knowledge preferred.

Description

In today's rapidly evolving cyber landscape, our insureds face increasingly complex threats from ransomware and business email compromise to largescale data breaches. Liberty Mutual has an immediate opening for a Claims Officer, NAS Cyber Claims position.

As a Cyber Claim Officer, you will manage highexposure, often timesensitive matters, working closely with breach coaches, forensic investigators, underwriters, actuaries and cybersecurity experts. You will play a critical role in helping organizations respond to emergent cyber incidents and privacy, media and technology errors & omissions litigation, ensuring a confident and coordinated response, and shaping best practices in our cyber claims strategy. This is a highimpact opportunity for someone who thrives on novel issues, technical complexity, fastmoving incidents, and collaborative problemsolving.

Responsibilities

  • Analyzes, investigates, and evaluates the loss to determine coverage and claim disposition.
  • Utilizes CMS to document claims and to diary future events or follow-up.
  • Within prescribed settlement authority, establishes appropriate reserves for both indemnity and expense and reviews on a regular basis to ensure adequacy.
  • Makes recommendations to set reserves at appropriate level for claims outside of authority level.
  • Prepares comprehensive reports as required. Identifies and communicates specific claim trends and account and/or policy issues to management and underwriting.
  • Manages the litigation process through the retention of counsel.
  • Adheres to the line of business litigation guidelines to include budget, bill review and payment.
  • Pro-actively manages the case resolution process.
  • Actively participates in mediations and arbitrations, as well as negotiation discussions within limit of settlement authority.
  • Participates in the claims audit process.
  • Provides claims marketing services by meeting with brokers, risk managers and reinsurers.
  • As required, maintains insurance adjuster licenses.

Additional CyberSpecific Responsibilities Added:

  • Coordinates incident response activities with breach coaches, forensic firms, crisiscommunications teams, and cybersecurity vendors during active cyber events.
  • Evaluates forensic findings (e.g., Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR), Forensic Accounting) and integrates conclusions into coverage and liability decisions.
  • Advises insureds on recovery strategies, including business interruption documentation, data restoration processes, and postincident cyberhygiene improvements.
  • Engages in thought leadership such as panel presentations, white papers, conference attendance, etc.

You will be required to go into the office twice a month if you reside within 50 miles of one of the following offices: Westborough, MA; Boston, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Chandler, AZ; Las Vegas, NV; Plano, TX; or Suwanee, GA. Please note this policy is subject to change.

Qualifications
  • Bachelors' and/or advanced degree
  • 10 + years claims experience, with at least 5 years within a technical specialty. Advanced Cyber claims experience preferred.
  • Highly advanced knowledge of claims handling concepts, practices and techniques, to include but not limited to coverage issues, and product line knowledge
  • Functional knowledge of law and insurance regulations in various jurisdictions
  • Demonstrated superior verbal and written communications skills
  • Highest level of advanced analytical, decision making and negotiation skills

About this job

Travelers Insurance seeks a Senior Cybersecurity Technologist in Atlanta to manage enterprise CyberArk privileged access management systems. The role involves architecting and maintaining self-hosted PAM components, developing custom automation, and advancing the organization's move toward password-less authentication.

Good fit if you have hands-on experience with self-hosted CyberArk PAM in production, strong PowerShell skills, and knowledge of Windows/Linux/Active Directory security.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$129,600.00 - $213,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

At Travelers, our Cybersecurity Engineering teams are responsible for the overall implementation and management of strategic platforms that provide oversight, process management, protection and enablement of security control processes and allow for an effective Cybersecurity practice.

As a Cybersecurity Engineer II, you will provide subject matter expertise and consultation on complex cybersecurity platforms to ensure correct installation, configuration, and maintenance. You will consult with business partners on any changes and/or enhancements and will effectively communicate potential operational impacts. Leveraging your technical expertise on strategic platforms, you will troubleshoot complex issues that may be escalated and provide guidance and coaching to team members.

What Will You Do?

  • Own the architecture, deployment, and lifecycle of self-hosted CyberArk components, including the Password Vault Web Access (PVWA), Central Policy Manager (CPM), and Privileged Session Manager (PSM/PSMP).
  • Maintain platform configurations, safe structures, access policies, and master policy settings that align with least-privilege and separation-of-duties principles.
  • Onboard privileged accounts and secrets across Windows, Linux/Unix, databases, network devices, and cloud platforms, developing custom CPM plugins and connectors where out-of-the-box support falls short.
  • Lead vault resilience efforts, including disaster recovery, high-availability configuration, backup validation, and version upgrades with minimal disruption.
  • Build automation for onboarding, reconciliation, reporting, and health monitoring using the CyberArk REST API, PowerShell, and related tooling.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across the PAM stack, from connection component failures and PSM recordings to CPM rotation errors and vault performance tuning.
  • Document standards and runbooks and contribute to the technical maturity of the broader team.
  • Help advance our privileged access roadmap toward password-less and modern authentication by reducing reliance on static credentials through ephemeral, certificate-based, and just-in-time access models, and tighter integration with our broader identity platform.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Hands-on experience operating self-hosted (on-premises) CyberArk PAM in a production enterprise environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of the full CyberArk component set: Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM/PSMP, and familiarity with PTA, Conjur, or CyberArk's SaaS offerings.
  • Experience developing custom connection components and CPM plugins for non-standard platforms.
  • Proficiency with the CyberArk REST API and scripting in PowerShell (Python a plus) to automate operational tasks.
  • Solid command of Windows Server and Active Directory, with working knowledge of Linux/Unix privileged access models.
  • Practical understanding of authentication protocols and PKI concepts (LDAP, SAML, Kerberos, certificates) as they relate to PAM.
  • Understanding of just-in-time and zero-standing-privilege access models, and how to move a program from static, always-on credentials toward ephemeral access.
  • Working knowledge of password-less and certificate-based authentication concepts, and how they apply to privileged access.
  • Experience integrating PAM with the surrounding identity and operations ecosystem IdP/SSO (Entra ID, Okta), ITSM (ServiceNow), SIEM, and secrets consumers via API.
  • Experience evaluating, piloting, or integrating new capabilities into an existing PAM program - able to weigh build-vs-buy tradeoffs and plan phased rollouts.
  • A track record of leading upgrades, migrations, or resilience improvements in a self-hosted deployment.
  • CyberArk certifications (Defender, Sentry, or Guardian).
  • Exposure to hybrid and cloud privileged access patterns (AWS, Azure).
  • Experience supporting privileged access in a regulated industry.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, similar degree, or its equivalent in work experience.
  • 4 years of experience in Information Technology Security Engineering or Software engineering.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. Job Summary

About the Role

The Enterprise Learning Training Design Manager will lead the CAS Training Design team in developing high-quality, scalable learning experiences that improve employee capabilities, operational performance, retention, and business results across Farmers.

This role manages Learning Experience Designers, Content Developers, and rotational design resources, providing direction, coaching, and quality oversight to ensure learning solutions meet consistent instructional, visual design, accessibility, and technical standards.

The team is evolving from a traditional trainer-led delivery model toward a modern, capability-based learning ecosystem that embeds learning into everyday work through technology, performance support, and leaders as teachers. As a key leader in this transformation, you will help determine the most effective learning approach for each business need, whether that means developing an interactive digital module, a concise job aid, a short video, or resources that enable supervisors to coach employees directly.

The ideal candidate combines strong instructional design expertise with people leadership, attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to balance quality, speed, and business impact in a fast-paced environment.

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead, coach, and develop Learning Experience Designers and Content Developers, promoting high-quality work and continuous improvement.
  • Establish and maintain instructional design, visual design, accessibility, and technical quality standards across learning materials.
  • Review learning assets and provide actionable feedback to improve instructional effectiveness, usability, and learner experience.
  • Manage team workload, project priorities, resource allocation, and deadlines to ensure efficient and timely delivery.
  • Guide the selection of appropriate learning solutions, including e-learning, videos, job aids, performance support, and supervisor-led coaching.
  • Partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to align learning solutions with operational needs and business objectives.
  • Drive the evolution toward a scalable, capability-based learning model that embeds learning into everyday work.
  • Promote the use of learning technologies, innovative design practices, and AI tools to improve development efficiency and learning outcomes.
  • Develop reusable frameworks, templates, and best practices to improve consistency, scalability, and team effectiveness.
  • Identify opportunities to improve learning processes, content quality, and business performance through continuous evaluation and innovation.

Experience Requirements

  • Significant experience in instructional design, learning experience design, training development, educational technology, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, or coaching design professionals or content development teams.
  • Strong understanding of instructional design methodologies, adult learning principles, and digital learning development.
  • Experience reviewing learning materials and providing detailed feedback on instructional effectiveness, visual design, accessibility, usability, and technical quality.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, balancing team capacity, prioritizing requests, and delivering high-quality work within established timelines.
  • Ability to evaluate business needs and recommend appropriate learning solutions based on complexity, urgency, scalability, and expected impact.
  • Experience with e-learning development tools, digital learning platforms, and multimedia learning solutions.
  • Strong understanding of visual design principles, content structure, learner experience, and accessibility considerations.

  • Strong coaching, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Marketing Decision Scientist to drive marketing measurement and media effectiveness through incrementality testing, causal inference, and advanced analytics. This role will partner with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver actionable insights that optimize media investments and improve business outcomes.

Team Function

The Media Measurement & Analytics team supports the media teams in executing and optimizing media budgets by providing analytical rigor to investment decisions. The team executes incrementality tests, builds measurement models, and reports on performance.

Role Description

This role will be responsible for:

  • Planning and implementing incrementality tests
  • Developing other forms of marketing measurement to provide a full picture of marketing effectiveness.
  • Communicating results to leadership and stakeholders.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable interpreting results of analyses to stakeholders across a wide range of seniority, from entry-level to C-suite. They will be able to clearly communicate actionable insights that will improve marketing efficiency.

Education Requirements

Bachelor's degree in a technical field.

Experience Requirements

  • Experience applying causal inference tools (Difference-in-Differences, synthetic controls, propensity score matching) to real-life problems.
  • Experience with experimental design and incrementality testing.
  • At least 3 years of experience in Analytics and/or Data Science.
  • Experience working with large and complex datasets.
  • Working knowledge of R or Python, SQL, and Power BI.
  • Fluency in English

Job Summary

WORKPLACE: REMOTE

About the Role

The Learning Experience Designer will design, develop, and evaluate learning solutions that improve employee capabilities, operational performance, and business results across Farmers.

Our CAS Training Design team is building a modern learning ecosystem that embeds learning directly into everyday work, helping employees access the knowledge and resources they need to perform at their best. The team supports frontline contact center operations, back-office functions, and the leaders who guide them, using innovative learning approaches and technology to improve performance, retention, and growth.

In this role, you will work closely with business leaders, supervisors, team coaches, and subject matter experts to understand operational challenges and develop practical learning solutions. You will observe employees in their work environment, identify performance gaps, and translate those insights into effective training materials and performance support resources.

The ideal candidate has strong instructional design fundamentals, experience developing training for back-office, non-phone, or vendor-facing teams, and the ability to work independently while building strong relationships with operational teams at an FBS hub

Essential Job Functions

  • Design, develop, and evaluate learning experiences from initial needs analysis through implementation and measurement.
  • Create training materials for back-office, non-phone, and vendor-facing teams, including e-learning, instructor-led training, virtual sessions, videos, job aids, and performance support resources.
  • Partner with business leaders, supervisors, team coaches, and subject matter experts to understand operational workflows and learning needs.
  • Conduct on-site observations, job shadowing, and side-by-side assessments to understand how employees perform their work and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate observations and business requirements into practical learning solutions that support real-world performance.
  • Recommend the most appropriate learning format based on business objectives, audience needs, complexity, timelines, and available resources.
  • Support the adoption of new tools, processes, and ways of working through learning materials and change support initiatives.
  • Collaborate with supervisors and team coaches to embed learning into daily workflows and reinforce employee capabilities.
  • Apply adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies to develop engaging, effective, and accessible learning experiences.
  • Use learning technologies and AI-enabled tools to improve content development and delivery.
  • Evaluate learning effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve training materials, employee performance, and business outcomes.
  • Maintain consistent instructional design standards and quality across all learning deliverables.
  • Work independently at an FBS hub while maintaining alignment with the broader CAS Training Design team, established standards, and quality expectations.
  • Share instructional design knowledge and best practices with subject matter experts and business partners to strengthen learning capabilities across the organization.

Experience Requirements

  • Experience in instructional design, learning experience design, training development, or a related field.
  • Strong instructional design fundamentals and knowledge of adult learning principles.
  • Experience designing and developing learning solutions for operational teams, particularly back-office, non-phone, or vendor-facing environments.
  • Experience conducting needs analysis, identifying performance gaps, and translating business requirements into learning solutions.
  • Experience developing learning materials such as e-learning, instructor-led training, videos, job aids, and performance support resources.
  • Ability to conduct job shadowing, observe employees in their work environment, and use findings to improve learning solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with supervisors, team coaches, and subject matter experts.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and deliver high-quality work while collaborating with a broader team.
  • Fluent English, with the ability to communicate effectively with international stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with learning technologies and digital content development tools.
  • Experience supporting change management, process adoption, or operational transformation is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred in Instructional Design, Learning Design, Adult Learning, Educational Technology, Human-Centered Design, Learning Analytics, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards, Universal Design for Learning, performance improvement, service design, or technical documentation is an advantage.

Additional Qualification

Ability to work on multiple projects at the same time with coinciding deadlines. Strong interpersonal, communications, presentation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to use the suite of Microsoft Office products including Word, PowerPoint.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chicago, IL
  • Experience: 3+ years

About this job

Remote bodily injury adjuster handling represented and litigation claims, primarily in California, western states, and Illinois. Investigates auto accidents, assesses coverage and liability, and negotiates settlements with customers and attorneys.

Good fit if you have 3+ years of casualty represented or litigation third-party claim handling experience and can work independently.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Represented/Litigation Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job:

The individual selected for this role will join a team who primarily handles claims in the following states: CA, other western states and/or IL

As a Represented/Litigation adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

* Candidates in the Pacific, Mountain and Central Time Zones preferred*

**This position is not available for California (Unless you have litigation background and 3 years experience in litigation), Alaska, Hawaii, Washington, or Puerto Rico residents.**

The first approximately 6-9 weeks of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.

Allstate Benefits
Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visitwww.allstategoodlife.comto learn more.

Youll wear a few hats to fill a few roles throughout your day that all require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expertyoull live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in eachcasualtyclaim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate casualty (and applicable LOB (line of business)) claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solveryoull utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3+years of Casualty Represented or Litigation third-party claim handling experienceespecially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

Notice of Licensing Requirement

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign-On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign-On Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designate Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

*Candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.*


Allstate Benefits:


Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

About this job

Field Property Claims Adjuster conducting virtual and on-site investigations to assess property damage, determine liability, and negotiate settlements. Work independently in a hybrid role covering Duluth, Brainerd, and Grand Rapids with paid training and potential for 1-3 catastrophe deployments per year.

Good fit if you have a high school diploma, valid driver's license, customer service experience, and are comfortable climbing ladders and working in confined spaces.

Full job description

We are Farmers – where ambition meets opportunity.

At Farmers, we're not just known for unforgettable jingle – we're a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people's lives. We deliver peace of mind when it matters most. Our results-driven, high-performance culture thrives on creativity, accountability and bold solutions. Here, growth isn't just a goal – it's a way of life for both the organization and every individual on our team. We tackle challenges head-on, learn from every experience and measure our impact on the customers who trust us.

Join an award-winning, equal opportunity employer, where you'll find more than a job – you'll find a supportive community. Enjoy competitive benefits, take part in meaningful volunteer projects, and help shape the future alongside talented colleagues across all backgrounds. At Farmers, helping others is at the heart of what we do.

Ready to make your mark? Discover our vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate. Connect with us on Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok, and let's build something incredible together!

Workplace: Remote ( #LI-Remote )

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered.

If you are looking for the following in your next career...

  • Paid training through the award-winning and industry-leading University of Farmers.
  • Flexibility and independence to work outside the confines of a desk job.
  • Total Rewards Benefits Package: 401K and a competitive starting salary.
  • Rapid growth potential and management opportunities for success-oriented people through education, mentorship programs, and inspirational leadership at a company you can be proud of.

… Then Farmers Insurance is the place for you!

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Claims Adjuster

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders' residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days.

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

If You Have the Following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable. Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

... then this could be a great career opportunity for you!

Final candidate qualifications may be reviewed against the requirements for the associated level of this role.

  • Climb Ladders to inspect roofs, and be comfortable working on rooftops, multiple times per day,
  • Work in small, confined spaces that have been damaged; such as attics and crawlspaces.
  • Achieve a minimum passing score on all claims training exams.

Physical Actions and Environment
