Company Details

Berkley Surety is a highly professional, service-oriented surety underwriting management company, providing a full spectrum of bonds for contract, environmental, and commercial surety accounts through multiple distribution channels in both the United States and Canada. We write on behalf of W. R. Berkley Corporation member company Berkley Insurance Company, which has an A.M. Best rating of A+ (Superior). We pride ourselves on building strong relationships with our agents. We highly value the insight and expertise our agency partners bring to the table which helps us provide timely and predictable surety solutions.

Company URL: www.berkleysurety.com

Responsibilities

Serves as lead underwriter for assigned field offices as front line for either the commercial or contract departments or both. Underwrites new and renewal business with limited supervision. Supports the Head of Underwriting in balancing the needs to achieve budgeted financial results (premium volume, loss ratio, premium collections and expense management including commissions) with effective price management through sound underwriting practices in an effort to produce profitable results. Serve as lead in Book of Business reviews and assist Head of Underwriting in portfolio management. Positively interacts and collaborates with the field underwriters in assigned territory as well as other critical internal/external business associates.

Key Functions/Duties of Position: Describe the overall job responsibilities (including any decision-making authority) for this position.

  • Provide approvals, with conditions as necessary, or declinations within prescribed authority limits in a timely and understandable manner consistent with BSG guidelines and goals. Make recommendations to Head of Underwriting on a course of action for approval or declination as well as overall policy positions and underwriting guidelines.
  • Review and underwrite new and renewal business from assigned field offices in the primary line of business Analyze submitted data, determine and obtain additional information when needed. Make decisions on approvals/declinations within prescribed authority limits. On accounts or bond requests over authority limits provide recommendations on course of action in a concise and timely manner.
  • Effectively communicates recommendations and decisions with confidence, clear communication, good listening skills, professionalism, and empathy with the goal to be a trusted adviser and valued partner to all parties.
  • Plans and executes regular travel to develop and enhance new and existing producer and account relationships. Visits new and existing accounts; prepares and shares meeting agendas, obtains follow up documentation, evaluates the accounts for appropriate action.
  • Interact and collaborate with assigned field offices, Home Office colleagues, reinsurers and other critical business associates. Maintain and manage workflow, including effective communications, with assigned field office meeting all company standards and expectations.
  • Participate in BSG senior management decisions as respects developing or improving underwriting procedures, guidelines and policy.
  • Effectively evaluates bond forms and other relevant documents in an effort to assess risk.
  • Keeps Head of Underwriting apprised of issues of importance to BSG.
  • Submit Special Acceptance requests to reinsurers for large capacity accounts.
  • Develop and train other team members such as Sr. Underwriters, Underwriters, Associates Underwriters and Trainees as appropriate.

Qualifications

  • Position involves a high degree of analytical and communication skills with the capacity to communicate this knowledge and expertise to others within BSG.
  • Is considered and expert in their ability to read, analyze, discuss and interpret financial statements, bond forms, supporting documents, and government regulations and reach appropriate risk assessment conclusions.
  • Provides well developed reasons for approvals/declinations as well as recommendations in support of new and existing accounts and specific bond needs over granted authority limits.
  • Communicate difficult decisions/positions in the face of counter positions.
  • Effective oral and written communication skills with the ability to write clear and effective reports and business correspondence so that others will clearly understand the content and the intent.
  • Ability to solve practical problems and appropriately deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.
  • Organize and adjust workflow to adapt to periods of high activity and demands with the ability to work independently and in a team environment
  • Self-motivation and an out-going orientation with strong customer focus
  • Provide coaching, mentoring and leadership to others.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in the use of automation tools provided by BSG (i.e. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Lotus Notes, U/W System, etc.)

Education Requirement:

  • Minimum 4-year degree or related industry experience
  • Business/Finance/Accounting Majors preferred, but not required
  • 10 years of Surety industry or related experience required
  • Prior experience in a branch or field office management is suggested.

Responsibilities

Lead the enterprise actuarial, analytics, and portfolio intelligence agenda so that pricing, reserving, capital, reinsurance, planning, and growth decisions consistently improve risk-adjusted returns. The Chief Actuarial Officer translates complex risk into clear choices, builds trusted decision systems, and develops the next generation of actuarial and analytical leadership.

Reporting to the President, the Chief Actuarial Officer is a member of the executive leadership team and the senior actuarial voice for the operating unit. The role owns the integrity and strategic application of actuarial work across pricing, reserving, forecasting, portfolio management, capital and reinsurance support, regulatory matters, and data-enabled decision making. The leader partners closely with the President, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Underwriting Officer, Chief Claims Officer, distribution leaders, and corporate actuarial stakeholders.

Over the five-year horizon, success requires moving beyond production of actuarial indications and reports toward an integrated decision-intelligence model. The Chief Actuarial Officer will establish governed, explainable, repeatable analytics; accelerate feedback loops; identify emerging risk early; and enable leaders to act with confidence while preserving actuarial standards, sound judgment, and appropriate human oversight.

Enterprise Strategy and Executive Decision Support

  • Serve as a strategic partner to the President and executive team, connecting actuarial insight to operating strategy, growth priorities, geographic expansion, product appetite, expense management, and risk-adjusted return objectives.
  • Frame choices through scenarios, ranges, sensitivities, trade-offs, and leading indicators rather than relying only on point estimates or historical summaries.
  • Own the actuarial narrative for quarterly results, annual operating plans, reforecasts, and corporate reviews, with clear explanations of performance drivers and corrective actions.
  • Create a multi-year actuarial and analytics roadmap aligned with enterprise priorities, technology capabilities, talent needs, and governance expectations.

Pricing, Portfolio Steering, and Product Economics

  • Lead pricing adequacy, rate-level, trend, loss-cost, retention, mix, and new-business analyses across Small Commercial and Middle Market package products, Commercial Auto, Workers Compensation, Umbrella, and other assigned lines.
  • Build portfolio steering capabilities that connect indicated need, achieved rate, underwriting action, exposure change, retention, claims emergence, and profitability at actionable segment levels.
  • Partner with underwriting and distribution leadership to define profitable growth guardrails, market and segment priorities, and measurable action plans.
  • Provide actuarial leadership for product development, coverage changes, filings, and experimentation, including disciplined test design, monitoring, and post-implementation evaluation.
  • Advance risk segmentation and price optimization practices while protecting fairness, explainability, regulatory compliance, and sound underwriting judgment.

Reserving, Financial Insight, and Prospective Risk

  • Own the operating unit reserving process and recommendations, including methods, assumptions, diagnostics, documentation, peer review readiness, and communication of uncertainty.
  • Connect reserve analysis with claims operations, underwriting actions, social and economic inflation, legal environment changes, catastrophe activity, and shifts in exposure or mix.
  • Develop prospective views of loss emergence and profitability using actual-versus-expected diagnostics, early-warning indicators, scenario analysis, and stress testing.
  • Partner with Finance on premium, loss, expense, cash-flow, and earnings forecasts; annual planning; and explanations of material variances.
  • Maintain readiness for auditors, regulators, rating agencies, corporate actuarial reviews, and other authorized oversight.

Capital, Reinsurance, Catastrophe, and Emerging Risk

  • Provide actuarial insight for capital allocation, risk appetite, volatility, accumulation, and return-on-equity decisions at line, segment, product, and portfolio levels.
  • Partner on ceded reinsurance strategy, structure evaluation, renewal analytics, exposure data quality, and assessment of retained volatility.
  • Advance catastrophe and climate-related risk analysis appropriate to the portfolio, including geographic concentration, hazard change, model uncertainty, and mitigation opportunities.
  • Establish a repeatable emerging-risk process covering cyber, autonomous and connected technologies, supply-chain disruption, litigation and social inflation, economic regime shifts, and other material exposures.
  • Translate stress and scenario results into practical underwriting, claims, product, reinsurance, and growth recommendations.

Data, AI, Decision Systems, and Model Governance

  • Own the actuarial data and analytics strategy in partnership with technology, data, underwriting, claims, finance, compliance, and corporate stakeholders.
  • Create governed data products and a consistent source of truth for pricing, reserving, plan, actual-versus-expected, rate and retention, exposure, and portfolio performance reporting.
  • Sponsor responsible use of predictive analytics, machine learning, generative AI, and automation where they improve speed, quality, insight, or scalability.
  • Implement model inventory, ownership, validation, documentation, change control, performance monitoring, bias and fairness review, explainability, access controls, and human-judgment standards proportionate to model risk.
  • Ensure automated outputs are reproducible, auditable, secure, and appropriately reviewed before they influence material decisions.
  • Modernize workflows to shorten decision cycles and redirect actuarial capacity from manual production toward interpretation, challenge, and action.

Qualifications

Required

  • Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS).
  • Bachelor's degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, economics, data science, finance, or another relevant quantitative field, or equivalent experience.
  • Significant progressive property and casualty actuarial experience, including leadership of pricing and reserving work and senior-level influence on business decisions.
  • Demonstrated experience leading teams, developing talent, managing change, and partnering across underwriting, claims, finance, technology, compliance, and distribution.
  • Ability to communicate complex analysis, uncertainty, and strategic choices clearly to executive and nontechnical audiences.
  • Working knowledge of applicable actuarial standards, insurance regulation, rate filing considerations, financial reporting, and model governance.

Preferred

  • Membership in the American Academy of Actuaries (MAAA).
  • Experience with commercial package, Commercial Auto, Workers Compensation, Umbrella, Small Commercial, or Middle Market portfolios.
  • Experience with reinsurance, catastrophe modeling, capital analysis, portfolio optimization, and emerging risks.
  • Fluency with modern actuarial and analytical ecosystems such as SQL, Python or R, visualization tools, cloud data platforms, and governed AI-enabled workflows.
  • Experience modernizing actuarial processes, implementing model governance, or building enterprise decision-support capabilities.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic enterprise thinking: Connects actuarial evidence to long-term competitive advantage, capital deployment, and operating priorities.
  • Commercial and underwriting acumen: Understands how product, appetite, distribution, claims, expense, and price interact to create sustainable returns.
  • Quality decision making: Balances rigor and speed; distinguishes what is known, uncertain, assumed, and actionable.
  • Influence and communication: Creates clarity, earns trust, constructively challenges, and turns analysis into commitment and action.
  • Technology and AI stewardship: Recognizes high-value use cases and establishes proportionate governance, controls, and human oversight.
  • Talent multiplication: Builds successors, broadens capabilities, and creates an environment where diverse perspectives improve decisions.
  • Execution and accountability: Sets priorities, simplifies work, assigns ownership, monitors outcomes, and closes the loop.

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Tax and Treasury Technology Leader to develop and implement the worldwide technology strategy and roadmap for tax and treasury systems, data, integrations, and digital capabilities. The person in this position brings expertise across direct and indirect tax, tax provision and compliance! Also transfer pricing, cash and liquidity management, payments, banking connectivity, debt and investments, foreign exchange, data and analytics, Agentic AI, and workflow automation. Translate priorities into secure, resilient, well-governed, and data-driven technology solutions.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world! As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

Serve as the senior technology leader responsible for both tax functions and treasury management, owning the strategy, architecture, roadmap, delivery, and operational health of the global technology ecosystem.

Be responsible for the portfolio of technologies, including tax provision and reporting: Global tax provision, effective tax rate, deferred tax, tax accounting, disclosure, and close-support solutions. Direct tax compliance: Corporate income tax, withholding tax, statutory reporting, return preparation, filing, and jurisdictional compliance platforms. Indirect tax: VAT, GST, sales and use tax, determination, calculation, invoicing, reporting, reconciliation, and e-filing technologies. Transfer pricing: Intercompany policy, calculation, documentation, operational transfer pricing, and country-by-country reporting solutions.

Oversee treasury management: Cash positioning, liquidity forecasting, bank account administration, payments, collections, in-house banking, netting, and reconciliation platforms. Financial risk and capital markets: Foreign exchange, interest rate and commodity risk, hedging, debt, investments, guarantees, and associated accounting and valuation capabilities.

The person in this role will be responsible for banking connectivity and payments: Bank portals, host-to-host connections, APIs, SWIFT connectivity, payment factories, file transmission, fraud controls, and payment status monitoring. Information analysis, computational insights, and artificial intelligence: Financial and liquidity data products, governed data models, dashboards, predictive insights, scenario modeling, intelligent automation, and Agentic AI capabilities

Ensure end-to-end process integrity and data consistency across tax determination, provision, compliance, statutory reporting, payments, cash positioning, liquidity forecasting, bank reconciliation, hedging, debt, and investment processes.

Partner closely with senior Tax, Treasury, Finance, Accounting, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, Data, Cybersecurity, and Technology leaders to align platform capabilities with business priorities and regulatory obligations.

Define and maintain the platform governance model for the technology solutions supporting Tax and Treasury functions, including demand intake, prioritization, architecture, security, change control, release management, access governance, and communication.

Take charge of the IT service model across application support, incident and problem management, monitoring, batch and interface operations, disaster recovery, business continuity, vendor support, and service-level performance. Oversee evaluation, adoption, and rollout of new platform features and releases; perform impact assessments and guide configuration, integration, controls, testing, deployment, and hypercare.

Drive adoption and support for new capabilities, ensuring teams are equipped to use systems, data, analytics, and AI effectively in day-to-day operations.

Champion data quality, lineage, standardization, retention, security, and controls across the landscape; establish clear ownership and collaborate with Data, Risk, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance teams.

Complete the AI strategy related to Tax and Treasury, prioritizing responsible use cases such as anomaly detection, reconciliation support, cash forecasting, scenario analysis, document intelligence, research assistance, workflow orchestration, and control monitoring.

Ensure effective integrations and data flows between Tax and Treasury platforms and adjacent ecosystems, including ERP, HR and payroll, procurement, billing, banking networks, market data, consolidation, regulatory reporting, and enterprise data platforms.

This role goes well beyond maintaining current tools. You will:

  • Implement the strategic vision for an integrated Tax/Treasury technology ecosystem, connecting operational processes, enterprise platforms, banking partners, authoritative data, analytics, automation, and AI.
  • Play a significant role in enterprise-wide transformation programs, including:
  • Global modernization and standardization of Tax/Treasury platforms, processes, controls, integrations, and data
  • AI-enabled automation and advanced analytics for cash forecasting, tax data preparation, reconciliations, exception management, regulatory change analysis, and aiding decision-making
  • Real-time and API-enabled banking, payment, and data connectivity, with resilient security and control frameworks
  • Blend executive level influence with hands-on leadership, from driving multi-year roadmaps and major transformations to engaging in architecture reviews, operational risk decisions, and proofs of concept.
  • Shape the day-to-day experience of teams by reducing manual effort, improving clarity, strengthening controls, and enabling faster, data-driven decisions.
  • Your work will directly support tax compliance, liquidity, financial risk management, payment integrity, operational resilience, and better enterprise decisions through technology, data, AI, and process excellence.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

Extensive experience, typically 7+ years, leading Tax, Treasury, Finance, or corporate technology portfolios in a global, matrixed organization.

  • Deep hands-on and strategic experience with:
  • Tax provision, tax accounting, direct tax compliance, indirect tax, transfer pricing, and statutory reporting technologies
  • Treasury management systems supporting cash, liquidity, payments, bank account management, debt, investments, foreign exchange, hedging, and reconciliation
  • Bank connectivity and payment technologies, including SWIFT, host-to-host, APIs, payment files, bank portals, and fraud-control capabilities
  • ERP, consolidation, sub ledger, payroll, procurement, billing, market data, data platform, and regulatory integrations that support Tax and Treasury processes
  • Data architecture, master and reference data, data lineage, reporting, analytics, and data product operating models
  • AI, machine learning, workflow automation, document intelligence, and agentic solutions, with responsible AI and governance controls
  • Proven success leading complex, multi-year transformations, global deployments, process standardization, platform rationalization, and operating model change across Tax and Treasury.
  • Experience establishing reliable application support and service management for time critical close, filing, payment, cash, and market-facing processes.
  • Experience driving adoption of AI, automation, and analytics in Tax and Treasury while maintaining appropriate human review, security, auditability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Solid background partnering with senior business collaborators to translate Tax/Treasury strategies, risks, controls, and performance measures into technology roadmaps and investment priorities.

Leadership & collaboration: Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing, global teams across business, technology, data, architecture, delivery, and operations skills. Excellent collaborator management and interpersonal abilities, with the ability to work with senior leaders in Tax, Treasury, Finance, Accounting, Risk, Compliance, Audit, Data, and Technology.

Experience managing portfolio prioritization, budgeting, capacity, resource planning, and delivery across concurrent programs, enhancements, regulatory commitments, and operational needs.

Strong vendor and partner management skills, including contracts, performance, service levels, product roadmaps, security requirements, implementation accountability, and risk allocation.

Strategic problem solver who can connect Tax and Treasury technology, data, controls, and AI capabilities to outcomes such as compliance, liquidity visibility, risk reduction, payment integrity, operational resilience, and improved efficiency.

Demonstrated experience identifying and implementing automation, AI/ML, advanced analytics, and agentic workflows in controlled financial processes. Ability to define a governed data strategy that improves data quality, accessibility, lineage, reuse, and decision support across jurisdictions and business divisions.

Comfortable operating in a matrixed, global environment, balancing enterprise standardization with local tax, banking, legal, regulatory, and market requirements.

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Business, or a related field.

An advanced degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Tax, Information Systems, Data, or a related field, or equivalent experience, is preferred.

Technology, data, cloud, cybersecurity, project management, or AI-related certifications are advantageous, particularly where they demonstrate skill in leading secure and well governed enterprise platforms.

Job Description

Partnering closely with Finance, Operations, Technology, and regional collaborators, this role will lead major PSA initiatives from discovery through implementation, stabilization, and ongoing support in a global, matrixed environment!

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world!

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Implement the vision, roadmap, governance, and lifecycle management of Workday PSA, aligning platform capabilities with global finance, order-to-cash, project delivery, and operational priorities.
  • Serve as the enterprise design authority for Workday PSA. Lead solution architecture across Projects, Project Billing, Customer Contracts, Customer Accounts, Time Tracking, Expenses, Revenue Management, Accounts Receivable, and Collections.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

Extensive hands-on experience architecting, configuring, and supporting Workday PSA and related Workday Financials capabilities in a complex global environment.

  • 7+ years of demonstrated experience with enterprise financial systems or professional services technology, including 5+ years of Workday Financials and PSA implementation, configuration, architecture, or consulting experience.

  • Good sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to lead architecture and delivery decisions through ambiguity.

  • Demonstrable ability to lead and influence multi-functional, global initiatives without direct authority.
  • Ability to build trusted partnerships with Finance, Accounting, Operations, Commercial, HR, Data, Risk, Audit, and Technology collaborators.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, resolve design conflicts, and maintain momentum across concurrent projects and operational commitments.
  • Experience mentoring team members and raising the quality and consistency of solution design and delivery practices.

Full job description

Job Description

Posting Description

Who We Are:

Wealthspire is a leading wealth management, retirement advisory, and business management firm serving individuals, families, endowments, and institutions across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. We provide a comprehensive platform that brings together wealth management, institutional consulting, business management, family office, and retirement plan advisory services—empowering clients to navigate complexity with clarity and confidence.

With over 1,200 employees across more than 40 offices, we deliver insights and solutions backed by deep research, technology, and decades of expertise. Our collective businesses create a unified ecosystem designed to meet clients wherever they are in their financial journey. Wealthspire is redefining the future of financial solutions through collaboration, scale, and a steadfast commitment to putting people first—our clients, our colleagues, and our communities.

For more information, visit www.wealthspire.com. Wealthspire Advisors LLC, Fiducient Advisors LLC, Wealthspire Retirement, LLC, dba Wealthspire Retirement Advisory, and certain other affiliates are separately registered investment advisers.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Plan Administrator with the technical expertise to support a variety of complex retirement plan administration projects. While this individual will have the knowledge and experience to provide full plan administration, their expertise will be leveraged by the Special Projects team to provide technical research, analysis, and guidance to internal and external stakeholders.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping clients and prospective clients navigate complex compliance challenges, resolve difficult plan issues, and protect the long-term health of their retirement plans.

The ideal candidate combines deep ERISA and plan administration expertise with the relationship-building skills needed to guide clients confidently through an increasingly complex regulatory landscape.

Key Responsibilities

Plan Administration & Compliance

  • Provide various technical compliance tasks for a multitude of clients including projects such as DB/DC/H&W 5500 preparation and corrective calculations
  • Perform non-discrimination and compliance testing, including ADP/ACP, 410(b) coverage, top-heavy, 415 annual addition limit, 401(a)(4) cross-testing and other necessary measurements
  • Calculate and allocate employer contributions
  • Assist clients with corrections through the various governmental programs
  • Reconcile payroll contributions and employee census to determine if prior activity aligns with prior instructions and determine current year plan eligibility
  • Reconcile trust assets and contributions, interpreting trust financial statements to resolve discrepancies
  • Interpret plan document provisions to ensure accurate, compliant administration
  • Ensure clients adhere to government filing and regulatory requirements

Government Filings & Regulatory Support

  • Complete, review, and provide audit support for Forms 5500, 5330, 8955-SSA, 1099-R, and related schedules
  • Review and validate work completed by other plan administrators and support staff to ensure accuracy prior to delivery
  • Maintain and expand ERISA compliance and software knowledge in step with evolving regulations and our evolving technology platform capabilities

Client & Relationship Management

  • Develop effective working relationships with clients, internal teams, external advisors, recordkeepers, and auditors supporting shared client relationships
  • Identify and present opportunities for new business development

Analysis & Communication

  • Review, analyze, and summarize plan data in clear, succinct written communication to support advisors, Consultants, and fellow Plan Administrators
  • Serve as a technical resource for research and plan analysis projects for internal and external clients

Professional Development

  • Comply with continuing education requirements and pursue ongoing credentialing
  • Participate in professional organizations and independent study to stay current on ERISA and industry developments
  • Integrate new knowledge and skills into daily work, sharing insights with colleagues as appropriate

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in business administration, business analytics, mathematical economics, finance, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

High school diploma required.

Experience

1-3 years of directly related experience in retirement plan administration and consulting.

Credentialing (one or more preferred)

  • ASPPA: Qualified 401(k) Administrator (QKA), Qualified Plan Specialist (QKS), Qualified 401(k) Consultant (QKC), and/or Qualified Pension Administrator (QPA)
  • NIPA: Accredited 401(k) Specialist (AKS), Accredited Pension Administrator (APA), and/or Accredited Pension Representative (APR)
  • IRS Enrolled Retirement Plan Agent (ERPA)
  • NAPA: Certified Plan Fiduciary Advisor (CPFA) and/or Qualified Plan Financial Consultant (QPFC)

Technical Skills

Experience with Stax.ai, FT William, and PensionPro strongly preferred; familiarity with ASC a plus. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Teams. High degree of technical and legal knowledge, including familiarity with the Internal Revenue Code and ERISA as they apply to qualified plans.

Core Competencies

  • Communication – effective oral, written, and interpersonal skills; communicates clearly and interactively with team members and support staff
  • Judgment & problem-solving – proven organizational and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment on plan design and compliance matters
  • Client service – demonstrated ability to deliver quality customer service while managing multiple tasks with a high degree of accuracy
  • Ownership – a sense of urgency and commitment to timely, high-quality project completion, balanced with attention to detail and confidentiality
  • Collaboration – ability to work independently and within a team, bringing a positive, proactive, and entrepreneurial mindset

What We Offer:

Wealthspire Advisors is proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others.

The base salary range for this position is $72,000 – $88,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $38,025 to $67,500 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Phoenix, AZ
  • Experience: 1+ year
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • Benefits: 401(k), paid time off, tuition assistance

About this job

Licensed life insurance sales representative role in Phoenix handling inbound and outbound calls to sell insurance products. Hybrid position with uncapped commissions, guaranteed base pay of $38,025-$67,500, and potential additional earnings up to $75,000.

Good fit if you have a life insurance license, minimum one year of sales experience, and can work rotating shifts including evenings and Saturdays.

Full job description

New Year - New Career! | Hybrid Role in Phoenix, AZ | Uncapped Earnings + Career Growth

Are you a persuasive communicator who thrives in a fast-paced performance driven environment? Join our February 2027 class of Direct Sales Representatives and help customers protect what matters most. At Farmers, your ambition fuels your income and your future. In this role, you will respond to calls coming into our call center by positively promoting Farmers insurance products to prospective customers, consulting with customers to understand their needs, and selling those products which best fit the customer's needs. You may also make outbound calls to optimize sales potential.

*Must already be licensed to sell LIFE INSURANCE*

Uncapped Commissions

Join a team where your performance drives your paycheck! Our compensation package is designed to reward your success.

  • Our model includes guaranteed annual base pay of $38,025 - $67,500 based on your experience
  • A competitive benefits package PLUS an uncapped performance-based incentive, giving you the opportunity to increase your earnings on average up to an additional $27,300 on top of the guaranteed base pay annually.
  • Many of our top performers who consistently meet and exceed their goals earn up to an additional $75,000 on top of their annual base pay.
  • 5% bilingual incentive.

If you're driven, competitive and ready to grow, this is the place to do it!

What You'll Bring

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a sales environment
  • Property and Casualty License and Life (Life + Health in Arizona)
  • Proven ability to meet quotas, metrics and goals
  • A drive to work in a fast-paced, high energy environment
  • Desire for a long-term career within the insurance industry
  • Proven ability to take initiative, solve problems, and prioritize tasks
  • Direct sales skills, and the aptitude to influence customers and close the sale
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; the ability to adapt communication style to each phone call, and explain complex policy and coverage information in understandable terms
  • Must be eligible to obtain resident/non-resident property and casualty license in all required states

Here's what you'll accomplish as a member of our team:

  • Sell insurance products to inbound callers by gathering data from customers to generate quotes and ultimately bind the business; in some instances, make outbound calls
  • Provide exceptional customer service and build strong relationships, while educating customers regarding coverages and cost so that the customer can select the most appropriate option
  • Qualify customers as buyers of other products/services to create cross-sell and upselling opportunities
  • Navigate multiple computer systems while seamlessly interacting with the customer

You'll thrive here IF:

  • Self-motivated & goal-oriented – You set ambitious goals and chase them relentlessly.
  • Customer-focused – You build trust and tailor solutions with empathy.
  • Tech-savvy & adaptable – You navigate systems with ease and embrace change.
  • Coachable & curious – You welcome feedback and seek growth.
  • Accountable & reliable – You own your outcomes and show up ready.

Location & Schedule

Workplace: Hybrid ( #LI-Hybrid )

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly at home as well as the opportunity to be together in person in the office. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days working from home for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office.

Office location: 2400 N. Farmers Way. Phoenix, Arizona, United States

Initial training may require in-office attendance, with the required days varying based on business need. Once training is complete, you'll transition to a hybrid work model, working in-office three days per week and at home two days. While most teams are in-office Monday through Wednesday; your assigned shift may vary.

Work Schedule:
Our priority is to our customers, and we work non-traditional hours to match their needs. Candidates hired for this role must be available to work any shifts within the hours below; this may include evenings, Saturdays, and holidays. Shifts are assigned based on business needs.

Department Hours:

  • Training Hours 8:30am - 5pm AZ
  • Monday-Friday 6am to 8pm AZ
  • Rotational Saturdays 7am to 5:30pm AZ
  • Sunday shifts may be possible

Full-time- 40 hours/week; five 8-hour shifts per week.

Experience Requirements

Minimum one year of sales or related experience required.

Education Requirement

High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Additional Qualification

Friendly and service-oriented. Seeks to acquire knowledge in area of specialty. Focused on training, ramp-up, and meeting foundational KPIs. Possesses strong technical aptitude. Proficient using basic sales tools. Strong verbal communication and listening skills.

  • Farmers offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications and location.
  • Bonus Opportunity (based on Company and Individual Performance)

Farmers is an award winning, equal opportunity employer, committed to the strength of an inclusive workforce. About this job

Sr. Solution Engineer at Farmers Insurance in Woodland Hills, CA, responsible for designing and implementing business applications for insurance processes. Leads technical projects across teams, manages solution architecture, and oversees Agile Release Trains with option for remote work.

Good fit if you have 7 years of Pega experience with UI/UX frameworks, databases, and 5 years leading enterprise BPM initiatives and full SDLC delivery in insurance domain.

Full job description

We are Farmers – where ambition meets opportunity.

At Farmers, we're not just known for unforgettable jingle – we're a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people's lives. We deliver peace of mind when it matters most. Our results-driven, high-performance culture thrives on creativity, accountability and bold solutions. Here, growth isn't just a goal – it's a way of life for both the organization and every individual on our team. We tackle challenges head-on, learn from every experience and measure our impact on the customers who trust us.

Join an award-winning, equal opportunity employer, where you'll find more than a job – you'll find a supportive community. Enjoy competitive benefits, take part in meaningful volunteer projects, and help shape the future alongside talented colleagues across all backgrounds. At Farmers, helping others is at the heart of what we do.

Ready to make your mark? Discover our vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate. Connect with us on Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok, and let's build something incredible together!

Workplace: On-site ( #LI-Onsite ), Hybrid ( #LI-Hybrid ), Remote ( #LI-Remote )

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered.

Job Summary

Farmers Group (Woodland Hills, CA) seeks a Sr. Solution Engineer to be responsible for providing expertise in the design and functionality of business applications to support Farmers Business Insurance processes. Specific duties include: providing expertise in the design and functionality of business applications; understanding customers' business processes and products and how best they can be supported by the application systems; leading multiple solution engineering technical projects across various teams and initiatives; developing, reviewing, and validating the detailed technical design for business applications provided by the supplier to ensure alignment with business requirements for complex solution; performing quality review checks on project deliverables; validating suppliers estimates; performing impact analysis of application changes across various components, holding an end-to-end view of the system; specifying/recommending integration and parallel testing criteria; supporting the implementation activities, troubleshooting system environmental issues, as required; overseeing Agile Release Trains to ensure they operate effectively and identify, resolve constraints across the development and delivery processes; providing a systems level view to guide technology delivery with broader supervisory oversight, ensuring alignment with business objectives; developing more robust technical designs that ensure scalability and performance; collaborating with teams to support product roadmaps and resolve issues impacting delivery timelines, including leading technical problem solving efforts for more complex solutions; contributing primarily to business unit level solutions and participating in enterprise level solution delivery; engaging in ongoing learning and sharing best practices; and mentoring or training less experienced team members. Option to work remotely from anywhere in the U.S. with occasional travel to headquarters.

Position requires a Bachelor's degree, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Engineering, Software Engineering, or a closely related field of study, plus 7 years of experience in the job offered, or as a Senior Software Engineer, Associate Architect, Internet Architect, System Architect, or similar position providing expertise in the design and functionality of business applications. Must have 7 years of experience with each of the following: working with Pega and related frameworks including CPM, CPMHC, CPMFS, and Decisioning; working with UI/UX capabilities using CSS, HTML, Angular, JavaScript, React, jQuery, and Pega Constellation/Cosmos; working with databases including SQL Server, Oracle, and PostgreSQL, and common integration standards. Must also have 5 years of experience with each of the following: planning, designing, developing, testing, performance tuning, and data modeling; leading enterprise BPM and application initiatives; managing full SDLC delivery; functioning as a PRPC SME; working in architecture, integration design, production support, and Insurance domain; and working with risk management, cross team collaboration, resource planning, stakeholder communication, and ongoing process improvement. Option to work remotely from anywhere in the U.S. with occasional travel to headquarters.

Full time position. Apply by submitting your resumes at Farmers.com/Careers, Job ID: 36267.

Job Description Summary
The Product Engineer architects and designs their digital products using modern tools, technologies, frameworks, and systems. They apply a systematic application of scientific and technological knowledge, methods, and experience to the design, implementation, testing, and documentation of software. They own and manage running their application in production, and ultimately becomes accountable for the success of their digital products through achieving KPIs. Product Engineers at Allstate are considered Software Engineers

Job Description

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Participate in inceptions and iteration planning meetings, infusing backlogs with technical input working in close partnership with the product manager.

  • Leads and participates in daily site, cross-site, and product team standups.

  • Leads and participates in retrospectives, demonstrating and encouraging each participant to provide feedback with empathy.

  • Participate in high-level and low-level component and system designs

  • Participate in performance improvements and tech review meetings

  • Partners in collaboration and strategy alignment across product portfolios (cross-product) in partnership with product managers, other peers and key stakeholders.

  • Serves as an expert on one or more business domain and a distinguished advocate of multiple technology stacks and shares that knowledge across organizations.

  • Coaches the team and leads daily practices of using paired programming and test-driven development in writing software and building products.

  • Establishes continuous integration, continuous delivery, and continuous deployment pipelines and practices.

  • Provides support for software products in user environments.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

  • Experience and knowledge in developing REST APIs using Java Spring boot, including tooling for documentation (swagger, REST-docs, OpenAPI spec), versioning, service discovery/registration, testing and management; experience using API gateways a plus.

  • Hands on experience and accountability architecting, designing, implementing and delivering large scale distributed systems and/or applications for the cloud, including MicroServices architectures.

  • Experience and knowledge in web and API security including authentication, authorization, OAuth, OWASP, OpenID, and SAML.

  • Experience in backend development design and implementation, database (MongoDB, caching) and Kafka messaging.

  • Knowledge and experience using distributed version control systems (git), artifact management systems, build and packaging systems (maven, gradle, npm, artifactory, etc ) and Jenkins or similar Continuous Integration tools .

  • Experience of working in an Agile environment or paired programming/engineering model.

  • Experience with Python is a plus..

  • Experience with the test driven approach and writing unit tests for front to back coverage.

  • Experience with problem-solving and analyzing performance bottlenecks.

Experience

3 or more years of experience (Preferred)

#LI-TH1

Skills

Application Development, Back-End Development, Java (Programming Language), JavaScript, Software Development, Spring Boot, Strategic Management, Web Application Development

Compensation offered for this role is 90,700.00 - 153,925.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

Responsible for creating a comprehensive estimate of damages for 1st and 3rd party RV, Heavy Equipment, trailers, and Motorcycle material damage claims leading to the proper disposition. This role is utilized as a peer mentor having mastered our processes and obtained technical expertise.

We are seeking an RV Adjuster to support field operations across the Raleigh, Burlington, and Greensboro, NC areas. In this role, you will assess and estimate damages on RVs, motorcycles, trailers, and commercial equipment, helping ensure accurate and timely claim resolution.


If you have strong estimating experience, enjoy working in the field, and take pride in delivering fair and thorough evaluations, this is a great opportunity to grow your career with National General, an Allstate company.


Key Responsibilities

Applies mastered content in interpretations of all policy types written by the company and assists leadership in formal and ad hoc training

Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files

Interprets regulatory compliance and fair claims practices

Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers

Exhibits mastery estimating fundamentals in order to create estimates of damages on 1st and 3rd party material damage losses of all severities


As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.


Training: Please note: You may be required to attend 2 weeks of training held in person at our Dallas, TX office.

Job Description

Allstate Technology Solutions is dedicated to creating a new type of insurance platform. By leveraging cutting edge technologies, innovative product design and true integration of artificial intelligence functions with emphasis on Generative AI, Agentic AI and other AI capabilities, we will revolutionize what is means to be a protection provider.

Our goal is to create a truly transformational customer experience, while also enabling significant opportunities for operational efficiencies and contextual personalization.

Become a part of our story.

At Allstate Technology Solutions, youll find a collaborative and dynamic team focused on exploring new capabilities and pushing the boundaries of what is possible. The team works in a continuous innovation cycle of ideas, research, testing, analysis, and delivery

The Role

As a talented Digital Product Manager, you love to execute on strategic vision and turning it into something tangible whether that be a story, a design or even code. We need you to get your hands dirty with raw data and derive meaningful and actionable insights that you can use to influence direction of product team and those that surround it. Youre an innovative thinker, an independent mover, an expert communicator, and an agile problem solver looking to join an exciting team.


As an ideal candidate, you can learn and adapt quickly and are able to use every tool at your disposalsoftware, data, analytics and beyondto understand and effectively tackle hard problems. You appreciate the importance working through problem statements and defining success before the team writes code. You can hop into architecture, UX, and business discussions and ensure that the team is always driving towards collective success.


Youre also an individual who.

  • Embraces a continuously evolving breadth of projects and goals.
  • Dedicates time and interest to learning and continuously improving.
  • Desires to contribute concretely to design sessions, analytical discussions, and retrospectives.
  • Innovates and problem-solves by using new modeling techniques or tools.
  • Takes initiative and works efficiently while maintaining a focus on the bigger picture.
  • Partners closely with technical and non-technical teammates to define product goals.
  • Works collaboratively with other team members in pursuit of a common goal and execution of shared strategy

Responsibilities:

Product Roadmap Execution: Craft and execute a comprehensive product roadmap, prioritizing features and enhancements. Ensure that portfolio of products are aligned horizontally and meeting product goals.

Problem/success understanding: Collaborate with stakeholders to define what needs to be true to meet intended outcomes, ensuring a deep understanding of user needs.


User Experience Design: Advocate and design for seamless user experiences, from concept to execution.


Qualifications:

Job Description

The Territory Sales Manager is responsible for consistently exceeding agreed upon new business production, direct written premium, and loss ratio goals, and other KPIs on an annual basis by effectively managing the agents of an assigned market to increase company market share by driving profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Positions and promotes full suite of National General Insurance products into Independent Agency Partners to include, multiple personal auto products, homeowners, commercial vehicle, flood, and recreational vehicle & key focus on Specialty Vehicle & Household package coverages (based on state availability

Job.JobTitle: Digital Product Manager - Control Integration Engineering
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chicago, IL

About this job

Digital Product Manager role at Allstate's Control Integration Engineering organization focused on security adoption across business units. Owns integration strategy, roadmaps, and adoption outcomes for enterprise security capabilities, working across MFBs, engineering, and security teams.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in product or platform management, experience with complex technology integrations, and technical depth in cybersecurity or cloud security.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Control Integration Engineering (CIE) organization accelerates consistent adoption, integration and measurement of enterprise security capabilities across Allstate and its subsidiary Market Facing Businesses (MFBs). We are seeking an experienced Digital Product Manager specializing in Integration Product Management to own the security-control integration and adoption journey for an assigned MFB portfolio.

The DPM understands each MFB's technology landscape, security posture, priorities and constraints, and works with MFB teams, control owners, Product Security, CIE engineering, architecture, risk and governance to turn them into a prioritized integration roadmap, reusable patterns and measurable adoption outcomes.

Rather than managing a traditional security product, this role productizes the integration experience, making enterprise security capabilities easier, faster and more consistent to consume. It owns the product strategy, roadmap, prioritization and outcomes for integrating these capabilities into the assigned MFB portfolio.

Integration Strategy, Roadmap & Prioritization

  • Own the integration product strategy and multi-quarter adoption roadmap for assigned MFBs, aligned to enterprise security priorities and MFB needs. Prioritize CIE investment by security value, adoption impact, effort, dependencies and reuse potential, sequencing adoption where capabilities add the most value.
  • Define outcomes, milestones and acceptance criteria with CIE engineering, reassessing priorities as needs, capacity and results change.
  • Manage competing demand and make transparent recommendations when demand exceeds CIE capacity.

Customer Discovery & MFB Partnership

  • Treat MFBs as CIE's internal customers; run structured discovery with their security, engineering, cloud, infrastructure and architecture leaders.
  • Understand their capabilities, patterns and constraints; identify adoption friction and separate legitimate requirements from unnecessary divergence.
  • Represent MFB needs within CIE and enterprise security, influencing capabilities before designs become difficult to change.

Productize Integration

  • Spot recurring requirements across MFBs so CIE solves each integration problem once, turning successful implementations into reusable patterns, playbooks, blueprints and automation with Managing and Product Engineers.
  • Feed recurring needs back to product and control owners, and ensure clear transitions to sustainable operational ownership.

Adoption & Outcome Management

  • Define adoption measures and track posture, gaps, blockers and divergence across assigned MFBs, using evidence to shape roadmap priorities.
  • Support enterprise reporting with control, measurement and governance teams, and communicate outcomes, trends, risks and opportunities to CIE and security leadership.

The DPM is accountable for whether adoption actually happened, measured by adoption velocity, coverage, time-to-integrate, reduced friction and variation, pattern reuse and sustainable operational transition, not stories completed, meetings held or projects closed.


Cross-Functional Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead initiatives spanning MFBs, Product Security, control owners, CIE engineering, architecture, risk and enterprise technology, influencing without direct authority.
  • Communicate trade-offs to senior leadership in business terms, surface unresolved dependencies and keep control, MFB risk and operational ownership with the appropriate organization.
  • Translate priorities into epics and requirements with Managing Engineers, keeping a backlog with outcome-based acceptance criteria; treat Agile as a means, not the purpose of the role.

Essential Skills

Integration Product Management

Demonstrated ability to develop product strategy and roadmaps through customer and technical discovery, prioritize across competing needs and dependencies, translate complex requirements into outcomes, define product and adoption measures, manage complex internal portfolios and influence direction without authority.


Technical & Security Acumen

Enough technical depth to work credibly with security architects and engineers. The DPM need not be the solution architect, but must question assumptions, recognize integration complexity and translate constraints into product decisions. Experience in several of these areas is preferred: cybersecurity controls; cloud security (AWS/Azure/GCP); identity and privileged access; application and API security; DevSecOps; vulnerability management; endpoint and network security; data protection; security architecture, platforms and tooling; and enterprise infrastructure.


Enterprise Integration Leadership

Experience leading platform adoption, integration, modernization or transformation across federated enterprises, working with engineering and architecture teams, managing senior stakeholders and competing priorities, and translating between business, security, product and engineering audiences. Subsidiary, acquisition or independent business-unit experience is highly desirable.


Qualifications

Essential

  • 5+ years in Product, Technical Product, Security Product or Platform Product Management, or comparable technology leadership roles.
  • Experience owning complex technology products, platforms, integrations or adoption initiatives, including strategies and roadmaps.
  • Strong analytical, prioritization, problem-solving and communication skills, with proven ability to lead through influence.

Desirable

  • Cybersecurity experience, including control frameworks and integrating cloud and security platforms across heterogeneous environments.
  • M&A technology integration or subsidiary/business-unit experience.
  • Relevant security, product or cloud certifications.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities.











#LI-JB2

Skills

Business, Business Case Analyses, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Technologies, Product Knowledge, Product Management, Product Roadmapping, Product Strategies, Strategic Roadmaps, Systems Thinking, Waterfall Model

Good fit if you have 3+ years of legal experience, an active law license, and at least 5 years of employment law experience preferred

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

$129,600.00 - $213,800.00

What Is the Opportunity?

The Counsel role is responsible for providing a broad range of cost-effective, high quality legal services in the area of employment law, including management of arbitration, litigation and administrative charges and dispute resolution. The Counsel position handles moderately complex employment law matters to support Human Resources, management and business initiatives.

Travelers offers a hybrid work location model that is designated to support flexibility.

What Will You Do?

  • Provide legal advice and counsel to internal stakeholders on all aspects of employment law including hiring, performance management, employment policies and practices, leave of absence, accommodations, termination, wage and hour, contingent workforce issues, training, restrictive covenants, employment arbitration and litigation, administrative charges and other employment related matters.
  • Represent the company in and advise internal stakeholders regarding arbitration, litigation, administrative charges and internal investigations, including drafting responses to administrative charges and oversight and management of external counsel.
  • Draft and negotiate employment-related agreements.
  • Participate in employment related projects and in the development and delivery of training on employment law topics.
  • Proactively partner with the HR team to develop employment policies and practices that mitigate risk and maintain compliance with employment laws and regulations.
  • Maintain awareness of external judicial and regulatory climate and legal developments in employment law and provide advice and counsel to address them.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal clients and other staff across the legal department.
  • Make effective use of technology and automation in the practice of law, including artificial intelligence.
  • This role acts as an individual contributor and does not lead others.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Minimum of 5 years of prior employment law experience in a large firm and/or in-house preferred.
  • Occasional travel required

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of prior legal experience.
  • Active license to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Outside Auto Appraiser, you are responsible for physically inspecting damaged vehicles, estimating repair costs, working closely with repair facilities, and determining and settling the actual cash value of total loss vehicles to ensure accurate and timely claim settlements. In this customer-facing role, you will need to have a high level of technical expertise in vehicle damage assessment, strong customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. This position will serve as a technical resource for auto claim staff and will provide advice and direction to claim professionals on claim damages to achieve optimal outcomes. This position is based remotely with work at residential and/or commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

What Will You Do?

  • Inspect and assess vehicle damage resulting from accidents, weather events, or other covered losses by conducting thorough virtual or on-site inspections at body shops or customer locations.
  • Perform estimate review work, conduct virtual inspections, and collaborate with repair facilities to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality across claims.
  • Prepare accurate repair estimates using industry-standard estimating software to determine the cost of parts, labor, and materials required to restore vehicles to pre-loss condition.
  • Evaluate and settle vehicle total losses by determining actual cash value (ACV) through market research, comparable vehicle analysis, and application of appropriate valuation tools and methodologies.
  • Negotiate repair costs and settlements with body shops, customers, and third-party claimants to reach fair and timely resolutions while maintaining quality repair standards.
  • Identify and document pre-existing damage, prior repairs, and potential fraud indicators to ensure accurate claim evaluation and protect company interests.
  • Collaborate with claim representatives, body shops, and vendors to coordinate repairs, authorize supplements, and resolve coverage or repair-related issues.
  • Provide exceptional customer service by explaining the appraisal process, answering questions, assisting in moving claims towards timely resolution, and keeping vehicle owners informed throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Two years of auto physical damage appraisal experience.
  • Proficient in claims management and estimating software, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers throughout the claim process.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution skills; ability to facilitate productive discussions and reach equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Basic understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations and claim handling requirements.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • One year of auto physical damage appraisal or comparable claim related experience or successful completion of required Travelers Claim Representative training program.
  • Valid driver's license.

If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$79,600.00 - $131,400.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Reports to Boiler and Machinery Field Manager. Conduct boiler and pressure vessel inspections in accordance with jurisdictional rules by performing thorough examinations, identifying hazardous conditions, applying appropriate codes and standards, and recommending corrective actions. Work cooperatively with Boiler and Machinery underwriting and claim groups, in support of helping them make informed decisions to maximize profit and growth. Primarily performs boiler and pressure vessel inspections on all accounts. Under close supervision, performs risk evaluations and claims investigations on less complex accounts as assigned. Participates in individual training opportunities to enhance/develop risk control and product/service knowledge.

What Will You Do?

  • Maintain a consistent field presence, spending approximately 20% - 50% of the time onsite with customers. Traveling to customers may entail long-distance, overnight travel, and/or multi-night trips depending on the needs of the business and alignment with territory and/or geography.
  • In this role, works with limited guidance and direction to manage jurisdictional inspection workload within an assigned territory. Take ownership of the territory and effectively prioritize, plan, and schedule work. Utilize provided technology resources for maximum efficiency. Respond to customer requests and helps customers understand and mitigate risks associated with equipment breakdowns.
  • Conduct boiler and pressure vessel inspections in accordance with jurisdictional rules by performing thorough examinations, identifying hazardous conditions, applying appropriate codes and standards, recommending corrective action and submitting required reports.
  • Under moderate supervision performs less complex risk evaluations, evaluate exposures and controls, develops meaningful loss estimates, and communicate findings to business partners.
  • Apply critical thinking to determine adequacy of controls preventing equipment breakdown, and overall insurability. Investigate less complex Equipment Breakdown claims as requested by the claim department. Evaluate elements of the breakdown, extent of damage, invoice review, and cause of loss.
  • Effectively document, communicate, and report findings.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in related field.
  • Technical Skills.
  • Demonstrates a basic level of understanding of mechanical and electrical principles.
  • Possesses a basic knowledge of predictive and preventive maintenance practices.
  • Demonstrates specific engineering/technical skills necessary to achieve established business goals.
  • Utilizes Risk Control workstation computer system applications to efficiently manage territorial workload, schedule and complete all job assignments.
  • Customer Service.
  • Identifies customer needs and takes appropriate action to meet those needs.
  • Acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Demonstrates a commitment to delivering an appropriate level of customer service.
  • Problem Solving.
  • Develops new methods or approaches to getting the work done.
  • Evaluates information and makes the right choice (decision).
  • Is resourceful in gaining information/resources to solve business problems.
  • Interpersonal Skills.
  • Results driven and takes responsibility for own decisions and actions.
  • Manages own work and seeks help as necessary.
  • Works independently and in a team environment.
  • Establishes and maintains effective work relationships.
  • Communication.
  • Clearly expresses ideas.
  • Listens to and understands what others are saying.
  • Shares information and maintains confidentiality.
  • National Board of Boiler and Pressure Vessel Inspector's Inservice commission.
  • Military Boiler or Nuclear Power operator certification.
  • Civilian Power Boiler Operation Certificate.
  • ANSI NDE Level II Examiner Certification.

What is a Must Have?

  • Two years of experience in the boiler and machinery industry or a related field, such as plant engineering, power generation, manufacturing operations or maintenance, or relevant military experience.
  • Valid driver's license.
  • Must obtain an Inservice Commission (IS) from the National Board of Boiler and Pressure Vessel Inspectors within six months of employment.
  • Must have or be able to attain appropriate certification to meet state-specific requirements, where applicable.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.
