If you are looking for the following in your next career ...

  • Paid training through the award-winning and industry-leading University of Farmers.
  • Flexibility and independence to work outside the confines of a desk job.
  • Total Rewards Benefits Package: 401K and a competitive starting salary.
  • Rapid growth potential and management opportunities for success-oriented people through education,mentorship programs, and inspirational leadership at a company you can be proud of.


… then Farmers Insurance is the place for you!

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Adjuster:

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders' residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days.

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

If You Have the Following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable. Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

... then this could be a great career opportunity for you!

Final candidate qualifications may be reviewed against the requirements for the associated level of this role.

Candidates Must be Willing & Able to:

  • Climb Ladders to inspect roofs, and be comfortable working on rooftops, multiple times per day,
  • Work in small, confined spaces that have been damaged; such as attics and crawlspaces.
  • Achieve a minimum passing score on all claims training exams.

Physical Actions & Environment:

  • Bending, Kneeling, Pulling, Pushing, Sorting, Carrying up to 50 lbs., Climbing, Reaching, Standing, Walking, Seeing
  • Speaking (English), Reading (English), Writing (English), & Key Entering

Required job duties are performed in the field and an in-home office environment. Exposure to some or all of the following environments when in the field: Uncontrolled outside environmental conditions, Excessive noise levels, Chemicals Chemical/Biological conditions, Moving mechanical parts, Areas considered dangerous, Conditions which could affect the respiratory system or skin such as fumes, odors, dust, mists, gases, oils, smoke, soot, or poor ventilation.

Job Summary

  • This position manages an assigned territory of core Foremost Independent Agencies, including responsibilities to prospect and appoint new agencies with guidance, drive profitable premium growth, and achieve financial and operational goals. This role develops and manages agency partnerships and serves as the primary relationship between the agency and the company.
  • The position develops and successfully promotes and supports the available suite of Foremost products and services, including a portfolio of moderately complex accounts, within an assigned territory. This role is at the forefront of building premium growth through relationships with agents to ensure market share is built successfully.
  • This position is an individual contributor who receives moderate guidance and direction from management and field distribution partners while performing work with business unit and enterprise impacts.
  • The position is remote with required weekly field travel in Northern California (Bay Area, Stockton, Sacramento, San Jose, San Francisco) - candidate must within territory.

Essential Job Functions

  • Owns and manages assigned territory driving profitable growth to achieve financial and operational targets.
  • With moderate guidance from management and field distribution partners, assists in leading, developing, and executing territory tactical plan and agency management processes (example business planning, training, compensation) to support financial and operational targets, measure results, and pivot as necessary.
  • With coaching, builds and cultivates mutually beneficial agency partnerships in person with agency ownership, management, and frontline staff using a consultative sales framework.
  • Establishes position as a trusted advisor while delivering product, underwriting philosophy, appetite, and system training, to support retention and new business development to increase depth and maximize agency revenue.
  • With moderate guidance, creates, maintains, and executes high quality agency strategies and plans, including holding agents accountable, to achieve written premium, profit, and new business goals.
  • Coordinates plans with field distribution partners, including strategic and tactical components, to align with business strategies such as carrier consolidation (agency book consolidation), agency storefront expansion, and new product or program rollout support.
  • With coaching, drives and ensures quality of new business flow, appropriate mix of business, and overall risk management of both ind ividual agency books and overall assigned territory.
  • Provides appetite and target market clarity, identifies and addresses profit or quality of business concerns to ensure profitability across territory.
  • Strategically utilizes internal reporting and tools designed to support the Independent Agent channel including all Marketing and Development programs, business development tools and internal production/profitability data and analysis.
  • Performs other duties as ass igned.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum three years of insurance sales and management work experience.
  • Experience achieving profitable premium growth and sales success.

Education Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred. CIC, CPCU, or insurance licenses preferred. Upon Hire.

Senior Financial Analyst role supporting financial operations and business analysis for Farmers Insurance. Responsibilities include budget variance analysis, financial modeling, forecasting, expense analysis, and finance operations including AP/AR and reconciliations.

Good fit if you have 4+ years in accounting or finance with strong Excel and ERP skills, and experience in financial analysis, budgeting, and reconciliations.

Full job description

Job Summary

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations and provide meaningful analysis to business unit leaders. This role combines financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, business modeling, and financial operations to help the business understand performance, identify trends, and make informed decisions.

You'll work closely with Finance, Accounting, and business stakeholders to maintain accurate financial information, support strategic planning, improve processes, and provide insights into the factors driving business performance.

Essential Job Functions

What You'll Do

  • Prepare and analyze monthly budget variance, forecasting, and KPI reports, identifying key trends and business drivers.
  • Develop financial and business models that provide insights to support business decisions.
  • Support annual strategic and financial planning, including consolidation and analysis.
  • Analyze expenses, vendors, and capital proposals, providing financial insights and recommendations.
  • Execute finance operations including AP/AR, reconciliations, banking transactions, and financial controls.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing accurate financial information and documentation.
  • Partner with Finance and business stakeholders on special projects, ad hoc analysis, and initiatives.
  • Lead or contribute to process improvement projects that improve efficiency and reduce operational risk.

Physical Actions

Physical Environment

Education Requirements

Experience Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in Accounting or Finance, preferably including financial analysis and finance operations.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Fluent English.
  • Strong experience with financial analysis, reconciliation, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Experience with AP/AR, banking operations, and financial controls.
  • Advanced proficiency with ERP systems and Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively with business and Finance stakeholders.
  • Experience identifying and implementing process improvements.
  • CPA or CMA exam progress, MBA/Master's coursework, or Six Sigma Yellow Belt certification is a nice to have
  • Knowledge in SAP
  • Desired knowledge in Tax

Job Summary

Farmers Group (Woodland Hills, CA) seeks a Solution Engineer to design, develop, and deliver scalable, enterprise-level technology solutions aligned with business objectives. Specific duties include: collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical designs; design end-to-end system architectures ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, scalability, performance, and security; lead solution design discussions across Agile Release Trains (ARTs) and coordinate implementation across multiple teams; define and manage non-functional requirements including performance, reliability, and availability; identify dependencies, constraints, and risks across applications and platforms; design and implement CI/CD pipelines; guide teams in coding standards, architecture patterns, and design principles; evaluate and integrate Google Cloud Platform services including Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Functions, and Cloud Storage; design and implement AI/ML solutions using Vertex AI, CCAI, Conversational AI, and Document AI; conduct technical feasibility analysis and proof-of-concepts; monitor solution delivery, perform root cause analysis, and recommend corrective actions; participate in PI Planning, Sprint Planning, system demos, and retrospectives; collaborate with QA teams to validate test strategies; maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams and design specifications; mentor junior engineers and promote knowledge sharing; research emerging technologies to enhance system capabilities. Position requires Specialization Certification covering GCP Machine Learning and Data Engineering. Position requires 10% travel within the U.S. Option to work remotely from anywhere in the U.S.

Position requires a Bachelor's degree, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a closely related field of study, plus 7 years of experience in the job offered, or as a Machine Learning AI Engineer, Computer Systems Analyst, Solution Lead, or similar experience in the IT software development position. Must have 7 years of experience with each of the following: working in software development, systems engineering, or solution engineering; designing and developing enterprise applications and distributed systems using Google Cloud Platform (GCP); implementing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices in the cloud platforms; programming in object-oriented and scripting languages using Python; working with data modeling, data processing, and database technologies; working with AI/ML frameworks, model development, and applied analytics; working with system integration, APIs, and microservices architecture; performing technical design, system analysis, and solution architecture; and working with Agile methodologies such as Scrum or SAFe. Must also have 1 year of experience mentoring junior developers. Must have Specialization Certification covering GCP Machine Learning and Data Engineering. Quick facts

  • Location: Fort Worth, TX
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • License: Valid driver's license
  • Benefits: 401(k), paid time off, tuition assistance

About this job

Field Property Claims Adjuster for Farmers Insurance in the Fort Worth area. Visit policyholders' homes to assess property damage, determine liability, and negotiate settlements using claims software. Starting wage $27.67/hr or higher.

Good fit if you have a high school diploma, customer service experience, valid driver's license, and can climb ladders and work in confined spaces multiple times daily.

Full job description

We are Farmers – where ambition meets opportunity.

At Farmers, we're not just known for unforgettable jingle – we're a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people's lives. We deliver peace of mind when it matters most. Our results-driven, high-performance culture thrives on creativity, accountability and bold solutions. Here, growth isn't just a goal – it's a way of life for both the organization and every individual on our team. We tackle challenges head-on, learn from every experience and measure our impact on the customers who trust us.

Join an award-winning, equal opportunity employer, where you'll find more than a job – you'll find a supportive community. Enjoy competitive benefits, take part in meaningful volunteer projects, and help shape the future alongside talented colleagues across all backgrounds. At Farmers, helping others is at the heart of what we do.

Ready to make your mark? Discover our vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate. Connect with us on Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok, and let's build something incredible together!

Workplace: Remote ( #LI-Remote ) - This is a field role requiring travel to and from policy holder homes.

Residency Requirement: Candidates must currently live within the Fort Worth, Arlingon, or Euless TX area and NORTH of Interstate 20 to be eligible for consideration.

The starting wage for this position is $27.67hr. or higher. Additional compensation may be offered based on relevant experience and transferable skills.

If you are looking for the following in your next career ...

  • Paid training through the award-winning and industry-leading University of Farmers.
  • Flexibility and independence to work outside the confines of a desk job.
  • Total Rewards Benefits Package: 401K and a competitive starting salary.
  • Rapid growth potential and management opportunities for success-oriented people through education,mentorship programs, and inspirational leadership at a company you can be proud of.


… then Farmers Insurance is the place for you!

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Adjuster:

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders' residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days.

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

If You Have the Following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable. Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

... then this could be a great career opportunity for you!

Final candidate qualifications may be reviewed against the requirements for the associated level of this role.

Candidates Must be Willing & Able to:

  • Climb Ladders to inspect roofs, and be comfortable working on rooftops, multiple times per day,
  • Work in small, confined spaces that have been damaged; such as attics and crawlspaces.
  • Achieve a minimum passing score on all claims training exams.

Physical Actions & Environment:

  • Bending, Kneeling, Pulling, Pushing, Sorting, Carrying up to 50 lbs., Climbing, Reaching, Standing, Walking, Seeing
  • Speaking (English), Reading (English), Writing (English), & Key Entering

Required job duties are performed in the field and an in-home office environment. Exposure to some or all of the following environments when in the field: Uncontrolled outside environmental conditions, Excessive noise levels, Chemicals Chemical/Biological conditions, Moving mechanical parts, Areas considered dangerous, Conditions which could affect the respiratory system or skin such as fumes, odors, dust, mists, gases, oils, smoke, soot, or poor ventilation.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of an Inside Property Adjuster, and what it take to do the job!

As an Inside Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve virtually inspecting damages, investigating coverage, preparing estimates, and settling claims promptly and accurately. You will be interacting with customers, contractors, and vendors through various software platforms such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. This communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. This role places a particular focus on water losses, ensuring that our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always.

  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Schedule:

During Training: IN OFFICE

  • Monday through Friday, 8am-4:30pm

After Training: HYBRID (IN OFFICE & REMOTE)

  • Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm with rotational Saturday duty

  • Mondays and Fridays (remote)

  • Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays (in-office)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of previous customer service experience.

  • Excellent organization skills.

  • Ability to multi-task.

  • Excellent negotiation and communication skills to interact with customers and stakeholders remotely.

  • Ability to work independently and manage time efficiently in an office and virtual work environment.

  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality and efficient claim resolutions.

  • Previous industry experience is highly desired.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign-on Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

  • Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Active Listening, Communication, Critical Thinking, Customer Service, Empathy, Multitasking, Time Management, Working Independently

Compensation

Base compensation offered for this role is $50,000-$86,400 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

About this job

Sell Allstate insurance products to inbound leads via phone, chat, and SMS from home. Work involves consultative sales with warm leads, no cold calling, and compensation includes base pay plus uncapped performance incentives.

Good fit if you have at least one year of sales or customer service experience and can obtain a Property and Casualty Producer license

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Pay: $18/hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $52,730$76,480/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)
  • Incentives are productivity-based and governed by the applicable bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstates discretion.

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Additional Benefits

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance
  • Monthly internet reimbursement
  • Home office equipment provided by Allstate

Why Join Allstate

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you
  • Career Growth: Develop your skills within a dynamic, supportive Fortune 100 company
  • Supportive Culture: Learn from best-in-class leaders and motivated teammates
  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customers needs

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer service (with a sales focus)
  • Active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license in your state of residence (preferred)
  • If unlicensed, ability to obtain a Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license with Allstates support
  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated by Allstate. This includes obtaining non-resident Producer licenses in all states as required for the role.
  • If hired, Sales Representative must relinquish all non-Allstate insurance carrier appointments and may not hold active appointments with other carriers while employed in this role, in accordance with Allstate licensing and appointment policies.
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Reliable high-speed internet with wired connection (Ethernet)
  • Dedicated, distraction-free home workspace (equipment provided)
  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends
  • Receptive to feedback and performance coaching
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and multitasking skills
  • Competitive, highly self-motivated and enjoys being rewarded for your efforts
  • Able to work independently and hold yourself accountable for your performance
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously

Essential Job Functions

  • Handle inbound and outbound customer calls as the primary method of customer engagement.
  • Maintain availability during assigned work hours to meet call volume and service expectations. This function is particularly crucial during an employees first 90 days of employment.
  • Deliver consultative sales conversations and complete transactions during live customer interactions.
  • Adhere to assigned schedules, including evenings and weekends, based on business coverage needs.
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and performance standards.
  • Navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously while actively engaged with customers.

This position is only available within theUS, but notcurrently available for Puerto Rico, California, New York, Alaska, Hawaii, or Washington state residents.

Candidates who reside in locations where the local minimum wage exceeds the base pay for this position are also not eligible for consideration. This is due to compliance with wage regulations and internal compensation practices.

Allstate provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their role. Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Representative, Insurance Sales, Insurance Agent
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Pay: $18/hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $52,730$76,480/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)
  • Incentives are productivity-based and governed by the applicable bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstates discretion.

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Additional Benefits

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance
  • Monthly internet reimbursement
  • Home office equipment provided by Allstate

Why Join Allstate

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you
  • Career Growth: Develop your skills within a dynamic, supportive Fortune 100 company
  • Supportive Culture: Learn from best-in-class leaders and motivated teammates
  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customers needs

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer service (with a sales focus)
  • Active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license in your state of residence (preferred)
  • If unlicensed, ability to obtain a Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license with Allstates support
  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated by Allstate. This includes obtaining non-resident Producer licenses in all states as required for the role.
  • If hired, Sales Representative must relinquish all non-Allstate insurance carrier appointments and may not hold active appointments with other carriers while employed in this role, in accordance with Allstate licensing and appointment policies.
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Reliable high-speed internet with wired connection (Ethernet)
  • Dedicated, distraction-free home workspace (equipment provided)
  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends
  • Receptive to feedback and performance coaching
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and multitasking skills
  • Competitive, highly self-motivated and enjoys being rewarded for your efforts
  • Able to work independently and hold yourself accountable for your performance
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously

Essential Job Functions

  • Handle inbound and outbound customer calls as the primary method of customer engagement.
  • Maintain availability during assigned work hours to meet call volume and service expectations. This function is particularly crucial during an employees first 90 days of employment.
  • Deliver consultative sales conversations and complete transactions during live customer interactions.
  • Adhere to assigned schedules, including evenings and weekends, based on business coverage needs.
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and performance standards.
  • Navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously while actively engaged with customers.

This position is only available within theUS, but notcurrently available for Puerto Rico, California, New York, Alaska, Hawaii, or Washington state residents.

Candidates who reside in locations where the local minimum wage exceeds the base pay for this position are also not eligible for consideration. This is due to compliance with wage regulations and internal compensation practices.


Reasonable Accommodation Statement

Allstate provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their role. During the first 90 days of employment, reasonable accommodations generally do not include removing essential job functions, creating new positions, or lowering performance or productivity standards.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Representative, Insurance Sales, Insurance Agent
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $18.00 an hour
  • Schedule: Full-time, includes weekends
  • Location: Madison, WI
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), tuition assistance

About this job

Full-time remote insurance sales role selling Property & Casualty and Personal Lines products to warm leads via phone, chat, and SMS. Base pay is $18/hour with uncapped performance-based incentives, bringing average total compensation to $52,730-$76,480/year.

Good fit if you have at least 1 year of sales or customer service experience, a state insurance license or ability to obtain one, reliable high-speed internet, and can work evenings and weekends.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Pay: $18/hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $52,730$76,480/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)
  • Incentives are productivity-based and governed by the applicable bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstates discretion.
  • Eligible licensed external candidates who complete licensing prior to hire or bring an active Property & Casualty or Personal Lines license before start date may be eligible for a bonus.

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Additional Benefits

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance
  • Monthly internet reimbursement
  • Home office equipment provided by Allstate

Why Join Allstate

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you
  • Career Growth: Develop your skills within a dynamic, supportive Fortune 100 company
  • Supportive Culture: Learn from best-in-class leaders and motivated teammates
  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customers needs

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer service (with a sales focus)
  • Active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license in your state of residence (preferred)
  • If unlicensed, ability to obtain a Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license with Allstates support
  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated by Allstate. This includes obtaining non-resident Producer licenses in all states as required for the role.
  • If hired, Sales Representative must relinquish all non-Allstate insurance carrier appointments and may not hold active appointments with other carriers while employed in this role, in accordance with Allstate licensing and appointment policies.
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Reliable high-speed internet with wired connection (Ethernet)
  • Dedicated, distraction-free home workspace (equipment provided)
  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends
  • Receptive to feedback and performance coaching
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and multitasking skills
  • Competitive, highly self-motivated and enjoys being rewarded for your efforts
  • Able to work independently and hold yourself accountable for your performance
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously


Essential Job Functions

  • Handle inbound and outbound customer calls as the primary method of customer engagement.
    Maintain availability during assigned work hours to meet call volume and service expectations. This function is particularly crucial during an employees first 90 days of employment.
    Deliver consultative sales conversations and complete transactions during live customer interactions.
    Adhere to assigned schedules, including evenings and weekends, based on business coverage needs.
    Meet established productivity, quality, and performance standards.
    Navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously while actively engaged with customers.

Quick facts

  • Pay: $20.00 an hour
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Gardendale, AL
  • Experience: 2+ years
  • Benefits: Health insurance, retirement plan, paid time off, paid holidays, tuition assistance

About this job

Sell auto, home, and specialty insurance to local customers in person and by phone for National General/Allstate. Generate new business, cross-sell existing customers, and build community relationships to drive growth.

Good fit if you have 0-2 years of experience and can obtain P&C licensing within 90 days, or already hold it.

Full job description

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making a difference, then apply to join our team today!

As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

  • Achieve sales goals through new business, cross-sell, and retention
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals
  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

What makes Direct Auto Insurance unique?

  • Day 1 Benefits
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Tuition Reimbursement, Pension & so much more
  • 20 PTO Days per year & 6 Paid Holidays
  • Ability to sell a multitude of industry-leading products through retail stores and phone
  • Entrepreneurial, performance-based, and results-focused culture
  • Multi-tiered and comprehensive paid training program
  • Base hourly rate plus uncapped monthly incentive

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 0 2 years of experience
  • P&C licensing (Preferred) or must attain required licensure within 90 days of joining the company.

Skills

Active Learning, Adaptability, Business Integrity, Customer Service, Persuasion, Sales, Social Orientation, Time Management

Base compensation: $20.00 per hour

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Cybersecurity Strategy Manager helps Allstate Cybersecurity & Controls (ACC) leaders turn complex cybersecurity risks, strategies, performance information, and technical initiatives into clear decisions, aligned action, and measurable outcomes. As part of the ACC Strategy team, this role develops compelling narratives and executive-ready communications for the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), ACC leadership, senior executives, the Board, and the Audit Committee. Operating as a trusted advisor in an evolving and often ambiguous environment, the role brings structure to complex questions, synthesizes technical and business perspectives, and frames priorities, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations in concise, non-technical language. Success is reflected in stronger executive decision-making, consistent strategic narratives, greater visibility into cybersecurity posture and outcomes, clear accountability, and coordinated progress on the highest-priority risks.

Key Responsibilities


  • Develop clear, compelling cybersecurity narratives for the CISO, senior executives, Board, and Audit Committee.
  • Translate complex cybersecurity risks, strategies, metrics, and technical initiatives into concise, non-technical, decision-ready communications.
  • Create executive-level presentations and communications, including briefings, talking points, strategic reports, leadership updates, and Board materials.
  • Support the development and governance of the Allstate Cybersecurity & Controls (ACC) strategy, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities, business strategy, and the evolving cybersecurity risk environment.
  • Monitor cybersecurity threats, regulatory developments, technology trends, and business changes to identify strategic implications and emerging priorities.
  • Coordinate cross-functional strategic governance, including key commitments, portfolio outcomes, dependencies, risks, metrics, and leadership decisions.
  • Measure and communicate strategic progress and cybersecurity outcomes through meaningful metrics, trends, gaps, and indicators of risk reduction.
  • Analyze complex and ambiguous business and cybersecurity challenges, combining quantitative and qualitative information to develop practical recommendations.
  • Frame strategic options, trade-offs, and recommendations and facilitate leadership discussions around prioritization, sequencing, and risk-informed decision-making.
  • Build alignment across cybersecurity and enterprise partners, including Technology, Enterprise Risk, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Communications, while strengthening governance practices and team standards.

Required Education and Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in strategy, executive communications, strategic planning, management consulting, business analysis, portfolio governance, risk, technology, financial services, or related roles.
  • Demonstrated experience developing executive presentations, strategic narratives, briefing materials, or Board-facing content and synthesizing complex technical and business information into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Experience supporting strategy development, governance, metrics, portfolio reporting, facilitation, cross-functional decision-making, or senior executive communications.
  • Experience in cybersecurity, technology, risk, consulting, financial services, insurance, or another complex regulated environment preferred.
  • Must be willing and able to travel into our Chicago, Illinois office on an as needed basis.

About this job

Design, build, and own scalable data pipelines and products using Microsoft Fabric and modern data engineering practices. Partner with product managers, engineers, and analysts to deliver data solutions that power digital products and business insights.

Good fit if you have strong proficiency with PySpark, Python, SQL, and experience with Apache Spark, Kafka, or similar tools

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Design, build, and own scalable data products and pipelines using Microsoft Fabric and modern data engineering practices, ensuring reliability, performance, governance, and effective delivery of trusted data for digital products and analytics.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and support high-quality data solutions and pipelines using modern engineering practices and tools. In this role, you will partner closely with product managers, software engineers, and data analysts to deliver scalable, reliable data capabilities that power digital products and business insights. You will be accountable for the endtoend lifecycle of your data products, from design and implementation through production support, data quality, and performance against key metrics.

Key Responsibilities:


Design, Build & Manage Data Solutions

  • Design, develop, and enhance scalable data pipelines and data processing systems.
  • Build reusable ingestion, transformation, and storage patterns to support product and analytical needs.
  • Integrate data from diverse sources including APIs, databases, event streams, and thirdparty systems.
  • Implement data models and schemas that create unified, consistent views of business operations.

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chicago, IL

About this job

Senior technical leadership role designing and delivering enterprise-scale data solutions across cloud, lakehouse, warehouse, streaming, and analytical platforms. Leads architecture modernization, establishes engineering standards, and drives data governance across multiple teams and business domains.

Good fit if you have expertise in data architecture, distributed processing technologies like Spark and Kafka, Microsoft Fabric, and cloud platforms.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Data Expert provides technical leadership in designing and delivering scalable, reliable, and well-governed enterprise data solutions. This role defines data architecture and engineering standards, solves complex data challenges, and drives modernization and engineering excellence across teams.

As a Data Expert, you will provide technical leadership in the design, engineering, governance, and evolution of enterprise data solutions. This role serves as a senior technical authority for complex data initiatives, translating business and analytical needs into scalable, secure, reliable, and well-governed data products.


You will lead the design of modern data architectures and engineering patterns, establish technical standards and best practices, and solve highly complex data problems spanning multiple systems and business domains. You will partner with product managers, architects, engineers, analytics teams, and business stakeholders to modernize data platforms and create trusted, reusable data capabilities.


You are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence technical direction across teams, mentor engineers, and drive continuous improvement in data architecture, engineering, governance, quality, observability, and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities:


Data Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Lead the architecture and design of complex, enterprise-scale data solutions across cloud, lakehouse, warehouse, streaming, and analytical platforms.
  • Define scalable architectural patterns for data ingestion, transformation, storage, integration, consumption, and lifecycle management.
  • Provide technical direction for complex initiatives involving multiple applications, data domains, platforms, and engineering teams.
  • Establish standards for data modeling, interoperability, metadata, lineage, security, performance, and platform integration.
  • Lead technical design reviews and evaluate architectural trade-offs involving scalability, reliability, maintainability, performance, security, and cost.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for complex data architecture, engineering, integration, and production challenges.
  • Guide modernization of legacy data platforms and workloads using modern cloud and distributed data technologies.

Advanced Data Engineering

  • Design and lead implementation of highly scalable batch, streaming, and event-driven data processing solutions.
  • Develop complex data solutions using Python, PySpark, Scala, SQL, or comparable engineering languages.
  • Apply distributed processing technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, Flink, dbt, or equivalent modern data frameworks.
  • Design reusable engineering frameworks and patterns that accelerate delivery across multiple data products and teams.
  • Design dimensional, relational, lakehouse, and domain-oriented data models appropriate for operational and analytical use cases.
  • Optimize distributed workloads, SQL queries, storage organization, partitioning strategies, and data pipelines for performance, scalability, and cost.
  • Establish advanced practices for automated testing, dependency management, orchestration, failure recovery, replay, and operational resilience.

Microsoft Fabric & Cloud Data Platforms

  • Provide technical leadership for modern data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Data Pipelines, Notebooks, Dataflows Gen2, and Semantic Models.
  • Design scalable processing solutions using Fabric Notebooks, Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, and Delta Lake.
  • Define patterns for data organization, ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and consumption within Microsoft Fabric.
  • Apply appropriate Azure and/or AWS cloud services to enterprise data architectures.
  • Evaluate emerging platform capabilities and determine where they can improve engineering productivity, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.

Engineering Excellence & DevOps

  • Define and promote software engineering standards for data development, including Git-based version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, and automated deployment.
  • Establish reusable development patterns, coding standards, testing strategies, and deployment practices.
  • Design observability strategies covering pipeline execution, data quality, dependencies, application health, performance, and failures.
  • Drive proactive monitoring and operational excellence using platforms such as Datadog or equivalent observability technologies.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for complex production issues and drive solutions that prevent recurrence.
  • Establish measurable engineering practices that improve reliability, maintainability, performance, and supportability.

Data Quality, Governance & Security

  • Define and implement enterprise-level practices for data quality, metadata management, lineage, retention, classification, and lifecycle management.
  • Establish automated data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and quality monitoring practices.
  • Partner with business owners, data custodians, governance teams, security teams, and architects to establish trusted and governed data products.
  • Ensure solutions align with applicable privacy, security, regulatory, retention, and enterprise data governance requirements.
  • Establish clear ownership and accountability for critical data elements and governed data products.
  • Design and communicate standards for documenting data sources, transformations, lineage, business rules, and downstream dependencies.

Technical Strategy & Innovation

  • Evaluate new data technologies, architectural patterns, and frameworks and recommend adoption where they provide measurable value.
  • Provide technical leadership for modernization initiatives and migration from legacy data ecosystems to modern cloud and lakehouse platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, reduce technical debt, improve development velocity, and increase reuse.
  • Apply generative AI and agentic AI tools and patterns where appropriate to improve data engineering productivity, metadata management, data quality, and operational processes.
  • Develop prototypes and reference implementations to validate emerging technologies and architecture patterns.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence

  • Partner with senior business and technology leaders to translate complex business needs into long-term data capabilities.
  • Communicate complex technical topics, architectural decisions, risks, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Facilitate architectural and technical discussions across engineering, product, analytics, governance, and business teams.
  • Influence technical direction across multiple teams without direct supervisory authority.
  • Mentor engineers and help develop advanced engineering and architecture capabilities across the organization.
  • Create technical documentation, reference architectures, standards, and reusable implementation guidance.

Core Skills

  • Expert-level knowledge of data architecture, data engineering, distributed processing, data integration, and data modeling.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, PySpark, Scala, SQL, or comparable languages used for large-scale data processing.
  • Advanced understanding of Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Notebooks, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and Semantic Models.
  • Strong knowledge of Delta Lake, lakehouse architecture, distributed computing, batch processing, and streaming architectures.
  • Advanced SQL expertise, including query optimization and performance tuning.
  • Strong understanding of relational, dimensional, NoSQL, and distributed data modeling techniques.
  • Experience designing reusable frameworks and enterprise-scale data processing patterns.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud architecture and data services within Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
  • Advanced understanding of engineering practices including Git, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure/deployment automation, and release management.
  • Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog and designing operational monitoring for enterprise data solutions.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, security, privacy, and retention principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex distributed data and production problems.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and influence engineering standards across multiple teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to communicate architecture and technical strategy to engineering teams, business partners, and senior leadership.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience designing large-scale solutions on Microsoft Fabric and Azure.
  • Experience modernizing legacy data warehouse, ETL, or enterprise data processing environments into cloud/lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience developing metadata-driven data processing and orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience with event-driven and real-time data architectures.
  • Experience establishing enterprise data engineering standards, reusable frameworks, or reference architectures.
  • Experience with data cataloging, lineage, governance, and observability capabilities.
  • Experience applying generative AI and agentic AI technologies to data engineering and operational use cases.
  • Experience leading architecture reviews, proof-of-concepts, technology evaluations, and complex platform modernization efforts.

Experience

  • 10 or more years of relevant technology, data engineering, data architecture, or data platform experience (Preferred).
  • Significant experience designing and delivering complex, enterprise-scale data solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership across large or cross-functional initiatives.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. Job Description

Leads complex data and analytics initiatives that deliver trusted, secure, and scalable enterprise data capabilities. This role combines technical expertise, business knowledge, and cross-functional leadership to advance data strategy, governance, quality, modernization, and analytics across the enterprise.

The Data & Analytics Lead Consultant provides strategic and technical leadership to deliver enterprise data and analytics capabilities that support business goals and enable trusted, data-driven decision making. This role combines strong data and analytics expertise with business knowledge to lead complex initiatives, establish scalable solutions and standards, and foster collaboration across business, technology, analytics, and data governance teams.


The Lead Consultant will contribute to enterprise data strategy across Data Governance & Quality, Analytics Ecosystem, Master Data Management, and Data Information & Security, while helping modernize data platforms and engineering practices.


Key Responsibilities:


Data & Analytics Strategy

  • Lead complex, cross-functional data and analytics initiatives aligned with business and enterprise data strategies.
  • Translate business objectives and requirements into actionable data, analytics, and technology solutions.
  • Contribute to functional strategy and define measurable success criteria for enterprise-wide initiatives.
  • Develop frameworks, roadmaps, and implementation plans for strategic data initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve how enterprise data is collected, integrated, managed, governed, and consumed.
  • Evaluate technical approaches and communicate recommendations, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs to stakeholders.

Data Solutions & Modernization

  • Lead the design and delivery of scalable data solutions supporting analytical and business needs.
  • Provide technical guidance for data ingestion, transformation, integration, storage, modeling, and consumption.
  • Apply modern data technologies and frameworks such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Spark, Python/PySpark, SQL, Kafka, dbt, or equivalent technologies.
  • Support modernization of legacy data platforms and processes through cloud, lakehouse, and modern data engineering patterns.
  • Promote reusable patterns and standards that improve consistency, scalability, maintainability, and delivery efficiency.
  • Ensure data solutions meet expectations for performance, reliability, security, and operational support.

Data Governance & Quality

  • Establish and promote practices that improve the reliability, consistency, accessibility, and quality of enterprise data.
  • Partner with business and technology teams to define data ownership, stewardship, metadata, lineage, and quality expectations.
  • Define and monitor data quality controls, validation rules, reconciliation processes, and key data quality metrics.
  • Help establish trusted and governed data sources that can be consistently reused across business and analytical applications.
  • Ensure appropriate data lifecycle, retention, privacy, and governance requirements are incorporated into data solutions.

Analytics Ecosystem

  • Enable the appropriate data, platforms, and capabilities needed to conduct analysis, inform decisions, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Partner with analytics, data engineering, product, and business teams to develop integrated analytical capabilities.
  • Promote consistent and reusable approaches to data modeling, data access, semantic definition, and analytics consumption.
  • Identify gaps in the analytics ecosystem and recommend improvements to platforms, processes, and capabilities.

Master Data Management

  • Support the development and adoption of trusted enterprise sources for key business data.
  • Establish processes and standards that improve the consistency, quality, and usability of shared data across business domains.
  • Partner with data owners, data custodians, technology teams, and business stakeholders to establish authoritative data definitions and ownership.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce duplication and inconsistencies across enterprise data assets.

Data Information & Security

  • Partner with security, governance, and technology teams to protect enterprise data through appropriate security and access controls.
  • Ensure data solutions align with applicable privacy, security, regulatory, and enterprise requirements.
  • Incorporate security considerations into data architecture, integration, storage, and consumption designs.
  • Promote appropriate data classification and access practices throughout the data lifecycle.

Program Leadership & Enterprise Collaboration

  • Lead integrated, multi-track projects and initiatives, ensuring high-quality deliverables, effective risk management, and alignment with business objectives.
  • Develop project plans, establish controls, track performance, manage dependencies, and communicate risks and status.
  • Collaborate across business units and technology teams to resolve complex data and delivery challenges.
  • Foster enterprise-wide collaboration and alignment across data engineering, analytics, architecture, governance, security, and business teams.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear business implications, capabilities, risks, and recommendations.
  • Communicate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.
  • Mentor team members and promote knowledge sharing and adoption of data and analytics best practices.

Core Skills

  • Strong knowledge of data and analytics strategy, data governance, data quality, data engineering, and analytics.
  • Strong understanding of modern data architecture, including lakehouse, data warehouse, batch and streaming processing, and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Hands-on knowledge of technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Spark, Python/PySpark, SQL, or equivalent modern data technologies.
  • Experience with data modeling, data integration, metadata, lineage, master data management, and data quality practices.
  • Understanding of Microsoft Fabric capabilities including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Notebooks, Data Pipelines, and Semantic Models.
  • Experience with modern software and data engineering practices including Git, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work through complex technical and business problems.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and influence outcomes without direct authority.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into business capabilities and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong collaboration, facilitation, consulting, and written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services.
  • Experience modernizing legacy data platforms and processes into cloud or lakehouse architectures.
  • Knowledge of enterprise data governance, data catalogs, metadata management, lineage, and data quality frameworks.
  • Experience with Master Data Management and enterprise data standardization.
  • Experience with data security, privacy, classification, and access-control practices.
  • Familiarity with generative and agentic AI capabilities and their application to data, analytics, and engineering productivity.

Experience

  • 7 or more years of relevant experience in data, analytics, technology, consulting, or related disciplines (Preferred).
  • Experience leading complex or cross-functional data and analytics initiatives (Preferred).

About this job

Investigate automobile accidents involving bodily injury, assess coverage and liability, and negotiate settlements with customers and third parties. Remote position in MST/PST time zones with technology provided and $80 monthly internet reimbursement.

Good fit if you have 2+ years of casualty bodily injury claims experience and strong phone communication and problem-solving skills.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

As a Claims Resolution Adjuster, your focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving bodily injury. In this role, you will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service. You will communicate with customers through voice calls, email, and text messages, and use innovative platforms and tools to negotiate fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

Candidates for this role must reside in the Pacific or Mountain time zones. This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.


At Allstate, responsibilities may vary from day to day. We are looking for adaptable professionals who thrive in a dynamic environment, bring care and sound judgment to each claim, and are excited to make an impact.


  • The Customer Service Expert Youll support customers by caring, empowering, and restoring throughout the claims process. You will do this by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator Youll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator Youll use phone, email, and sometimes video chat to help customers through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also tailor your approach to claim handling by honoring the customers communication preferences and keeping them updated on claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claim settlements with customers, vendors, third-party carriers, and claimants in accordance with legal and business standards. You will incorporate tactics for handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver Youll use multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimating tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, while applying strong critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder Youll help protect the company financially by following applicable policies and keeping a clear record of your work in the claims system. Youll ensure timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of claims experience, specifically with casualty bodily injury claims.
  • Claims investigation and negotiation experience preferred.
  • Experience with liability investigations, coverage investigations, property damage coverage, method of inspection, rental, and liability resolution preferred.
  • Strong phone communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.

Work Location


This position is a remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States within one of the listed time zones above.


When you work from home full time, youll need:

  • A dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.


What will Allstate provide?

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet.

Work Schedule

  • 8-hour shift Mon-Fri | 8:00am - 4:30pm with potential Saturday duty rotation.

Licensing Requirements

  • You may be required to obtain an adjuster and/or appraiser license as a condition of employment.
  • If required, licensing may include an additional Department of Insurance background check and must be completed within 60 days of hire.
  • If you currently hold an active insurance license, you must terminate all existing appointments before onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments during employment.
  • If you are seeking an adjuster role and hold a resident producer license, you must formally surrender that license when instructed by the licensing team.
  • The Hiring Manager and Centralized Licensing team will provide support if licensing is required. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and agree to comply with these licensing requirements.

Sign-On Bonus Information

  • Candidates with the active license(s) required for this role may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign-On Bonus.
  • Eligible licenses may include a Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.
  • Current employees and candidates previously employed by Allstate or its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Allstate Benefits

  • Day 1 benefits, including time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.
  • Competitive pay, plus support for ongoing development and career advancement.
  • Time off programs and resources that support work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to help you succeed in the role.
  • Additional benefits may include 401(k)/pension, education reimbursement, and programs that support life outside of work. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

  • In our virtual environment, employees are expected to be on camera and actively participate during online meetings and training sessions.
  • This job description is not intended to include a complete list of all duties and responsibilities. Employees may be asked to perform other related duties as assigned.
  • Regular, predictable attendance is an essential function of this role.

The first approximately 8-12 of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.
