About this job

Conduct on-site and virtual risk assessments for high-value homes in New York City, identifying vulnerabilities and developing customized loss prevention strategies. Serve as trusted advisor to affluent homeowners while supporting underwriting decisions on property characteristics and coverage adequacy.

Good fit if you have 3+ years in risk management, loss control, underwriting, or related property discipline, know residential construction and valuation, and can communicate complex risks clearly.

Full job description

Company Details

Berkley One is a modern insurance provider for a modern generation of affluence. We serve clients who live dynamic, adventurous lives and expect their insurance experience to match. Our mission is to deliver highly personalized risk and claims management through a blend of expert independent agents, cutting-edge digital tools, and the strength of the W.R. Berkley brand.

Why Join Us?
At Berkley One, you'll be part of a forward-thinking team that's reimagining personal insurance. We're building solutions that are as sophisticated and agile as the clients we serve—individuals and families who value innovation, simplicity, and exceptional service. You'll collaborate with passionate professionals, leverage modern technology, and help shape the future of our industry.

What We Value

  • A client-first mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional experiences
  • Curiosity, creativity, and a drive to challenge the status quo
  • Collaboration across disciplines to build smarter, more intuitive solutions
  • Integrity, expertise, and a commitment to excellence

Join us in creating a new standard in personal insurance—where protection meets possibility.

#LI-AV1 #LI-REMOTE

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer.

Responsibilities

As a High Value Home Risk Consultant, you'll serve as a trusted advisor to affluent homeowners, helping them protect their homes, families, and valuable assets from preventable loss. Through on-site and virtual risk assessments, the consultant identifies vulnerabilities and exposures, educates clients on emerging and common risks, and develops practical, customized loss prevention strategies.

By combining technical expertise with a consultative approach, the Risk Consultant helps clients understand their risks, evaluate mitigation options, and make informed decisions that enhance safety, resilience, and long-term asset protection. The role is focused not only on identifying exposures, but also on influencing action and supporting clients throughout their loss prevention journey.

You'll be an essential partner to Underwriting by validating property characteristics, assessing overall risk quality, establishing accurate replacement cost estimates, and escalating material underwriting concerns that may impact eligibility, pricing, or coverage decisions.

This is a fully remote/work-from-home position supporting accounts throughout New York City with heavy concentration in Manhattan, and serving the Brooklyn/Kings county area.

What you can expect:

  • Culture of innovation, teamwork, supportive colleagues and leaders willing to invest in talent
  • Internal mobility opportunities
  • Visibility to senior leaders and partnership with cross functional teams
  • Opportunity to impact change
  • Benefits – competitive compensation, paid time off, comprehensive wellness benefits and programs, employer funded health savings account, profit sharing, 401k, paid parental leave, employee stock purchase plan, tuition assistance and professional continuing education

We'll count on you to:

  • Conduct comprehensive risk assessments for high-value homes to identify exposures that could lead to property damage, personal liability, or threats to client safety and security.

  • Evaluate risks associated with water damage, fire, electrical systems, severe weather, natural catastrophes, homes under construction, personal security, and other exposures common to affluent homeowners.

  • Deliver tailored loss prevention recommendations designed to reduce the likelihood and severity of loss while improving the resilience of the home and lifestyle.

  • Act as a trusted advisor by educating clients on risks, explaining mitigation options, and supporting informed decision-making.

  • Encourage and influence adoption of loss prevention measures through effective consultation, clear communication, and ongoing engagement with clients and brokers.

  • Maintain knowledge of emerging loss trends, technologies, and best practices to provide relevant and actionable risk management guidance.

  • Collaborate with brokers, clients, contractors, and service providers to facilitate the implementation of recommended risk mitigation solutions.

  • Validate and document property characteristics, construction features, protective systems, and occupancy information to support sound underwriting decisions.

  • Develop, validate, and maintain accurate replacement cost estimates to help ensure adequate insurance-to-value.

  • Identify, evaluate, and escalate material underwriting concerns, changes in risk profile, or coverage adequacy issues discovered during the assessment process.

  • Prepare clear and concise risk assessment reports that communicate exposures, recommendations, and underwriting considerations.

  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

What you'll need to have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent

  • 3+ years of experience in risk management, loss control, underwriting, claims, construction, appraising, or a related property risk discipline.

  • Strong ability to identify property loss exposures and provide effective loss prevention and risk mitigation recommendations.

  • Knowledge of residential construction, building systems, property valuation, and replacement cost methodologies.

  • Experience working with affluent clients and a solid understanding of personal insurance products and risk management principles.

  • Proficiency with e2Value or similar valuation platforms.

  • Exceptional communication, consulting, and relationship-management skills.

  • Customer-focused with the ability to influence action, build trust, and advocate for client needs.

  • Highly organized, accountable, and collaborative, with strong judgment and problem-solving skills.

What makes you stand out:

  • Curious, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement and innovation.

  • Ability to travel throughout the assigned territory, including occasional overnight travel and flexible scheduling

Additional Company Details

We do not accept any unsolicited resumes from external recruiting agencies or firms.

The company offers a competitive compensation plan and robust benefits package for full time regular employees which for this role include:
• Base Salary Range: $110,000 - $135,000
• Eligible to participate in annual discretionary bonus.
• Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Wellness, Paid Time Off, 401(k) and Profit-Sharing plans.

The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment.

Sponsorship not Offered for this Role

At Farmers, we're not just known for unforgettable jingle – we're a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people's lives. We deliver peace of mind when it matters most. Join an award-winning, equal opportunity employer, where you'll find more than a job – you'll find a supportive community. Enjoy competitive benefits, take part in meaningful volunteer projects, and help shape the future alongside talented colleagues across all backgrounds. At Farmers, helping others is at the heart of what we do.

Ready to make your mark? Discover our vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate. Connect with us on Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok, and let's build something incredible together!

Workplace: Hybrid ( #LI-Hybrid ), Remote ( #LI-Remote )

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered.

Job Summary

This position collaborates with business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver technical solutions that support complex to highly complex business initiatives. The role acts as a subject matter expert to provide systems-level views of technology and devise technical solutions aligned with business objectives. It focuses on enhancing solution design, optimizing development processes, and effectively implementing CI/CD pipelines to deliver impactful solutions that meet business needs. The position ensures technology delivery is successful within lines of business and across the enterprise. It performs work independently while receiving guidance or direction for only the most complex scenarios. Mentors, trains, and coaches team members at all levels.

Essential Tasks & Leadership Philosophy

  • Partners with cross-functional business stakeholders and technical teams to understand and address complex to highly complex initiatives within a business unit or at the enterprise level. Leads discussions to gather requirements, develop solutions, validate technology assumptions, and evaluate implementation alternatives. Influences solution strategies by leveraging comprehensive business knowledge and depth of expertise in solution engineering.
  • Acts as a servant leader for the solution by ensuring Agile Release Trains operate effectively. Anticipates and removes constraints across the development and delivery process while collaborating with Release Train Engineers to coordinate delivery. Provides a systems view of the development lifecycle to lead technology delivery and align architecture with business objectives. Serves solutions with multiple Agile Release Trains or business units. Primarily serves solutions at the enterprise level but may support solutions at all levels as needed.
  • Leads multiple technical projects simultaneously by prioritizing and coordinating solution engineering efforts across teams and initiatives. Establishes performance metrics to measure effectiveness and continuously optimize performance. Manages non-functional requirements and ensures compliance with industry standards throughout the solution development and delivery process.
  • Develops and refines robust technical designs to meet business requirements for complex to highly complex solutions while ensuring scalability and performance. Collaborates with developers and Agile Release Trains to align solutions with enterprise architecture. Works with DevOps teams to implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines that streamline deployment and integrate new features. Engages with quality assurance teams to validate that technical solutions meet performance and reliability standards.
  • Leads development and delivery of complex to highly complex solutions by ensuring technical implementation s align with product roadmaps and overarching business strategies. Monitors progress, resolves issues affecting delivery timelines, and leads technical problem-solving efforts during development and deployment phases. Partners with business stakeholders and technical teams to address challenges and optimize solutions.
  • Oversees the maintenance of technical documentation for solutions to ensure effective knowledge sharing. Engages in continuous learning to stay current with trends and technologies in solution engineering. Applies learning to enhance own skills and impact the achievement of team and project objectives. Acts as a subject matter expert to consult and advise on solution engineering across business units and the enterprise. Leads pioneering of design and development practices to promote innovation and improvements across solutions. Performs other duties as assigned.

First Year Success Factors

  • Establish credibility as a trusted AI partner and primary AI contact for both IT and Business organizations.
  • Translate business opportunities into a sequenced portfolio of AI initiatives, clearly defining target outcomes, required capabilities, dependencies, and success measures.
  • Partner across business, architecture, engineering, data, security, and governance teams to identify and remove barriers to execution, accelerate delivery from concept through production, and ensure solutions are scalable, supportable, and reusable across the enterprise.
  • Drive adoption of the enterprise Spec-Driven Development (SDD) framework and AI-assisted engineering practices, achieving 90% adoption across targeted teams.
  • Drive measurable business and technology outcomes through faster delivery cycles, improved software quality, increased automation adoption, and successful deployment of AI capabilities that deliver enterprise value.
  • Lead multiple AI initiatives from concept through production readiness, partnering with engineering ensuring successful delivery while proactively removing obstacles and managing risks.
  • Establish reusable AI delivery assets, including implementation playbooks, patterns, templates, evaluation frameworks, governance controls, CI/CD standards, and production-readiness checklists.
  • Build a portfolio of AI success stories and reusable solutions that accelerate adoption across the enterprise.
  • Champion AI adoption across IT through hackathons, innovation challenges, monthly technology summits, workshops, and enablement programs.
  • Coach and enable engineers, architects, product owners, and technical teams on AI technologies, SDD, and modern engineering practices.
  • Ensure all AI solutions adhere to enterprise architecture, security, privacy, governance, and Responsible AI standards.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and AI-driven transformation across the IT organization.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

  • Bachelors degree required in computer science, engineering, or similar field.
  • Minimum 9 years of experience required in solution engineering, software development, systems architecture, or related.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and working in Agile teams required.
  • Experience in the insurance industry preferred.
  • Lead Solution Engineer is in support of AI COE / Forward Deployed Engineer in the AI and Automation Team.
  • This role is targeting the IT / Systems AI FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer) in support of Farmers IT Core SDLC Functions.

Additional Qualification

  • Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Able to clearly communicate technical information to non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated written communication skills.
  • Excellent collaboration and team building skills.
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills. Able to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues of varying complexity.
  • Possesses flexibility to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ability to drive multiple projects to successful completion.
  • Demonstrated project management skills.
  • Possesses strong technical aptitude. Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite. Deep knowledge of software architecture principles and design patterns. Strong proficiency in one or more phases of the software development lifecycle. In-depth knowledge of multiple systems and their key components. Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and version control systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, etc.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Frequently sits for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including, navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and/or places objects or materials weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Rarely performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category require rare, if any, travel.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Claims Consultant Mass Tort & Environmental
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Take your complex claims expertise to the next level in a highly specialized role focused on some of the most challenging exposures in the casualty space.

As a Senior Claims Consultant Mass Tort & Environmental, you will independently manage sophisticated legacy and long-latency claims involving asbestos, environmental contamination, talc, PFAS, and other mass tort exposures. You will apply advanced coverage analysis, strategic claims handling, negotiation, and litigation management skills to claims arising from historical CGL, umbrella, and excess liability policies.

This is an opportunity to join a specialized team where your judgment, technical expertise, and ability to navigate complex coverage issues will have a direct impact. The role supports claims across multiple U.S. jurisdictions and Canada and offers significant autonomy in managing complex matters from evaluation through resolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Complex Claims & Coverage Analysis

  • Independently manage complex, high-exposure casualty claims involving historical CGL, umbrella, and excess liability policies.
  • Analyze historical policy language, underlying facts, applicable law, and long-latency exposures to determine coverage positions and claims strategy.
  • Manage legacy runoff claims arising primarily from policies issued during the 1970s through the mid-1980s.
  • Develop thoughtful, well-supported strategies for resolving complex coverage and liability issues.

Mass Tort & Environmental Claims

  • Handle complex asbestos bodily injury, talc, PFAS, environmental contamination, and other mass tort claims.
  • Evaluate environmental exposures involving soil and groundwater contamination and remediation.
  • Manage claims involving large commercial and industrial insureds with significant liability exposure.
  • Navigate complex, multi-jurisdictional claims across the U.S. and Canada.

Litigation, Negotiation & Resolution

  • Manage litigated claims and coverage actions involving Allstate.
  • Partner with internal and external counsel to develop effective litigation and resolution strategies.
  • Participate in mediations, arbitrations, settlement negotiations, and other dispute-resolution activities.
  • Serve as a witness when required.

Financial & Strategic Management

  • Establish, document, and adjust case reserves and financial projections based on evolving claim exposure.
  • Develop and execute strategic action plans designed to move complex claims toward resolution.
  • Provide clear, well-supported analysis and recommendations to key stakeholders.

Caseload & Operational Excellence

  • Independently manage a diverse portfolio of complex claims while maintaining accurate and thorough documentation.
  • Ensure claim files comply with applicable internal guidelines and standards.
  • Work effectively across multiple claims systems and adapt to evolving technology and AI-supported workflows.
  • Communicate complex coverage and claim issues clearly and effectively in both written and verbal settings.

What You Bring:


Preferred Experience

  • 3+ years of experience handling mass tort, asbestos, environmental, or other long-latency claims.
  • Casualty claims experience involving complex coverage analysis, excess liability policies, or legacy runoff portfolios strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing claims across multiple U.S. jurisdictions and/or Canada.
  • Experience with litigation, negotiation, mediation, arbitration, or complex claim resolution.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strong knowledge of complex casualty claims and coverage analysis.
  • Ability to interpret and apply historical insurance policy language.
  • Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven negotiation and settlement capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage complex, high-exposure matters and competing priorities.
  • Comfort working across multiple systems and adapting to new technology and AI-supported processes.
  • High level of ownership, sound judgment, and accountability in a remote environment.

Why This Role

This opportunity is ideal for a seasoned claims professional who enjoys digging into complex coverage questions, sophisticated litigation, historical policies, and high-exposure claims. You will have the autonomy to own challenging matters while collaborating with experienced claims professionals and legal partners on issues that require both technical expertise and strategic thinking.


Work Environment

  • Remote-friendly opportunity within a highly specialized claims team.
  • Independent role suited for a self-starter who is comfortable taking ownership of complex matters.
  • Collaborative environment with exposure to legal partners and sophisticated casualty claims.

Skills

Claims Administration, Claims Resolution, Complex Claims, Mass Torts, Settlement Negotiations

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 65,600.00 - 110,075.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Job.JobTitle: Inside Property Adjuster - In Office / Hybrid - Long Island City, NY
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Long Island City, NY
  • Experience: 1+ year

About this job

Moderate Inside Property Adjuster role at Allstate in Long Island City, NY, handling virtual damage inspections, claim investigations, and settlements. Hybrid schedule with in-office work Tuesday-Thursday and remote work Monday-Friday.

Good fit if you have 1+ years of customer service experience and can work independently with strong communication and negotiation skills.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

This is an IN-OFFICE Hybrid Trainee role in the Allstate Long Island City, NY office

THIS IS AN IN OFFICE ROLE

8:00 5:00 EST

Tuesday,Wednesday, Thursday - In Office

Monday, Friday - Remote

28-07 Jackson Ave

Long Island City, NY 11101

A day in the life of an inside Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Moderate Inside Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. The work schedule is in-office at our Long Island City location on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with remote work on Monday and Friday. Your primary responsibility will involve virtually inspecting damages, investigating coverage, preparing estimates, and settling claims promptly and accurately. You will be interacting with customers, contractors, and vendors through various software platforms such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. This communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. This role places a particular focus on water losses, ensuring that our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always. This role involves taking care of customers in their times of need

The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

About this job

Senior Underwriter for middle market commercial property and casualty risks at Liberty Mutual in Plano, Texas. You'll make independent underwriting decisions on complex accounts, manage broker relationships, and mentor junior underwriters.

Good fit if you have 2.5+ years of underwriting experience, a business degree or equivalent, and can work in-person in the Plano area.

Full job description


Description

We are seeking an experienced Middle Market Senior Underwriter to underwrite commercial property & casualty risks in the middle market segment. As an individual contributor, you will make analytical, data-driven underwriting decisions within delegated authority, with limited guidance from leadership. You will evaluate and price moderately complex to complex accounts, manage broker and client relationships, and help shape product and portfolio strategy for your book of business.

To be considered for this role, candidates must reside within the specified geographic location. This position requires regular in-person visits with local brokers and agents, so remote hires outside the designated territory cannot be accommodated.

Key Responsibilities

  • Underwrite middle market commercial accounts within assigned authority by assessing submissions, reviewing coverage terms, exposures, loss history, financials, and supporting information to determine accept/decline, terms, and pricing.
  • Make independent, data-driven decisions on risk selection and pricing consistent with underwriting appetite and profitability objectives.
  • Coordinate referrals for accounts above individual authority or that require specialized support.
  • Manage a portfolio of brokers, agents, and insureds:
  • Maintain and grow relationships with producing brokers and agents; act as a visible Liberty representative in the market.
  • Develop targeted broker strategies to source profitable middle market business and expand market share.
  • Provide timely, clear responses to brokers and clients; negotiate coverage and terms while protecting portfolio profitability.
  • Underwrite higher-limit, complex, or unusual submissions typical to middle market clients (specialty exposures, large single-location risks, multi-location schedules, or industry-specific hazards).
  • Engage internal partners (Claims, Actuarial, Risk Control, Legal) to structure appropriate terms and risk mitigation plans.
  • Mentor and coach junior underwriters and new hires on middle market underwriting practices, decision-making, and Liberty processes
Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 2.5 years, typically 3 or more years, of progressive underwriting experience and/or other related experience
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge underwriting risks within scope of responsibility that includes competence with all phases and aspects of the underwriting process, and proficiency in the use of qualitative and quantitative tools and techniques
  • Must demonstrate comprehension of complex technical underwriting issues and be capable of defining and implementing necessary underwriting and administrative processes/workflows to properly manage or administer those issues
  • Proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable business

Description

We are looking for a Sales Agent to join our team in our The Woodlands office. Success in this role will require a strong local network and in-person relationship building in the community.This is an on-site and field sales focused position.

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Description

Were Hiring Immediately!

As an Insurance Sales Associate, you will work alongside with and support a Comparion Insurance Sales Agent in profitable growth through new business sales and customer retention. Responsibilities:

  • Utilize consultative sales techniques to prospect and initiate new business sales.

  • Identifies mass marketing prospects through existing book of business and community prospecting opportunities.
  • Meet monthly goals for new business sales.
  • Completes follow-ups on new policies in order to keep retention level high and capitalize cross-selling opportunities.
  • Coordinates activities with other departments to ensure quality customer service
  • Acts as initial contact in addressing customer concerns regarding establishment of policies and new account status.

  • 1-2 years of relevant sales experience preferred

  • Professional business acumen, strong presence and confidence
  • Resourceful team player that can contribute and accept new ideas
  • A state insurance licenseor willingness to earn one with training and supportin Property & Casualty, and Life

Were Hiring Immediately!

As an Insurance Sales Associate, you will work alongside with and support a Comparion Insurance Sales Agent in profitable growth through new business sales and customer retention. Working for Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, means working for a company thats committed to advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion. Ready to find out what it means to work for an agency that is backed by Liberty Mutuala Fortune 100 company thats committed to putting people first, acting responsibly and making things better?

  • Utilize consultative sales techniques to prospect and initiate new business sales.

  • Identifies mass marketing prospects through existing book of business and community prospecting opportunities.
  • Meet monthly goals for new business sales.
  • Completes follow-ups on new policies in order to keep retention level high and capitalize cross-selling opportunities.
  • Coordinates activities with other departments to ensure quality customer service
  • Acts as initial contact in addressing customer concerns regarding establishment of policies and new account status.

  • 1-2 years of relevant sales experience preferred

  • Ability to handle common objections and educate customers in a consultative manner

Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

THIS IS NOT A REMOTE POSITION and you must be able to commute to Fredericksburg, VA

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$89,800.00 - $148,300.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As an Associate Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to develop your legal expertise and litigation skills working under the mentorship of senior lawyers to handle a caseload of lower complexity matters and deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers.

What Will You Do?

  • In the handling of a case load of lower complexity matters, your responsibilities will include:
  • Acquire and develop knowledge on how to apply effective litigation/negotiation skills.
  • Conduct legal research and demonstrate effective and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other file documents under the supervision of experienced counsel.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments with or under the supervision of experienced counsel.
  • Provide case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and claim partners on file handling strategy.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 1-3 years of litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Demonstrates persuasive legal writing and oral advocacy skills.
  • Proficiency in legal research tools & technology
  • Ability to foster collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service
  • Demonstrates strong communication skills, sense of urgency, and responsiveness.
  • Exercises sound decision making and effective negotiation skills.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly attends case related events (e.g. trials, deposition, site visits, etc.) and has the ability to transport to those events. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $25.00 to $26.00 an hour
  • Schedule: Internship
  • Location: Hartford, CT
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Internship in bond and specialty insurance underwriting with Travelers Insurance in Hartford. Interns complete project work over 10-12 weeks, learn analytical and AI tools, and participate in networking events and speaker series.

Good fit if you have or are pursuing a bachelor's degree and are authorized to work in the U.S.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The hourly salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual hourly rate for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards. 

Salary Range

$25.00 - $26.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning in September. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role. Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The Bond & Specialty Insurance (BSI) Underwriting Internship Program provides qualified interns with an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand experience, receive valuable on-the-job training and learn more about the property & casualty insurance industry. What exactly is an Underwriter? Insurance is the contractual transfer of financial risk from one party to another. Underwriters (Account Executives) are the heart of the insurance process, gathering and researching pertinent information and then using finely tuned analytical skills to evaluate the acceptability of business and institutional risk. However, underwriters are more than just analysts - they are the core relationship builders with our agents and clients. They are responsible for managing a profitable portfolio of business through our distributing agents and brokers. An underwriting career includes a dynamic blend of analytical and marketing skills - it's challenging, stimulating and a superb career choice. BSI provides management liability, professional liability and surety to businesses of all sizes. It also provides traditional property casualty coverages to financial institutions, and is organized into six separate and distinct business units which include: Commercial Surety (protects a third party from the failure of an insured to perform or fulfill an obligation); Construction Services (insuring the bond between contractors and clients); Financial Institutions (insurance for community banks, credit unions, insurance companies, investment advisors and large depository & non-depository institutions); Private/Non Profit Liability (insurance products for private companies and non-profit institutions); Professional Liability (coverage protects against liability claims for negligence, errors and omissions in the performance of professional services; and Public Company Liability (insurance products crafted to address the diverse management liability exposures faced by today's public companies.) Positions last approximately 10-12 weeks beginning in late May/early June and ending in mid-August. Housing assistance is not provided.

What Will You Do?

  • Each intern will be expected to complete challenging and meaningful project work over the course of this program. In addition, there are core assignments and a designated coach to further develop interns' knowledge of insurance underwriting, sales and marketing.
  • Learn to leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
  • Participate in the Enterprise Internship experience which includes Executive Speaker Series, Networking events, and Rising Senior Intern Symposium.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Obtained or pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Liberal Arts (with business focus preferred), Management, Marketing, Risk Management and Insurance.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

What is a Must Have?

  • Pursuing or obtained a Bachelor's degree.

What Is the Opportunity?

As a Claim Rep, Auto Damage, you will support our customers and third-party claimants through the claims process when they experience vehicle damage. In this role, you will serve as a trusted resource and will deliver exceptional customer service by providing clear explanations of policies and coverage options while investigating and evaluating claims to ensure accurate payments.

Travelers offers a hybrid work location model that is designed to support flexibility.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage auto physical damage claims from first notice of loss through resolution and settlement, handling low to moderate complexity cases, including total loss evaluations and vehicle repair oversight. Types of claims are typically multi-vehicle (2 or more cars) auto damage with unclear liability and no injuries.
  • Evaluate and analyze policy terms, conditions, and exclusions to determine coverage, liability, and damage; negotiate equitable settlements within your authority.
  • Coordinate and partner with appraisal team(s) and repair facilities to obtain necessary information and ensure thorough accurate damage assessments and timely claim resolution.
  • Leverage all internal and external resources to conduct thorough investigations to gather all relevant facts accurately document findings in the claim management system and maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Determine settlement amounts based upon appraisal estimate, negotiate and convey claim settlements within authority limits to insureds and claimants. As appropriate, write denial letters, Reservation of Rights and other necessary correspondence to insureds and claimants.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, representatives, and internal stakeholders.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers' requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Two years of auto claim handling experience.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Proficient in claims management systems with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers throughout the claim process.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution skills; ability to facilitate productive discussions and reach equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Basic understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations and claim handling requirements.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • One year auto claim handling experience or comparable claim experience, or successful completion of Travelers Auto Claim Representative training program.

Our Architects are responsible for designing and guiding the technology vision that enables business transformation, specializing in creating enterprise-wide solutions that bridge current capabilities with future possibilities. This strategic position requires expertise in cloud-native technologies, APIs, AI/ML, and emerging platforms to establish scalable architectures where business applications can evolve and thrive. The ideal candidate orchestrates the technical strategy that empowers development teams - defining target states, creating technology roadmaps, and establishing architectural frameworks that accelerate innovation while maintaining standards and governance. As the essential bridge between business strategy and technical implementation, this role directly impacts organizational agility, system integration, and the enterprise's ability to rapidly adapt and scale technology solutions across the business landscape.

What Will You Do?

  • Scope:
  • Responsible for architecture for multiple technology and or/ business segments/domains for a single business unit.
  • Technical Execution:
  • Responsible for the enterprise database migration and modernization strategy, governing the transition of SQL Server, Oracle, open-source databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB), and MongoDB from on-premises environments to cloud-native platforms (AWS RDS, Aurora, DMS, Azure SQL, Oracle Database@Cloud)
  • Develop migration sequencing, tooling standards, and reference architectures that minimize risk and disruption while accelerating delivery timelines
  • Architect conversion strategies to transition proprietary database platforms to cost-effective open-source alternatives, eliminating significant annual licensing costs
  • Establish database engineering standards covering high availability, replication, performance tuning, schema governance, and observability across cloud-managed and self-managed database services
  • Define and implement database disaster recovery and resiliency frameworks with automated failover, backup validation, and compliance-aligned retention policies
  • Responsible for the enterprise data migration strategy for transitioning on-premises data stores-including block storage, file systems, archive repositories, and backup platforms-to cloud-native solutions (AWS S3, EFS, Glacier, FSx, Backup)
  • Architect end-to-end data platform solutions spanning ingestion, storage, processing, transformation, and consumption layers across hybrid and cloud environments
  • Architect enterprise block storage solutions for cloud environments, including high-performance EBS volumes, storage tiering strategies, snapshot lifecycle management, and performance optimization for database and transactional workloads
  • Design file storage architectures supporting both cloud-native (AWS EFS, FSx for Windows File Server, FSx for NetApp ONTAP) and hybrid use cases, including protocol compatibility (NFS, SMB), access control, and high-availability configurations for shared workloads
  • Define storage platform standards covering provisioning, capacity management, encryption at rest, replication, and cost optimization across block, file, object, and archive tiers
  • Develop FinOps discipline for data platform decisions-modeling TCO for migration scenarios, quantifying licensing and infrastructure savings, and optimizing storage tiering strategies
  • Drive continuous technology transformation to minimize technical debt.
  • Conduct hands-on prototyping of new technology solutions.
  • Architect cloud-native data and database solutions primarily on AWS, with knowledge of Azure and GCP as a plus for multi-cloud and hybrid scenarios
  • Define infrastructure-as-code (IaC) standards, SLAs/SLOs, and platform reliability engineering practices across data and database services
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging cloud-native data technologies aligned with organizational needs-including managed database services, streaming platforms, lakehouses, and vector/graph databases
  • Drive platform security posture including encryption, secrets management, IAM governance, and network isolation for data workloads
  • Strategic Accountability:

  • Collaborate with ETS teams-infrastructure, security, operations, and application development-to align platform architecture with enterprise standards and ensure seamless service delivery
  • Mentor and develop engineers and DBAs, building cloud and open-source competencies while fostering a culture of engineering excellence and continuous learning
  • Provide strong thought leadership in pursuit of modern architecture principles and technology modernization.

By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$136,100.00 - $224,500.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As a Senior Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of higher exposure cases and more complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim matters depending on line of business. You will deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers and will mentor less experienced attorneys.

What Will You Do?

  • In the independent handling of a caseload of higher exposure cases and most complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim depending on line of business, your responsibilities will include:
  • Leverage trial experience to apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct advanced legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft substantive pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other legal documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide in-depth, substantive case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and Claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Collaborates with expert witnesses and consultants to develop case strategies, evaluate technical matters, and prepare compelling testimony for litigation.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships, including independent responsibility for managing client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide internal and external training, seminars and legal updates to insured clients and Claim partners.
  • Provide leadership through mentoring other attorneys and legal support staff.
  • Initiate special projects and identifies other opportunities to support office goals/business needs.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 7+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Strong aptitude for trying cases to a jury; proven track record of litigating jury trials, with a history of successful courtroom outcomes
  • Demonstrates strong technical knowledge in the practice area(s) and the ability to effectively communicate complex information on litigated matters to diverse audiences.
  • Advanced oral and written advocacy skills, with a demonstrated track record of summary judgment and/or appellate successs.
  • Possesses in-depth knowledge of the bench, bar, local jurisdictional practices, adversaries.
  • Excels in fostering collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service
  • Demonstrates strong leadership through mentoring and influencing skills.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses advanced negotiation skills.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency & responsiveness.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 7 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Serve as the primary operational and strategic liaison among the client, Account Team, and operational units, including Device Care Centers. Lead day-to-day coordination of Device Lifecycle Management operations or other initiatives as assigned, monitor KPIs and SLAs, deliver project management and revenue/growth initiatives, mitigate operational risks, and contribute business intelligence, reporting, and continuous improvement recommendations that support optimal client and business outcomes.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?


  • On-site stakeholder and relationship management: Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for Account Executive stakeholders; support and deliver client-facing business reviews, performance updates, and operational readouts; and maintain strong relationships with DCC operational leadership and cross-functional partners.
  • Program and operational execution: Coordinate multiple client initiatives and workstreams, align priorities, translate client needs into operational plans, track goals, timelines, and deliverables, and communicate performance against established objectives and expectations.
  • Cross-functional alignment and insights: Resolve operational dependencies and provide business and operational insights and recommendations that improve client outcomes and support profitable growth.
  • Continuous improvement: Identify process inefficiencies, influence process re-engineering efforts, streamline workflows, improve operational performance, and contribute to operational best practices.
  • Supply chain and financial performance: Monitor operational and financial performance across device lifecycle and reverse logistics programs and partner with account, operations, finance, and supply chain teams to optimize recovery value, profitability, and client outcomes.
  • Risk and issue management: Manage program-level escalations, cross-project risks, and issue-resolution pathways; proactively develop mitigation and contingency plans to minimize operational disruption.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Project or Program Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience managing multiple, interrelated projects concurrently preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in client relations, account management, program leadership, operations, data analytics, and device lifecycle management.
  • Working knowledge of supply chain operations for mobile devices and other electronics, including reverse logistics.
  • Working knowledge of client financial arrangements and contract terms, account-level financial performance, billing, and reporting.
  • Strong leadership, influencing, stakeholder management, and cross-functional coordination capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, executive-level reporting, meeting facilitation, and follow-through.
  • Ability to manage complex, multi-workstream programs in a highly matrixed environment.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, strategic thinking, organizational, and continuous improvement skills.
  • Ability to connect operational performance and cost drivers to client financial outcomes.
  • Proficiency with data analytics and reporting tools such as Excel, SQL, or Power BI.
  • Executive presence and ability to build trust, influence decisions, and communicate effectively in client-facing environments.
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask while balancing long-term strategy with practical execution.
  • Leads coordinated execution across multiple client initiatives and workstreams, aligns priorities among account leadership, client stakeholders, delivery teams, and DCC operations, monitors timelines and deliverables, resolves dependencies and escalations, and implements risk mitigation and contingency plans.

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist (Direct Auto Insurance is an Allstate Business) is responsible for the profitable growth and attainment of business goals by driving new business sales and understanding customers needs to build rapport and trust. This position drives sales and builds and retains their book of business within the market / retail location. This position is responsible for attracting and generating new customers and cross-selling existing customers, in support of our product offerings including but not limited to Auto, Life, Auto Club, and Roadside Assistance. This role sells to walk-in customers, markets products outside of the office via marketing calls and in-person visits creating community relationships to promote continued growth and assists customers in the office.

Want to grow your sales career with one of the fastest growing auto insurers in the country? Start a new career in a performance-driven environment where youre recognized and rewarded for your results?

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment where making a difference matters, then apply to join our team today!

What makes Direct Auto Insurance unique?

  • 20 PTO Days per year & 6 Paid Holidays!
  • Ability to sell a multitude of industry-leading products through retail stores and phone!
  • Entrepreneurial, performance-based, and results-focused culture!
  • Multi-tiered and comprehensive paid training program!

About this job

Field Auto Appraiser for Allstate Insurance in Queens, NY. You'll meet customers on-site to evaluate vehicle damage, write estimates, and guide them through the repair or total loss process using in-person visits, virtual inspections, and written communication.

Good fit if you have 3-5 years auto collision estimating experience with CCC or Mitchell software, a valid driver's license, and strong communication skills.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Are you someone who enjoys being on the move, solving problems, and making a real impact for customers? As a Field Auto Appraiser, you'll be at the forefront of our claims processmeeting customers where they are, whether it's at their home, a repair shop, or a tow yard.

You'll take the lead in writing estimates and guiding customers through the repair or total loss process, using a mix of in-person visits, virtual inspections, and written communication. No two days are the samewhether you're evaluating damage on-site or collaborating with body shops and service providers, you'll enjoy a fast-paced, hands-on role that keeps you engaged and on your toes.

If you're looking for a career that blends technical know-how, customer service, and the freedom of field work, this is your chance to thrive in a role where your expertise truly matters.

Preferred Qualifications

  • You have 3-5 years' experience in auto collision estimating using CCC or Mitchell
  • You have a High School Diploma or a GED
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with customers
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to write precise and comprehensive estimates
  • Comfortable with utilizing technology and various platforms for claims processing
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills to manage multiple assignments effectively
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements

A day in the life of the Field Auto Damage Appraiser, and what it takes to do the job!

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner on each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder Your Eye for Detail Keeps Everything on Track- In this role, youll ensure claims are documented accurately and in line with policy agreements. As you handle each case, youll maintain clear, timely records in our claims system (which well train you on). Your attention to detail helps keep the process smooth, organized, and transparent from start to finish.

Work Location

  • This position is a field-based role.To be eligible for this role, you must be located in the following locations: Queens, NY

Description

Were Hiring Immediately!

Success in this role will require building a strong local network and in-person relationship in the community.

Ready to find out what it means to work for an agency that is backed by Liberty Mutuala Fortune 100 company thats committed to putting people first, acting responsibly and making things better?

About this job

Senior Underwriting Manager overseeing Major Accounts Property portfolio in the Central Region, managing a team of underwriters focused on complex monoline property accounts with minimum Total Insured Value of $100 million. Full job description


Description

We are seeking a Senior Underwriting Manager to oversee our Major Accounts Property portfolio in the Central Region. In this role, you will be responsible for managing a team of underwriters focused on complex monoline property accounts with a minimum Total Insured Value of at least $100 million. You will guide, mentor, and develop your team, ensuring they have the tools and resources needed to succeed while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional growth.

Your responsibilities will include analyzing and approving underwriting decisions for large single carrier admitted property accounts by evaluating property exposures, hazards, financial information, requested coverages, loss history, pricing targets, and desired program structures to determine appropriate terms and conditions. You will work closely with Risk Engineering to enhance underwriting processes and strategies, ensuring a profitable book of business, while cultivating and maintaining strong relationships with producers and customers to drive growth and retention.

Additionally, you will contribute to the development and execution of underwriting strategies that align with overall business objectives and market trends. To excel in this role, you will need to maintain the highest level of knowledge in the large property space. Sharing insights and best practices with your team and other stakeholders will be essential to sustain and elevate overall performance.

Responsibilities

  • Drives a culture of underwriting excellence across entire portfolio. Drives change initiatives within the team.
  • Maintains a visible external profile and excellent relationships with external brokers/agents, partners and stakeholders, leveraging these relationships to help the team achieve their goals and expand their own networks.
  • Acts as a point of escalation/referral on particularly tricky or novel underwriting decisions and upholds and exemplifies Liberty`s value proposition across the business and market.
  • May cover for manager where required. Accountable for the performance of a portfolio (or part thereof) within a sub-segment of business underwritten by the team.
  • Specific technical responsibilities (e.g., related to planning, portfolio management, marketing, product development etc.) will differ in different parts of GRS.
  • May continue underwriting specific policies and delivering the work of an Underwriter.
Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 10 years progressive underwriting experience expected, including a minimum of 2 years of proven underwriting management experience, preferred
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate high impact underwriting risks within scope of responsibility
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex analyses and information
  • Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills in dealing with internal and external partners required
  • Must possess the following skills, abilities and attributes: strong leadership skills, development of people, strategic thinking, sustained effective portfolio management and profitable growth, communications skills, decision-making skills, results-oriented, industrious, innovative, problem-solving skills, coaching and mentoring skills, and negotiating skills
