Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

The Territory Sales Manager is responsible for consistently exceeding agreed upon new business production, direct written premium, and loss ratio goals, and other KPIs on an annual basis by effectively managing the agents of an assigned market to increase company market share by driving profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborates with Product, Pricing, Operations to perform stakeholder (agency) and risk analysis on market related issues

Develops and maintains the assigned markets new agency appointment pipeline, supports National Accounts & Alternative Distribution Initiatives to implement corporate agreements at the local market level & coach new TSMs

Key company liaison within assigned market to both independent agencies and industry associations and must be field facing 4 days per week, driving key business initiatives, maintaining accurate records of these sales activities, client interactions, and follow-ups in CRM software

Collaborates with Independent Agents to assist with creation of agency-specific short term and long-term strategic business plans, periodically reviews and suggests adjustments as necessary to achieve results

Positions and promotes full suite of National General Insurance products into Independent Agency Partners to include, multiple personal auto products, homeowners, commercial vehicle, flood, and recreational vehicle & key focus on Specialty Vehicle & Household package coverages (based on state availability)

Delivers on the business units annual execution plan (growth, profitability, agency engagement, new appointments) for their market with focus on SV & HH package coverages under the guidance of a Regional Sales Manager and/or Director

Consults with IAs by having a strong knowledge of the independent agency channel, including industry competitors, major brokers and national industry associations to gather market intel to help promote and position NGAAC products and/or make market enhancement to align with industry opportunity

Position is responsible for product/user integration with industry technology and comparative rating platforms within market and assigned agencies

Role uses full suite of production data and reporting to identify trends, capitalize on opportunity and regularly address agency level performance including training / skill gap to execute on business plan

Territory Sales Manager handles increasing the quote and issuance flow of assigned market beyond the rate and UW trends filed and implemented in the market


Candidates must reside in the greater Bay Area (San Jose, San Francisco, Vallejo, Salinas)


Experience

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job does not have supervisory duties.


Skills

Job.JobTitle: Large Loss Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Louisville, KY
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $72,000 to $115,000 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Louisville, KY
  • Experience: 4 to 5 years
  • License: Valid driver's license

About this job

Large Loss Property Adjuster conducting on-site inspections, investigating coverage, and settling claims for Allstate in Louisville. Role involves traveling to customer homes and handling virtual claims countrywide, with focus on water losses using Xactimate and other software.

Good fit if you have 4-5 years of outside property adjuster experience, proficiency with Xactimate, and can physically access roofs and carry equipment.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Large Loss Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!


As a Large Loss Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:


  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • 4-5 years previous experience as an outside property adjuster is highly desired.
  • Experience handling claims with multiple trades and over $100,000 in losses
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating preferred.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.
  • Reside within 40 miles of Louisville, KY

This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:


  • Must be able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access roofs with up to a 6/12 pitch.
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.
  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:


  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

** Please note, you will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX **

Notice of Licensing Requirement:


  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:


  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:


Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:


Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making a difference, then apply to join our team today!

As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$117,600.00 - $194,000.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Behavioral science is becoming a critical function for many businesses today and Travelers is no exception. Travelers Claim Behavioral Science group uses scientific methods to understand the changing needs of our customers, claimants and employees. As a Director, Behavioral Scientist, you will apply behavioral science frameworks and academic insights to practical business challenges in the Property and Casualty Insurance industry. You will serve as a researcher, interviewer, design thinking facilitator, and data analyst for the application of behavioral science to Travelers Claim strategies and projects.

What Will You Do?

  • In close collaboration with key stakeholders across Claim, conduct pilots, apply behavioral science frameworks, and implement interventions to influence choices customers or claimants make before or throughout the lifecycle of a claim.
  • Conduct research and test behavioral interventions to enhance claim practices, product design, business strategies, as well as customer and employee experiences.
  • Collect and analyze quantitative data, conduct semi-structured interviews, facilitate group design thinking sessions, and conduct test and learns with follow up measurements.
  • Apply behavioral science frameworks to test interventions that inform product design and experiences, and that impact financial results.
  • Collaborate with product designers, data scientists, project managers and marketing and communications to design, develop, conduct and evaluate projects and proofs of concept.
  • Help to develop and document research to support multiple recommendations to improve Claim business line results.
  • Implement agreed upon interventions in partnership with various sponsors.
  • Apply insights internally to influence how employees within the organization react to and manage transformational change.
  • Provide insights, best practices, tools, and training to help develop organizational capabilities in the application of behavioral science.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 5+ years of applied industry experience in a business setting.
  • Proven ability to design, conduct, analyze and communicate research results and recommendations as business cases.
  • Ph.D., with certification and/or applied experience in Data Science.
  • Proficiency with Excel, and R, SAS, or Python.
  • Experience in natural language processing and/or statistically based text analysis methods.
  • Experience in designing and conducting semi-structured interviews or user research for Behavioral Science interventions.
  • Group-led facilitation using design thinking collaboration software across multi-disciplinary groups.
  • Natural curiosity is key - demonstrated ability to understand problems and ask the right questions.
  • Strong research and analytical skills including an ability to observe and record behaviors.
  • Experience advocating for and influencing business partners to adopt behavioral science research, experimentation, and interventions.
  • Strong Project Management Skills and the ability to bring projects from idea to testing, and implementation; ability to balance priorities while working on multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment and effectively collaborate across business areas.
  • Insurance or financial services industry experience

What is a Must Have?

  • Master's in Behavioral Science, Psychology, Economics, HCI, UX, People Analytics or related field.
  • Some experience applying behavioral science frameworks, insights, and experimental research in a business setting.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers is seeking a Director, Agile Product Owner to join our organization to lead a team to deliver capabilities/solutions in an agile way. This role will lead a team working on emerging capabilities that support Property, including aerial imagery and other new data sources that provide better insights into a risk. In this position you will act as a voice of the end-user to guide day-to-day work of a cross-functional team, focusing on achievement of defined outcomes versus defining how the work is completed.

What Will You Do?

  • Define, prioritize and ensure a ready backlog of work for a cross-functional product team, accept final product output, focusing on achievement of defined outcomes versus defining how the work is completed.
  • Effectively manage a backlog of deliverables and capabilities as well as 'test and learn'/experimentation targeted at defining/refining future deliverables, measuring performance and adjusting the overall roadmap of deliverables as needed.
  • Translate business strategies and needs into execution ready work for an Agile product team; define team goals and strategy, ensuring alignment with circle and value stream vision; Articulate team goals and strategy effectively to key stakeholders, Circle Leads, and team members.
  • Act as voice of the end-user; have a deep understanding of and anticipate and proactively seek customer feedback ensuring needs and requirements are clearly defined; ensure team work product meets defined acceptance criteria.
  • Own team backlog, including prioritization and refinement; Make trade-off decisions to maximize value.
  • Optimize the flow of value by setting objectives and key performance indicators (KPIs) for solutions.
  • Inform and participate in business readiness; understand the impact of change, translate the approach to manage adoption and mitigate resistance.
  • Provide feedback on work-in-progress, clarify requirements and contribute to removing roadblocks or impediments; Look for opportunities for continuous team and process improvement.
  • Partner with key leaders and peers across to determine resources required to achieve defined business outcomes.
  • Share best practices across teams to ensure alignment and consistency in ways of working within a value stream.
  • Foster an innovative, inclusive and diverse team environment, promoting positive team culture, encouraging collaboration and self-organization.
  • May manage Agile Product Owners.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Two years of experience in Agile product management.
  • Two years of work experience within the discipline being supported (e.g.: Claim, Risk Control, Technology, Project Management, Production, Application Development, etc.).
  • Three years of experience articulating and translating business strategy, product vision, and analysis for a product.

The Role at a Glance

We are seeking an experienced Director of Customer Experience to lead and scale Customer Experience capabilities across Workplace Solutions. This leader will bring deep, hands-on CX expertise and a demonstrated track record of building mature, repeatable practices that embed customer-centered decision-making across an organization. In this role, you will set the CX strategy and operating model, strengthen governance and measurement, and create the tools, standards, and ways of working that enable teams across Product, Operations, Technology, Digital, Marketing, and Distribution to consistently improve the experience. You will champion the voice of the customer while connecting customer insights and experience improvements to measurable business outcomes, including growth, retention, efficiency, and differentiation.

This is not a role focused solely on journey mapping or Voice of Customer programs. We are looking for a proven CX leader who has helped an organization move from individual projects to an integrated, enterprise-scale CX capability. You will influence senior leaders, develop talent, build cross-functional commitment, and translate customer needs into clear priorities, investment decisions, and sustained change.

What you'll be doing

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Customer Experience professionals, setting clear expectations and building the strategic, analytical, and influencing capabilities needed to deliver meaningful impact.
• Define and execute a scalable CX strategy and operating model, including governance, standards, roles, decision rights, prioritization, and cross-functional ways of working.
• Build and mature the organization's CX capabilities by establishing repeatable methods, tools, training, and frameworks that enable teams to apply customer-centered practices consistently and independently.
• Partner with senior leaders across Product, Operations, Technology, Digital, Marketing, and Distribution to embed customer needs into business strategy, transformation roadmaps, investment decisions, and solution design.
• Establish an enterprise approach to journey management that identifies priority journeys, clarifies ownership, connects insights across touchpoints, and drives coordinated improvement over time.
• Integrate Voice of Customer, research, behavioral and operational data, market intelligence, and employee insights to identify root causes, size opportunities, and inform strategic recommendations.
• Translate complex customer and business challenges into actionable strategies, business cases, executive-level recommendations, and sequenced roadmaps.
• Define and monitor a CX measurement framework that connects experience outcomes to business results such as growth, retention, utilization, digital adoption, cost, and operational performance.
• Drive adoption and accountability through change leadership, stakeholder engagement, communication, and capability-building across the organization.
• Champion the thoughtful use of AI and emerging technologies to improve customer outcomes, increase efficiency, and create competitive advantage.

What we're looking for

Must-haves:
• 5+ years of progressive CX experience, including CX strategy, journey management, customer insights, experience measurement, service design, or related disciplines
• Demonstrated experience building, scaling, or maturing a CX practice across a complex organization, including establishing operating models, governance, standards, tools, measurement, and cross-functional adoption
• 3+ years of people leadership experience, with a track record of developing high-performing teams and leading through influence in a matrixed environment
• Experience translating customer insights and journey opportunities into enterprise priorities, funded roadmaps, measurable improvements, and business outcomes
• Strong executive presence and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and gain alignment across functions with competing priorities
• Strong business acumen and the ability to connect CX investments to growth, retention, efficiency, risk reduction, and market differentiation
• Demonstrated change leadership experience, including building organizational commitment, establishing accountability, and driving sustained adoption of new CX practices
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of a Bachelor's degree)

Nice-to-haves:
• Recognized Customer Experience certification, such as CCXP, or comparable certification in human-centered design, service design, design thinking, or change management
• Experience leading CX in financial services, insurance, employee benefits, retirement, or another regulated and complex service environment
• Working knowledge of Group Benefits and/or Retirement Plans
• Experience applying AI, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve customer experiences and operational outcomes

Application Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted through November 20th, 2026 subject to earlier closure due to applicant volume.

The Role at a Glance

We are seeking a Lead Actuary to join our Variable Annuity (VA) and Registered Index-Linked Annuity (RILA) Valuation team. In this role, you will produce monthly and quarterly valuations for Lincoln's VA and RILA blocks while partnering with internal stakeholders to analyze results and gain insights. You will also provide support to various actuarial modernization and automation projects.

What you'll be doing

•Produce VA and RILA financial reporting results, including statutory reserve and capital under VM-21 and market risk benefits (MRBs) under GAAP LDTI.
•Develop expertise in modeling, automation, and visualization tools used in valuation processes.
•Ensure compliance with internal controls, SOX requirements, and regulatory standards.
•Build new tools and processes that provide deeper insight into VA and RILA valuations.
•Support existing automation efforts to increase efficiency, reduce the potential for error, and improve presentation of results.
•Collaborate cross-functionally with teams across Lincoln, including Accounting, Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Market Risk Management (MRM), Model Development, Pricing, Audit, ERM, Investments, Capital Management, and the Qualified Actuary team.

What we're looking for

•4-year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum required)
•5-7+ years of actuarial experience with actuarial credentials (FSA or ASA with additional years of experience)
•Substantial knowledge of annuity products
•Experience with actuarial modeling software (e.g., GGY-AXIS) and data automation and visualization tools (e.g., Dataiku, Tableau)
•Strong execution and time management skills, with a record of producing high-quality work and meeting deadlines
•Self-starter with ability to work independently and demonstrated accountability

Good fit if you have 10+ years of actuarial experience, FSA designation, annuity product knowledge, and experience with modeling platforms like AXIS, Python, or SQL.

This role drives insights that directly inform investments, risk management, capital and liquidity decisions while partnering across the organization with business units and functions supporting these decisions.


You will lead a high-performing team responsible for building the process, running the analysis and providing the recommendation supporting the growth of our Annuity business. This role partners closely with Finance, Investments, Product, Risk Management and Treasury teams to translate complex Annuity modeling and financial analysis into actionable business insights and decisions.

What you'll be doing

•Lead analysis on, and monitoring of, Lincoln's emerging pricing risks.
•Provide thought leadership and pricing insights in the development investment strategies, ALM and emerging risk across Lincoln's Annuity business.
•Work in partnership with the Finance, Investments and In-force modeling teams to connect Annuity pricing model output to its impact on the company's strategic goals, ensuring results are understood in both regulatory and earnings contexts.
•Collaborate with internal stakeholders across the organization to educate on techniques used in Annuity New Business modeling and socialize insights derived through team's work.
•Collaborate with teammates to share knowledge, institute best practices, and develop shared insights.
•Lead a team of professionals in the execution of the team's responsibilities.

What we're looking for

•10+ years of actuarial experience, with demonstrated competency in the specific responsibilities for this position
•Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA) designation or Associate (ASA) with additional years of actuarial experience
•Annuity product knowledge and general insurance/business knowledge
•Demonstrated success in providing strategic and holistic thought leadership
•Demonstrated success in balancing and pivoting across projects with shifting priorities
•Strong relationship management skills across functional areas, including senior management and peers, including ability to influence effectively
•Experience building and mentoring actuarial talent
•Curiosity, comfort asking questions and challenging the status quo, and critical thinking with an eye for innovation
•Experience with actuarial modeling platforms and programming/analytics tools (e.g. AXIS, Python, SQL)

The Role at a Glance

As the COLI BOLI Insurance Consultant for Lincoln's Executive Benefit's Underwriting Team, you will analyze and deliver on COLI BOLI ICOLI cases. The Corporate-Owned Life Insurance (COLI) Underwriter is responsible for evaluating mortality, financial, and insurable risk associated with corporate-sponsored life insurance programs. The role supports the issuance and management of COLI and BOLI cases by assessing underwriting evidence, applying carrier guidelines, and making risk-based decisions that support profitable growth while maintaining regulatory compliance. Responsibilities often include collaboration with sales, actuarial, legal, case management, and corporate clients

This is a developmental opportunity designed for someone who brings relevant experience and knowledge of the COLI, BOLI, or broader institutional life insurance marketplace and is interested in building deeper underwriting expertise. Candidates may bring transferable experience from areas such as operations, product management, client service, implementation, relationship management, or other roles that provide meaningful exposure to COLI and BOLI programs.

What you'll be doing

  • Underwrite Corporate-Owned Life Insurance (COLI) applications, including corporate and institutionally sponsored programs.

  • Review and approve pre-issue and post-issue underwriting transactions, including policy changes, face amount adjustments, and other in-force underwriting requests.
  • Collaborate with Sales, New Business, Legal, Compliance, Actuarial, and Operations to support case design and execution.
  • Identify underwriting trends, emerging risks, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Maintain current knowledge of COLI regulations, underwriting philosophies, and market practices.

Nice-to Have's

  • Strong understanding of the institutional life insurance marketplace

Good fit if you have 10+ years of insurance industry experience and expertise in RILA or similar insurance and investment products.

Full job description

The Role at a Glance

We are excited to bring on an AVP, Product Development – Registered Indexed Linked Annuities (RILA) to support the Annuity business in a hybrid work environment. Preferred key cities include Hartford, Greensboro, Fort Wayne, Radnor.

Background Details

As the AVP, Product Development for RILA products, you will play a leadership role focused on shaping and executing the future of Lincoln's RILA product portfolio. This position is responsible for driving product opportunities and growth by identifying market opportunities, and developing differentiated solutions, for a rapidly evolving segment of the annuity marketplace.

Working across the organization and with external partners, you will leverage industry expertise, market insights, and strong relationships to influence product direction and enhance Lincoln's competitive position. Success in this role requires a deep understanding of RILA products, the broader annuity landscape, and emerging trends that impact customers, advisors, and the industry.

The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of developing and advancing RILA or similar insurance and investment products, along with the strategic vision to anticipate market needs and translate them into meaningful product solutions. This role is well-suited for a product leader who thrives at the intersection of market strategy, product innovation, and business growth. If this role is for you, please read on!

Please note: This is a product leadership role focused on product strategy and development, not a project management position.

What you'll be doing

  • You will lead the discovery, design, development, and delivery of RILA solutions that support business growth, market differentiation, and long-term product strategy.
  • You will identify emerging market opportunities, consumer needs, and industry trends to develop strategies that expand into new markets and diversify the product portfolio.
  • You will assist business leaders by influencing product priorities and future growth opportunities.
  • You will work alongside business partners to assess the annuity and adjacent markets to identify product concepts and evaluate their viability, competitiveness, and alignment with business objectives.
  • You will collaborate with Pricing, Distribution, Marketing, Legal, State Filings, Operations, and Implementation teams to develop and bring product solutions from concept to market.
  • You will build and leverage relationships with external partners, industry organizations, and third-party providers to gather market insights, identify opportunities, and inform product innovation efforts.
  • You will play a key role in evaluating product performance, in-force management strategies, and market competitiveness to support portfolio optimization and business growth.
  • You will contribute to risk management and product governance processes by assessing potential impacts to product design, pricing strategies, business mix, and overall portfolio performance.
  • You will help define and execute short- and long-term product strategies by maintaining a deep understanding of market dynamics, competitor offerings, regulatory developments, and emerging industry trends.

What we're looking for

  • 4 Year Bachelor's degree or 4+ years of experience of equivalent work experience
  • 10+ Years experience in a similar role in the insurance industry. (Required)
  • Strong presentation skills with demonstrated ability to influence at all levels of management through clear, informed and logical discussions/presentations.
  • Demonstrates ability to communicate knowledgeably and credibly with senior management and internal constituents.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to solve problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.
  • Ability to think critically, analyze information and to evaluate the implications of a course of action or solution.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify, develop and implement process improvements.
  • Demonstrated strong relationship management skills with internal clients (e.g. senior management, peers and colleagues); proven ability to develop creative and collaborative approaches.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

About this job

Build shared cloud platforms and engineering foundations on AWS that enable AI agents and agentic applications at Lincoln Financial. Focus on runtime, tooling, guardrails, model access, orchestration, observability, and DevSecOps.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in platform engineering or DevOps, strong AWS and Python skills, and hands-on experience with LLM frameworks like LangChain and agent tools.

Full job description

Alternate Locations: Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania); Charlotte, NC (North Carolina); Fort Wayne, IN (Indiana); Greensboro, NC (North Carolina)

Work Arrangement:

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

Relocation assistance: is not available for this opportunity.

Requisition #: 76592

The Role at a Glance

The Agentic Platform Engineer builds the shared cloud platform and engineering foundations that enable AIDA teams to deliver secure, scalable AI agents and agentic applications. This role focuses on the runtime, tooling, and guardrails that agents depend on: model access, tool and context integration, orchestration frameworks, evaluation, observability, and DevSecOps on AWS.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain shared platform services that support agent runtimes, LLM gateways, model routing, prompt/context management, and tool integration.
  • Standardize agentic delivery patterns including tool/function calling, MCP-style tool servers, retrieval pipelines, memory and state management, and multi-agent orchestration.
  • Implement guardrails for agent safety: input/output filtering, prompt injection defenses, human-in-the-loop approval paths, sandboxed execution, and least-privilege agent identities.
  • Improve developer productivity through CI/CD, environment templates, agent scaffolding, SDKs, and platform automation.
  • Build observability and evaluation for agentic systems: tracing, token and cost telemetry, latency, quality/eval harnesses, and regression testing of prompts and agent behavior.
  • Manage cost-aware model consumption, rate limits, caching, and secure secrets/access patterns across environments.
  • Partner with architecture, security, risk, and engineering leaders to apply AI controls, interoperability standards, and governance guardrails.
  • Document platform standards and help delivery teams adopt agentic patterns consistently.

What we're looking for

Must Haves:

  • 5+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE, with hands-on work building or operating AI/LLM-based applications.
  • Strong experience with AWS, including services supporting AI workloads (Bedrock, SageMaker, containers, serverless).
  • Practical experience with agent frameworks and LLM tooling such as LangChain/LangGraph, MCP, vector databases, and RAG architectures.
  • Strong coding ability in Python; Java or NodeJS is a plus.
  • Experience enabling engineering teams through CI/CD, GitLab, observability, reusable services, and platform standards.
  • Experience with API infrastructure, containers, deployment pipelines, and operational tooling.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with agent evaluation and LLM observability tooling (LangSmith, LangFuse, Arize, or similar).
  • Experience supporting production systems, data platforms, and AI/ML workloads.
  • Exposure to regulated enterprise environments, identity/access controls, AI risk frameworks, and audit logging.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Indianapolis, IN
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • License: Valid driver's license
  • Physical: Lifting up to 20 lbs
  • Benefits: 401(k), paid time off, tuition assistance

About this job

Property Adjuster II at Erie Insurance handles property claims including investigations, inspections, estimates, and negotiations. Remote position in Indiana with company car and work-from-home equipment provided.

Good fit if you have five years of claims handling experience or a bachelor's degree with two years of experience, and a valid driver's license

Full job description

*This range represents a national range and the actual salary will depend on several factors including the scope and complexity of the role and the skills, education, training, credentials, location (State) based on ERIE's geographical differences, and experience of an applicant, as well as level of role for which the successful candidate is hired. Position may be eligible for an annual bonus payment.

At Erie Insurance, you're not just part of a Fortune 500 company; you're also a valued member of a diverse and inclusive team that includes more than 6,000 employees and over 13,000 independent agencies. Our Employees work in the Home Office complex located in Erie, PA, and in our Field Offices that span 12 states and the District of Columbia.

Benefits That Go Beyond The Basics

We strive to be Above all in Service® to our customers—and to our employees. That's why Erie Insurance offers you an exceptional benefits package, including:

  • Premier health, prescription, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents. Coverage begins your first day of work.
  • Low contributions to medical and prescription premiums. We currently pay up to 97% of employees' monthly premium costs.
  • Pension. We are one of only 13 Fortune 500 companies to offer a traditional pension plan. Full-time employees are vested after five years of service.
  • 401(k) with up to 4% contribution match. The 401(k) is offered in addition to the pension.
  • Paid time off. Paid vacation, personal days, sick days, bereavement days and parental leave.
  • Career development. Including a tuition reimbursement program for higher education and industry designations.

Additional benefits that include company-paid basic life insurance; short-and long-term disability insurance; orthodontic coverage for children and adults; adoption assistance; fertility and infertility coverage; well-being programs; paid volunteer hours for service to your community; and dollar-for-dollar matching of your charitable gifts each year.

Position Summary

Exercises independent discretion or judgment in handling all types of property claims. Also assists or acts on behalf of the claims supervisor when required.

  • This is a remote, work from home position in Indiana
  • The selected candidate will ideally live in Marion County and/or surrounding areas
  • The hiring manager will also consider candidates for Property Adjuster I. Level of position offered will be based upon the depth and breadth of selected candidate's experience and qualifications.
  • A company car and equipment to work from home will be provided
  • Good time management and organization skills preferred

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Conducts investigations, interviews, and inspects damage, driving to site of damage within assigned territory or other if required. Prepares estimates, makes recommendation, and handles coverage questions, and litigation.
  • Sets and maintains reserves, reviews reports and related materials, directs experts, determines coverage and claim value, issues or declines payment, and negotiates claims with plaintiff attorneys when necessary.
  • Documents claim files and submits report for closure.
  • Recognizes subrogation situations and initiates appropriate action.
  • Services assigned territory and brings assigned claims to conclusion.
  • Interacts with Agents and district sales managers on matters of mutual concern.
  • Assists claims supervisor or acts on his/her behalf, including representing the company at legal proceedings, as required.
  • Completes industry-related training programs and continues to attend training programs to remain informed on policy changes, interpretation or new legislation.
  • Assists in training of new claims adjusters.
  • Participates on Catastrophe Team when required.


The first five duties listed are the functions identified as essential to the job. Essential functions are those job duties that must be performed in order for the job to be accomplished.


This position description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the incumbent. Employees are required to follow any other job-related instruction and to perform any other duties as requested by their supervisor, or as become evident.

Capabilities

  • Values Diversity
  • Nimble Learning
  • Self-Development
  • Collaborates
  • Customer Focus
  • Information Management Skills
  • Cultivates Innovation
  • Instills Trust
  • Job-Specific Knowledge
  • Optimizes Work Processes (IC)
  • Ensures Accountability
  • Decision Quality

Qualifications

Minimum Educational and Experience Requirements

  • High School Diploma or GED and five years of claims handling experience, or equivalent required; or
  • Bachelor's Degree and two years of claims handling experience, or equivalent required.


Additional Experience

  • Incumbent must live in territory assigned unless a change is approved by the company.
  • Position requires the incumbent to serve on Catastrophe Team, which may include travel on short notice to other locations for periods in excess of two consecutive weeks.


Designations and/or Licenses

  • Willingness to obtain and maintain any required licenses.
  • Successful completion of Associate in Claims (AIC) program preferred.
  • Valid driver's license and good driving record required.

Physical Requirements

  • Use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is required for this role.
  • Ability to move over 50 lbs using lifting aide equipment; Often (20-50%)
  • Climbing/accessing heights; Moderate (30-40%)
  • Driving; Frequent (50-80%)
  • Lifting/Moving 0-20 lbs; Often (20-50%)

At Erie Insurance, you're not just part of a Fortune 500 company; you're also a valued member of a diverse and inclusive team that includes more than 6,000 employees and over 13,000 independent agencies. Benefits That Go Beyond The Basics

We strive to be Above all in Service® to our customers—and to our employees. That's why Erie Insurance offers you an exceptional benefits package, including:

  • Premier health, prescription, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents. Coverage begins your first day of work.

  • Paid time off. Paid vacation, personal days, sick days, bereavement days and parental leave.
  • Career development. Including a tuition reimbursement program for higher education and industry designations.

Additional benefits that include company-paid basic life insurance; short-and long-term disability insurance; orthodontic coverage for children and adults; adoption assistance; fertility and infertility coverage; well-being programs; paid volunteer hours for service to your community; and dollar-for-dollar matching of your charitable gifts each year.

Recruits, trains and guides assigned Agents in matters of sales, underwriting and re-underwriting, profitability, agency management and related matters. Serves as a company representative in maintaining favorable Policyholder relationships. Interacts with, supports, coaches and motivates Agents.

Job Summary

Provides life underwriting guidance and support to agents throughout the application and underwriting process. Applies expertise in underwriting philosophies, requirements, workflows, and policy provisions to explain requirements and decisions, address complex inquiries, and help agents understand next steps. Facilitates communication between agents and underwriting resources to support case progression and an effective service experience.

Essential Job Functions

Responds to underwriting-related inquiries from agents regarding application status, case requirements, underwriting processes, policy provisions, and other insurance matters. Reviews available case and account information across multiple systems to identify appropriate information and guidance. Addresses escalated or ambiguous inquiries using knowledge of underwriting guidelines, products, and applicable compliance and legal requirements. Documents interactions and outcomes in applicable systems. Explains life underwriting processes, philosophies, workflows, and requirements to agents. Provides guidance regarding information or actions needed to support case progression and helps agents navigate underwriting requirements and application-related issues. Applies underwriting expertise to communicate information clearly and support agent understanding throughout the underwriting process. Provides clarification regarding underwriting decisions and the factors or requirements associated with case outcomes. Helps agents understand underwriting information and available next steps for pending, postponed, declined, or incomplete applications. Facilitates communication with underwriting resources when additional information or clarification is needed. Serves as a liaison between agents and underwriting resources to facilitate communication and support timely case progression. Identifies communication gaps or barriers affecting the underwriting experience and helps resolve complex service issues. Provides guidance and information intended to improve agent understanding and the overall underwriting service experience. Maintains current knowledge of underwriting philosophies, guidelines, workflows, requirements, policy provisions, and applicable compliance and legal requirements through self-directed learning. Develops and maintains underwriting knowledge resources to support accurate and consistent information. Performs other duties as assigned.

Education Requirements

High School Diploma or equivalent is required. Bachelors degree is preferred but not required.

Experience Requirements

Minimum three years of experience in customer service is required. Minimum one year of experience with life insurance and underwriting required.

Additional Qualification

Demonstrated customer service skills. Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Demonstrated written communication skills. Demonstrated problem solving skills. Demonstrates a high level of accuracy, even under pressure. Ability to simultaneously handle multiple priorities. Possesses strong technical aptitude.

Job Summary

Sales Trailblazer Wanted! | Inbound Sales Consultant | Uncapped Earnings + Career Growth

We're looking for sales-driven, enthusiastic experienced sales professionals to join our next classes of Sales Consultants beginning in January 2027.

In this role, you will respond to calls coming into our call center by positively promoting Farmers insurance products to prospective customers, consulting with customers to understand their needs, and selling those products which best fit the customer's needs. You may also make outbound calls to optimize sales potential. You will earn a competitive base salary in addition to monthly incentive earnings based upon your performance.

We provide a comprehensive paid training program, combining classroom and hands-on learning with mentoring to ensure that you have the skills you need to succeed at Farmers. Ongoing coaching and training will remain a focus throughout your career to help you grow in your role and advance to new opportunities.

Join a team where your performance drives your paycheck! Our compensation package is designed to reward your success.

  • Our model includes guaranteed annual base pay of $40,000+ based on your experience.
  • A competitive benefits package PLUS an uncapped performance-based incentive, giving you the opportunity to increase your earnings on average up to an additional $27,300+ on top of the guaranteed base pay annually.
  • Many of our top performers who consistently meet and exceed their goals earn up to an additional $75,000+ on top of their annual base pay.
  • Experienced and licensed insurance sales professionals with 3+ years working in a competitive call center environment will be considered for higher salary grades - Senior or Lead sales roles, with starting annual base pay of $50,000+.

You'll thrive here if you are:

  • Self-motivated & goal-oriented – You set ambitious goals and chase them relentlessly.
  • Customer-focused – You build trust and tailor solutions with empathy.
  • Tech-savvy & adaptable – You navigate systems with ease and embrace change.
  • Coachable & curious – You welcome feedback and seek growth.
  • Accountable & reliable – You own your outcomes and show up ready.

If you're driven, competitive and ready to grow, this is the place to do it! Check out a Day in the Life of a Sales Representative!

You'll thrive in this position if you have:

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a sales environment
  • Proven ability to meet quotas, metrics and goals
  • A drive to work in a fast-paced, high energy environment
  • Desire for a long-term career within the insurance industry
  • Proven ability to take initiative, solve problems, and prioritize tasks
  • Direct sales skills, and the aptitude to influence customers and close the sale
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; the ability to adapt communication style to each phone call, and explain complex policy and coverage information in understandable terms
  • Must be eligible to obtain resident/non-resident property and casualty license in all required states

Here's what you will accomplish as a member of our team:

  • Sell insurance products to inbound callers by gathering data from customers to generate quotes and ultimately bind the business; in some instances, make outbound calls

  • Provide exceptional customer service and build strong relationships, while educating customers regarding coverages and cost so that the customer can select the most appropriate option

  • Qualify customers as buyers of other products/services to create cross-sell and upselling opportunities

  • Navigate multiple computer systems while seamlessly interacting with the customer

  • Experience in property & casualty insurance sales is preferred
  • Must be eligible to obtain resident/non-resident property and casualty license in all required states
  • Education - High School diploma or equivalent; College degree preferred

    We will provide you with the technology that you need successfully to connect from home, including laptop & accessories.

Job Summary

Are you an inquisitive individual with a passion for uncovering insights and driving improvements to positively impact an organization? Farmers Insurance is for Senior Business Internal Auditors to strengthen our assurance practices through the performance of quality audit work as part of our transformation to become a leading practice audit function. What You'll Do:

  • Lead: Lead audit engagements in accordance with Farmers Internal Audit Standards with minimal oversight.
  • Deliver: High quality audits that help Farmers deliver on its value proposition to its customers.
  • Contribute: Participate in the development of the Internal Audit Strategy and Plan, as well as the Audit Universe, by demonstrating a thorough understanding of the risks facing the company or business unit. Analyze controls and information gathered through audits, meetings, and other sources, and escalate relevant findings to Audit Management.
  • Collaborate: Establish strong working relationships with, and knowledge of, the business while partnering with IT Internal Audit in the performance of integrated audits
  • Communicate: Prepare executive ready reports and other written correspondence that effectively and efficiently communicate findings and recommendations.
  • Transform: Bring, and drive, transformational ideas that drive the Internal Audit function forward.
  • Facilitate Knowledge Sharing: Mentor peers and colleagues to support their professional development and enhance the overall capability of the team.
  • Cultivate Professional Development: Grow as a professional through various stretch and growth opportunities that will develop and hone skillsets needed for advancement.

Join our team to lead impactful audit engagements and contribute to the continuous improvement of our internal audit processes.

Essential Job Functions

Leads audit engagements with minimal supervision - on time and in a quality manner. Preparation of reports and communication with the business. Administrative duties supporting departmental activities, individual development plan, training, performance management, and general administration. Participates in departmental special projects.

Physical Actions

This role, whether performed virtually or in an office setting, will include normal and customary distractions, noise, and interruptions. Sits or stands for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift. Occasionally reaches overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Occasionally moves, lifts, carries, and places objects and supplies weighing 0-10 pounds without assistance. Listens to, interprets, and differentiates auditory information (example others speaking) at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Visually verifies and reads information. Visually locates material, resources and other objects. Ability to continuously operate a computer for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift. Physical dexterity sufficient to use hands, arms, and shoulders repetitively to operate keyboard and other office equipment up to a full work shift.

Education Requirements

High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred. Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), or other comparable designation preferred.

Experience Requirements

Five or more years experience in Auditing at an external firm or financial services firm, or seven years experience with Farmers Insurance and/or one year as a Farmers Insurance Auditor. Detailed subject matter expertise of at least one area of the business or industry.

The preferred candidate will possess:

  • Prior experience in insurance or financial services.
  • Demonstrated ability in advanced audit techniques including data analysis, data visualization, data mining, process mining, provide audit insights and critically think through complex problems.
  • Proficient in data analytics tools such as PowerBI, Excel, and SQL.
  • Experience using artificial intelligence methods within the audit process.
  • Skilled in tracing transactions to the general ledger.
  • Experience leading complex audit engagements.
  • Strong understanding of auditing principles, methodologies, and techniques.
  • Proven ability to manage and maintain professional relationships.

Special Skill Requirement

Strong analytical skills. Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong project management skills. Ability to effectively communicate with individuals in the business.

Full job description

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered.

Job Summary

This position collaborates with business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver technical solutions that support complex business initiatives. The role acts as a knowledgeable resource to provide systems-level views of technology and devise technical solutions aligned with business objectives. It focuses on enhancing solution design, optimizing development processes, and effectively implementing CI/CD pipelines to deliver impactful solutions that meet business needs. The position ensures technology delivery is successful within lines of business and across the enterprise. It performs work independently while receiving limited guidance or direction.

Essential Tasks & Leadership Philosophy

  • Engages with cross-functional business stakeholders and technical teams to understand and address complex initiatives within a business unit or at the enterprise level. Participates in discussions to gather requirements, develop solutions, validate technology assumptions, and evaluate implementation alternatives. Influences solution strategies by leveraging in-depth business knowledge and practical experience in solution engineering.
  • Leads multiple technical projects simultaneously by prioritizing and coordinating solution engineering efforts across teams and initiatives. Uses established performance metrics to measure effectiveness and make necessary adjustments. Manages non-functional requirements and ensures compliance with industry standards throughout the solution development and delivery process.
  • Acts as a servant leader for the solution by ensuring Agile Release Trains operate effectively. Identifies and resolves constraints across the development and delivery process while collaborating with Release Train Engineers to coordinate delivery. Provides a systems view of the development lifecycle to guide technology delivery and align architecture with business objectives. Serves solutions with one or more Agile Release Trains or business units.
  • Develops and refines technical designs to meet business requirements for complex solutions while ensuring scalability and performance. Collaborates with developers and Agile Release Trains to align solutions with enterprise architecture. Works with DevOps teams to implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines that streamline deployment and integrate new features. Engages with quality assurance teams to validate that technical solutions meet performance and reliability standards.
  • Supports development and delivery of complex solutions by ensuring technical implementations align with product roadmaps and overarching business strategies. Monitors progress, resolves issues affecting delivery timelines, and contributes to technical problem-solving efforts during development and deployment phases. Collaborates with business stakeholders and technical teams to address challenges and optimize solutions.
  • Maintains technical documentation for solutions to facilitate knowledge sharing and makes updates as architecture or functionality changes. Engages in continuous learning to stay current with trends and technologies in solution engineering. Applies learning to enhance own skills and impact the quality of work produced. Shares best practices in solution engineering across business units and the enterprise to promote peer learning. Supports pioneering of design and development practices to promote innovation and improvement across solutions.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred in computer science, engineering, or similar field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience required in solution engineering, software development, systems architecture, or related.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and working in Agile teams preferred.
  • Experience in the insurance industry preferred.

First Year Success Factors

  • Establish credibility as the trusted advisor and primary point of accountability for AI strategy and business value realization across IT and business organizations.
  • Develop and maintain a prioritized portfolio of AI opportunities aligned to enterprise objectives, ensuring clear business outcomes, investment rationale, value realization targets, and executive sponsorship.
  • Partner with senior business and technology leaders to identify strategic opportunities where AI can improve customer experience, operational efficiency, employee productivity, risk management, and revenue growth.
  • Drive enterprise alignment across business units, technology teams, governance bodies, and executive stakeholders to accelerate AI adoption and remove organizational barriers to execution.
  • Define and track meaningful business KPIs for AI investments, ensuring measurable outcomes through productivity gains, cost reduction, process optimization, improved decision-making, and customer impact.
  • Lead the governance and prioritization process for AI initiatives, ensuring investments are aligned with enterprise strategy, regulatory requirements, risk appetite, and organizational capacity.
  • Build and institutionalize repeatable frameworks for AI opportunity assessment, business case development, prioritization, value tracking, and executive reporting.
  • Create a portfolio of enterprise AI success stories that demonstrate business impact and serve as catalysts for broader adoption across the organization.
  • Champion a culture of innovation and responsible AI by leading executive engagement, business workshops, innovation forums, strategic planning sessions, and change management initiatives.
  • Influence and enable leaders, product owners, and business teams to identify, evaluate, and adopt AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Partner with architecture, data, security, legal, compliance, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions meet enterprise standards while balancing speed, innovation, and risk management.
  • Establish executive-level visibility into AI strategy, investments, risks, adoption metrics, and business outcomes through regular reporting, scorecards, and portfolio reviews.
  • Build strategic partnerships across internal teams and external vendors to accelerate innovation, leverage emerging capabilities, and maximize enterprise value.
  • Foster an organization-wide mindset focused on continuous improvement, experimentation, business transformation, and value-driven adoption of AI technologies.

Additional Qualification

  • Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Able to clearly communicate technical information to non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated written communication skills.
  • Effective interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills. Able to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Possesses flexibility to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ability to simultaneously handle multiple priorities.
  • Demonstrated project management skills.
  • Possesses strong technical aptitude. Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite. In-depth knowledge of software architecture principles and design patterns. Strong proficiency in one or more phases of the software development lifecycle. In-depth knowledge of multiple systems and their key components. Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and version control systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, etc.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. About this job

Handle General Liability and Commercial Auto claims including investigations, coverage determinations, reserve setting, and payment authorization. Remote position requiring seven years of claims experience and state adjusting license.

Good fit if you have seven plus years handling GL or Commercial Auto claims and can obtain a state adjusting license

Full job description

What you'll be doing:
In accordance with application of state and federal laws and company best practices, gather and review claim information, determine coverage, determine duty, and conduct liability investigations. Initiate and maintain contact with claim parties to provide updates and resolve issues timely. Update the claim system to document claim handling activities throughout the life of the claim. Determine, set, and maintain reserves and issue payments in line with a level of authority.  Review contracts and thoroughly investigate risk transfer possibilities.  Investigate and refer identified claims to Loss Recovery Services, as applicable.  Direct vendors and review reports to evaluate exposure.  Manage and direct counsel when litigation is involved.

On any given day, you'll:

  • Perform claim tasks timely and document claim files appropriately. Proactively manage claim activities to ensure fair claim resolution. Handle all claims in accordance with state and federal laws.
  • Make complex coverage decisions by gathering information necessary to make an informed decision in a fair, equitable, and ethical manner. Deny losses within authority level, providing detailed explanation, citing facts, and policy language.
  • Perform a thorough investigation based upon the type, complexity, and severity of the claim. Upon completion of the investigation, analyze and evaluate the potential exposure and damages, including potential full or partial liability and compensability denials. Formulate and document an action plan based on the covered damages and injuries.
  • Determine and set reserves based on the most probable outcome of the claim, within authority level. Evaluate and negotiate directly with insured, claimant, or claimant's attorney on all cases within authority level. Review claim facts and exposure with claims management, as appropriate, to guide claim strategy. Make complete, accurate, and timely payments within authority for covered losses. Refer claims above authority to appropriate team member for review and potential reassignment.
  • Maintain a professional, courteous, and helpful approach when communicating in-person, on the phone, or through email and other correspondence with internal and external customers, business partners and brokers.
  • Recognize when vendor partners are required on a claim, including experts, independent adjustors, nurses, defense attorneys, etc. Assign and direct vendors, as needed, to aid in the investigation and evaluation of the claim. Manage claim expense by concluding vendor assignment when vendor is no longer adding value to the claim.
  • Investigate and refer identified claims to Loss Recovery Services, as applicable.
  • Act as a resource to share knowledge and experience with other claim handlers. Assist and support their development with mentoring and auditing functions.
  • Negotiate settlements, attend mediations, attend settlement conferences, engage in various ADR opportunities.

Here's what we expect:

  • Minimum of seven years handling General Liability and/or Commercial Auto claims is required.
  • Three years of litigation management experience is preferred.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree preferred. A combination of equivalent education and/or experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Additional training in insurance, medical, and/or building terminology knowledge is desirable.
  • Completion of INS, AIC, or CPCU is preferred.

Necessary Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain state adjusting license requirements and complete continuing education requirements.
  • Ability to work independently and manage workload timely.
  • Strong listening, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Proficient knowledge of policy terminology and legal principles involving at least one or more of the following: insurance, automobile, medical and property claims.

Liberty Mutual Investments manages Liberty Mutual Insurance Groups global financial assets across public and private domains, to create capital and generate income. With over $100 billion in AUM and staffed with 300+ investment, finance and operations professionals located in Boston, MA., Liberty Mutual Investments offers the best of both worlds; the look and feel of a boutique investment firm, and the reputation and financial strength of a Fortune 100 company.

Note: This role has a preferred hybrid work arrangement (3 days per week in our Boston office).

The Principal Full Stack Software Engineer for the Public Markets Agile Squad will:

- Provide hands-on technical leadership designing and building real-time, highthroughput trading and market data platforms for Global Liquid Markets.

- Partner closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and Solution Engineers to cocreate solution designs that balance speed, resilience, security, and enterprise quality.

- 8+ years of software engineering experience in an agile environment

- Prior experience building realtime trading, execution, order management, or market data systems for institutional investors strongly preferred.

- Deep understanding of distributed systems, lowlatency architectures, and resilient, faulttolerant design.

- Proven experience working in fastpaced, regulated financial services environments.

Skills

- Strong proficiency in Python and modern backend development; experience with cloudnative architectures on AWS (e.g., Lambda, Fargate, Step Functions).

- Experience designing and consuming REST and eventdriven APIs; familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake and ingestion pipelines.

- Practical experience applying AIassisted tools in the SDLC (e.g., code generation, test creation, observability, or productivity tooling).

- Excellent communication, facilitation, and influence skills.

Knowledge

- Deep knowledge of software architecture patterns, security and privacy controls, and enterprise engineering practices.

- Strong grasp of agile delivery, backlog management, and incremental value delivery.

Education

A Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Description

This approach optimizes both remote and in-person interactions, enabling you to connect and ideate with your team and deepen valuable relationships across the company, while still enjoying the flexibility of remote work for focused tasks and projects.

Are you looking for an opportunity to join a claims team with a fast-growing company that has consistently outpaced the industry in year-over-year growth? Liberty Mutual has an excellent claims opportunity available. As a Commercial Insurance Claims Representative, you will review, and process simple and straightforward Commercial claims within assigned authority limits consistent with policy and legal requirements. In addition to a wide range of benefits, as a direct employee, your insurance education and training are paid by Liberty Mutual.

You will be required to go into the office twice a month if you reside within 50 miles of one of the following offices:Boston, MA; Westborough, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL;Weatogue, CT; Indianapolis, IN; Plano, TX;Suwanee, GA; orLake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Chandler, AZ. (Please note this policy is subject to change.)

Job.JobTitle: Senior Claims Specialist, Miscellaneous Medical Facilities & Long-Term Care Professional Liability
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Liberty Mutual has an immediate opening for an experienced claims professional with focus on Miscellaneous Medical Facilities (MMF) and Long-Term Care (LTC) Professional Liability.As a Senior Claims Specialist, you will handle a book of specialty lines MMF/LTC Professional Liability claims throughout the life of the claim. In this role, you will be responsible for conducting investigations, recommending adequate reserves, monitoring, documenting, and settling/closing claims in an expeditious and economical manner within prescribed authority limits for the line of business.

Responsibilities

  • Analyzes, investigates, and evaluates MMF/LTC Professional Liability claims from first notice of loss through resolution he loss to determine coverage and claim disposition.
  • Within prescribed settlement authority for the line of business, establishes appropriate reserves for both indemnity and expense and reviews on a regular basis to ensure adequacy.
  • Makes recommendations to set reserves at appropriate level for claims outside of authority level.
  • Prepares comprehensive reports as required. Identifies and communicates specific claim trends and account and/or policy issues to management and underwriting.
  • Manages the litigation process through the retention of counsel.
  • Adheres to the line of business litigation guidelines to include budget, bill review and payment.
  • Monitors the case resolution process. Actively participates in mediations and arbitrations, within limit of settlement authority.
  • Participates in meetings with brokers, risk managers, and reinsurers.
  • As required, maintains insurance adjuster licenses.

*This position may have in-office requirements and other travel needs depending on candidate location. You will be required to go into an office twice a month if you reside within 50-miles of one of the following offices: Boston, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Plano, TX; Suwanee, GA; Chandler, AZ; or Westborough, MA. We will consider a remote candidate if you do not live within 50-miles of one of these offices. This policy is subject to change.

Qualifications
  • Bachelors' and/or advanced degree. JD is a plus, especially with experience litigating Professional Liability claims (MMF or LTC).
  • 5+ years claims/legal experience, with substantive, hands-on, medical Professional Liability claims (providers and/or facilities).
  • Functional knowledge of claims handling Professional Liability concepts, practices and techniques, to include but not limited to coverage issues, and product line knowledge.
  • Functional knowledge of law and insurance regulations in various jurisdictions common to Miscellaneous Medical Facilities and/or Long-Term Care Professional Liability.
  • Proven analytical, negotiation and written/verbal communication skills; able to present complex clinical and coverage positions to Counsel, Underwriters, Senior Management, and other applicable parties.
