Job.JobDescription:
We are Farmers – where ambition meets opportunity.

At Farmers, we're not just known for unforgettable jingle – we're a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people's lives. We deliver peace of mind when it matters most. Our results-driven, high-performance culture thrives on creativity, accountability and bold solutions. Here, growth isn't just a goal – it's a way of life for both the organization and every individual on our team. We tackle challenges head-on, learn from every experience and measure our impact on the customers who trust us.

Join an award-winning, equal opportunity employer, where you'll find more than a job – you'll find a supportive community. Enjoy competitive benefits, take part in meaningful volunteer projects, and help shape the future alongside talented colleagues across all backgrounds. At Farmers, helping others is at the heart of what we do.

Ready to make your mark? Discover our vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate. Connect with us on Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok, and let's build something incredible together!

Workplace: Remote ( #LI-Remote ) - This is a field role requiring travel to and from policy holder homes.


Residency Requirement: Candidates must currently live within the Chicagoland, Illinois area to be eligible for consideration. Ideal locations include Waukegan, North Chicago, Libertyville, Buffalo Grove, Oak Park, Skokie, Elmhurst, Oak Brook, and Downers Grove.

The starting wage for this position is $29.61/hr. or higher. Additional compensation may be offered based on relevant experience and transferable skills.

If you are looking for the following in your next career ...

  • Paid training through the award-winning and industry-leading University of Farmers.
  • Flexibility and independence to work outside the confines of a desk job.
  • Total Rewards Benefits Package: 401K and a competitive starting salary.
  • Rapid growth potential and management opportunities for success-oriented people through education,mentorship programs, and inspirational leadership at a company you can be proud of.


… then Farmers Insurance is the place for you!

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Adjuster:

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders' residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days.

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

If You Have the Following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable. Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

... then this could be a great career opportunity for you!

Final candidate qualifications may be reviewed against the requirements for the associated level of this role.

Candidates Must be Willing & Able to:

  • Climb Ladders to inspect roofs, and be comfortable working on rooftops, multiple times per day,
  • Work in small, confined spaces that have been damaged; such as attics and crawlspaces.
  • Achieve a minimum passing score on all claims training exams.

Physical Actions & Environment:

  • Bending, Kneeling, Pulling, Pushing, Sorting, Carrying up to 50 lbs., Climbing, Reaching, Standing, Walking, Seeing
  • Speaking (English), Reading (English), Writing (English), & Key Entering

Required job duties are performed in the field and an in-home office environment. Exposure to some or all of the following environments when in the field: Uncontrolled outside environmental conditions, Excessive noise levels, Chemicals Chemical/Biological conditions, Moving mechanical parts, Areas considered dangerous, Conditions which could affect the respiratory system or skin such as fumes, odors, dust, mists, gases, oils, smoke, soot, or poor ventilation.

Benefits

  • Farmers offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications and location.
    o HI/IL/MN/VT Only: $23.22 - $38.76
  • Bonus Opportunity (based on Company and Individual Performance)
  • 401(k)
  • Medical
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Life Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Tuition Assistance
  • For more information, review “What we offer” on https://www.farmers.com/careers/corporate/#offer

Preferred locations are within our North (Waukegan/Libertyville area), Central (Skokie area), or West/Southwest (Elmhurst/Oak Brook/Downers Grove area) territories.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Representative, Insurance Sales, Insurance Agent
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $18.00 an hour
  • Schedule: Full-time, includes weekends
  • Location: Wichita, KS
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), tuition assistance

About this job

Full-time remote insurance sales role selling Allstate products to warm leads via phone, chat, and SMS. Base pay $18/hour plus uncapped performance incentives, with paid training, licensing support, and home office equipment provided.

Good fit if you have 1+ years of sales or customer service experience, hold or can obtain a Property & Casualty or Personal Lines license, and can work evenings and weekends from home.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Pay: $18/hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $52,730$76,480/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)
  • Incentives are productivity-based and governed by the applicable bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstates discretion.
  • Eligible licensed external candidates who complete licensing prior to hire or bring an active Property & Casualty or Personal Lines license before start date may be eligible for a bonus.

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Additional Benefits

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance
  • Monthly internet reimbursement
  • Home office equipment provided by Allstate

Why Join Allstate

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you
  • Career Growth: Develop your skills within a dynamic, supportive Fortune 100 company
  • Supportive Culture: Learn from best-in-class leaders and motivated teammates
  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customers needs

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer service (with a sales focus)
  • Active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license in your state of residence (preferred)
  • If unlicensed, ability to obtain a Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license with Allstates support
  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated by Allstate. This includes obtaining non-resident Producer licenses in all states as required for the role.
  • If hired, Sales Representative must relinquish all non-Allstate insurance carrier appointments and may not hold active appointments with other carriers while employed in this role, in accordance with Allstate licensing and appointment policies.
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Reliable high-speed internet with wired connection (Ethernet)
  • Dedicated, distraction-free home workspace (equipment provided)
  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends
  • Receptive to feedback and performance coaching
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and multitasking skills

Job.JobTitle: Senior Database Engineer Security & Data Platform Resilience
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Bring your database engineering expertise to the evolving world of cybersecurity. If youre an experienced database engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and wants to expand your impact into cybersecurity, this could be a compelling next step in your career.


Allstate internal Business Title: Service Consultant Database Exposure Intelligence

Allstate Job Profile & Family: Lead Consultant- Threat & Incident Response

Team and overall work scope

  • The team operates within a newly established Exposure Management function in the broader cybersecurity organization, focused on modernizing how the enterprise identifies, prioritizes, and mitigates security vulnerabilities shifting from traditional patch approaches to a more strategic focus on true business risk and exploitability
  • Individual Contributor/ Service Consultant roles are designed to bring in deep respective domain expertise (network, endpoint, cloud, identity, infrastructure, Databases & Data Stores, etc.) to bridge the gap between security insights and practical remediation strategies
  • Exposure Intelligence Service Consultant Databases & Data Stores is the SME responsible for identifying and prioritizing exposure risk across data platforms, including RDBMS, NoSQL systems, data warehouses, object storage, and data permissions models.
  • This role applies CTEM (Continuous Threat Exposure Management)model principles to identify exploitable exposure conditions that lead to unauthorized access, data exfiltration, or privilege misuse, partnering with data platform and engineering teams to reduce real enterprise exposure.

About the role and the ideal candidate:


  • Were looking for a Senior Database Engineer who is passionate about database and data-platform engineering and interested in applying that expertise to complex security challenges.
  • This is an engineering-first, security-focused role for someone experienced with databases, data stores, permissions, access models, and enterprise data environments. You do not need to be a dedicated database security professional. We're looking for a strong engineer who has gained security exposure through their work and wants to deepen that expertise.

Success Measures


  • Reduction in high-impact data exposure conditions (permissions and access pathways).
  • Improved visibility and prioritization of data-access-related attack paths.
  • Stronger partnership with data platform teams and fewer recurring access control failures.

What Youll Do


  • Apply your database and data-platform engineering expertise across RDBMS, NoSQL, data warehouses, object storage, and related data services. Analyze database configurations, permissions, access models, storage, encryption, and service-to-service access through a security lens.
  • Investigate issues such as overly broad access, stale entitlements, exposed storage, weak auditability, and misconfigured access policies.
  • Use queries, logs, and technical evidence to validate potential exposures and understand their real-world impact. Identify potential attack paths that could lead to unauthorized data access, privilege expansion, or sensitive-data exposure.
  • Partner with database, data platform, cloud, and security teams to develop practical remediation strategies and preventative engineering guardrails.
  • Help prioritize which issues matter most based on exploitability and potential business impact rather than treating every technical finding equally.
  • Help reduce recurring database and data-access risks through better engineering practices, configurations, and controls.

Required Qualifications


  • Interest in developing deeper expertise in data security, attack-path analysis, and Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The underlying role applies CTEM principles to data-platform exposure.
  • Strong hands-on experience in database engineering, database administration, or data-platform engineering.
  • Experience working with RDBMS and/or NoSQL database technologies and their underlying architecture, configuration, and operations.
  • Solid understanding of database authentication, authorization, roles, permissions, and access models.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex database or data-platform issues using queries, logs, or other technical data.
  • Experience identifying or remediating overly broad permissions, stale access, misconfigured storage, or service-to-service access concerns.
  • Understanding of how database and data-layer weaknesses could contribute to privilege escalation, unauthorized access, or data exposure.
  • Working knowledge of database hardening, access controls, encryption, vulnerability remediation, or other security considerations encountered through database engineering work.
  • Ability to analyze complex technical issues and translate them into practical engineering solutions.
  • Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work across database, platform, cloud, engineering, and cybersecurity teams.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with data warehouses, object storage, cloud databases, or cloud data services.
  • Experience with database hardening and secure configuration practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud data services and their permission models.
  • Exposure to data-access governance, security engineering, vulnerability management, or exposure management.

What Makes This Opportunity Different?


  • This isnt traditional database engineering, and it isnt traditional cybersecurity. It brings the two together.
  • Instead of focusing only on operating and optimizing databases, youll use your engineering expertise to understand how database and datastore environments can become exposed and how better engineering can reduce that risk.
  • For a database engineer who has developed an interest in security, this is an exciting opportunity to stay rooted in engineering while growing your expertise in data security, exposure management, and cybersecurity.

Skills

Authentication Methods, Cloud Data Architecture, Database Access Control, Database Engineering, Database Segmentation, Security Configuration

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 100,000.00 - 170,500.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Consultant II / Senior Consultant I is responsible for investigating moderately complex and occasionally complex, represented and unrepresented claims. The individual also may handle moderate and occasionally complex CPL (comprehensive personal liability) claims. The individual takes recorded statements, resolves loss of use claims, makes payments to appropriate parties, and negotiates and settles property damage to third parties. This desk handles multiple types of homeowners, condos, boat, and ATV policies as well as all perils related to third party liability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Negotiates and settles claims in accordance with business unit best practices.
  • Reviews estimates in preparation for claims settlement evaluation.
  • Coordinate the appraisal process for highly complex, disputed claims, ensuring adherence to policy provisions.
  • Determines and explains minimum coverage limits in moderately complex and occasionally complex claims involving single or multiple claimants, also determines claim value.
  • Sets initial reserve, updates reserve, documents rationale and claim summary notes.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for policyholder attorneys, leading direct negotiations to resolve disputes efficiently.
  • Draft and respond to attorney correspondence, requests for information, and demands to maintain compliance and mitigate legal exposure.
  • Researches and responds to moderately complex and occasionally complex customer communications, concerns, conflicts or issues.
  • Summarizes documents and enters into claim system notes, documenting a claim file with notes, evaluations and decision-making process.
  • Analyzes contracts such as lease agreements and condominium documents.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of claims experience.
  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.
  • The ability to handle condo claims and property liability.
  • Prior large loss claim and litigation handling.

Notes
The preceding description is not designed to be a complete list of all duties and responsibilities. May be required to perform other related duties as assigned. Regular, predictable attendance is an essential function of this job.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job does not have supervisory duties.

Remote Home-Based Work:

This position is a permanent remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States. This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii, or Washington residents.

When you work from home full time, youll need:

  • A home office a dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.

What will Allstate provide?

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.
  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign-on Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.
  • Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Allstate Benefits:

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:
  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Business Communications, Contract Management, Critical Thinking, General Liability Claims, Homeowners Claims, Information Collection, Investigative Skills, Negotiation, Policy Documentation, Property Claims, Third Party Liability, Time Management

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $56,000 to $82,500 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: York, ME

About this job

Field Property Adjuster for National General/Allstate investigating and evaluating homeowners property claims from start to finish. You will confirm facts of loss, determine coverage, assess damages, and negotiate settlements while managing the entire claim lifecycle.

Good fit if you have experience with property claims, proficiency in Xactimate, an active adjuster license or reciprocal license, and are located near Hollis Center, ME or within 1 hour radius.

Full job description

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will investigate and evaluate homeowners property claims from start to finish. You will confirm the facts of loss, determine coverage, assess damages, and negotiate settlements within your assigned authority. In this role, you will manage the entire claim lifecycle, including supplements, Additional Living Expense (ALE) claims, contents, and personal property losses. You will work closely with customers, contractors, and other partners to ensure claims are handled accurately and efficiently.

A key part of this position is delivering excellent customer service through clear, timely communication, keeping customers informed and supported throughout the claims process.

We are seeking an experienced Field Property Adjuster located near Hollis Center, ME/ York County or within a 1 hour radius. With proficiency in Xactimate and a strong foundation in claims handling, including supplements, ALE, contents and full claim ownership. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong organizational skills, a proactive approach, excellent customer service, and the ability to adapt in a fastpaced environment. Experience handling claims in both field and desk settings is strongly preferred. Holds an active adjuster license or possess a license that qualifies for reciprocity in the applicable states is strongly preferred.



Key Responsibilities

Exhibits mastery estimating fundamentals in order to create estimates of damages on the most complex 1st party homeowner losses of all severities

Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers

Interprets regulatory compliance and fair claims practices

Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files

Applies mastered content in interpretations of all policy types written by the company and assists leadership in formal and ad hoc training

Recommends process improvements


Supervisory Responsibilities

This job does not have supervisory duties.


Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designation

People who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Skills

Analytical Thinking, Communication, Insurance, Insurance Claims, Negotiation, Payment Handling, Property Claims, Relationship Building, Xactimate

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chicago, IL

About this job

Two Managing Engineer roles leading design and delivery of scalable data solutions at Allstate. Combines hands-on data engineering with technical leadership, team mentorship, and collaboration with product and business teams.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in data solutions or pipelines, hands-on programming experience, and 1+ years of technical leadership or mentoring.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

We are seeking Two Managing Engineers, Data Engineering to lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable data solutions that support digital products, analytics, and business decision-making.

Both opportunities combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership, team development, and delivery responsibility. You will partner with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Data Analysts, Architects, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, and high-performing data products.

Based on an assessment of each candidate's experience, technical expertise, and leadership background, candidates may be considered for the opportunity that best aligns with their qualifications.

Key Responsibilities


People and Engineering Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and coach Data Engineers while supporting their technical and professional development.
  • Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish engineering standards and encourage consistent use of best practices.
  • Balance hands-on engineering with technical leadership, team development, and delivery responsibilities.
  • Depending on the position level, support or lead hiring, onboarding, performance feedback, career development, and workforce planning.

Data Solution Design and Development

  • Lead the design, development, implementation, and support of scalable batch and streaming data solutions.
  • Develop reusable patterns for data ingestion, transformation, storage, and access.
  • Integrate data from APIs, databases, event streams, third-party platforms, and enterprise systems.
  • Remain actively involved in architecture discussions, solution design, code reviews, troubleshooting, and complex problem-solving.
  • Ensure data solutions are reliable, maintainable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective.

Engineering Excellence and Production Support

  • Promote modern engineering practices, including version control, automated testing, continuous integration, automated deployment, and infrastructure automation.
  • Establish standards for data quality, validation, monitoring, lineage, and observability.
  • Optimize data pipelines, databases, queries, and storage solutions for performance and cost.
  • Support production operations and provide leadership during critical incidents, root-cause analysis, and preventative improvements.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and operational risk.

Product Collaboration and Delivery

  • Partner with Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, Analysts, and business stakeholders to understand priorities and deliver effective data solutions.
  • Translate business and product needs into technical roadmaps and clearly defined engineering work.
  • Lead or contribute to planning, prioritization, estimation, and delivery activities.
  • Manage risks, dependencies, resource needs, and competing priorities.
  • Communicate progress, technical recommendations, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders and leaders.

Data Governance, Security, and Standards

  • Promote data governance practices, including metadata management, data lineage, classification, and data quality.
  • Ensure solutions meet applicable security, privacy, governance, and regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with Architecture, Security, Risk, and Governance teams to align solutions with enterprise standards.
  • Support the responsible access, use, storage, and movement of enterprise data.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices that may improve data capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to increase automation, simplify development, and improve engineering productivity.
  • Support cloud modernization and data platform transformation initiatives.
  • Promote continuous learning and the responsible use of generative and agent-based artificial intelligence tools.

Essential Qualifications


Managing Engineer: 5 or More Years of Experience

  • 5 or more years of experience designing, developing, and supporting data solutions, data pipelines, or enterprise software systems.
  • 1 or more years of experience providing technical leadership, mentorship, coaching, or project leadership.
  • Experience guiding engineers through technical mentorship and knowledge sharing.
  • Strong hands-on experience developing data pipelines using Python, Java, Scala, or a comparable programming language.
  • Experience designing and supporting batch or streaming data solutions.
  • Experience with Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, dbt, or comparable technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL, NoSQL databases, data modeling, and data storage concepts.
  • Experience integrating data from APIs, databases, event streams, and third-party systems.
  • Experience with automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, deployment automation, and DevOps practices.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence technical outcomes and lead through expertise.

Managing Engineer: 7 or More Years of Experience

  • 7 or more years of experience designing, developing, and supporting data solutions, data pipelines, or enterprise software systems.
  • 3 or more years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing technical professionals.
  • Experience with coaching, performance management, career development, hiring, and team development.
  • Strong hands-on experience developing data pipelines using Python, Java, Scala, or a comparable programming language.
  • Experience designing and supporting scalable batch and streaming data solutions.
  • Experience with Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, dbt, or comparable technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL, NoSQL databases, data modeling, and data architecture.
  • Experience integrating data from APIs, databases, event streams, and enterprise systems.
  • Experience optimizing data platforms, pipelines, databases, and storage solutions for performance and cost.
  • Experience implementing automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, observability, and engineering excellence practices.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong communication, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to balance hands-on engineering, people leadership, and delivery accountability.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience with data services and platforms in Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Semantic Models, and Fabric Notebooks.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar tools.
  • Experience with Datadog or another monitoring and observability platform.
  • Experience supporting or leading cloud modernization or data platform transformation initiatives.
  • Experience building reusable data frameworks, shared services, internal platforms, or developer tools.
  • Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, data lineage, privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise data products.
  • Familiarity with generative and agent-based artificial intelligence tools used to improve engineering productivity.

About this job

Enterprise Architect for Allstate's data and analytics strategy, defining technology platforms and standards for a data-driven enterprise. Role focuses on large-scale data lake and lakehouse modernization, cloud adoption, and advancing analytics and AI capabilities across the organization.

Good fit if you have 10-15 years in data architecture or cloud architecture, hands-on experience with MPP databases and cloud data warehouses, and can communicate strategy to both engineers and executives.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description


At Allstate's Enterprise Architecture organization, we define the technology strategies, platforms, and standards that enable a data-driven enterprise. Our team partners across business and technology to modernize data platforms, accelerate cloud adoption, and advance analytics and AI capabilities that power smarter decisions across the company.

The Opportunity

  • Defining and socializing the data analytic practices across the Allstate corporation. This role will provide strategic guidance for technical and business teams on ingestion, integration, data visualization, and advanced analytics including generative AI, ultimately enabling our business to advance.

  • This role will focus on large scale data lake implementation and data lake house modernization through engagements that will focus on customer solutions such as data warehousing, business intelligence, and advanced analytics tools. You'll work with senior leaders, engineers, and architects across the organization to build solutions that make enterprise-scale analytics and intelligence possible. ,

  • You'll be expected to roll up your sleeves, develop prototypes, evaluate emerging technologies, and influence how the next generation of data and AI platforms are built across Allstate.

What We're Looking For

  • You are a senior data architecture leader who combines deep technical expertise with strong business influence. You have experience leading cloud and data modernization initiatives, remain close to the technology, and can confidently communicate architectural strategy to both engineers and executives. You thrive in fast-changing environments and are passionate about the future of analytics, cloud, and AI.

Primary Responsibilities Include:

  • Drive the evolution and data architecture for a scalable and secure data platform
  • Work closely with business partners, architecture, security, and engineering teams to design and implement a modern data lake and lake house architecture
  • Engage with strategic customers and ensure their future needs and vision are top of mind for a data-driven enterprise
  • Oversee deployment of long-term strategic data products and infusing key data and analytics services in applicable areas of business and IT
  • Build POCs of cloud native microservices architecture for data with focus on IaaS, metadata driven frameworks and DevOps
  • Design and guide practices for data models, data flows, and integration patterns for the data lake, lake house , and consumption data layers
  • Support delivery leaders and engineers in building and managing conceptual, logical, and physical architecture
  • Collaborate, design and provide hands-on development of high-priority prototypes in a cloud platform and demonstrate value and feasibility of the solutions and architecture
  • Be involved in all project phases and drive architecture initiatives
  • Communication with senior and executive leadership on architecture initiatives
  • Strong communicator individually, in groups and in presentations with a vision for how cloud data platforms can enable a better future powered by data

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent professional experience
  • Rich experience building POCs with at least 1-2 successful adoptions across Enterprise
  • 10 to 15 years of experience in at least two IT disciplines such as data architecture, technical cloud architecture, analytics & data science, big data technologies, database management, data governance & security in a heterogeneous environment.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in implementation and performance tuning MPP (Massively Parallel Processing) databases (Oracle Exadata, Teradata, Netezza, Greenplum, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience in lead roles architecting solutions at scale for cloud data platforms including experience with major cloud providers (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Experience designing analytics environments for use with data visualization and model development tools and AI driven data agents
  • Hands-on experience with business intelligence tools (Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
  • Experience in analyzing Data Warehouses such as Teradata, Netezza, Oracle, etc.
  • Experience in analyzing Cloud Data Warehouses such as AWS Redshift, Azure Synapse, or Snowflake, etc.
  • Experience designing database environments, analyzing production deployments, and making recommendations to optimize performance
  • Hands on experience architecting and building secure, scalable, and flexible enterprise data projects using AWS, Microsoft Fabric and other on-prem and cloud native platforms
  • Expertise in building secure and scalable data ingestion, ETL/ELT solutions using various server-based and serverless tools
  • Experience with data warehouse data structure and dimensional modeling and key definition with tools such as ERWIN or others
  • Experience with data structures and models for a microservices environment, data lake and cloud lake houses and supporting downstream applications based on various modeling tools and platforms
  • Hands on experience in leading large-scale enterprise data warehousing (EDW) projects
  • Strong SQL skills
  • Product development mindset and expertise in CI/CD pipeline
  • Experience with big data platforms, SQL & no SQL databases

Leadership & Communication:

  • Collaborative influence, intellectual humility, and enterprise-first decision making; demonstrate intellectual curiosity and humility, balancing conviction with flexibility by considering alternative viewpoints and championing solutions that best serve organizational goals, regardless of origin
  • Experience with prioritization of projects that mitigate trade-offs
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Experience driving architectural direction across multiple teams and organizations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric and modern lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience building AI-enabled analytics platforms, AI agents, or generative AI solutions.
  • Experience leading large-scale cloud and analytics transformation programs. Cloud architecture certifications (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
  • Insurance or other highly regulated industry experience.
  • Working within a scaled agile program and collaborating with product managers in creating and managing technical backlog of stories and epics
  • Experience in cloud based services such as: S3, IAM, SNS/SQS

Analytics Architecture, Cloud Data Architecture, Data Lake, Data Lakehouse Architecture, Data Strategies, Enterprise Architecture (EA), Enterprise Data Architecture

Job.JobTitle: Large Loss Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Detroit, MI
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Large Loss Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Large Loss Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.


You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Qualifications:

  • 4 years previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.
  • Experience handling claims with multiple trades and over $100,000 in losses.
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

As a Strategic Business Architect Expert, you will be the bridge between enterprise business needs and HR delivery, providing deep expertise to translate complex strategic priorities into integrated, scalable people processes, capabilities, and experiences that drive meaningful business impact. You will lead complex business architecture and end-to-end transformation efforts, establish architecture standards and future-state roadmaps, and guide critical design decisions to ensure HR capabilities evolve to meet the demands of a dynamic, AI-enabled, global protection provider.

This is more than process improvement; it is about shaping enterprise HR architecture and accelerating transformation by aligning HR programs, policies, technology, and experiences directly with what the business needs to thrive. We seek individuals who are compelling storytellers, trusted advisors, collaborative problem-solvers, and execution-driven professionals with deep Workday HCM and business architecture expertise. This role will support HR Service Delivery, Risk/Compliance, and Payroll, while partnering with colleagues across a globally distributed team, including India and Northern Ireland.

Key Responsibilities

  • Influence and advise senior HR and technology stakeholders, productively challenging current mindsets and guiding complex architecture and solution decisions to deliver better outcomes for the business and our people.
  • Lead complex, end-to-end HR process and employee experience discovery and redesign across multiple capabilities, including strategy blueprinting, capability mapping, root cause analysis, and removal of systemic blockers, inefficiencies, and waste.
  • Independently translate enterprise HR priorities into integrated as-is and to-be process models, business architecture blueprints, future-state operating models, capability roadmaps, and scalable solutions.
  • Apply deep Workday HCM functional and configuration expertise to evaluate business requirements against delivered capabilities, determining when to leverage existing functionality, redesign processes, or pursue alternative solutions while minimizing unnecessary customization and complexity.
  • Collaborate with HR Technology and Service Delivery teams to architect solutions that improve operational efficiency through streamlining, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities, while considering impacts to integrations, security, reporting, data, and downstream systems.
  • Shape the ongoing evolution of the global HR Service Delivery model, identifying and resolving complex process and capability gaps that span HR functions, technologies, and geographic regions.
  • Establish and promote business architecture methodologies, design standards, and governance practices that drive consistency, scalability, and effective decision-making across HR initiatives.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and escalation resource for complex business architecture challenges, advising leaders on solution alternatives, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs while providing guidance and mentorship to less experienced architects.
  • Drive measurable business outcomes by balancing global operating models with local business and employee needs and ensuring solutions improve effectiveness, efficiency, employee experience, and long-term HR capability maturity.

Required Experience

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in HR, HR technology, business architecture, enterprise transformation, or related disciplines.
  • 5+ years of substantial hands-on Workday HCM experience, with demonstrated depth in core business processes, configuration concepts, system capabilities, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, enterprise-scale HR transformation and business architecture initiatives involving multiple functions, systems, and stakeholders.
  • Advanced Workday HCM expertise, including strong knowledge of Core HCM and demonstrated expertise in one or more additional functional areas such as Payroll or Time Tracking, with the ability to evaluate how process and configuration decisions affect adjacent Workday capabilities.
  • Proven ability to independently architect end-to-end business processes and future-state operating models, translating complex or ambiguous business needs into actionable architecture blueprints and scalable solutions.
  • Experience partnering across HR Business Partners, Centers of Excellence, HR Technology, and Service Delivery to translate enterprise priorities into integrated process and technology solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating solution alternatives and advising senior leaders on business impacts, technical constraints, dependencies, risks, and architectural tradeoffs.
  • Experience establishing or applying business architecture principles, process standards, and governance frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership, communicate complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences, and drive alignment across competing priorities without direct authority.
  • Proven experience mentoring colleagues and providing expert-level guidance within complex, globally distributed and cross-functional environments.

Preferred Experience

  • Participation in multiple Workday implementations, large-scale optimizations, and/or enterprise-wide HR transformation programs.
  • Working knowledge of Workday integrations, security, reporting, and downstream system dependencies.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks and business architecture methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence enterprise technology strategy and solution design within a complex global HR ecosystem.
  • Practical application of automation, process simplification, and/or AI-enabled solutions to HR service delivery and employee experiences.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

About Law & Regulations
The Law & Regulations organization provides strategic legal and compliance services that protect the company and its customers while ensuring adherence to evolving legal, regulatory, privacy, and ethical standards. The team supports critical business functions including Claims Litigation, Legal Operations, Matter Management, Document Management, Regulatory Compliance, and Legal Technology Solutions.
________________________________________
Position Summary
We are seeking an accomplished and highly motivated Software Engineer (Full Stack Developer) to join the Law & Regulations Technology team. This position is responsible for the design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support of enterprise applications that enable legal operations, matter and document management, compliance initiatives, and business process automation.
The successful candidate will demonstrate strong full stack development expertise and hands-on proficiency in React, Java, Spring Boot, microservices, cloud technologies, APIs, and event-driven architectures. This individual will collaborate with cross-functional partners across Legal, Compliance, Product Management, Architecture, Data Engineering, and other business functions to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative technology solutions.
This role provides an opportunity to contribute to the modernization of enterprise legal technology while working with contemporary cloud-native platforms and engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

Full Stack Application Development

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain enterprise-grade applications across the technology stack.
  • Build modern, responsive, and scalable web applications using React and modern UI frameworks.
  • Develop secure, high-performing backend services and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code following software engineering best practices.
  • Participate in application modernization and cloud transformation initiatives.

Legal Technology and Matter Management Solutions

  • Develop and support Matter Management, Legal Operations, and Document Management solutions.
  • Build integrations between legal platforms, claims systems, document repositories, and enterprise applications.
  • Implement workflow-driven solutions supporting legal intake, matter lifecycle management, document processing, and regulatory compliance.
  • Support litigation, claims management, legal reporting, and operational processes through technology solutions.

Backend and API Development

  • Design and develop cloud-native microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful architectures.
  • Build scalable APIs and enterprise integrations supporting business-critical applications.
  • Develop event-driven solutions utilizing technologies such as Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent messaging platforms.
  • Implement authentication, authorization, and security controls aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Optimize application performance, reliability, scalability, and availability.

Frontend Development

  • Develop responsive user interfaces using React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and microservices.
  • Create reusable UI components and implement modern design patterns.
  • Improve usability, accessibility, and overall user experience.

Database and Data Management

  • Design and support solutions utilizing MongoDB, SQL Server, Oracle, and document-based databases.
  • Develop and maintain relational and NoSQL data models.
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, performance, and scalability across applications.

Cloud and DevOps

  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline development and deployment automation.
  • Support cloud-native application deployment and operations.
  • Work with containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Participate in Azure and AWS cloud environments.
  • Support monitoring, alerting, logging, observability, and incident management activities.
  • Perform production support, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.

Agile Delivery and Collaboration

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate closely with Legal, Compliance, Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, and Engineering teams.
  • Translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support testing, releases, upgrades, and post-production activities.
  • Contribute to peer code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 3-5 years of professional experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer.
  • Strong experience with:
  • undefined
  • Experience designing and developing enterprise applications and integrations.
  • Experience with distributed messaging platforms such as Kafka or Azure Service Bus.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native application development principles.
  • Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DocumentDB).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices, authentication, authorization, and application security.

Cloud and Platform Experience

  • Experience developing and deploying applications in Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
  • Experience building and supporting cloud-native, containerized applications.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jenkins, and similar automation platforms.
  • Experience supporting production environments through monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational excellence practices.

Preferred Domain Experience

  • Experience with Matter Management, Legal Operations, Case Management, Claims Systems, or Document Management platforms.

Job.JobTitle: Bodily Injury Adjuster - Represented, Complex/Severe - Remote
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Represented Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job.

As a Represented Adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury on complex/severe claims. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

Qualifications:


  • 3+years of Casualty Represented complex/severe claim handling experience.
  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.
  • The individual selected for this role will join a team who primarily handles claims in the following states: Ohio, Michigan, Indiana.
  • Candidates in the Central and Eastern time zones preferred.

Training:


The first approximately [six-nine weeks] of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.


Youll wear a few hats to fill a few roles throughout your day that all require a level of experience:


  • The Customer Service Expertyoull live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in eachcasualtyclaim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate casualty (and applicable LOB (line of business)) claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solveryoull utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:


  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign-On Bonus Information:


  • Candidates with the active license(s) required for this role may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign-On Bonus.
  • Eligible licenses may include a Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.
  • Current employees and candidates previously employed by Allstate or its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Allstate Benefits:


Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visitwww.allstategoodlife.comto learn more.

This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii, Washington, or Puerto Rico residents.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $68,500 to $104,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Naperville, IL

About this job

Field Property Adjuster investigates and adjusts homeowner insurance claims in Illinois suburbs, determining coverage and damages for water, roof, and interior losses. Role handles complex, high-value claims and requires strong estimating skills and property claims expertise.

Good fit if you have property claims experience, strong estimating fundamentals, and an active insurance license or appraiser certification.

Full job description

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

The Outside Property Consultant investigates and confirms the facts of loss for advanced homeowner claims. The role determines coverage, damages and otherwise adjusts and negotiates claims within limit of authority. The position creates or audits a comprehensive estimate of damages for first party homeowner claims leading to the proper disposition.

We are seeking an experienced Property Field Adjuster to support the Illinois suburbs, primarily covering Kane and Cook Counties, with coverage extending into DuPage County as needed. This team supports our premier clients and is looking for a seasoned professional who brings strong communication, customer service, and property claims expertise. In this role, you will handle a variety of property claims, including water-related losses, roof claims, and interior losses, many of which may be high-value and complex in nature.

Key Responsibilities

  • Possesses a deep understanding of the content of all policy types written by the company
  • Possesses strong estimating fundamentals in order to create or audit estimates of damages on first party homeowner losses with complexity
  • Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers across multiple lines
  • Evaluates settlement alternatives by reviewing regulatory compliance and fair claims practices and makes decisions on best option
  • Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files across multiple lines

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.


Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.


*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.*





As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Compensation

Base compensation offered for this role is:

Outside Property Adjuster Sr Cons I: $68,500- $104,100
Outside Property Adjuster Sr Cons II: $70,100 - $110,400

Job.JobDescription:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$136,100.00 - $224,500.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Responsible for the management, development and execution of sales strategies for a high-performing, complex territory. With Enterprise leaders, creates, and drives a sales strategy that consistently provides a competitive edge in the marketplace. Builds and leverages sales capabilities through effective tactical and strategic deployment of Sales resources and executing world class disciplines and skills.

What Will You Do?

  • Influence and drive National Distribution sales strategies and develop annual business development strategies for assigned territory. Territory is typically complex or challenging.
  • Partner with National Distribution agents and partners to develop annual and three-year sales plans with defined goals and objectives that support segment-specific strategies.
  • Manage key producer relationships within National Distribution, ensuring distribution channel alignment with business needs and effective development and administration of compensation programs.
  • Proactively manage and tailor measures of point-of-sale success, sales plan effectiveness, and customer satisfaction.
  • Direct and coordinate implementation of regional and national strategies and tactics with Enterprise partners as well as, regional leaders, sales directors and/or sales executives.
  • Manage key strategic distribution relationships with national brokers, regional brokers, and other significant cross-enterprise distribution resources.
  • Use business development and management processes that deliver critical strategic initiatives, high quality plans and prospects to the business and are focused on profit and growth.
  • Align with product, underwriting and integration management, as well as other business units, to successfully execute underwriting, technology and experience efforts and ensure delivery of broader vision and strategies.
  • Share field trends and competitive practices with peers, product manager and leaders to promote organization learning and opportunities.
  • Maintain knowledge of internal products, competitor products and capabilities and general market trends.
  • Cultivate new partnerships and opportunities that align with growth strategies including book consolidations, programs, and integrations.
  • Mentor internal and external partners leveraging experiences in managing complex relationships and thought leadership on relevant topics and in support of evolving marketplace.
  • Actively participate, lead and manage special projects and workstreams that support National Distribution strategies and work efforts.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Ten or more years of professional sales experience with complex and/or high-performing agents and/or brokers.
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities.
  • Excellent technical sales and marketing skills with the ability to coach others on these skills.
  • Superior knowledge of selling through intermediaries and distributors.
  • Strong business acumen and knowledge of P&C industry.
  • C.I.C. Preferred

What is a Must Have?

  • Seven or more years of insurance, marketing, or sales experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.
