Job.CustomJobTypeName: Talent Acquisition Specialist, Human Resources & Training
Job.JobDescription:
Serve as a player-coach responsible for leading the organization's talent acquisition function while actively managing key recruiting initiatives and strategic searches. Develop and execute a forward-looking talent acquisition strategy that enables the organization to attract, engage, and hire top talent in a rapidly evolving workforce landscape. Lead recruiting operations, develop team capabilities, drive recruiting innovation, and implement enablement strategies that improve recruiter effectiveness, hiring manager engagement, candidate experience, and hiring outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines strong recruiting leadership with expertise in talent acquisition enablement, process optimization, workforce insights, recruiting technology, and change leadership. This individual will serve as a strategic partner to business leaders and help position Talent Acquisition as a critical driver of organizational growth and long-term workforce success.

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Talent Acquisition Strategy

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive talent acquisition strategy aligned with organizational goals and workforce needs.
  • Partner with business leaders and Human Resources to anticipate future talent requirements and develop proactive hiring strategies.
  • Translate workforce trends, labor market intelligence, and business priorities into actionable recruiting plans.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen talent pipelines for critical and emerging roles.

Recruiting Enablement & Innovation

  • Lead recruiting enablement efforts by optimizing processes, tools, resources, and recruiter capabilities.
  • Evaluate and implement modern recruiting technologies, automation solutions, sourcing tools, and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Develop recruiting playbooks, sourcing methodologies, interviewing frameworks, and hiring manager resources.
  • Drive adoption and utilization of recruiting technology and best practices across the organization.
  • Continuously assess and improve the effectiveness of the recruiting function through innovation and process improvement.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop Talent Acquisition team members.
  • Establish performance expectations and support individual professional growth.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, partnership, customer service, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Provide ongoing coaching related to sourcing strategies, stakeholder management, candidate engagement, and consultative recruiting.

Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Personally manage a portfolio of critical, complex, leadership, or hard-to-fill positions.
  • Execute full-cycle recruitment activities including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer development, and closing.
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future workforce needs.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to hiring leaders throughout the recruitment process.

Hiring Manager Partnership

  • Develop strong relationships with leaders across the organization.
  • Consult with hiring managers on market conditions, recruiting strategies, talent availability, and selection practices.
  • Improve hiring manager capability through training, tools, and best-practice guidance.
  • Promote consistent and effective interviewing and candidate evaluation practices.

Talent Analytics & Workforce Insights

  • Establish and monitor recruiting metrics that measure effectiveness and business impact.
  • Utilize data to identify trends, improve decision-making, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Provide reporting and insights related to talent acquisition performance, market conditions, and workforce needs.

Candidate Experience & Employer Brand

  • Champion a candidate-centric recruiting experience.
  • Support initiatives that strengthen the organization's employer brand and talent value proposition.
  • Ensure high-quality candidate communications and engagement throughout the hiring process.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of of progressive talent acquisition experience.
  • 3+ years of leadership experience within recruiting or talent acquisition.
  • Demonstrated success leading full-cycle recruiting efforts across a variety of functional areas and levels.
  • Experience developing recruiting strategies and implementing process improvements.
  • Experience utilizing applicant tracking systems, sourcing technologies, recruitment marketing platforms, and recruiting analytics.
  • Strong business acumen, communication skills, and consultative leadership capabilities.

 

Preferred

  • Insurance or financial services industry experience.
  • Experience leading recruiting transformation, enablement, or technology initiatives.
  • Experience implementing AI-enabled recruiting tools, automation solutions, talent CRM platforms, or candidate engagement technologies.
  • Professional HR certification (SHRM, HRCI, or equivalent).

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Professional hybrid office environment.

Job.JobTitle: Product Owner III, Insurance Investment Accounting, Liberty Mutual Investments
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Accountant, Accounting / Finance, Insurance Product Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Description

The Company:

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is the investment firm for Liberty Mutual Group (Liberty) and is responsible for powering Libertys strategy amid profound change in global capital markets. With deep expertise in fixed income, equity, and alternative strategies, LMI invests $120+ billion (as of 12/31/2025) of capital globally,taking a long-term approach across its integrated platform and has a team of over 350 investment, finance, and operations professionals located in Boston, MA, and New York, NY.

LMI has a clear purpose: build enduring businesses side-by-side with our partners, drive economic growth, and generate superior risk-adjusted returns that power Libertys strategy and secure its promises. We offer the best of both worlds the look and feel of a boutique investment firm with the reputation and financial strength of a global leader. As the investment firm of a mutual with long-term capital, LMI has a single client mandate. This gives us the freedom to focus on what we do best.

Our portfolio spans a broad spectrum of public and private investments, and we are committed to expanding our capabilities and our toolkit in support of our mission. We invest across diverse asset classes, financial structures, and industries, including real estate, digital infrastructure, healthcare, renewable energy, and technologywith the aim of creating value and powering innovation. We pride ourselves on our extensive network of mutually beneficial partnerships, and we use our substantial influence, capital, and energy to drive towards a better future. #LMI #LI-LMI

The Position:

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is seeking aProduct Owner III to support its Accounting Product, with responsibility for investment accounting and regulatory and financial reporting capabilities across multiple reporting frameworks, including statutory (National Association of Insurance Commissioners, NAIC), GAAP, and TAX. The role will focus on enhancing and maintaining accounting and reporting capabilities within LMI's investment accounting platform, SimCorp Dimension, and its related data and reporting processes, with an emphasis on the end-to-end processes and upstream data that produce reported figures, including quarterly and annual statutory investment schedules. This position reports to the Accounting Portfolio Product Owner within Financial Products and Global Investment Solutions (GIS).

Operating at the intersection of Investment Accounting, Finance, Technology, Data, Investment Product, and the platform vendor, the Product Owner will translate business, accounting, and regulatory requirements into actionable product priorities and drive the delivery of technology solutions that enable accurate, timely, and reliable financial and regulatory reporting. The role will own the Accounting Product backlog and proactively partner with Agile delivery teams, other Product Owners, and SimCorp Dimension's Regulatory Center of Excellence (REGCOE) to deliver solutions aligned with business priorities and regulatory commitments.

This role requires strong business acumen, technical fluency, sound judgment, and a proactive approach: anticipating regulatory and accounting changes, setting and communicating timelines, and aligning dependencies early. The Product Owner will collaborate with business partners and senior leadership to strengthen data quality and controls, improve reporting processes, reduce operational risk, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

The Responsibilities:

Product Strategy, Prioritization & Delivery

  • Partner with the Accounting Portfolio Product Owner and stakeholders to shape and execute the Accounting Product roadmap across reporting frameworks (statutory/NAIC, GAAP, and TAX), ensuring alignment with broader product strategy and regulatory requirements.
  • Own and prioritize the Accounting Product backlog, balancing business value, regulatory deadlines, strategic enhancements, technical improvements, and production support, and serve as the point of coordination for all accounting- and reporting-related changes across product backlogs.
  • Translate business, accounting, and regulatory requirements into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Proactively collaborate with other Product Owners, SimCorp Dimension's REGCOE, and technology and data teams to anticipate dependencies, remove impediments before they affect delivery, and drive outcomes.
  • Set clear deadlines and handoff dates for each deliverable and maintain visibility of partner teams' commitments and deadlines so that dependencies, sequencing, and critical-path risks are managed in advance.
  • Lead Agile delivery activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, and coordination of development, testing, business validation, and production implementation.
  • Evaluate business value, feasibility, and regulatory risk to make informed prioritization decisions and ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.

Regulatory & Accounting Change Management

  • Proactively monitor regulatory, statutory accounting, and reporting framework changes (e.g., NAIC updates), as well as SimCorp REGCOE releases and roadmap items, and assess their impact on systems, data flows, and downstream processes ahead of effective dates.
  • Translate upcoming changes into backlog items with defined timelines, owners, and testing and validation plans, and communicate impacts, priorities, and risks to stakeholders and senior leadership early.
  • Assess the impact of new investment types and reporting requirements across statutory, GAAP, and TAX bases, including basis differences (such as the statutory-to-GAAP "stat gap") and their effect on reporting content and downstream processes.
  • Apply working knowledge of investment accounting, investment operations, and the upstream data that feeds reporting (trade capture and settlement, security master and reference data, pricing and valuation sources, custodian and counterparty data, and corporate actions) to evaluate how upstream changes affect reporting accuracy and timing.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Internal (LMI): Partner with Investment Reporting, Operations, Investment Product, Data Product, Technology and other Financial Product teams to deliver accurate, complete, and timely financial and regulatory reporting.
  • Liberty Mutual Group (LMG): Coordinate with LMG Corporate Accounting, Finance, TAX, and other group functions that depend on LMI's accounting and reporting outputs, aligning on requirements, calendars, and priorities.
  • Vendors: Work with SimCorp, implementation partners, and other platform and data vendors to manage releases, defects, enhancements, and delivery commitments.
  • Regulators and external parties: Support engagement with regulators, auditors, and advisors as needed, and ensure reporting changes and regulatory requirements are understood and addressed ahead of deadlines.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Accounting Product stakeholders, building strong relationships, facilitating decisions, and communicating priorities, progress, and risks to stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Proactively identify and resolve reporting issues, data quality concerns, and cross-team dependencies, escalating risks as appropriate to protect critical reporting timelines.

Data Quality, Risk & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with Data Product and Investment Product, alongside Accounting, Finance, and Technology stakeholders, to define data requirements, ownership, and quality standards for the data that feeds accounting and reporting.
  • Strengthen data integrity, reporting accuracy, and regulatory compliance through effective data validation, reconciliation, and operational controls, identifying and addressing data quality gaps at the source.
  • Drive process improvements and leverage automation, including AI-enabled capabilities, to reduce manual effort, improve reporting efficiency, and mitigate operational risk.
  • Balance delivery of new capabilities with platform stability, ongoing production support, and evolving regulatory and data governance requirements.
  • Define and monitor product-level KPIs to measure reporting timeliness, data quality, operational efficiency, and delivery outcomes.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in business, technology, financial services, or consulting, including 5+ years working with Agile teams in a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role.
  • Working knowledge of investment accounting and financial and regulatory reporting frameworks, including statutory accounting principles (SAP) and NAIC investment reporting, GAAP, and TAX, including basis differences between them.
  • Demonstrated experience managing product backlogs, translating complex business and technical requirements into actionable user stories, and delivering technology or data-driven solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to evaluate business processes, data dependencies, risks, and competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams, external partners, and senior stakeholders
  • Proven ability to proactively plan and independently drive complex initiatives from requirements through implementation, set and meet deadlines, manage dependencies, and deliver business value in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Demonstratesstrong AI literacy and uses AI-enabled tools to enhance speed, accuracy, and insight generation whilemaintainingsound judgment and compliance with governance standards

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in insurance or asset management, with familiarity with investment instruments and accounting processes.
  • Experience with SimCorp Dimension or comparable investment accounting platforms such as Blackrock Aladdin, Eagle STAR, State Street Alpha, Charles River, Princeton Financial System, Clearwater, FIS, SS&C Advent Geneva
  • Data management and regulatory reporting capabilities, and multi-basis (statutory, GAAP, and TAX) accounting.
  • Experience working with data and investment product teams on data quality, reference data, and data governance.
  • Familiarity with Agile tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence), reporting automation, and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

Fair Chance Notices

  • California
  • Los Angeles Incorporated
  • Los Angeles Unincorporated
  • Philadelphia
  • San Francisco

About this job

Staff Attorney role at Liberty Mutual managing moderately complex civil litigation matters involving personal injury and property damage claims up to approximately $50,000 exposure. Position is primarily remote in California with required in-person appearances, and includes responsibilities for case strategy, settlement negotiations, mentoring junior attorneys, and legal compliance.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of trial experience, California bar admission, insurance law background, and proficiency with e-discovery tools and case management software.

Full job description


Description

This role is primarily remote in the state of California except for required appearances.

In addition to the base salary, an incentive bonus is a part of the compensation package and will be discussed during the interview process.

At Liberty Mutual, were committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders rights and positively impacting our business. As an Attorney at Liberty Mutual, youll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligible performance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If youre looking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where youll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual is seeking a skilled and proactive Attorney to independently manage moderately complex civil litigation matters. This role requires a deep understanding of legal principles and insurance law, strategic case management, advanced technology utilization, and strong clientrelationship skills. The Attorney will develop and execute sophisticated legal strategies, lead settlement negotiations, mentor junior attorneys, and contribute to organizational improvements while maintaining the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Management and Execution: Independently manage all phases of litigation involving claims of moderate to heavy value (up to approximately $50,000 exposure). Conduct comprehensive legal research, draft precise pleadings, motions, and other legal documents. Lead settlement negotiations and participate in hearings, trials, and mediations to achieve optimal case outcomes.
  • Litigation Support: Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Legal Strategy Development: Develop, implement, and continuously refine advanced legal strategies for discovery, investigation, and trial preparation.

Description

Are you looking for an opportunity to join a claims team with a fast growing company that has consistently outpaced the industry in year over year growth? Liberty Mutual has an excellent claims opportunity available. As a Commercial Insurance Claims Representative, you will review and process simple and straightforward Commercial claims within assigned authority limits consistent with policy and legal requirements. In addition to a wide range of benefits, as a direct employee, your insurance education and training are paid by Liberty Mutual.

Responsibilities:

  • Investigates claim using internal and external resources including speaking with the insured or other involved parties, analysis of reports, researching past claim activity, utilizing evaluation tools to make damage and loss assessments.
  • Extensive and timely direct interaction with Insured's, Claimants, Agent's and Internal Customers.
  • Determines policy coverage through analysis of investigation data and policy terms. Notifies agent and insured of coverage or any issues.
  • Establishes claim reserve requirements and makes adjustments, as necessary, during the processing of the claims.
  • Determines and negotiates settlement amount for damages claimed within assigned authority limits.
  • Writes simple to moderately complex property damage estimates or review auto damage estimates.
  • Takes statements when necessary and works with the Field Appraisal, Subrogation, Special Investigative Unit (SIU) as appropriate.
  • Maintains accurate and current claim file/damage documentation and diaries throughout the life cycle of claim cases to ensure proper tracking and handling consistent with established guidelines and expectations.
  • Alerts Unit Leader to the possibility of fraud or subrogation potential for claims being processed.
Qualifications
  • Bachelors Degree preferred. High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • 1-2 years of experience. Claims handling skills preferred.
  • Strong customer service and technology skills.
  • Able to navigate multiple systems, strong organizational and communication skills.
  • License may be required in multiple states by state law.

Are you looking for an opportunity to join a claims team with a fast growing company that has consistently outpaced the industry in year over year growth? Liberty Mutual has an excellent claims opportunity available. As a Commercial Insurance Claims Representative, you will review and process simple and straightforward Commercial claims within assigned authority limits consistent with policy and legal requirements. In addition to a wide range of benefits, as a direct employee, your insurance education and training are paid by Liberty Mutual.

Responsibilities:

  • Investigates claim using internal and external resources including speaking with the insured or other involved parties, analysis of reports, researching past claim activity, utilizing evaluation tools to make damage and loss assessments.
  • Extensive and timely direct interaction with Insured's, Claimants, Agent's and Internal Customers.
  • Determines policy coverage through analysis of investigation data and policy terms. Notifies agent and insured of coverage or any issues.

  • Determines and negotiates settlement amount for damages claimed within assigned authority limits.
  • Writes simple to moderately complex property damage estimates or review auto damage estimates.
  • Takes statements when necessary and works with the Field Appraisal, Subrogation, Special Investigative Unit (SIU) as appropriate.
  • Maintains accurate and current claim file/damage documentation and diaries throughout the life cycle of claim cases to ensure proper tracking and handling consistent with established guidelines and expectations.
  • Alerts Unit Leader to the possibility of fraud or subrogation potential for claims being processed.
Qualifications
  • Bachelors Degree preferred. High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • 1-2 years of experience. Claims handling skills preferred.
  • Strong customer service and technology skills.

Job.JobTitle: Product Owner II, Insurance Investment Accounting, Liberty Mutual Investments
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Accountant, Accounting / Finance, Insurance Product Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Boston, MA
  • Experience: 5+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Product Owner II supporting investment accounting and financial reporting across multiple frameworks (statutory, GAAP, TAX) for Liberty Mutual Investments. Role focuses on managing the SimCorp Dimension accounting platform backlog, translating regulatory and business requirements into product priorities, and coordinating delivery across technology, data, and accounting teams.

Good fit if you have investment accounting knowledge, experience managing product backlogs in regulated environments, and can translate complex regulatory requirements into technical priorities.

Full job description


Description

The Company:

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is the investment firm for Liberty Mutual Group (Liberty) and is responsible for powering Libertys strategy amid profound change in global capital markets. With deep expertise in fixed income, equity, and alternative strategies, LMI invests $120+ billion (as of 12/31/2025) of capital globally,taking a long-term approach across its integrated platform and has a team of over 350 investment, finance, and operations professionals located in Boston, MA, and New York, NY.

LMI has a clear purpose: build enduring businesses side-by-side with our partners, drive economic growth, and generate superior risk-adjusted returns that power Libertys strategy and secure its promises. We offer the best of both worlds the look and feel of a boutique investment firm with the reputation and financial strength of a global leader. As the investment firm of a mutual with long-term capital, LMI has a single client mandate. This gives us the freedom to focus on what we do best.

Our portfolio spans a broad spectrum of public and private investments, and we are committed to expanding our capabilities and our toolkit in support of our mission. We invest across diverse asset classes, financial structures, and industries, including real estate, digital infrastructure, healthcare, renewable energy, and technologywith the aim of creating value and powering innovation. We pride ourselves on our extensive network of mutually beneficial partnerships, and we use our substantial influence, capital, and energy to drive towards a better future. #LMI #LI-LMI

The Position:

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is seeking aProduct Owner II to support its Accounting Product, with responsibility for investment accounting and regulatory and financial reporting capabilities across multiple reporting frameworks, including statutory (National Association of Insurance Commissioners, NAIC), GAAP, and TAX. The role will focus on enhancing and maintaining accounting and reporting capabilities within LMI's investment accounting platform, SimCorp Dimension, and its related data and reporting processes, with an emphasis on the end-to-end processes and upstream data that produce reported figures, including quarterly and annual statutory investment schedules. This position reports to the Accounting Portfolio Product Owner within Financial Products and Global Investment Solutions (GIS).

Operating at the intersection of Investment Accounting, Finance, Technology, Data, Investment Product, and the platform vendor, the Product Owner will translate business, accounting, and regulatory requirements into actionable product priorities and drive the delivery of technology solutions that enable accurate, timely, and reliable financial and regulatory reporting. The role will own the Accounting Product backlog and proactively partner with Agile delivery teams, other Product Owners, and SimCorp Dimension's Regulatory Center of Excellence (REGCOE) to deliver solutions aligned with business priorities and regulatory commitments.

This role requires strong business acumen, technical fluency, sound judgment, and a proactive approach: anticipating regulatory and accounting changes, setting and communicating timelines, and aligning dependencies early. The Product Owner will collaborate with business partners and senior leadership to strengthen data quality and controls, improve reporting processes, reduce operational risk, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

The Responsibilities:

Product Strategy, Prioritization & Delivery

  • Partner with the Accounting Portfolio Product Owner and stakeholders to shape and execute the Accounting Product roadmap across reporting frameworks (statutory/NAIC, GAAP, and TAX), ensuring alignment with broader product strategy and regulatory requirements.
  • Own and prioritize the Accounting Product backlog, balancing business value, regulatory deadlines, strategic enhancements, technical improvements, and production support, and serve as the point of coordination for all accounting- and reporting-related changes across product backlogs.
  • Translate business, accounting, and regulatory requirements into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Proactively collaborate with other Product Owners, SimCorp Dimension's REGCOE, and technology and data teams to anticipate dependencies, remove impediments before they affect delivery, and drive outcomes.
  • Set clear deadlines and handoff dates for each deliverable and maintain visibility of partner teams' commitments and deadlines so that dependencies, sequencing, and critical-path risks are managed in advance.
  • Lead Agile delivery activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, and coordination of development, testing, business validation, and production implementation.
  • Evaluate business value, feasibility, and regulatory risk to make informed prioritization decisions and ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.

Regulatory & Accounting Change Management

  • Proactively monitor regulatory, statutory accounting, and reporting framework changes (e.g., NAIC updates), as well as SimCorp REGCOE releases and roadmap items, and assess their impact on systems, data flows, and downstream processes ahead of effective dates.
  • Translate upcoming changes into backlog items with defined timelines, owners, and testing and validation plans, and communicate impacts, priorities, and risks to stakeholders and senior leadership early.
  • Assess the impact of new investment types and reporting requirements across statutory, GAAP, and TAX bases, including basis differences (such as the statutory-to-GAAP "stat gap") and their effect on reporting content and downstream processes.
  • Apply working knowledge of investment accounting, investment operations, and the upstream data that feeds reporting (trade capture and settlement, security master and reference data, pricing and valuation sources, custodian and counterparty data, and corporate actions) to evaluate how upstream changes affect reporting accuracy and timing.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Internal (LMI): Partner with Investment Reporting, Operations, Investment Product, Data Product, Technology and other Financial Product teams to deliver accurate, complete, and timely financial and regulatory reporting.
  • Liberty Mutual Group (LMG): Coordinate with LMG Corporate Accounting, Finance, TAX, and other group functions that depend on LMI's accounting and reporting outputs, aligning on requirements, calendars, and priorities.
  • Vendors: Work with SimCorp, implementation partners, and other platform and data vendors to manage releases, defects, enhancements, and delivery commitments.
  • Regulators and external parties: Support engagement with regulators, auditors, and advisors as needed, and ensure reporting changes and regulatory requirements are understood and addressed ahead of deadlines.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Accounting Product stakeholders, building strong relationships, facilitating decisions, and communicating priorities, progress, and risks to stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Proactively identify and resolve reporting issues, data quality concerns, and cross-team dependencies, escalating risks as appropriate to protect critical reporting timelines.

Data Quality, Risk & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with Data Product and Investment Product, alongside Accounting, Finance, and Technology stakeholders, to define data requirements, ownership, and quality standards for the data that feeds accounting and reporting.
  • Strengthen data integrity, reporting accuracy, and regulatory compliance through effective data validation, reconciliation, and operational controls, identifying and addressing data quality gaps at the source.
  • Drive process improvements and leverage automation, including AI-enabled capabilities, to reduce manual effort, improve reporting efficiency, and mitigate operational risk.
  • Balance delivery of new capabilities with platform stability, ongoing production support, and evolving regulatory and data governance requirements.
  • Define and monitor product-level KPIs to measure reporting timeliness, data quality, operational efficiency, and delivery outcomes.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in business, technology, financial services, or consulting, including 3+ years working with Agile teams in a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role.
  • Working knowledge of investment accounting and financial and regulatory reporting frameworks, including statutory accounting principles (SAP) and NAIC investment reporting, GAAP, and TAX, including basis differences between them.
  • Demonstrated experience managing product backlogs, translating complex business and technical requirements into actionable user stories, and delivering technology or data-driven solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to evaluate business processes, data dependencies, risks, and competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams, external partners, and senior stakeholders
  • Proven ability to proactively plan and independently drive complex initiatives from requirements through implementation, set and meet deadlines, manage dependencies, and deliver business value in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Demonstratesstrong AI literacy and uses AI-enabled tools to enhance speed, accuracy, and insight generation whilemaintainingsound judgment and compliance with governance standards

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in insurance or asset management, with familiarity with investment instruments and accounting processes.
  • Experience with SimCorp Dimension or comparable investment accounting platforms such as Blackrock Aladdin, Eagle STAR, State Street Alpha, Charles River, Princeton Financial System, Clearwater, FIS, SS&C Advent Geneva
  • Data management and regulatory reporting capabilities, and multi-basis (statutory, GAAP, and TAX) accounting.
  • Experience working with data and investment product teams on data quality, reference data, and data governance.
  • Familiarity with Agile tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence), reporting automation, and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

About this job

Manager overseeing risk assessment and controls for Global Risk Solutions, which operates in 20+ countries. Role combines analytical process evaluation with cross-functional stakeholder collaboration, integrating GenAI tools to streamline controls work across underwriting, claims, compliance and finance teams worldwide.

Good fit if you have 7+ years auditing and accounting experience, 5+ in insurance, with CPA or CIA, and prior people leadership experience.

Full job description


Description

Global Risk Solutions writes business in more than 20 countries, and the controls behind that business have to hold up everywhere. This role owns a meaningful piece of how we prove they do and how we keep proving it faster, using the AI tools now built into the way our team works.

This is a role for someone who genuinely likes both halves of controls work: the analytical half, where you dig into a process and find the gap nobody else noticed, and the influencing half, where you bring a business owner along without owning their process or their decision. You'll partner with underwriting, claims, compliance and finance leaders across North America, Latin America, Europe and Asia Pacific and with external program partners, where you'll often be the Liberty Mutual voice in the room.

The opportunity

You'll help lead how GRS assures and strengthens its control environment worldwide driving the resolution of audit findings, elevating the quality of account reconciliations, building attestation programs from the ground up, and leading controls audits of our program partners. Alongside all of it, you'll bring a builder's mindset to how the work itself gets done: using GenAI to take on the mechanical lift so more of your time and your team's goes toward judgment, not formatting.

Where you'll make an impact

  • Audit remediation & assurance
    • Serve as GRS's connective tissue with Global Internal Audit keeping findings, action plans and closure evidence moving toward resolution, and escalating where the risk warrants it.
    • Support the external audit process- Coordinating request, resolving open items with external auditor on a timely basis.
  • Controls & attestation quality
    • Raise the bar on the controls framework across GRS strengthening account reconciliations and attestation coverage across entities and extending that same rigor to every project and initiative the business takes on.
    • Turn documentation, process gaps and structural weaknesses into durable fixes.
  • Program partner oversight
    • Plan and lead controls audits of external program partners, testing what they report against what actually happens and following up until remediation is real.
  • AI-augmented analysis
    • Put GenAI to work on reshaping data, drafting first-pass analysis and getting up to speed on technical findings quickly then build repeatable AI workflows the rest of the team can use too.
  • People leadership
    • Coach and develop team members, including across significant time-zone gaps, building their judgment so they can make sound calls independently.

Built around AI, not bolted on

Liberty Mutual is investing heavily in AI across the enterprise, and GRS Financial Controls is one of the places that shift shows up first. This role sits right at that intersection: you'll use GenAI to compress the time spent on mechanical work reshaping files, comparing narratives across entities, drafting the first version of an observation and apply the time you get back to the calls that actually need a human. You'll also help set the pattern for the rest of the team, turning one-off prompts into repeatable processes others can pick up and trust.

What you'll bring

Preferred Qualifications

  • Property & casualty insurance experience programs, reinsurance or surety a plusCPA, CIA, CPCU or an advanced degree in accounting, finance or business
  • Prior people-leadership experience
Qualifications
  • Master's degree/MBA; CPA
  • Requires 7+ years of auditing and accounting experience, 5+ insurance industry experience
  • Knowledge of financial accounting systems, business processes and reporting tools
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills, Strong negotiation skills, Project management skills

Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and specialty insurance.

We are looking for candidates living in: Newark, DE | Oxford, PA | Avondale, PA | West Grove, PA & Kennett Square, PA.

THIS POSITION HAS IN-OFFICE REQUIREMENTS.

What you'll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.

  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

Essential functions include: meeting with customers in the office and in the community, communicating by phone, email, and in person, traveling locally, and using a computer and sales software.

  • Self-motivated and accountable: you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive: you follow through and do what you say you'll do.

  • Relationship-focused: you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Strong communicator: you're comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Comfortable with technology: you can learn and use new software and digital tools with ease.
  • Composed and dependable: you stay organized and professional while managing multiple customer needs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.

Job.JobDescription:
Put your Insurance Experience to work – FROM HOME!

At WAHVE, we value significant insurance experience and want to revolutionize the way people think about phasing into retirement by offering qualified candidates the opportunity to continue their career working from home. As we say – retire from the office but not from work. Our unique platform provides you with real work/life balance and allows you to choose a full or part-time work schedule while continuing to utilize your insurance expertise in a remote, long-term position which includes company benefits!

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WAHVE

We created a welcoming place to work with friendly and professional leadership. We are known for the great care we take with our staff and our clients. We are passionate and determined about delivering the best customer service, preserving insurance industry knowledge, and making a difference by the work that we do.

WHAT WE ARE SEEKING

We have assignments available to help our insurance carrier or MGU clients in Premium Auditor / Auditor Assistant positions. Responsibilities may include:

  • Conduct audits of insurance policies by evaluating the insured's business operation, including examining, verifying, and recording pertinent classification-related data from financial/business records.
  • Review and summarize submitted information from insureds to determine correct exposures for all classifications. 
  • Review dispute information received from agents or insureds who contest audit results, analyze the submitted information for relevance and appropriate documentation.
  • Communicate with all internal and external customers regarding exposures, classification changes, or general auditing procedure questions pertaining to premium audits.
  • Ensure the process complies with regulatory, statutory, and procedural requirements. Including evaluating system access and management control reports.
  • Proven experience with problem solving, analyzing data, and recommending corrective measures.
  • Currently - HIGH DEMAND for General Liability and/or Workers Compensation premium audit experience.

TO BECOME A WORK-AT-HOME VINTAGE EXPERT, WE REQUIRE

  • 25 years of full-time work experience
  • 10 most current years of premium audit experience with Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance carrier or MGU in an auditor role

BENEFITS OF BECOMING A WAHVE VINTAGE EXPERT

  • Health insurance based on eligibility.
  • 401(k) with a 4% match based on eligibility.
  • Voluntary Dental, Vision, Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D).
  • Retire from the office but not from work.
  • Eliminate the office stress and the commute.
  • Choose the work you would like to do now.
  • Available in either full or part-time schedules.
  • Utilize your years of insurance industry knowledge.
  • Be part of our dynamic yet virtual team environment and connect with other experienced insurance professionals like yourself!

HOW TO GET STARTED

WE LOOK FORWARD TO MEETING YOU!

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Remote
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k)

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $142,900 to $235,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Blue Bell, PA
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off

About this job

Sr. Claim Counsel for Travelers' Construction Services Team, handling claims on construction-related and surety bonds. Responsibilities include investigating and resolving claims, providing legal advice to underwriting and claims colleagues, managing outside counsel, and coordinating recovery efforts.

Good fit if you have legal expertise in surety or construction claims and can work with minimal supervision on complex matters.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$142,900.00 - $235,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Bond & Specialty Insurance (BSI) provides management and professional liability, cyber, crime insurance, and surety bonds to or on behalf of businesses of all sizes. The BSI Claim Counsel team conducts thorough investigation, analysis, evaluation, and disposition of claims and claim litigation to achieve superior customer service and to optimize claim results. INSERT LOB SPECIFIC LANGUAGE. As a valued member of our team, in addition to claim, you also will provide legal advice to our underwriting colleagues and non-attorney claim colleagues, and participate in BSI claim strategic initiatives. LOB Specific Language (REMOVE WHEN POSTING) Commercial Surety: Travelers' Commercial Surety Team handles claims on non-construction surety bonds; mitigates exposures on commercial surety accounts; and provides a wide range of business support and legal services to advance our mission to serve as trusted advisors to our underwriting partners. Construction Services: Travelers' Construction Services Team includes legal, accounting, and engineering professionals to handle claims on construction-related and other surety bonds, mitigate exposures on construction surety accounts, and provide a wide range of business support and legal services to advance our mission to serve as trusted advisors to our underwriting partners. Financial Institutions: Travelers' Financial Institutions Team provides management liability coverage for diversified classes of financial institutions. Private Non-Profit: Travelers' Private/Non-Profit Team provides executive and organizational management liability coverage to privately held companies and non-profit entities of all types and sizes as well as certain governmental public entities. Programs: Travelers' PNP Programs Team provides coverage for Community Associations, Healthcare Institutions and Providers, Managed Care Organizations, Life and Health Underwriters and Public Adjusters. Professional Liability: Travelers' Professional Liability Team offers errors and omissions liability products to various market segments including accountants, design professionals, lawyers, real estate agents, property managers, and miscellaneous professional liability. Public Company Liability: Travelers' Public Company Liability Team provides management liability coverage for publicly traded companies of all types and sizes and private companies with public debt. Recovery Management: Travelers' Recovery Management Team focuses on subrogation, salvage, and loss mitigation on Surety and Management Liability claims. Crime: Travelers' First-Party Claim Team is responsible for handling first-party claims, including Commercial Crime (including Fidelity), Cyber Crime, Kidnap & Ransom, Public Official Bonds, and Identity Fraud/Theft. The First-Party Claim Team partners with and supports business units including Private-Non-Profit, Public Companies, Financial Institutions, Insurance Companies, Investment Advisors, and Professional Liability. Cyber: Travelers' Cyber Claim Team is responsible for handling claims focusing on cyber privacy and security breach incident response, computer crime, infrastructure attacks and restoration, notification to affected parties and regulators, business interruption, consumer privacy liability, and identity fraud/theft. The First-Party Cyber Claim Team partners with and supports business units including Private-Non-Profit, Public Companies, Financial Institutions, Insurance Companies, Investment Advisors, and Professional Liability.

What Will You Do?

  • Follow operational policies to analyze, investigate, and resolve BSI claims of varying levels of severity with limited supervision from claims management.
  • Prepare and present reports for management that accurately reflect loss development, potential/actual financial exposure, reserve adjustments, coverage issues, and claim and recovery strategies.
  • Retain, monitor, and manage outside counsel actively utilizing litigation management plans and budgets.
  • Communicate with underwriting on significant claim exposures.
  • Identify all recovery opportunities and coordinate recovery efforts with the Recovery Management Unit and Claim management.
  • Travel to and attend mediations, settlement conferences, claim conferences, field office visits, trials and depositions.
  • Recovery Management specific:
  • Coordinate recovery efforts with Claim Professionals to identify potential sources of recovery and optimize loss mitigation opportunities.
  • Identify potential sources of recovery, and to analyze, investigate, develop and refine recovery strategies, and resolve claims within authority; retain, manage and direct outside counsel and vendors to optimize outcomes and resolve recovery claims of varying levels of severity.
  • Research, analyze and provide recovery and loss mitigation advice to claim and underwriting colleagues on claims of varying complexity, including drafting/reviewing settlement agreements, releases, assignments, and/or other documents modifying recovery policy provisions or impacting recovery opportunities, and provide transactional support to claim and underwriting colleagues.
  • Management Liability specific:
  • Refine policy interpretation/coverage analysis skills including drafting coverage opinions with case law included.
  • Negotiate settlements/resolutions, review releases and settlement agreements, including confidentiality and non-disclosure provisions.
  • Support underwriting marketing efforts, including participation in broker and account visits and risk mitigation seminars and authoring customer-focused white papers and articles.
  • Monitor marketplace conditions, conduct research, and draft reference materials to inform claim and underwriting colleagues on law impacting Travelers' underwriting and claim decisions.
  • Obtain and maintain required adjusters' licenses.
  • Surety specific:
  • Provide legal review and advice to underwriters on bond obligations and project contract documents. Review, draft and/or modify bond forms, contract documents and other agreements including, indemnity, takeover, completion, subcontractor ratification, financing and collateral.
  • Engage in account workout risk mitigation analysis, advise on mitigation strategies, and assist in execution of such strategies.
  • Monitor account bankruptcy proceedings and document post-bankruptcy indemnity. Draft and file proofs of claim and advise as to potential recovery. Retain outside counsel where appropriate to protect or enforce surety rights.
  • Negotiate the resolution of bonded obligations on defaulted contracts, and terms of agreements including indemnity agreements, letters of credit, set aside letters from lenders, intercreditor agreements and subordination agreements.
  • Determine whether bond exposure has expired, including for the purpose of releasing collateral, by reviewing bond terms, applicable law, and court dockets (when applicable).
  • Monitor marketplace conditions, conduct research, and draft reference materials to inform claim and underwriting colleagues on law impacting Travelers' underwriting and claim decisions.
  • Review documents pertaining to mergers, equity sales and asset sales to determine the legal status and ownership of indemnitors undergoing a change of control. Draft and negotiate appropriate agreements to document indemnity changes related to such transactions.
  • Support underwriting marketing efforts, including participation in broker and account visits and risk mitigation seminars and authoring customer-focused white papers and articles.
  • Obtain and maintain required adjusters' licenses.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Six or more years of relevant legal or claim handling work experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively work through conflict and resolve issues with a professional demeanor.
  • Ability to make sound decisions and negotiate terms and conditions within designated authority limit.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate coverage determinations.
  • Time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities with an attention to detail, data and analytics.
  • Ability to build and maintain effective and collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Juris Doctorate Degree.
  • Properly licensed, registered or authorized, and in good standing, to practice law in the jurisdiction in which you will be working.
  • Three years of relevant legal experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Job.JobTitle: Business Insurance Underwriting Professional Development Program (BI UPDP) Internship
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $25.00 to $26.00 an hour
  • Schedule: Internship
  • Location: Blue Bell, PA
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

10-week summer internship in business insurance underwriting at Travelers, running June through mid-August in Blue Bell, Pennsylvania. Interns complete training modules, project work, and learn to use analytical and AI tools while gaining commercial insurance experience.

Good fit if you are pursuing a bachelor's degree in business, economics, finance, or related field and are interested in an underwriting career

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The hourly salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual hourly rate for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards. 

Salary Range

$25.00 - $26.00

Target Openings

2

What Is the Opportunity?

Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning in October. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role. Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Are you curious by nature? Do you enjoy managing relationships and employing your critical thinking skills? Underwriters perform the critical function of evaluating the acceptability of risk and determining appropriate pricing for insurance products. The Business Insurance (BI) Underwriting Professional Development Internship Program provides students with an amazing opportunity to gain exposure to this critical function at Travelers. The 10-week program (running from early June to mid-August) provides qualified interns with an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand commercial insurance underwriting experience, receive valuable on-the-job training, and learn more about the property and casualty insurance industry from industry professionals. Given that, we are seeking interns that are serious about entering the insurance industry and who are excited about the prospect of making underwriting their future career choice. This role is a potential pathway to our full-time Underwriting Professional Development Program (UPDP). Housing assistance is not provided.

What Will You Do?

  • Within your assigned business unit, each intern will be given a designated coach and be expected to:
  • Complete core assignments and training modules geared toward insurance and underwriting principles.
  • Participate and complete self-paced professional development courses in time management, presentation skills, and other key areas.
  • Complete challenging and meaningful project work over the course of this program at the discretion of your manager. You may work independently or with other interns and will be asked to present your findings to local leadership. Sample projects include a territorial risk assessment to determine profitability and underwriting opportunities as well as a business process analysis to determine underwriting gaps.
  • Learn to leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
  • Learn about other areas at Travelers such as Risk Control, Claims, and related corporate functions. Interns may also engage in agency visits with Account Executives.
  • Participate in the Enterprise Internship experience which includes Executive Speaker Series, Networking events, and Rising Senior Intern Symposium.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Obtained or pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Liberal Arts (with business focus preferred), Management, Marketing, Risk Management and Insurance.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

What is a Must Have?

  • Pursuing or obtained a Bachelor's degree.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

We are committed to providing accommodation to persons with disabilities. If you require accommodation during the recruitment or interview process we will work with you to accommodate your needs.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

The 10-week program (running from early June to mid-August) provides qualified interns with an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand commercial insurance underwriting experience, receive valuable on-the-job training, and learn more about the property and casualty insurance industry from industry professionals. Given that, we are seeking interns that are serious about entering the insurance industry and who are excited about the prospect of making underwriting their future career choice. This role is a potential pathway to our full-time Underwriting Professional Development Program (UPDP). Housing assistance is not provided.

What Will You Do?

  • Within your assigned business unit, each intern will be given a designated coach and be expected to:
  • Complete core assignments and training modules geared toward insurance and underwriting principles.
  • Participate and complete self-paced professional development courses in time management, presentation skills, and other key areas.
  • Complete challenging and meaningful project work over the course of this program at the discretion of your manager. You may work independently or with other interns and will be asked to present your findings to local leadership. Sample projects include a territorial risk assessment to determine profitability and underwriting opportunities as well as a business process analysis to determine underwriting gaps.
  • Learn to leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
  • Learn about other areas at Travelers such as Risk Control, Claims, and related corporate functions. Interns may also engage in agency visits with Account Executives.
  • Participate in the Enterprise Internship experience which includes Executive Speaker Series, Networking events, and Rising Senior Intern Symposium.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Obtained or pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Liberal Arts (with business focus preferred), Management, Marketing, Risk Management and Insurance.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

What is a Must Have?

  • Pursuing or obtained a Bachelor's degree.

Employment Practices

We are committed to providing accommodation to persons with disabilities. If you require accommodation during the recruitment or interview process we will work with you to accommodate your needs.

About this job

Account Executive Officer for construction loss sensitive accounts at Travelers Insurance in Houston. Partner with agents and brokers to underwrite and manage complex customer accounts while building relationships to drive profitability and growth.

Good fit if you have six to eight years of underwriting experience in construction loss sensitive and hold a CPCU designation.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Salary Range

$120,400.00 - $198,700.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

The Account Executive Officer (AEO), Construction Loss Sensitive will partner with agents and brokers to provide coverage for new and renewal business based on customers' needs. This role is seen as a technical resource.

As an AEO, you are decisive, detail-oriented, and know how to build relationships internally and externally to drive results. Your ability to independently assess complex risk and sell our products in challenging markets will contribute to the profitability and success of Travelers.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage the profitability, growth, and retention of an assigned book of business.
  • Underwrite and skillfully negotiate complex customer accounts to minimize risk and maximize profitability.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal partners within the business unit and across the enterprise to create sales plans and identify cross-selling opportunities.
  • Foster and maintain relationships with external partners by regularly meeting in person with agents and brokers to market and sell Travelers products with a goal of writing and retaining accounts consistent with our risk appetite. Must be able to travel to such meetings.
  • Identify and capture new business opportunities using consultative marketing and sales skills.
  • Independently develop and execute agency sales plans and frequently partner with your Managing Director (MD) to develop region/group sales plans.
  • May assist in the training and mentoring of less experienced Account Executives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Six to eight years of relevant underwriting experience with experience in construction loss sensitive.
  • Deep knowledge of construction loss sensitive products, the regulatory environment, and the local insurance market.
  • Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to proactively identify underwriting, marketing, or financial challenges and analyze available information to make timely decisions in alignment with our risk appetite.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to successfully negotiate in difficult situations with agents and brokers.
  • CPCU designation.

What is a Must Have?

  • Four years of underwriting, claim, operations, risk assessment, actuarial, sales, product, or finance experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Good fit if you have 8+ years market research experience, 3+ years leading brand equity or campaign measurement research, and a bachelor's degree in business, marketing, economics, or related field.

What Is the Opportunity?

At Travelers, Market Researchers collaborate across the company to inform business decisions, drive winning go-to-market strategies, and enable the business to capitalize on change. They provide strategic consulting and actionable insights; helping the business grow profitably, build the Travelers brand, and positively position the company in the marketplace. As a Senior Director of Brand Research, you lead the enterprise Brand Research practice, providing strategic direction and oversight for a portfolio of brand, marketing, and creative insights programs. You conduct and oversee complex, high-exposure research to understand the needs, behaviors, attitudes, and expectations of key target audiences including customers, prospects, and distribution partners. You serve as the enterprise subject matter expert on brand insights and marketing effectiveness, partnering with brand management, advertising, and marketing leaders to ensure insights drive creative development and campaign execution. You work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and senior leadership to ensure research aligns to business objectives and delivers decision-ready recommendations. This role has people leadership responsibilities.

What Will You Do?

  • Oversee and conduct high complexity/exposure qualitative and quantitative primary research projects from initial scoping to final report generation and presentation on assigned brand, marketing, and creative insights topics, requiring mastery of sophisticated qualitative and quantitative market research methods, documentation, and tools.
  • Lead enterprise-wide brand, marketing, and creative insights programs, including brand health tracking, creative and copy testing, sponsorship measurement, and content marketing impact; own the enterprise brand and marketing insights agenda end to end, from primary research design and fielding through synthesis of secondary/syndicated sources to decision-ready recommendations.
  • Use a wide range of methodologies and sources to synthesize research findings into clear and actionable insights to support senior leadership decision-making.
  • Develop highly complex research projects and associated deliverables, including documentation such as proposals, project plans, data specs, and final reports; act as a strategic consultant and frequently present findings to leadership. May recommend further research based on outcomes.
  • Manage timelines and resources effectively across multiple projects, with minimal management support as needed. Identifies and advocates for resources, as necessary.
  • Assess accuracy, credibility, and appropriateness of data while ensuring quality standards are met by the entire team; establish quality control practices across assigned staff and monitor for timely, high-quality delivery of outcomes.
  • Serve as Engagement Lead for one or more businesses or corporate functions; represent the unit at interdepartmental and governance meetings.
  • May lead one or more department-wide initiative; drive departmental goals and represent the Brand Research practice to senior management.
  • Provide strategic guidance, mentorship, and coaching across the department in collaboration with peers; drive hiring, performance management, coaching, and development of staff within the assigned unit, fostering a high-performance culture.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 8 or more years of market research or related work experience.
  • 3 or more years of leadership/management experience in brand equity/brand health tracking, creative and copy testing and campaign measurement research.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, economics, mathematics, psychology, anthropology, or comparable analytical degree.
  • MBA, Master of Research, or other advanced degree.
  • Deep understanding of industry-standard brand equity and brand health models and vendor offerings (e.g., Ipsos, Kantar, Nielsen); experience partnering with brand, advertising, marketing, and media/agency stakeholders and managing specialized external research vendors and syndicated trackers.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office products.
  • Self-motivated.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate information clearly and effectively, exhibiting an understanding of the audience and tailoring messaging appropriately.
  • Highly effective collaboration skills, including with vendors, business partners, and leaders.
  • Expert ability to create and cultivate relationships and use them to inform business outcomes.
  • Deep knowledge of business and/or insurance concepts. Financial Services/P&C experience.
  • Expert knowledge of, and experience conducting, primary research, including research techniques, research design, survey and discussion guide development, data tabulation specifications, analysis and interpretation of research data, and data visualization and insights reporting.
  • Expert ability to analyze multiple, disparate data sets to derive conclusions and/or research recommendations.

What is a Must Have?

  • 6 years of market research or related experience.
