If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.

Who We Are

For over 70 years, Glatfelter Insurance Group has believed in doing the right thing for our clients, agents, communities and associates. This founding principle has enabled Glatfelter to grow from the kitchen-table, one-man-operation as it began, to one of the largest managing general agencies in the U.S. with nearly 500 associates across the country, a distribution network of over 4,500 independent brokers and more than 30,000 clients. It is what drives us to innovate—the desire to deliver the best for our clients. Founded as The Glatfelter Agency, which is still in operation, the program basis of Glatfelter Insurance Group, Volunteer Firemen's Insurance Services (VFIS), was founded in 1969. Throughout the years, Glatfelter has expanded to include specialized program business inclusive of public entities, educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and religious organizations. Glatfelter provides their insureds with comprehensive insurance solutions including property, casualty, life insurance, and more. In 2018, Glatfelter joined American International Group (AIG) and is now part of the AIG family.

About the Position

Glatfelter Insurance Group is seeking a Claims Specialist - Accident and Sickness for our Glatfelter Claims Management department. The Claims Specialist is responsible for the investigation, evaluation, negotiation, and resolution of Accident & Sickness claims from first report through final disposition. This position ensures timely, accurate, and customer-focused claim handling while maintaining compliance with policy provisions, regulatory requirements, company standards, and assigned financial authority. The representative serves as a primary point of contact for claimants, insureds, agents, attorneys, vendors, and other stakeholders throughout the claims process.

This position is required to be onsite at our Leader Heights, York, PA office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactive handling of assigned claims in compliance with applicable state regulatory requirements, departmental standards, and designated financial authority.
  • Review medical records, accident reports, hospital documentation, wage information, and other claim-related evidence to determine coverage, eligibility, and claim validity.
  • Upholding the highest standards of customer satisfaction and service to insureds, agents, regional directors, and other interested parties while fulfilling obligations to protect our insured's interests and the company's assets.
  • Communicating investigation and handling status and final determinations to insureds and claimants in compliance with regulatory requirements and departmental standards. This includes verbal communications, written correspondence, internal reports, and issuance of formal denial, disclaimer, and reservation of rights letters.
  • Representing GIG through continuous countrywide contact with insureds, claimants, brokers, insurance carriers, and vendors.
  • Maintaining claim file integrity to document activity, preserve evidence in an organized fashion, capture accurate claims data, and provide an appropriate basis for all claims handling decisions.
  • All specialized tasks and duties necessary for the prompt and efficient handling of assigned claims within the handler's designated specialty/line(s) of business. May include litigation management, subject matter expertise development or other advanced technical training or industry education.
  • All other duties as assigned. (May include training, mentoring or other staff development or supervisory support functions.)

What We're Looking For

Education

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Associate degree, bachelor's degree, or professional claims designation (such as Associate in Claims) preferred.

Experience

  • Three or more years of Accident & Sickness claims handling experience or relevant transferable experience in insurance, medical claims, disability claims, workers' compensation, or a related field.
  • Experience investigating, evaluating, and resolving insurance claims preferred.
  • Experience reviewing medical records, evaluating treatment plans, interpreting clinical documentation, and communicating with healthcare providers is highly desirable.
  • Prior leadership, supervisory, or team lead experience is highly desirable.

Technical Qualifications:

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Efficient time management skills.
  • Proficient knowledge of insurance policy forms, pertinent coverages, and claims handling processes and procedures.
  • Proficient understanding of technical subject matter appropriate to assigned specialty/line(s) of business.
  • Must be proficient with the use of computer applications (standard Microsoft products), keyboard/typing, and telecommunication tools and technology.
  • Quality focus and attention to detail.
  • Working knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy, physiology, diagnoses, and treatment protocols.
  • Ability to review, interpret, and analyze medical records, physician reports, diagnostic testing, operative reports, and treatment plans.
  • Understanding of disability, impairment, causation, and return-to-work considerations as they relate to insurance claims.
  • Effective interpersonal skills and ability to work as part of a team.

Upon employment the Associate is required to:

  • Develop a working knowledge and understanding of GCM processes and procedures as well as GIG culture, products, and services within an appropriate period of time.
  • Develop functional proficiency in the use of GIG/GCM computer systems and applications.
  • Complete required training as assigned to enhance knowledge, expand technical understanding, and develop skills.
  • Obtain required adjuster licenses within an aggressive timeframe and maintain licensure renewals by obtaining required continuing education credits.
  • Demonstrate ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and complete tasks timely/accurately.

Why Choose Glatfelter?

Glatfelter is honored to have been named a Best Place to Work in PA since 2005. We are proud to offer a range of employee benefits and resources that help you protect what matters most - your health care, savings, financial protection and wellbeing. In addition to 17 paid holidays, (which includes a personal holiday and mental health and wellness day) we provide a variety of leaves for personal, health, family, and volunteer needs.

About this job

Director of Operations role leading end-to-end certified pre-owned mobile device operations at Assurant's Lewisville facility. Responsible for demand planning, production, repair, quality, profitability, and team leadership across multiple operational functions.

Full job description

We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Director of Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) Operations to lead and optimize our end-to-end CPO operations. This executive leadership role is responsible for driving operational excellence, quality, profitability, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement across multiple functions, including demand planning, production and repair operations, new product introduction, customer implementations, service delivery, and product lifecycle management. The ideal candidate is a proven operations leader with experience managing complex manufacturing, repair, or refurbishment environments. This individual will leverage Lean Six Sigma methodologies, data-driven decision making, and cross-functional leadership to deliver scalable processes, exceptional customer outcomes, and sustained business growth.

This is an onsite role in our Lewisville TX facility, with occasional travel (~10%).

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Lead all aspects of CPO operations, ensuring high levels of quality, service, productivity, and profitability
  • Develop and execute short- and long-term operational strategies aligned with business objectives
  • Establish policies, procedures, and performance standards that drive operational excellence and accountability
  • Oversee demand planning, operations planning and control, production processes, repair operations, parts reclamation, customer implementations, system support, and customer service functions
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Six Sigma principles and best practices
  • Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance programs that improve efficiency, reduce waste, and enhance customer satisfaction
  • Partner with Product Development and Engineering teams to support new product introductions and operational readiness
  • Identify opportunities to optimize workflows, improve scalability, and enhance operational performance
  • Own operational financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and profitability analysis
  • Evaluate business opportunities and operational investments through financial modeling and data-driven analysis
  • Monitor key performance indicators and implement corrective actions to achieve business goals
  • Recruit, develop, coach, and lead high-performing teams
  • Establish performance expectations, succession planning, and employee development strategies
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Serve as the primary operational partner for internal stakeholders and external clients.
  • Resolve operational, product, system, and customer-related issues while maintaining strong client relationships
  • Collaborate across departments to successfully deliver strategic initiatives and operational improvements
  • Present recommendations, business cases, and operational updates to leadership teams and executive audiences
  • Support the development, launch, and operational integration of new products and services
  • Drive ongoing product profitability, compliance, and lifecycle performance
  • Partner with key stakeholders to identify and implement innovative solutions that support business growth

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 6+ years of progressive leadership experience managing complex manufacturing, repair, refurbishment, or operations environments
  • Strong experience in demand planning, production planning, procurement, materials management, and new product introduction
  • Proven success leading process improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Six Sigma methodologies
  • Advanced analytical and financial acumen with experience in budgeting, forecasting, and operational performance management
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, trend analysis, reporting, and data visualization
  • Experience with project management, resource planning, and systems implementation
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong problem-solving abilities with a data-driven approach to decision-making

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Experience using AI tools and automation technologies to improve business processes and operational efficiency
  • Background in technical, mechanical, electronics repair, refurbishment, or manufacturing environments
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or higher
  • Experience working within ISO and OSHA-regulated environments
  • Experience with Oracle ERP systems
  • Experience supporting wireless or consumer electronics products

This job is responsible for working with the Supervisors and assisting in training and developing the team, monitoring production performance, ensuring production and quality controls are met while adhering to the work instructions for the area of responsibility.


This is an onsite role at our Lewisville, TX DCC, with a schedule of Friday through Sunday, 6:00 am to 6:30 pm.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Working knowledge of shop floor systems (CVision, Oracle, Unit Tracker, Great Plains, Ghost)
  • Participate in daily stand-up meetings with Supervisor
  • Participate in internal and external customer or vendor meetings
  • Work with Supervisor to reallocate resources (people/supplies/products etc.) as needed to meet customer goals
  • Work with other departments as needed to ensure proper workflow is achieved
  • Point of contact for employees for handling escalation issues
  • Work with Engineering to identify and resolve process issues
  • Track and maintain daily attendance roster for Emergency Evacuation purposes
  • Participate with the 6S Audit team on monthly 6S audits
  • Work with supervisor to implement any changes or adjustments on production floor as a result from the audits
  • Perform on-the-job (OJT) refresher training and work station assessment
  • Monitor inventory levels (WIP Aging) for specific area of responsibility
  • Monitor KPI and SLA performance levels and escalate any issues/concerns to supervisor when needed

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 1+ years lead or supervisory experience in a manufacturing and/or warehouse environment

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Prior leadership experience in manufacturing, logistics, operations, or another applicable environment is preferred
  • Ability to collaborate with other departments with their area of responsibility
  • Training environment experience
  • Forklift certified if needed for area of responsibility
  • Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of employees
  • Must be proficient and certified in the area that they are responsible for leading

Environmental/ physical demands

  • Occasional: Bending, squatting, kneeling, reaching, twisting, exposure to changes in temperature, being near moving machinery, and office machinery.
  • This position requires incumbents to regularly sit at a desk and operate.
  • standard office equipment such as a computer and bar scanner
  • Employee is occasionally required to stand and walk, lift, carry and/or move up to 40 pounds
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus
  • Must be able to talk and hear

Pay Range

$17.34 - $27.75

Expected Application Deadline

11/14/2026

If no application deadline is provided, this role may be a pipeline requisition, and we'll continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis, or there is no requirement for this information in the location where the role is posted.

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience, and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America's Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.

Job.JobTitle: Director, Financial Data Operations and Delivery
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Urbandale, IA
  • Experience: 15+ years

About this job

Director role managing financial data architecture, reporting platforms, and analytics environments for a Fortune 500 insurance company. Oversees Oracle Essbase, data warehouses, and modernization efforts to migrate legacy systems to Databricks and AI-enabled analytics.

Good fit if you have experience with Oracle Essbase, data warehousing, ETL processes, and leading technical teams supporting financial reporting systems.

Full job description

Company Details

We provide a foundation of stability and predictability that gives employees the confidence to succeed.

Founded in 1967, W. R. Berkley Corporation has grown from a small investment management firm into one of the largest commercial lines property and casualty insurers in the United States.


Along the way, we've been listed on the New York Stock Exchange, become a Fortune 500 Company, joined the S&P 500, and seen our gross written premiums exceed $15 billion.


Today the Berkley brand comprises 60 businesses worldwide and is divided into two segments: Insurance and Reinsurance and Monoline Excess. Led by Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer, W. Robert Berkley, Jr., W. R. Berkley Corporation is well positioned for long-term success and future growth.

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer.

Responsibilities

This position supports the Corporate Financial Data and Analysis function by designing, maintaining, and modernizing the finance data architecture, reporting platforms, and analytical environments used by Corporate Finance, operating units, actuarial, information technology, and other enterprise stakeholders.

The role provides technical and functional support for Oracle Essbase, Oracle Analytics Server, PeopleSoft financial data, Vena, BDW, ledger-related processes, data warehouse integrations, and financial reporting data flows.

The position is responsible for supporting recurring production processes, troubleshooting data and reporting issues, maintaining and enhancing Essbase cubes and related jobs, assisting with ledger and financial close data validation, and partnering with business and technology teams to improve the reliability, scalability, and transparency of finance data.

The role will be responsible for supporting current modernization efforts to migrate and refactor finance data processes into expanded AI-enabled analytics and exception handling, strengthen data governance, and reduce manual effort across financial reporting, reconciliations, data calls, and close-related activities.

This position requires the ability to translate finance and accounting requirements into technical solutions; develop and maintain reports, databases, scripts, queries, integrations, and ETL/ELT processes; support production operations; assist with system upgrades and platform transitions; and communicate effectively with internal business users, technology partners, vendors, and operating unit stakeholders.

Key Functions/Duties of Position:

  • Design, develop, maintain, and support finance data architecture, data warehouse structures, ETL/ELT processes, scripts, queries, reports, dashboards, cubes, and analytical environments used by Corporate Finance and operating units.
  • Participate in Databricks modernization efforts by helping identify legacy finance data processes to migrate, refactor existing data jobs, validate results between legacy and Databricks environments, support workflow orchestration, and help establish scalable data processing patterns.
  • Assist with the transition from legacy SQL Server, DataStage, SSIS, OAS, Essbase, and other existing data processes toward Databricks and modern lake house-based architecture where appropriate.
  • Support AI and automation initiatives by helping prepare trusted finance data, define business rules, identify exception-handling opportunities, improve metadata and semantic definitions, and enable self-service analytics, AI-assisted inquiry, and governed data access.
  • Provide ongoing production support for Oracle Essbase, Oracle Analytics Server, PeopleSoft warehouse data, Vena integrations, BDW reporting processes, and related financial reporting platforms.
  • Monitor recurring finance data processes, including nightly and monthly cube refreshes, data loads, job failures, close-related processing, and system-generated exception messages; investigate issues and coordinate timely resolution.
  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance Essbase cubes and related reporting structures, including PeopleSoft company cubes, BDW cubes, Schedule P, Schedule F, corporate dashboard, auditing, allocation, and other financial reporting use cases.
  • Support ledger and financial close processes by assisting with hierarchy maintenance, new general ledger accounts, close error monitoring, PeopleSoft data validation, month-end close reporting, balancing, reconciliation, and downstream reporting impacts.
  • Partner with Corporate Finance, operating units, actuarial teams, and other technology teams to define requirements, resolve data issues, validate results, and implement reporting and data integration improvements.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for processes, data flows, system dependencies, controls, validations, support procedures, and modernization changes to reduce key-person risk and improve long-term supportability.
  • Provide technical analysis and support for finance data requests, including historical general ledger data, BDW validation, premium, loss, producer, expense, reinsurance, allocation, and other financial or operational datasets.
  • Assist with ServiceNow requests, security access, user support, Smart View and reporting access, data availability questions, and troubleshooting for finance reporting users.
  • Participate in system maintenance, upgrades, disaster recovery planning, server migrations, platform testing, and production deployment activities for finance data and reporting systems.
  • Apply sound development and support practices, including code review, testing, documentation, version control, issue tracking, deployment coordination, and clear communication of risks, dependencies, and downstream impacts.
  • Provide strategic and technical leadership for the Financial Data and Analysis team and business partners, establishing priorities and accountability across recurring production support, financial data architecture, reporting platforms, data quality, and modernization initiatives while ensuring reliable, scalable, and well-controlled delivery of finance data solutions.
  • Lead, coach, and develop team members by providing clear technical direction, strengthening knowledge of finance data structures and reporting environments, and promoting disciplined practices for testing, documentation, controls, issue resolution, and change management, while building the team's capabilities in Databricks, AI-enabled analytics, automation, and modern lake house technologies.

Qualifications

Education Requirement:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent; preferably in actuarial science, math or computer science.

Qualifications:

  • 12-15+ years of experience in finance data architecture, data engineering, business intelligence, financial reporting systems, data warehousing, analytics, or related technical support roles.
  • Strong SQL experience, preferably with Microsoft SQL Server and enterprise financial data warehouse environments.
  • Experience leading or managing a team.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, or supporting ETL/ELT processes, data integrations, data pipelines, batch jobs, and production data workflows.
  • Experience with Databricks, lake house architecture, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, notebooks, workflow orchestration, APIs, or cloud-based data modernization preferred.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled analytics, semantic layers, metadata management, business definitions, exception detection, automation, and self-service finance reporting preferred.
  • Experience with Oracle Essbase, Oracle Analytics Server, Smart View, financial reporting cubes, dimensional structures, metadata, and cube refresh or maintenance processes.
  • Experience supporting finance, accounting, ledger, close, planning, budgeting, reconciliation, allocation, or statutory reporting processes.
  • Strong project management, organizational, prioritization, and planning skills, including the ability to manage competing demands, recurring production responsibilities, and modernization initiatives.
  • Working knowledge of financial data, general ledger structures, chart fields, accounting hierarchies, month-end close processes, and downstream reporting dependencies preferred.
  • Ability to understand complex finance, accounting, actuarial, and insurance reporting requirements and translate them into effective data and technology solutions.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose root causes across data, process, system, and business-rule issues.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively across Corporate Finance, operating units, actuarial, technology, data governance, vendor, and support teams.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to business users, document support procedures, and summarize risks, dependencies, and recommended actions.
  • Demonstrated commitment to data quality, control, auditability, documentation, supportability, and customer service.
  • Multi-line property and casualty insurance experience is beneficial.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and provide leadership in ambiguous or evolving technical and business environments.

Additional Company Details

We do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting agencies or firms.

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Wilmington, DE
  • Experience: 3+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Design and manage Microsoft Copilot Studio agents and Power Platform solutions across business units. Responsibilities include environment administration, integration with Microsoft 365 and third-party systems, technical support, and security-first implementation.

Good fit if you have 3+ years Power Platform experience, 1+ year recent Copilot Studio production experience, and a bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.

Full job description

Company Details

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer.

Responsibilities

• Design, build, test, and publish Microsoft Copilot Studio agents, including topics, generative answers, knowledge sources, actions, connectors, and Power Automate flows to solve business problems across operating units.
• Manage the Copilot Studio environment, including agent lifecycle, publishing channels, authentication, analytics, capacity and Copilot Credits consumption, and licensing, while enforcing responsible AI, DLP, and security standards.
• Design and develop solutions using Power Apps (canvas and model-driven), Power Automate (cloud and desktop flows), and Dataverse, following ALM best practices with solutions, environment variables, and managed deployments.
• Administer Power Platform environments, including environment strategy, DLP policies, connectors, security roles, and the Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit; monitor usage, capacity, and maker activity to ensure a secure and well-governed tenant.
• Integrate Power Platform and Copilot Studio solutions with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Azure, and third-party systems using standard and custom connectors and APIs, following defined change control processes.
• Monitor and manage ticket queues, provide technical support and guidance to makers and end users, and troubleshoot Power Platform and Copilot Studio issues.
• Create process and technical documentation, solution designs, runbooks, and maker guidance to support clarity, consistency, and efficiency within IT operations.
• Implement security-first practices by integrating cybersecurity, data protection, and responsible AI considerations into every solution, ensuring agents and apps respect data classification, sensitivity labels, and access controls.
• Develop a basic understanding of business processes and core business functions; gather and document business requirements; communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders; and apply Power Platform and AI capabilities to solve business problems and support business outcomes.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience in IT systems engineering or application development.
• 3+ years of hands-on Microsoft Power Platform experience, including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse.
• At least 1 year of recent (within the last 2 years) hands-on Microsoft Copilot Studio experience developing, deploying, and managing agents in a production environment.
• Experience with Power Platform administration, environment strategy, DLP policies, and ALM (solutions, pipelines, managed/unmanaged deployments).
• Experience integrating solutions with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, and Microsoft 365 Copilot.
• Working knowledge of Power Fx, connectors (standard, premium, and custom), and REST APIs.
• Demonstrated comfort using AI-assisted tools in a professional context and viewing AI as a standard part of modern workflow.
• Experience with Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AI Builder, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations (preferred).
• Experience with the Power Platform CoE Starter Kit and Power Platform admin center / PowerShell (preferred).
• Experience with Power BI report development (preferred).
• Experience in the insurance or financial services industry (preferred).
• Ability to promote and work within an Agile methodology, emphasizing flexibility, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• Ability to streamline processes using automation and scripting to enhance efficiency and reduce potential for human error.
• Strong business acumen with the ability to align technical expertise to broader business objectives.
• Familiarity with cloud computing concepts and leveraging Microsoft 365 and Azure to support and enhance business operations.
• Demonstrated innovation mindset to drive technological advancements and improve business processes.
• Ability to design and support scalable systems that meet organizational growth and evolving needs.
• Strong troubleshooting skills to quickly and effectively resolve issues and maintain smooth operation of IT systems.
• Conceptual thinking skills.
• Ability to manage information effectively.
• Strong sense of personal ownership and accountability.
• Quality decision-making skills.
• Composure and flexibility in a dynamic environment.

Education Requirement


• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
• Equivalent experience and/or alternative qualifications will be considered.
• Current Microsoft certifications such as AB-620 (AI Agent Builder Associate), AB-410 (Intelligent Applications Builder Associate), or PL-400/AB-400 (Power Platform Developer) preferred; previously earned PL-200 or PL-600 certifications are also valued.

Additional Company Details

We do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting agencies or firms.

Additional Requirements

Location and Travel:
Wilmington, DE
Urbandale, IA
Manassas, VA
Scottsdale, AZ

Sponsorship Details

Sponsorship not Offered for this Role

Job.JobTitle: Sr. Sys Engineer-(Power Platform and AWS Connect)
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Wilmington, DE
  • Experience: 5+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Senior Systems Engineer for enterprise Amazon Connect and Microsoft Teams Phone contact center platforms. Lead engineer designing and supporting voice solutions for multiple operating units, with hands-on development in AWS Lambda, Teams Phone administration, and carrier integrations.

Good fit if you have 3+ years Amazon Connect production experience, 5+ years Teams Phone design and administration, and SIP/call quality troubleshooting expertise.

Full job description

Company Details

Berkley Technology Services

At Berkley Technology Services, we believe AI-assisted ways of working are becoming a foundational part of how excellent engineering work gets done — much the way digital communication tools did a generation ago. We expect every member of our team to actively integrate AI tools into their daily work, not as a substitute for expertise, but as a natural extension of it. Candidates who bring genuine curiosity about AI, and a demonstrated habit of using it to work smarter, will find themselves at home here.

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer.

Responsibilities

The Senior Systems Engineer – Contact Center & Voice serves as the lead engineer and platform owner for enterprise Amazon Connect and Microsoft Teams Phone voice services, designing, developing, and supporting contact center capabilities for W. R. Berkley operating units and partnering with business stakeholders to deliver secure, reliable solutions.

• Serve as primary engineer and platform owner for the enterprise Amazon Connect environment, designing, building, and maintaining contact flows, flow modules, queues, routing profiles, hours of operation, prompts, quick connects, security profiles, and agent/supervisor configuration.
• Develop and maintain AWS Lambda functions (Python and/or Node.js), Amazon Lex bots, and API integrations for caller self-service, data lookups, directory lookup, and intelligent routing.
• Design and support integrations between Amazon Connect and ServiceNow (ServiceNow Voice), CRM and agent desktop solutions, workforce management (WFM), identity services, and chat.
• Lead onboarding of operating-unit contact centers onto Amazon Connect and Teams Phone, including requirements and phone-tree sessions, call-flow design, build and testing, production cutover, and hypercare.
• Lead migrations from legacy telephony and contact center platforms (e.g., Cisco, Webex) to Amazon Connect and Teams Phone.
• Design, configure, and support Microsoft Teams Phone, including call queues, auto attendants, resource accounts, voice routing, dial plans, calling policies, and emergency calling compliance (Kari's Law and RAY BAUM'S Act).
• Manage PSTN connectivity through Direct Routing, Operator Connect, and SIP trunking, including number porting, LOA preparation and validation, carrier coordination, and port scheduling.
• Serve as liaison to carriers for voice service issues and coordinate resolution.
• Architect and support call transfer and interoperability between Amazon Connect, Teams Phone, and carrier networks, recommending appropriate platforms for operating-unit calling needs.
• Deliver contact center reporting and analytics, including real-time and historical metrics, dashboards and wallboards, abandoned-call and contact detail reporting, CTR data, and Contact Lens AI call summaries and sentiment analysis.
• Improve agent experience through optimized call transfer processes and agent desktop configuration, and expand capabilities such as Amazon Connect Chat, Tasks, and AI-driven features (e.g., Amazon Q in Connect, conversational IVR).
• Ensure contact center and voice services run efficiently, reliably, and securely in a highly available 24x7 environment; monitor using CloudWatch, Teams Admin Center, Call Quality Dashboard (CQD), and SIP traces; provide second- and third-level support.
• Integrate Amazon Connect, Teams Phone, carrier, and business application components, following change control processes and using version control and infrastructure-as-code (AWS CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform) where applicable.
• Monitor and manage ServiceNow ticket queues for incidents, problems, changes, and service requests; troubleshoot contact center, call routing, call quality, and integration issues; track project work in Jira.
• Create and maintain architecture diagrams, call-flow diagrams, runbooks, standards, and process documentation in Confluence.
• Automate provisioning, number management, and reporting with PowerShell, Python, and Power Automate to drive operational efficiency.
• Integrate security into every aspect of contact center and voice design and operation, including IAM least-privilege access, encryption, call recording access and retention, and regulatory compliance.
• Serve as primary technical liaison to AWS, Microsoft, carriers, and implementation partners; manage support cases and partner deliverables through resolution.
• Act as Lead Engineer on contact center and voice engagements, collaborating with Project Management and operating-unit stakeholders; lead status syncs and contribute to executive status reporting.
• Define standards and design patterns for contact center development and enterprise telephony and mentor Systems Administrators and engineers on BTS standards and quality expectations.
• Develop and maintain strong business knowledge of contact center operations, metrics, and how they support operating-unit objectives; gather and document business requirements and communicate technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

• Typical Years of Experience is 7 years.
• 3+ years of hands-on Amazon Connect development and administration in a production environment supporting multiple business units, including contact flows, routing, Lambda integrations, and Amazon Lex.
• 5+ years of experience designing and administering Microsoft Teams Phone (Calling), including Direct Routing and/or Operator Connect, call queues, auto attendants, voice routing, dial plans, and calling policies.
• Solid knowledge of SIP, RTP, codecs, Session Border Controllers (SBCs), call quality troubleshooting, and emergency calling (E911) requirements.
• Hands-on number porting experience, including LOA preparation, carrier coordination, and port troubleshooting.
• Experience with Amazon Connect reporting and analytics, including real-time and historical metrics, contact trace records (CTR), Contact Lens, and dashboards/wallboards.
• Experience integrating Amazon Connect with ServiceNow, CRM or agent desktop solutions, workforce management, and chat.
• Working knowledge of core AWS services supporting contact centers (Lambda, IAM, S3, DynamoDB, Kinesis, CloudWatch); infrastructure-as-code experience (CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform) preferred.
• PowerShell scripting and automation experience.
• Proven ability to lead requirements sessions with non-technical business leaders and translate them into call flows and technical designs.
• Experience managing vendor, partner, and carrier relationships (e.g., AWS, Microsoft, implementation partners, telecom carriers).
• IT service management experience with ServiceNow; project tracking with Jira; documentation in Confluence.
• Relevant certifications highly preferred, such as AWS Certified Developer – Associate, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, and Microsoft 365 Certified: Teams Administrator Associate.
• Ability and willingness to learn quickly, accept challenges and changes, and work independently with minimal direction.
• Detail-oriented and self-managing, with the ability to determine how environment changes impact customers and other systems.
• Strong customer service skills with a focus on delivering value-added collaborative services.
• Experience working with Agile methodology to promote flexibility, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• Strong automation and scripting skills to streamline processes, enhance efficiency, and reduce the potential for human error.
• Business acumen to align technical expertise with broader business objectives.
• Cloud computing skills, with familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
• Demonstrated innovation mindset to drive technological advancements and improve business processes.
• Ability to design scalable systems that can support organizational growth and evolving needs.
• Strong troubleshooting skills to quickly and effectively resolve issues and maintain smooth IT operations.
• Broad thinking and creative thinking, with a development-oriented approach.
• Demonstrated comfort using AI-assisted tools in a professional context and approaching AI as a standard part of modern workflow.

Education Requirement


• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
• Equivalent experience and/or alternative qualifications will be considered.

We do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting agencies or firms.

Wilmington, DE
Urbandale, IA
Manassas, VA
Scottsdale, AZ

Job.JobTitle: Sr. Engineer, Enterprise Patch & Vulnerability Management
Job.JobDescription:
Company Details

Company URL: https://www.berkleytechnologyservices.com/

Berkley Technology Services (BTS) is the dynamic technology solution for W. R. Berkley Corporation, a Fortune 500 Commercial Lines Insurance Company. With key locations in Urbandale, IA and Wilmington, DE, BTS provides innovative and customer-focused IT solutions to the majority of WRBC's 60+ operating units across the globe. BTS's wide reach ensures that ideas and opinions are considered at every level of the organization to guarantee we find the best solutions possible.

Driven by a commitment to collaboration, BTS acts as consultants to our customers and Operating Units by providing comprehensive solutions that not only address the challenge at hand but proactively plan for the “What's Next” in our industry and beyond.

With a culture centered on innovation and entrepreneurial spirit, BTS stands as a community of technology leaders with eyes toward the future -- leaders who truly care about growing not only their team members, but themselves, and take pride in their employees who shine. BTS offers endless ways to get involved and have the chance to grow your career into a wide range of roles you'd never known existed. Come join us as we push forward into the future of industry leading technological solutions.

Berkley Technology Services: Right Team, Right Technology, Simple and Secure.

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer.

Responsibilities

The Sr. Engineer, Enterprise Patch & Vulnerability Management serves as the technical engineering lead for VIPR (Vulnerability Incident Prevention & Remediation), the enterprise capability accountable for the patch and vulnerability remediation lifecycle across services, applications, platforms, and infrastructure. Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Enterprise Patch & Vulnerability Management, this role leads the technical planning, orchestration, and execution of patch-related changes and partners with BTS technology teams, Cybersecurity, Service Management, Change Management, Application Support, and Operating Unit Technology organizations to ensure patches, vulnerabilities, hardening items, and posture management findings are remediated in a timely manner aligned with established service level agreements (SLAs).

The role is accountable for technical change orchestration and execution, AI-based vulnerability and patch analysis, exception review, and incident escalation. Success requires deep technical breadth across enterprise platforms, strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, operational discipline, and the ability to collaborate with and influence technical teams without direct authority.

Key functions include but are not limited to:

  • Technical Lead – Change Orchestration & Execution: Serve as the technical lead for patch-related change orchestration and execution across the enterprise. Build and sequence automated deployment plans, maintenance windows, dependencies, and rollback procedures; prepare and submit change records; and lead technical execution and bridge coordination during enterprise maintenance events. Coordinate remediation across products onto shared maintenance windows so that systems are touched once rather than repeatedly, reducing end-user disruption and change collisions.
  • AI-Based Vulnerability & Patch Analysis: Leverage AI-enabled tools, analytics, and automation to analyze vulnerability scan data, threat intelligence, and patch release information; correlate findings to assets and service owners; predict deployment risk and service impact; identify remediation trends, recurring failures, and root causes; and produce data-driven prioritization recommendations. Ensure AI-generated outputs are validated and used in alignment with BTS security, data, and responsible AI standards.
  • Exception Review & Risk Validation: Perform technical review of patch and vulnerability exception requests, validating business justification, compensating controls, residual risk, and remediation timelines. Provide technical recommendations to the Sr. Manager and Cybersecurity, track exceptions to expiration, and ensure exceptions are re-evaluated and closed in alignment with governance expectations.
  • Incident Escalation & Response: Act as the escalation point for patch-related incidents, failed deployments, and service degradation following maintenance activities. Triage issues, engage appropriate resolver groups, coordinate rollback or remediation actions, escalate critical issues to technology leadership, and participate in post-incident and problem management reviews to prevent recurrence.
  • Offshore Execution Pod Technical Direction: Provide day-to-day technical direction to the offshore execution pod, including remediation wave planning and handoffs, automated testing execution, ticket queue prioritization, evidence quality, and off-hours execution readiness; review pod work for accuracy and completeness.
  • Vulnerability Remediation Execution: Partner with teams to drive technical remediation of critical, high, medium, and low vulnerabilities, hardening items, and posture management findings across every device on the network within established SLAs.
  • Code Remediation Influence & Enablement: Partner with product owners to influence, prioritize, and drive code changes required to remediate vulnerabilities. Champion and leverage AI-based tools to facilitate code analysis, development of remediation recommendations, and validation of proposed fixes, working with product owners to drive implementation within established remediation SLAs.
  • Service Validation and Post-Patch Checkout: Lead tiered service health validation following remediation — from enterprise up/downs to basic and comprehensive automated validation — partnering with product owners and stakeholder teams who define what healthy looks like. Confirm operational readiness, capture remediation evidence, and implement new tests when disruption reveals gaps in coverage.
  • Automation and Tooling: Partner with SRE and DevOps team, Platform Engineering, and product owners to design, build, and enhance automated checkout and validation, remediation orchestration, deployment pipelines, and evidence collection using enterprise tools and scripting.
  • Reporting and Compliance Support: Review and analyze reporting prepared by the offshore execution pod on patch compliance, vulnerability aging, SLA adherence, deployment success rates, exception status, and incident trends, providing technical insight to support management and executive reporting.
  • Documentation and Continuous Improvement: Develop and maintain technical runbooks, standard operating procedures, and knowledge articles; identify opportunities to improve patching reliability, reduce deployment risk, and increase automation coverage.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Equivalent experience and/or alternative qualifications will be considered.
  • 5+ years of technical experience
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise patch management, vulnerability remediation, systems engineering, or infrastructure operations
  • Experience leading technical execution of enterprise change and maintenance activities across multiple platforms
  • Hands-on experience with patch and vulnerability tooling
  • Experience applying AI, analytics, or automation tools to operational or security data
  • Working knowledge of public cloud platforms and modern data, integration, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, and cybersecurity practices.

Core Skills/Competencies:

  • Patch Management Engineering (P) - plans, sequences, and executes enterprise patch deployments safely and consistently.
  • Vulnerability Management (P) - analyzes findings, prioritizes remediation, and drives SLA compliance.
  • Change Orchestration & Execution (P) - leads technical change planning, implementation, validation, and rollback across platforms.
  • AI and Data Analysis (P) - applies AI-based tools and analytics to vulnerability, patch, and operational data to inform prioritization and decisions.
  • Risk and Exception Analysis (P) - evaluates exposure, compensating controls, and residual risk to support exception decisions.
  • Incident Management (P) - triages, escalates, and coordinates resolution of patch-related incidents.
  • Automation and Scripting (N) - improves deployment reliability, reporting, and evidence collection.

Additional Company Details

We do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting agencies or firms.

Full job description

Company Details

Company URL: https://www.berkleytechnologyservices.com/

Berkley Technology Services (BTS) is the dynamic technology solution for W. R. Berkley Corporation, a Fortune 500 Commercial Lines Insurance Company. With key locations in Urbandale, IA and Wilmington, DE, BTS provides innovative and customer-focused IT solutions to the majority of WRBC's 60+ operating units across the globe. BTS's wide reach ensures that ideas and opinions are considered at every level of the organization to guarantee we find the best solutions possible.

Driven by a commitment to collaboration, BTS acts as consultants to our customers and Operating Units by providing comprehensive solutions that not only address the challenge at hand but proactively plan for the “What's Next” in our industry and beyond.

With a culture centered on innovation and entrepreneurial spirit, BTS stands as a community of technology leaders with eyes toward the future -- leaders who truly care about growing not only their team members, but themselves, and take pride in their employees who shine. BTS offers endless ways to get involved and have the chance to grow your career into a wide range of roles you'd never known existed. Come join us as we push forward into the future of industry leading technological solutions.

Berkley Technology Services: Right Team, Right Technology, Simple and Secure.

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer.

Responsibilities

The Sr. Manager, Enterprise Patch & Vulnerability Management serves as the technical engineering lead for VIPR (Vulnerability Incident Prevention & Remediation), the enterprise capability accountable for the patch and vulnerability remediation lifecycle across services, applications, platforms, and infrastructure. Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Enterprise Patch & Vulnerability Management, this role leads the technical planning, orchestration, and execution of patch-related changes and partners with BTS technology teams, Cybersecurity, Service Management, Change Management, Application Support, and Operating Unit Technology organizations to ensure patches, vulnerabilities, hardening items, and posture management findings are remediated in a timely manner aligned with established service level agreements (SLAs).

The role is accountable for technical change orchestration and execution, AI-based vulnerability and patch analysis, exception review, and incident escalation. Success requires deep technical breadth across enterprise platforms, strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, operational discipline, and the ability to collaborate with and influence technical teams without direct authority.

Key functions include but are not limited to:

  • Technical Lead – Change Orchestration & Execution: Serve as the technical lead for patch-related change orchestration and execution across the enterprise. Build and sequence automated deployment plans, maintenance windows, dependencies, and rollback procedures; prepare and submit change records; and lead technical execution and bridge coordination during enterprise maintenance events. Coordinate remediation across products onto shared maintenance windows so that systems are touched once rather than repeatedly, reducing end-user disruption and change collisions.
  • AI-Based Vulnerability & Patch Analysis: Leverage AI-enabled tools, analytics, and automation to analyze vulnerability scan data, threat intelligence, and patch release information; correlate findings to assets and service owners; predict deployment risk and service impact; identify remediation trends, recurring failures, and root causes; and produce data-driven prioritization recommendations. Ensure AI-generated outputs are validated and used in alignment with BTS security, data, and responsible AI standards.
  • Exception Review & Risk Validation: Perform technical review of patch and vulnerability exception requests, validating business justification, compensating controls, residual risk, and remediation timelines. Provide technical recommendations to the Sr. Manager and Cybersecurity, track exceptions to expiration, and ensure exceptions are re-evaluated and closed in alignment with governance expectations.
  • Incident Escalation & Response: Act as the escalation point for patch-related incidents, failed deployments, and service degradation following maintenance activities. Triage issues, engage appropriate resolver groups, coordinate rollback or remediation actions, escalate critical issues to technology leadership, and participate in post-incident and problem management reviews to prevent recurrence.
  • Offshore Execution Pod Technical Direction: Provide day-to-day technical direction to the offshore execution pod, including remediation wave planning and handoffs, automated testing execution, ticket queue prioritization, evidence quality, and off-hours execution readiness; review pod work for accuracy and completeness.
  • Vulnerability Remediation Execution: Partner with teams to drive technical remediation of critical, high, medium, and low vulnerabilities, hardening items, and posture management findings across every device on the network within established SLAs.
  • Code Remediation Influence & Enablement: Partner with product owners to influence, prioritize, and drive code changes required to remediate vulnerabilities. Champion and leverage AI-based tools to facilitate code analysis, development of remediation recommendations, and validation of proposed fixes, working with product owners to drive implementation within established remediation SLAs.
  • Service Validation and Post-Patch Checkout: Lead tiered service health validation following remediation — from enterprise up/downs to basic and comprehensive automated validation — partnering with product owners and stakeholder teams who define what healthy looks like. Confirm operational readiness, capture remediation evidence, and implement new tests when disruption reveals gaps in coverage.
  • Automation and Tooling: Partner with SRE and DevOps team, Platform Engineering, and product owners to design, build, and enhance automated checkout and validation, remediation orchestration, deployment pipelines, and evidence collection using enterprise tools and scripting.
  • Reporting and Compliance Support: Review and analyze reporting prepared by the offshore execution pod on patch compliance, vulnerability aging, SLA adherence, deployment success rates, exception status, and incident trends, providing technical insight to support management and executive reporting.
  • Documentation and Continuous Improvement: Develop and maintain technical runbooks, standard operating procedures, and knowledge articles; identify opportunities to improve patching reliability, reduce deployment risk, and increase automation coverage.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Equivalent experience and/or alternative qualifications will be considered.
  • 5+ years of technical experience
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise patch management, vulnerability remediation, systems engineering, or infrastructure operations
  • Experience leading technical execution of enterprise change and maintenance activities across multiple platforms
  • Hands-on experience with patch and vulnerability tooling
  • Experience applying AI, analytics, or automation tools to operational or security data
  • Working knowledge of public cloud platforms and modern data, integration, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, and cybersecurity practices.

Core Skills/Competencies:

  • Patch Management Engineering (P) - plans, sequences, and executes enterprise patch deployments safely and consistently.
  • Vulnerability Management (P) - analyzes findings, prioritizes remediation, and drives SLA compliance.
  • Change Orchestration & Execution (P) - leads technical change planning, implementation, validation, and rollback across platforms.
  • AI and Data Analysis (P) - applies AI-based tools and analytics to vulnerability, patch, and operational data to inform prioritization and decisions.
  • Risk and Exception Analysis (P) - evaluates exposure, compensating controls, and residual risk to support exception decisions.
  • Incident Management (P) - triages, escalates, and coordinates resolution of patch-related incidents.
  • Automation and Scripting (N) - improves deployment reliability, reporting, and evidence collection.

Full job description

Job Description

Title: Health Reinsurance Actuarial Leader, Managed Care Analytics and Advisory

Location: Flexible - United States

About the Role

In this role, you will serve as a senior client-facing leader, blending deep health actuarial expertise, managed care knowledge, and strategic insight. You will lead a team of actuaries and analysts delivering advanced analytics that shape risk strategies in the healthcare industry, including provider risk arrangements, health insurer reinsurance strategies, and employer stop loss.

You will help clients understand the nature of the risk they face, how that risk shifts in different scenarios, and how to structure risk transfer and mitigation solutions that are aligned with their strategic, operational, and financial objectives. You will also oversee traditional stop loss and reinsurance placement analyses. This role carries significant responsibility for client leadership, team development, innovation, and business growth in the US market.

Key Responsibilities

Client Leadership & Strategic Advisory

  • Serve as the lead actuarial and analytics advisor for a portfolio of US-based health plan and healthcare provider clients.
  • Shape client risk strategies for commercial value-based care arrangements and CMS ACO programs, including upside/downside risk contracts, global budgets, and other alternative payment models.
  • Translate complex actuarial and financial analyses into clear, concise, and actionable recommendations for C-suite and senior leadership audiences.
  • Lead executive-level client meetings and presentations, representing Aon as a trusted advisor and thought leader in the managed care and value-based care space.

Value-Based Care & Risk Analytics

  • Direct the design and review of models to project utilization, cost, and performance distributions under value-based contracts and ACO arrangements.
  • Oversee analyses of historical and prospective performance, including scenario and sensitivity testing around contract parameters, population characteristics, and care management interventions.
  • Quantify the financial impact of alternative program designs (e.g., shared savings vs. full risk, partial vs. full capitation, global budgets) and advise on contract structure selection.
  • Integrate quality, utilization, cost, and operational inputs to support clients in making informed, data-driven strategic decisions.
  • Lead the development of standardized frameworks, tools, and best practices for value-based care analytics across the practice.

Reinsurance Analytics

  • Oversee health reinsurance and stop loss placement strategy
  • Articulate cost-benefit tradeoffs of various risk transfer structures
  • Develop innovative health risk solutions including emerging risks
  • Provide technical negotiation support with reinsurers and carriers

Leadership, Talent Development & Technical Oversight

  • Lead and develop a team of junior actuaries and analysts, providing coaching, feedback, and career development guidance.
  • Set expectations and standards for actuarial rigor, documentation, and peer review, ensuring that all work meets Aon's quality and professional standards.
  • Oversee multiple concurrent projects and workstreams, ensuring timely, high-quality delivery and a positive client experience.
  • Encourage experimentation with new methods, data sources, and tools, while maintaining appropriate controls and governance.

Growth, Innovation & Business Development

  • Play a key role in business development activities including pipeline management, go-to-market strategies, proposal development, and pitch meetings.
  • Contribute to and help shape Aon's intellectual capital and solution portfolio in the managed care and value-based care domains, including participation in thought leadership, external speaking, and publishing as appropriate.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive health actuarial experience at leading actuarial consulting firms, health insurers, provider-sponsored plans, or similar organizations.
  • Deep expertise in the US managed care environment, including commercial and government programs, with substantial hands-on experience in value-based payment models and/or ACO arrangements.
  • Demonstrated leadership of complex actuarial projects involving value-based contracts, shared savings/shared risk arrangements, capitation, and/or global budgets.

Job Summary

The Sr. Manager, Product Marketing will lead the digital customer experience strategy for Farmers' product solutions. This role will partner with enterprise stakeholders to define product strategies, enhance customer experiences, and drive digital innovation across the organization.This individual will serve as a bridge between business, marketing, product, and technology teams, identifying opportunities to improve customer engagement, optimize digital experiences, and bring innovative solutions to market. The role requires a strategic thinker who can navigate ambiguity, influence cross-functional stakeholders, build business cases, and lead initiatives from concept through execution.

A key focus of the position will be evaluating emerging technologies and digital capabilities that can enable customer experience transformation while supporting both short- and long-term business objectives. The successful candidate will combine strategic vision with strong execution skills, helping shape the future of Farmers' digital customer journey and product experience ecosystem.

Essential Tasks & Leadership Philosophy

  • Lead the vision, strategy, and application of digital product solutions, leveraging emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Augmented Reality/Virtual Reality (AR/VR), Connected Devices, and evolving product development methodologies.
  • Identify, evaluate, and scope enterprise opportunities, including the development and delivery of prototypes, proofs of concept (POCs), and minimum viable products (MVPs).
  • Drive key customer experience transformation initiatives by leading cross-functional teams, prioritizing work across product backlogs, and delivering solutions that align with Farmers' customer experience standards and business objectives.
  • Foster a culture of innovation by promoting a test-and-learn mindset and enabling new capabilities through experimentation and continuous improvement.
  • Effectively engage and influence executive leadership by presenting strategic recommendations, facilitating decision-making, and driving alignment across stakeholder groups.
  • Partner with enterprise stakeholders to gather business requirements and develop detailed use cases, customer journeys, and user stories that support strategic objectives.
  • Collaborate closely with Technology, Operations, and business partners to develop, manage, and execute product roadmaps that address customer needs and deliver measurable business value.
  • Serve as the bridge between business objectives and technology solutions, ensuring tools, processes, and methodologies align with Marketing and Customer Strategy goals.
  • Lead all aspects of product development and implementation, including strategy, requirements definition, prototyping, testing, training, communications, support planning, and deployment.
  • Monitor innovation trends within the insurance industry and adjacent sectors to identify opportunities that can enhance digital experiences and drive competitive advantage.
  • Develop competitive analyses and benchmarks to evaluate potential enhancements, quantify benefits, and support investment decisions.
  • Assess emerging technologies and leverage customer, market, and performance data to identify opportunities for innovation and customer experience optimization.
  • Recommend and prioritize short- and long-term product investments and roadmap initiatives that align with Customer Strategy, Marketing objectives, and enterprise priorities.
  • Conduct competitive landscape assessments to inform product strategy, customer experience enhancements, and go-to-market planning.
  • Establish measurement frameworks, success metrics, and reporting requirements to evaluate program effectiveness and ensure successful delivery and ongoing performance management.
  • Analyze and report on digital experience, product, and marketing performance metrics, providing actionable insights and recommendations to business leaders and key stakeholders.

First Year Success Factors

  • Establish yourself as the trusted leader for digital customer experience initiatives by building strong partnerships across Marketing, Product, Technology, Underwriting, Operations, and Sales.
  • Lead the optimization of Farmers' digital quote-and-buy experience, driving enhancements that improve customer outcomes, increase digital production, and create a more seamless end-to-end customer journey.
  • Develop and execute a prioritized product roadmap that delivers measurable improvements in customer engagement, conversion, customer satisfaction, and business performance.
  • Identify, evaluate, and implement innovative solutions and emerging technologies that enhance the customer experience and support enterprise growth objectives.
  • Drive complex cross-functional initiatives from concept through implementation, aligning stakeholders, influencing decisions, and delivering measurable business value.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization.
  • Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, establish priorities, and drive initiatives from concept through implementation.
  • Demonstrated strength in stakeholder management, organizational influence, and building alignment across diverse teams.
  • Strategic thinker with a customer-centric mindset and a passion for innovation, continuous improvement, and measurable business impact.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Information Systems, Product Management, Digital Strategy, or a related field required.
  • Master's degree (MBA or related discipline) preferred.
  • Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will be considered.
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in Product Marketing, Product Management, Digital Strategy, Customer Experience, Marketing Technology, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience leading digital customer experience initiatives and partnering across business and technology organizations to deliver customer-centric solutions.
  • Proven success developing product strategies, business cases, roadmaps, and requirements that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional programs and influencing stakeholders across matrixed organizations without direct authority.
  • Strong background translating customer insights, business needs, and market opportunities into actionable product enhancements and customer experience improvements.
  • Experience evaluating, implementing, or supporting emerging technology solutions, including AI, automation, personalization, digital platforms, or other customer experience enabling capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to define success metrics, analyze performance data, and leverage insights to optimize customer engagement, digital adoption, and business performance.
  • Experience working within insurance, financial services, banking, or other highly regulated industries preferred.
  • Experience supporting digital quote, purchase, enrollment, self-service, or customer acquisition platforms strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of Agile methodologies, user story development, backlog prioritization, and digital product delivery practices preferred.

Job Summary

Farmers Insurance is seeking a Technology Auditor to support high‑quality technology audits as part of our transformation to a modern, risk‑focused Internal Audit function. This role is hands‑on and execution‑focused, with primary responsibility for technology control testing, evidence evaluation, and audit documentation across IT and cyber risk areas.

What You'll Do

  • Lead discussions with technology and business stakeholders to understand the objectives, processes, systems, data flows, key risks, and control environment associated with the area under review, and challenge assumptions where necessary.
  • Independently identify and assess technology risks, evaluate key controls, and help shape audit scope, testing strategies, and evidence requirements using a risk-based approach.
  • Execute technology audits across cybersecurity, identity and access management, applications, cloud, infrastructure, data, and emerging technology domains.
  • Perform stakeholder discussions, evaluate process and control design, and identify gaps, inconsistencies, or emerging risks by asking effective "why" and "how" questions.
  • Gather, evaluate, and challenge the completeness, reliability, and relevance of evidence obtained through interviews, system reports, configurations, logs, tickets, analytics, and other audit procedures.
  • Apply professional judgment and skepticism throughout the audit by assessing whether evidence supports management's assertions and investigating anomalies, exceptions, and conflicting information.
  • Own assigned audit areas from planning through reporting, proactively managing activities, stakeholder requests, dependencies, and timelines while escalating risks and blockers promptly.
  • Work in iterative audit cycles, continuously reassessing risks, adjusting testing approaches, and incorporating feedback as new information emerges.
  • Prepare high-quality workpapers that clearly document procedures performed, evidence reviewed, judgments applied, and conclusions reached in accordance with Internal Audit methodology and quality standards.
  • Identify, evaluate, and develop audit issues by determining root causes, assessing business and technology impacts, validating facts with stakeholders, and recommending practical corrective actions.
  • Clearly communicate risks, observations, and audit conclusions to stakeholders at various levels, translating technical issues into business-relevant risk implications.
  • Participate actively in audit team reviews, challenge sessions, showcases, and quality discussions, providing constructive challenge to strengthen audit outcomes.
  • Leverage approved analytics, automation, and AI-enabled tools responsibly to improve audit effectiveness, insight generation, and efficiency while maintaining accountability for audit conclusions.
  • Assess the design and effectiveness of remediation activities and validate that corrective actions appropriately address underlying risks and root causes.
  • Continuously expand expertise in technology, cybersecurity, emerging technologies, audit methodology, risk management, and industry practices through ongoing learning and professional development.

Essential Job Functions

  • Leads audit engagements with minimal supervision - on time and in a quality manner.
  • Preparation of reports and communication with the business.
  • Administrative duties supporting departmental activities, individual development plan, training, performance management, and general administration.
  • Participates in departmental special projects.

Physical Actions

This role, whether performed virtually or in an office setting, will include normal and customary distractions, noise, and interruptions. Sits or stands for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift. Occasionally reaches overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Occasionally moves, lifts, carries, and places objects and supplies weighing 0-10 pounds without assistance. Listens to, interprets, and differentiates auditory information (example others speaking) at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Visually verifies and reads information. Visually locates material, resources and other objects. Ability to continuously operate a computer for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift. Physical dexterity sufficient to use hands, arms, and shoulders repetitively to operate keyboard and other office equipment up to a full work shift.

Education Requirements

High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred. Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), CISA, or other comparable designation preferred.

Experience Requirements

Five or more years experience in Auditing at an external firm or financial services firm, or seven years experience with Farmers Insurance and/or one year as a Farmers Insurance Auditor. Detailed subject matter expertise of at least one area of the business or industry.

Special Skill Requirement

Strong analytical skills. Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong project management skills. Ability to effectively communicate with individuals in the business.

Benefits

Quick facts

  • Location: Phoenix, AZ

About this job

Territory Sales Manager for National General Insurance in Phoenix, managing sales to independent agents and driving profitable growth across home, auto, and specialty insurance products. Position requires field work four days per week and five or more years of sales experience.

Good fit if you have insurance sales experience, can build relationships with agents, and live in the greater Phoenix area.

Full job description

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

The Territory Sales Manager is responsible for consistently exceeding agreed upon new business production, direct written premium, and loss ratio goals, and other KPIs on an annual basis by effectively managing the agents of an assigned market to increase company market share by driving profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Positions and promotes full suite of National General Insurance products into Independent Agency Partners to include, multiple personal auto products, homeowners, commercial vehicle, flood, and recreational vehicle & key focus on Specialty Vehicle & Household package coverages (based on state availability

Delivers on the business units annual execution plan (growth, profitability, agency engagement, new appointments) for their market with focus on Specialty Vehicle & Household package coverages under the guidance of a Regional Sales Manager and/or Director

Key company liaison within assigned market to both independent agencies and industry associations and must be field facing 4 days per week, driving key business initiatives, maintaining accurate records of these sales activities, client interactions, and follow-ups in CRM software

Collaborates with Independent Agents to assist with creation of agency-specific short term and long-term strategic business plans, periodically reviews and suggests adjustments as necessary to achieve results

Role uses full suite of production data and reporting to identify trends, capitalize on opportunity and regularly address agency level performance including training / skill gap to execute on business plan

Territory Sales Manager handles increasing the quote and issuance flow of assigned market beyond the rate and Underwriting trends filed and implemented in the market

Consults with IAs by having a strong knowledge of the independent agency channel, including industry competitors, major brokers and national industry associations to gather market intel to help promote and position National General products and/or make market enhancement to align with industry opportunity

Position is responsible for product/user integration with industry technology and comparative rating platforms within market and assigned agencies

Collaborates with Product, Pricing, Operations to perform stakeholder (agency) and risk analysis on market related issues

Develops and maintains the assigned markets new agency appointment pipeline, supports National Accounts & Alternative Distribution Initiatives to implement corporate agreements at the local market level & coach new TSMs


Candidates must reside in the greater Phoenix, AZ area


Experience

5 or more years of experience (Preferred)


Supervisory Responsibilities

This job does not have supervisory duties.


Skills

Consultative Selling, Insurance Products, Relationship Building, Strategic Collaboration, Territory Sales Management

Compensation

Base salary: $95,000 - $104,000 plus incentives based on performance
