Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Boise, ID

About this job

Associate Attorney role handling moderately complex civil litigation and workers compensation matters for Liberty Mutual Insurance. Position is primarily remote in Idaho with management of cases from inception through resolution, including discovery, trials, and mediations.

Good fit if you are admitted to the Idaho bar, have knowledge of insurance and workers compensation law, and can work independently on case management.

Full job description


Description

This role is primarily remote in the state of Idaho except for required appearances.

At Liberty Mutual, were committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders rights and positively impacting our business. As an Associate Attorney at Liberty Mutual, youll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligibleperformance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If yourelooking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where youll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual Insurance offers an engaging opportunity for an Associate Attorney to represent the company and its policyholders in routine civil litigation and workers compensation matters involving moderately complex legal issues and claims for monetary damages or compensation related to personal injury or property damage. Under moderate supervision, you will manage cases from inception through resolution, applying your legal knowledge, research skills, and client relationship capabilities in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Execution: Manage all phases of litigation, including discovery, hearings, trials, mediations, and drafting legal documents such as pleadings and motions. Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide clear and reasoned legal opinions and strategic advice to Claims Representatives and insured clients. Develop and maintain strong client relationships through transparent and effective communication.
  • Technology Utilization: Utilize e-discovery and case management technologies to streamline legal processes, improve efficiency, and reduce operational costs. Demonstrate effective coordination with remote team members and proficiency in remote work settings.
  • Risk Evaluation and Case Resolution Facilitation: Identify, evaluate, and collaborate on strategies to mitigate legal risks, working closely with clients and senior counsel to facilitate effective resolutions.
  • Documentation Accuracy and Compliance: Ensure all legal documents, pleadings, and motions are meticulously prepared, accurate, and compliant with applicable standards and client expectations.
  • Timely Client Communication: Provide clear, consistent, and timely updates and recommendations to insured clients and claims professionals to maintain alignment with case objectives.
  • Contribution to Organizational Improvement: Participate in initiatives aimed at enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and best practices within Staff Legal and Global Legal & Compliance organizations.
  • Ethical Compliance Adherence: Uphold the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance, following legal regulations and licensing requirements and promoting a culture of integrity within the legal team.
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in Idahoand in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • General knowledge of insurance law, and as necessary, workers compensation and/or No Fault law.
  • Proficient in e-discovery, case management systems, and basic legal analysis tools.
  • Strong analytical, research, and legal writing skills.
  • Basic knowledge of negotiation techniques including preparation, active listening, and problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cases from start to finish under supervision.
  • Effective communication and persuasion skills, both written and oral.
  • Ability to collaborate with clients, claims professionals, and senior attorneys.
  • Organized, process-oriented with strong time management skills.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://LMI.co/Benefits

This role is primarily remote in the state of Idaho except for required appearances.

At Liberty Mutual, were committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders rights and positively impacting our business. As an Associate Attorney at Liberty Mutual, youll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligibleperformance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If yourelooking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where youll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual Insurance offers an engaging opportunity for an Associate Attorney to represent the company and its policyholders in routine civil litigation and workers compensation matters involving moderately complex legal issues and claims for monetary damages or compensation related to personal injury or property damage. Under moderate supervision, you will manage cases from inception through resolution, applying your legal knowledge, research skills, and client relationship capabilities in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Execution: Manage all phases of litigation, including discovery, hearings, trials, mediations, and drafting legal documents such as pleadings and motions. Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide clear and reasoned legal opinions and strategic advice to Claims Representatives and insured clients. Develop and maintain strong client relationships through transparent and effective communication.
  • Technology Utilization: Utilize e-discovery and case management technologies to streamline legal processes, improve efficiency, and reduce operational costs. Demonstrate effective coordination with remote team members and proficiency in remote work settings.
  • Risk Evaluation and Case Resolution Facilitation: Identify, evaluate, and collaborate on strategies to mitigate legal risks, working closely with clients and senior counsel to facilitate effective resolutions.
  • Documentation Accuracy and Compliance: Ensure all legal documents, pleadings, and motions are meticulously prepared, accurate, and compliant with applicable standards and client expectations.
  • Timely Client Communication: Provide clear, consistent, and timely updates and recommendations to insured clients and claims professionals to maintain alignment with case objectives.
  • Contribution to Organizational Improvement: Participate in initiatives aimed at enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and best practices within Staff Legal and Global Legal & Compliance organizations.
  • Ethical Compliance Adherence: Uphold the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance, following legal regulations and licensing requirements and promoting a culture of integrity within the legal team.
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in Idahoand in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • General knowledge of insurance law, and as necessary, workers compensation and/or No Fault law.
  • Proficient in e-discovery, case management systems, and basic legal analysis tools.
  • Strong analytical, research, and legal writing skills.
  • Basic knowledge of negotiation techniques including preparation, active listening, and problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cases from start to finish under supervision.
  • Effective communication and persuasion skills, both written and oral.
  • Ability to collaborate with clients, claims professionals, and senior attorneys.
  • Organized, process-oriented with strong time management skills.

About this job

Manage a commercial insurance territory with 100+ agencies, driving profitable premium growth and building agent partnerships. Lead end-to-end account management across a broad product portfolio, with significant field presence and cross-functional collaboration.

Good fit if you have six-plus years of insurance sales and management experience, thrive on relationship building, and are willing to travel extensively in your territory.

Full job description


Description

We are seeking a results-drivenBusiness Lines Senior Territory Managerto own and lead a defined geographic territory, driving profitable premium growth and strong agency performance across a broad commercial product portfolio. In this highly visible role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to independent agents and brokers, balancing day-to-day small commercial flow with strategic pursuit of targeted larger accounts. Youll leverage deep relationship management, data-driven strategy, and cross-functional collaboration to optimize territory performance and achieve financial and operational objectives.

This is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned insurance professional who thrives in the field, enjoys building long-term partnerships, and wants to make a meaningful impact within a dynamic commercial insurance organization.

Key Responsibilities:

Territory & Agency Ownership

  • Own and manage an assigned geographic territory, driving profitable growth and achieving written premium, profitability, and operational targets.
  • Lead comprehensive agency management activities, including prospecting, business planning, engagement, training, compensation, and agency plant optimization.
  • Manage a large and diverse agency footprint (100+ storefronts), optimizing performance across the territory.

Agency Partnership & Business Development

  • Independently build and sustain strong, mutually beneficial relationships with agency owners, leadership, and frontline staff through primarily in-person engagement, supplemented by virtual and digital channels.
  • Establish credibility as a trusted advisor by delivering product expertise, underwriting philosophy, appetite guidance, and system training.
  • Support retention initiatives and new business development to deepen agency relationships and maximize revenue.

Commercial Lines & Portfolio Management

  • Focus on commercial business lines, working across a broad range of products, coverages, and market appetite.
  • Drive consistent flow of small commercial business while strategically engaging agents and brokers on targeted mid-to-larger accounts.
  • Manage the account pipeline end-to-end, including renewals, and collaborate across multiple underwriting segments to ensure strong outcomes.
  • Ensure appropriate book mix, risk quality, and overall profitability at both the agency and territory level.

Strategy, Execution & Analytics

  • Develop, execute, and continuously refine high-quality agency and territory strategies aligned to enterprise Personal Lines and Business Lines priorities.
  • Support strategic initiatives such as carrier consolidation (book transfers), agency expansion, service center integration, and new product or program rollouts.
  • Utilize internal and external tools, programs, and data analytics to inform decisions, monitor performance, and identify growth opportunities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner closely with underwriting, product management, claims, and risk control teams to identify opportunities, resolve issues, and share competitive and market intelligence.
  • Act as the voice of the agent and customer within the organization.
  • Collaborate with Personal Lines and Business Lines counterparts on shared agency relationships.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to peers and team members, contributing to continuous improvement and best practices.

What Youll Bring

  • Proven experience managing agency relationships and driving profitable growth within commercial insurance.
  • Strong consultative, relationship-building, and influencing skills.
  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision while managing complex priorities.
  • Comfort leveraging data, tools, and insights to guide territory and agency strategies.
  • Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory for in-person agency engagement.

Why Join Us:

  • Ownership of a high-impact territory with autonomy to shape strategy and results.
  • Opportunity to work across a broad commercial product portfolio with strong internal support.
  • Collaborative culture that values innovation, insight, and leadership.
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and long-term career growth opportunities
Qualifications

Bachelor`s Degree or equivalent industry experience.
Minimum six years of progressively more responsible insurance sales and management work experience.
Advanced knowledge of company services, products, marketing techniques, insurance contracts, risk funding and rating plans, and industry trends.
Proven track record of revenue growth and sales success in a prior role.
Proven success in developing and building partnerships, decision making and problem solving.
Advanced knowledge of the business including production management, claims, loss prevention, underwriting, administration, sales operations and agency business operations.
Highly effective written and oral communication skills, including presentation, persuasion, timing, tact and negotiation skills.
High degree of customer focus, interpersonal relationship skills and problem solving.
Advanced analytical thinking, business analytics and business development skills.
Strong time management and team orientation skills.
Well versed understanding of marketing principles.
Must be licensed by the state if required.
Ability to travel daily with occasional overnight travel.
Appropriate driving record required to operate a company vehicle.

Remote inside sales representative for Liberty Mutual handling inbound insurance calls and warm leads. Free P&C license training provided with paid training time, 16-18 week training period, and work-from-home option available.

Good fit if you have 2+ years sales or service experience, strong sales and communication skills, and reliable high-speed internet at home.

Full job description


Description

Apply Today Training Classes Begins in January 2027!

Looking for a career in insurance? Join our Inside Sales team and get free P&C license training with paid training time. Start your rewarding career today!

Key Date:

  • Unlicensed Class: January 25, 2027
  • Licensed Class: January 11, 2027

Start your journey with us and build a career where your talent and passion for helping others truly make an impact.

As an Inside Sales Representative at Liberty Mutual, youll have the tools, training and support you need to succeed from day one.

Plus, youll enjoy:

  • Generous earning potential
  • Paid licensing and training opportunities
  • Comprehensive benefits
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Strong work-life balance
  • And more!

Why Liberty Mutual?

Pay Details:

  • Starting base salary is $45K with opportunity for growth.
  • Average earnings range from $55K-$75K through a combination of base salary and generouscommission.
  • Top Performing Agents in their second year and onward, can earn up to $85k+.

We are currently hiring quality Inbound sales professionals in the following states:AR, AZ, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NE, NH, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, andWV

Licensed only candidates based in ID, MT, WY, GA, TN, AL, OK, KS and KY Applicants must reside within these specified locations to be considered for this role.

Positivity. Flexibility. Determination and a persuasive personality. Qualities like these cannot be taught. But they can be sharpened, strengthened, and appropriately compensated when you join Liberty Mutual Insurance as a part of our Contact Center Sales Organization. Bring your unique sales talent to our Fortune 100 company and receive paid-training, licensing in all 50 states, and a dynamic role that directs only warm leads your way (no cold calls) because we believe in supporting your success, not holding it back. Join our sales team and realize the rewards of a career with unlimited earning potential, generous commissions, and a portfolio of benefits that start on day one.

Job Details

As an Inside Sales Agent you will be handling inbound calls and warm leads, consulting with customers on their insurance needs and match the correct coverages, products, and benefits to convert sales leads into policyholders.

Due to state licensing restrictions, employees must remain in their resident state for at least one year before relocating.

Youd be a great fit if you are:

A Passionate Seller:When a lead comes in, you skillfully pick up the phone and use your sales expertise to turn prospects into happy, confident Liberty Mutualpolicyholders.

A Front Lines Liaison:You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in what youre selling, and you enjoy connecting customers to the right products for their individual needs.

A Reliable Teammate:Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules, and the varying needs of ourpolicyholders.

A Customer-Centric Closer:While sales is in your title, integrity is in your nature. That means you sincerely care that our customers get exactly the quality products and services they need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

Position Details:

From day one you will begin paid training in a remote work environment. All insurance representatives need to hold a Property & Casualty Insurance license. If you do not have one, no worries, paid training also includes licensing!

  • Training extends over a period of 16 weeks for licensed hires and 18 weeks for unlicensed hires.
  • Comprehensive medical benefits from Day 1.
  • No cold calls, all incoming warm leads.
  • Opportunities for rewards and recognition.

  • Must be available to work a schedule of 4 weekdays and 1 weekend day. Standard shift is 11:30-8 EST, 12:30-9 CST, or 8:30-5 PST.

  • All computer equipment is provided. Youmust be able to maintain department.Work at home (W@H) requirements whichinclude a professional workspace/room with adedicated desk and wired (cable, fiber of DSLservice) high-speed internet connection with aminimum 100 MBps download speed and 20MBps upload speed. Liberty Mutual does notsupport satellite and mobile internet services.
Qualifications
  • 2-3 years sales experience preferred. 2 yearsof sales/service-related work experiencerequired.
  • Strong, engaging interpersonal and persuasion skills needed to close sales.
  • Ability to communicate well to both prospects and customers.
  • Excellent analytical, decision-making and organizational skills.
  • Strong typing capabilities and PC proficiency.
  • Property and Casualty Insurance License. Training will be provided if you do not currently hold a license.

Description

Apply Today Training Classes Begins in January 2027!

Looking for a career in insurance? Join our Inside Sales team and get free P&C license training with paid training time. Start your rewarding career today!

Key Date:

  • Unlicensed Class: January 25, 2027

Start your journey with us and build a career where your talent and passion for helping others truly make an impact.

As an Inside Sales Representative at Liberty Mutual, youll have the tools, training and support you need to succeed from day one.

Plus, youll enjoy:

  • Generous earning potential

  • Strong work-life balance
  • And more!

Why Liberty Mutual?

  • Starting base salary is $45K with opportunity for growth.

We are currently hiring quality Inbound sales professionals in the following states:AR, AZ, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NE, NH, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, andWV

Licensed only candidates based in ID, MT, WY, GA, TN, AL, OK, KS and KY Applicants must reside within these specified locations to be considered for this role.

Positivity. Flexibility. Determination and a persuasive personality. Qualities like these cannot be taught. But they can be sharpened, strengthened, and appropriately compensated when you join Liberty Mutual Insurance as a part of our Contact Center Sales Organization. Bring your unique sales talent to our Fortune 100 company and receive paid-training, licensing in all 50 states, and a dynamic role that directs only warm leads your way (no cold calls) because we believe in supporting your success, not holding it back. Join our sales team and realize the rewards of a career with unlimited earning potential, generous commissions, and a portfolio of benefits that start on day one.

Job Details

As an Inside Sales Agent you will be handling inbound calls and warm leads, consulting with customers on their insurance needs and match the correct coverages, products, and benefits to convert sales leads into policyholders.

Due to state licensing restrictions, employees must remain in their resident state for at least one year before relocating.

Youd be a great fit if you are:

A Passionate Seller:When a lead comes in, you skillfully pick up the phone and use your sales expertise to turn prospects into happy, confident Liberty Mutualpolicyholders.

A Front Lines Liaison:You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in what youre selling, and you enjoy connecting customers to the right products for their individual needs.

A Reliable Teammate:Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules, and the varying needs of ourpolicyholders.

A Customer-Centric Closer:While sales is in your title, integrity is in your nature. That means you sincerely care that our customers get exactly the quality products and services they need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

Position Details:

From day one you will begin paid training in a remote work environment. All insurance representatives need to hold a Property & Casualty Insurance license. If you do not have one, no worries, paid training also includes licensing!

  • Training extends over a period of 16 weeks for licensed hires and 18 weeks for unlicensed hires.
  • Comprehensive medical benefits from Day 1.
  • No cold calls, all incoming warm leads.
  • Opportunities for rewards and recognition.

  • Must be available to work a schedule of 4 weekdays and 1 weekend day. Standard shift is 11:30-8 EST, 12:30-9 CST, or 8:30-5 PST.

  • All computer equipment is provided. Youmust be able to maintain department.Work at home (W@H) requirements whichinclude a professional workspace/room with adedicated desk and wired (cable, fiber of DSLservice) high-speed internet connection with aminimum 100 MBps download speed and 20MBps upload speed. Liberty Mutual does notsupport satellite and mobile internet services.
Qualifications
  • 2-3 years sales experience preferred. 2 yearsof sales/service-related work experiencerequired.
  • Strong, engaging interpersonal and persuasion skills needed to close sales.
  • Ability to communicate well to both prospects and customers.
  • Excellent analytical, decision-making and organizational skills.
  • Strong typing capabilities and PC proficiency.
  • Property and Casualty Insurance License. Training will be provided if you do not currently hold a license.

Description

At Liberty Mutualyoull join a company devoted to helping people live safer, more secure lives. We partner with independent agents nationwide to deliver exceptional property and casualty products, and were deeply committed to supporting the communities where we live and work. As part of a team that values collaboration, integrity, and a diverse workforce, you will have the opportunity to do meaningful work that makes a real impact every day.

We are seeking a Senior Territory Manager to lead profitable premium growth and strengthen Liberty Mutual's market presence within an assigned territory. In this high-visibility, relationship-driven role, you will cultivate strong partnerships with independent agents, guide strategic business planning, and collaborate closely with underwriting and internal teams to drive long-term success.

What Youll Do

Territory & Agency Leadership

  • Own and manage a designated territory with accountability for profitable growth and achievement of financial and operational targets.
  • Lead all aspects of territory and agency managementincluding agency prospecting, business planning, engagement, training, compensation discussions, and optimization of agency distribution.

Agency Partnership & Development

  • Build strong, mutually beneficial relationships with agency owners, leaders, and frontline staff through consistent in-person engagement.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by delivering training on products, underwriting philosophy, appetite, and systems to support retention, new business production, and deeper agency partnerships.
  • Develop and execute high-quality agency strategies and plans aligned with key Personal Lines or Business Lines goals, such as carrier consolidation, agency plant expansion, service center adoption, and new program launches.

Growth, Profitability & Risk Management

  • Drive high-quality new business flow and ensure an appropriate mix of business and risk across individual agencies and the broader territory.
  • Provide clear guidance on appetite and target markets, identify profitability concerns, and take proactive steps to support agency success and ensure sustained profitability.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with underwriting, product management, claims, and risk control teams to identify opportunities, solve challenges, and share competitive and industry insights.
  • Collaborate with Personal Lines or Business Lines colleagues to support shared agency assignments and cohesive market strategy.

Tools, Programs & Leadership

  • Strategically leverage internal and external tools, marketing programs, and business development resources to support agency performance and growth.
  • Offer mentorship to peers, contribute to agency initiatives, and bring forward ideas that enhance team performance and continuous improvement.

What You Bring

  • Experience in territory management, agency distribution, or insurance sales leadership
  • Strong relationship-building, communication, and negotiation skills
  • Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and craft strategic action plans
  • Collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset
  • Willingness to travel within assigned territory

Why Youll Love Working Here

  • A mission-driven organization committed to protecting individuals and families
  • Inclusive culture that values diversity, equity, and belonging
  • Opportunities for career growth, professional development, and leadership exposure
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement programs, paid time off, and more
Qualifications

Bachelor`s Degree or equivalent industry experience.
Minimum six years of progressively more responsible insurance sales and management work experience.
Advanced knowledge of company services, products, marketing techniques, insurance contracts, risk funding and rating plans, and industry trends.
Proven track record of revenue growth and sales success in a prior role.
Proven success in developing and building partnerships, decision making and problem solving.
Advanced knowledge of the business including production management, claims, loss prevention, underwriting, administration, sales operations and agency business operations.
Highly effective written and oral communication skills, including presentation, persuasion, timing, tact and negotiation skills.
High degree of customer focus, interpersonal relationship skills and problem solving.
Advanced analytical thinking, business analytics and business development skills.
Strong time management and team orientation skills.
Well versed understanding of marketing principles.
Must be licensed by the state if required.
Ability to travel daily with occasional overnight travel.
Appropriate driving record required to operate a company vehicle.

Lead profitable premium growth and strengthen market presence in an assigned territory for Liberty Mutual's Personal Lines business. Build partnerships with independent agents, guide strategic planning, and collaborate with underwriting and internal teams to drive long-term success.

Good fit if you have six or more years of insurance sales and management experience, strong relationship and negotiation skills, and willingness to travel within territory.

Full job description


Description

At Liberty Mutualyoull join a company devoted to helping people live safer, more secure lives. We partner with independent agents nationwide to deliver exceptional property and casualty products, and were deeply committed to supporting the communities where we live and work. As part of a team that values collaboration, integrity, and a diverse workforce, you will have the opportunity to do meaningful work that makes a real impact every day.

We are seeking a Senior Territory Manager to lead profitable premium growth and strengthen Liberty Mutual's market presence within an assigned territory. In this high-visibility, relationship-driven role, you will cultivate strong partnerships with independent agents, guide strategic business planning, and collaborate closely with underwriting and internal teams to drive long-term success.

What Youll Do

Territory & Agency Leadership

  • Own and manage a designated territory with accountability for profitable growth and achievement of financial and operational targets.
  • Lead all aspects of territory and agency managementincluding agency prospecting, business planning, engagement, training, compensation discussions, and optimization of agency distribution.

Agency Partnership & Development

  • Build strong, mutually beneficial relationships with agency owners, leaders, and frontline staff through consistent in-person engagement.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by delivering training on products, underwriting philosophy, appetite, and systems to support retention, new business production, and deeper agency partnerships.
  • Develop and execute high-quality agency strategies and plans aligned with key Personal Lines or Business Lines goals, such as carrier consolidation, agency plant expansion, service center adoption, and new program launches.

Growth, Profitability & Risk Management

  • Drive high-quality new business flow and ensure an appropriate mix of business and risk across individual agencies and the broader territory.
  • Provide clear guidance on appetite and target markets, identify profitability concerns, and take proactive steps to support agency success and ensure sustained profitability.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with underwriting, product management, claims, and risk control teams to identify opportunities, solve challenges, and share competitive and industry insights.
  • Collaborate with Personal Lines or Business Lines colleagues to support shared agency assignments and cohesive market strategy.

Tools, Programs & Leadership

  • Strategically leverage internal and external tools, marketing programs, and business development resources to support agency performance and growth.
  • Offer mentorship to peers, contribute to agency initiatives, and bring forward ideas that enhance team performance and continuous improvement.

What You Bring

  • Experience in territory management, agency distribution, or insurance sales leadership
  • Strong relationship-building, communication, and negotiation skills
  • Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and craft strategic action plans
  • Collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset
  • Willingness to travel within assigned territory

Why Youll Love Working Here

  • A mission-driven organization committed to protecting individuals and families
  • Inclusive culture that values diversity, equity, and belonging
  • Opportunities for career growth, professional development, and leadership exposure
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement programs, paid time off, and more
Qualifications

Bachelor`s Degree or equivalent industry experience.
Minimum six years of progressively more responsible insurance sales and management work experience.
Advanced knowledge of company services, products, marketing techniques, insurance contracts, risk funding and rating plans, and industry trends.
Proven track record of revenue growth and sales success in a prior role.
Proven success in developing and building partnerships, decision making and problem solving.
Advanced knowledge of the business including production management, claims, loss prevention, underwriting, administration, sales operations and agency business operations.
Highly effective written and oral communication skills, including presentation, persuasion, timing, tact and negotiation skills.
High degree of customer focus, interpersonal relationship skills and problem solving.
Advanced analytical thinking, business analytics and business development skills.
Strong time management and team orientation skills.
Well versed understanding of marketing principles.
Must be licensed by the state if required.
Ability to travel daily with occasional overnight travel.
Appropriate driving record required to operate a company vehicle.

Job.JobTitle: Director I, Data Science- AI Products
Job.JobDescription:
Description

We are transforming commercial underwriting & claims processing with AI-assisted workflows that enable disciplined responsiveness for decision making at scale driving consistency, efficiency, and profitability across the business in GRS. The Global AI Products & Transformation Team sits within the Data Science Solutions department in Global Risk Solutions (GRS) and is responsible for building and scaling those AI-enabled automation products across all segments of the commercial business. Our AI-enabled products provide underwriting intelligence for decision making, and are being currently integrated into the system of engagement. We plan to scale these capabilities and more to rest of the business in near future. To support this effort, we are seeking an exceptional, hands-on data science manager to join our team. In this role, you will lead a small team of data scientists while remaining hands-on technically.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and evaluate GenAI solutions and agentic workflow automation systems
  • Build evaluation metrics and tools to assess GenAI systems performance, reliability, and safety
  • Identify core reusable capabilities within a particular use case and work with other teams to scale those capabilities across other franchises in the business
  • Collaborate with data scientists, AI & data engineers, and business partners to develop AI-enhanced decision-aid tools and drive strategic decision-making
  • Communicate complex technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Serve as a technical consultant on complex, high-impact projects
  • Recruit, manage and develop a team of data scientists and analysts

Qualifications & Skills

  • Strong foundational knowledge of data science and AI, combined with statistical knowledge for model diagnosis
  • Proven expertise in building agentic AI systems using LangChain/LangGraph for underwriting automation
  • Strong MLOps expertise across the complete data science lifecycle using MLFlow3/Databricks
  • Familiarity with GenAI evaluation methodologies and experience assessing AI workflows
  • Demonstrated ability to exchange ideas and convey complex information clearly and concisely
  • Ability to guide and mentor junior data scientists and analysts on the team
  • Proven ability to build and sustain relationships both within and beyond the department
  • Ability to translate analytical results into recommendations that influence team, department, and senior leadership decisions
  • Broad knowledge of the business and market context, in particular, commercial underwriting & claims workflows, and ability to prioritize work based on the value it generates.
  • Competencies typically acquired through a Ph.D. in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or another scientific field, plus a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience, a Masters degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience; or may be acquired through a Bachelors degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience.
Qualifications
  • Responsible for the management, technical oversight and development for a team of data science and advanced analytics staff.
  • Collaborates with business partners to develop tools and services such as modeling, dashboard development, and decision aids to drive strategic decision making.
  • Presents findings, shares insights, and makes recommendations that impact profitability, growth and/or customer satisfaction.
  • Provides tactical input on highly technically complex projects that drive change across function, SBU or Corporate Department.
  • Supervises and performs highly complex well-defined work, containing technical and creative predictive analytics projects.
  • Regularly engages with the data science community and leads cross functional working groups.

About this job

Manage data operations strategy and delivery for insurance pricing at Liberty Mutual's Seattle office. Lead the Modeling Data Solutions team through modernizing data architecture, pipelines, and governance across enterprise data warehouses and external vendors.

Good fit if you have 15+ years in data strategy, architecture, or warehousing, can influence senior stakeholders, and know cloud platforms like Snowflake and Databricks.

Full job description


Description

Owns the strategy and delivery of the training and calibration data the P&L vertical teams in US Data Science (USDS) and Product Delivery need for pricing. Leads the modernization of the departments data architecture to keep pace with the organizations growing needs.

Provides strategic and tactical direction for the department. This position requires deep knowledge of feature engineering and dataset preparation for data science, data architecture, and modern pipeline approaches, along with the proven ability to lead a large organization.

Leads and develops the teams within the Modeling Data Solutions (MDS) department. Oversees the sourcing of data from enterprise data warehouses and external vendors, including vendor data acquired to test potential new modeling features. Owns the process changes needed when new source systems come online, such as new policy or claims platforms. Directs the end-to-end pipelines team in modernizing existing MDS pipelines so that model-ready data can be delivered at the speed the P&L vertical teams need. Works closely with the Data Office and DAE to help shape the enterprise data strategy.

Oversees teams that serve as the data experts for their lines of business, explaining where the data comes from and how it was built, and working closely with data science partners on changes and improvements to the datasets.

Collaborates with USDS, ED&DS, Data Office, DAE, and Product Delivery in developing these solutions.

Qualifications
  • 15+ years coding experience in data strategy, analytics, data management, data warehousing, data architecture, data product ownership or unstructured data environments, and defining and executing data governance policies and procedures
  • Bachelor`s degree or equivalent experience required, MBA or advanced degree preferred
  • Experience working in a global, multicultural environment working across multiple geographies and business groups
  • Experience influencing senor level management and key stakeholders
  • Strong written and oral communication skills required
  • Familiarity with Agile practices
  • Familiarity with process management a plus
  • Working knowledge of cloud data platforms such as Snowflake and Databricks, and of AWS services including SageMaker
  • Experience sourcing, integrating, and governing data from enterprise data warehouses and external vendors
  • Strong understanding of data architecture, data pipelines, and data lineage practices
  • Ability to partner with data science, technology, and business stakeholders and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences
  • Familiarity with modern pipeline and orchestration tools such as dbt and Airflow

Owns the strategy and delivery of the training and calibration data the P&L vertical teams in US Data Science (USDS) and Product Delivery need for pricing. Leads the modernization of the departments data architecture to keep pace with the organizations growing needs.

Provides strategic and tactical direction for the department. This position requires deep knowledge of feature engineering and dataset preparation for data science, data architecture, and modern pipeline approaches, along with the proven ability to lead a large organization.

Leads and develops the teams within the Modeling Data Solutions (MDS) department. Oversees the sourcing of data from enterprise data warehouses and external vendors, including vendor data acquired to test potential new modeling features. Owns the process changes needed when new source systems come online, such as new policy or claims platforms. Directs the end-to-end pipelines team in modernizing existing MDS pipelines so that model-ready data can be delivered at the speed the P&L vertical teams need. Works closely with the Data Office and DAE to help shape the enterprise data strategy.

Oversees teams that serve as the data experts for their lines of business, explaining where the data comes from and how it was built, and working closely with data science partners on changes and improvements to the datasets.

Collaborates with USDS, ED&DS, Data Office, DAE, and Product Delivery in developing these solutions.

Qualifications
  • 15+ years coding experience in data strategy, analytics, data management, data warehousing, data architecture, data product ownership or unstructured data environments, and defining and executing data governance policies and procedures
  • Bachelor`s degree or equivalent experience required, MBA or advanced degree preferred
  • Experience working in a global, multicultural environment working across multiple geographies and business groups
  • Experience influencing senor level management and key stakeholders
  • Strong written and oral communication skills required
  • Familiarity with Agile practices
  • Familiarity with process management a plus
  • Working knowledge of cloud data platforms such as Snowflake and Databricks, and of AWS services including SageMaker
  • Experience sourcing, integrating, and governing data from enterprise data warehouses and external vendors
  • Strong understanding of data architecture, data pipelines, and data lineage practices
  • Ability to partner with data science, technology, and business stakeholders and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences
  • Familiarity with modern pipeline and orchestration tools such as dbt and Airflow

Job.JobTitle: Senior Director I, Modeling Data Pipelines
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Seattle, WA
  • Experience: 8+ years

About this job

Senior leader overseeing development of end-to-end data pipelines and feature store capabilities for insurance pricing models. Manages team of data analysts and MLOps specialists while setting strategy for modeling data across US Data Science teams.

Good fit if you have 8+ years in data science, analytics, or MLOps leadership and deep experience with dbt, Snowflake, and Databricks.

Full job description


Description

Leads the development and delivery of end-to-end data pipelines and feature store capabilities that give data scientists the modeling data they need, at the speed the P&L vertical teams require.

Provides strategic and tactical direction for the department, and helps set the direction for how MDS, data scientists, and deployment teams across US Date Science (USDS) work with modeling data. This position requires a proven ability to lead large-scale change across multiple teams.

Responsible for the management, technical oversight, and development of a team of data analysts, MLOps specialists, and subject matter experts. Owns the strategy and execution for modernizing and standardizing the modeling data lifecycle, from data ingestion through model deployment, in partnership with our P&L vertical data science, modeling data, and deployment teams.

Uses modern pipeline frameworks and scalable architecture patterns so data lineage is tracked throughout feature development. Leads the design and adoption of a feature store strategy that ensures features are defined once, managed consistently across model development, calibration, and deployment, and can be added to directly by data scientists. Leverages pipeline modernization to develop AI solutions that speed up how features are built, tested, and maintained.

Requires deep knowledge of modern data pipelines and feature management practices, including tools such as dbt, Snowflake, and Databricks, and advanced application of those practices to the development, calibration, and deployment of pricing models.

Collaborates with USDS, Data Office, DAE, ED&DS, and Product Delivery in developing these solutions.

Qualifications
  • Advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Typically 8+ years of relevant experience, including leadership experience in data science, analytics, data operations, or MLOps.
  • Experience sourcing, integrating, and governing data from enterprise data warehouses and external vendors
  • Ability to partner with data science, technology, and business stakeholders and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences
  • Responsible for the management, technical oversight and development a team of data science and advanced analytics staff, which may include subordinate managers.
  • Coaches team to understanding of organizational vision and goals.
  • Collaborates with business partners to develop tools and services such as modeling, dashboard development, and decision aids to drive strategic decision making.
  • Provides strategic and tactical direction at the highest levels. Has accountability for the performance and results of one or more large, strategically important business unit in an extremely large market.
  • Works on issues of diverse scope where analysis of situation or data requires evaluation of a variety of factors, including an understanding of current business trends.
  • Owns relationship with a defined segment of the business, delivering advanced tools and insights, including ongoing monitoring of metrics and initiatives.
  • Responsible for highly technical, individualized and difficult to develop tools and their usage which are transformative in nature and have broad strategic impact to the aligned business units(s).
  • Leads highly technical, complex, and cross functional projects that drive change across function, SBU or Corporate Department.
  • Directs and may perform highly complex, technical and creative predictive analytics projects and cross functional assignments within designated business unit collaborating with multiple functions.
  • Shapes the data science community and/or larger audiences and leads cross functional working groups.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Director I, Modeling Data Pipelines
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Plano, TX
  • Experience: 8+ years

About this job

Senior director role leading end-to-end data pipeline and feature store development for Liberty Mutual's modeling data organization in Plano, Texas. Manages a team of data analysts, MLOps specialists, and subject matter experts while driving modernization of the modeling data lifecycle using tools like dbt, Snowflake, and Databricks.

Good fit if you have 8+ years in data science, analytics, or MLOps leadership, advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or related field, and expertise with modern data pipeline tools and feature management.

Full job description


Description

Leads the development and delivery of end-to-end data pipelines and feature store capabilities that give data scientists the modeling data they need, at the speed the P&L vertical teams require.

Provides strategic and tactical direction for the department, and helps set the direction for how MDS, data scientists, and deployment teams across US Date Science (USDS) work with modeling data. This position requires a proven ability to lead large-scale change across multiple teams.

Responsible for the management, technical oversight, and development of a team of data analysts, MLOps specialists, and subject matter experts. Owns the strategy and execution for modernizing and standardizing the modeling data lifecycle, from data ingestion through model deployment, in partnership with our P&L vertical data science, modeling data, and deployment teams.

Uses modern pipeline frameworks and scalable architecture patterns so data lineage is tracked throughout feature development. Leads the design and adoption of a feature store strategy that ensures features are defined once, managed consistently across model development, calibration, and deployment, and can be added to directly by data scientists. Leverages pipeline modernization to develop AI solutions that speed up how features are built, tested, and maintained.

Requires deep knowledge of modern data pipelines and feature management practices, including tools such as dbt, Snowflake, and Databricks, and advanced application of those practices to the development, calibration, and deployment of pricing models.

Collaborates with USDS, Data Office, DAE, ED&DS, and Product Delivery in developing these solutions.

Qualifications
  • Advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Typically 8+ years of relevant experience, including leadership experience in data science, analytics, data operations, or MLOps.
  • Experience sourcing, integrating, and governing data from enterprise data warehouses and external vendors
  • Ability to partner with data science, technology, and business stakeholders and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences
  • Responsible for the management, technical oversight and development a team of data science and advanced analytics staff, which may include subordinate managers.
  • Coaches team to understanding of organizational vision and goals.
  • Collaborates with business partners to develop tools and services such as modeling, dashboard development, and decision aids to drive strategic decision making.
  • Provides strategic and tactical direction at the highest levels. Has accountability for the performance and results of one or more large, strategically important business unit in an extremely large market.
  • Works on issues of diverse scope where analysis of situation or data requires evaluation of a variety of factors, including an understanding of current business trends.
  • Owns relationship with a defined segment of the business, delivering advanced tools and insights, including ongoing monitoring of metrics and initiatives.
  • Responsible for highly technical, individualized and difficult to develop tools and their usage which are transformative in nature and have broad strategic impact to the aligned business units(s).
  • Leads highly technical, complex, and cross functional projects that drive change across function, SBU or Corporate Department.
  • Directs and may perform highly complex, technical and creative predictive analytics projects and cross functional assignments within designated business unit collaborating with multiple functions.
  • Shapes the data science community and/or larger audiences and leads cross functional working groups.

Job.JobTitle: Associate Attorney - Special Investigation Unit and Liability
Job.JobDescription:
Description

This role is primarily remote in the state of New York except for required appearances.

At Liberty Mutual, were committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders rights and positively impacting our business. As an Associate Attorney at Liberty Mutual, youll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligible performance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If youre looking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team in a role that combines special investigations legal support with liability litigation.

Liberty Mutual Insurance offers an engaging opportunity for an Associate Attorney whose practice will focus on special investigations matters and on liability litigation. Under moderate supervision, you will provide legal support for the investigation and evaluation of potentially fraudulent or materially misrepresented insurance claims, working collaboratively with Special Investigations Unit (SIU) professionals, claims representatives, and senior counsel. You will also represent Liberty Mutual and its policyholders, as appropriate, in moderately complex civil litigation involving claims for monetary damages arising from personal injury or property damage.

You will apply your legal knowledge, investigative judgment, research skills, and client relationship capabilities to develop facts, assess legal risks, and support fair, well-reasoned claim decisions and effective litigation outcomes in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Responsibilities:

Special Investigations

Investigative Legal Support: Partner with SIU professionals and claims representatives to develop legally sound investigation strategies for claims involving suspected fraud, material misrepresentation, or other potentially improper activity. Identify relevant legal issues, evidentiary needs, and appropriate next steps while maintaining an objective, fact-based approach.

Examinations and Evidence Development: Prepare for and conduct examinations under oath, where authorized and appropriate, and assist with witness interviews, document requests, and other fact-development activities. Evaluate testimony, claim documentation, and other evidence to identify inconsistencies and determine whether additional investigation is warranted.

Legal Research and Claim Evaluation: Research and analyze applicable law concerning insurance fraud, misrepresentation, policy conditions, and investigative procedures. Provide clear and reasoned legal opinions to support claim evaluation, coordinating with coverage counsel or other designated counsel when appropriate.

Investigation-Related Litigation: Handle or support litigation arising from special investigations within the scope of the assigned practice, including discovery, depositions, motions, hearings, and trial preparation. Collaborate with senior counsel on matters involving moderately complex investigative and evidentiary issues.

SIU Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing: Maintain effective working relationships with SIU, Claims, and legal partners. Share legal developments and practical guidance that strengthen investigative practices, evidence preservation, and documentation quality.

Liability Litigation

Litigation Execution: Manage assigned personal injury and property damage liability cases from inception through resolution, including pleadings, discovery, depositions, hearings, mediations, and trials. Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in case preparation, management, and trial execution.

Risk Evaluation and Case Resolution: Assess liability, damages, and litigation exposure. Develop defense strategies and collaborate with claims representatives, insured clients, and senior counsel to facilitate effective case resolutions.

Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide strategic legal advice and clear, consistent, and timely updates to insured clients and claims professionals. Maintain strong client relationships through transparent communication and alignment with case objectives.

Responsibilities Across Both Practice Areas

Technology Utilization: Use e-discovery, legal research, and case management technologies to improve efficiency and support effective collaboration with remote team members.

Documentation Accuracy and Compliance: Prepare accurate, thorough, and timely legal documents, investigative assessments, and case reports in accordance with applicable legal standards and client expectations.

Contribution to Organizational Improvement: Participate in initiatives that enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and best practices within Staff Legal and Global Legal & Compliance.

Ethical Compliance and Professional Judgment: Uphold the highest standards of legal ethics, confidentiality, and professional responsibility. Recognize and appropriately address conflicts of interest, preserve applicable privileges, and ensure investigative and litigation activities comply with governing law and licensing requirements.

Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in NY and in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • General knowledge of insurance law
  • Proficient in e-discovery, case management systems, and basic legal analysis tools.
  • Strong analytical, research, and legal writing skills.
  • Basic knowledge of negotiation techniques including preparation, active listening, and problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cases from start to finish under supervision.
  • Effective communication and persuasion skills, both written and oral.
  • Ability to collaborate with clients, claims professionals, and senior attorneys.
  • Organized, process-oriented with strong time management skills.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

Job.JobTitle: Principal Data Solutions Analyst, Compliance & Insurance Analytics
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Compliance Analyst, Compliance / Legal, Data Engineer
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Are you someone who enjoys solving complex data problems, connecting the dots, and finding better ways to get things done?

We're looking for a curious, detail-oriented, and resourceful Data Analyst to help solve some of our organization's most challenging data questions. In this role, you'll respond to regulatory data requests that require navigating complex business questions, analyzing multiple data sources, and collaborating across teams to deliver accurate, reliable information. You'll become a trusted expert in insurance data while developing a broad understanding of our business and solving meaningful problems. Beyond answering today's questions, you'll help us work smarter by identifying opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and improved data practices to make future requests faster and easier to fulfill. If you enjoy tackling difficult data challenges and finding ways to make them easier to solve the next time we'd love to hear from you.

Candidates who live within 50 miles of Boston, MA; Portsmouth, NH; Seattle, WA; Columbus, OH; or Plano, TX will follow a hybrid schedule, coming into the office two days per week. Otherwise, this role is remote with occasional travel.

What You'll Do:

  • Solve challenging data problems: Investigate complex regulatory data requests, identify relevant data sources, and perform the analysis needed to deliver accurate, complete, and defensible responses.
  • Become a trusted data expert: Develop a deep understanding of our insurance products, underwriting data, and business processes, helping partners navigate complex data questions.
  • Collaborate to deliver results: Work closely with regulatory, compliance, product, underwriting, and technology teams to understand requirements, resolve data challenges, and ensure responses meet business needs.
  • Improve how we work: Identify recurring challenges and opportunities to simplify, standardize, and expedite the process of responding to regulatory requests.
  • Build reusable knowledge: Document data sources, business logic, and prior analyses to make future requests easier to understand and fulfill.
  • Drive visibility and accountability: Develop and maintain reporting that provides senior leadership with visibility into regulatory request status, progress, and emerging challenges, highlighting risks and issues that may require escalation or leadership support.

What We're Looking For:

  • Experience: 5+ years in data analytics or a related data solutions role, including coding for data management, data warehousing, or other data environments.
  • Tooling: Comfortable across the broader data and analytics toolset used for the role (e.g., Snowflake, SAS Viya, SQL, GitHub), with the ability to use AI-assisted tools (e.g., GPT/Copilot/Claude) to improve productivity.
  • Project management: Demonstrated experience leading projects from scoping through delivery and reporting on progress and challenges.
  • Analytical mind: Candidate must be analytical and curious, with the ability to read ambiguous regulatory guidance, ask the right questions, and translate vague instructions into precise data requirements and testable rules. Strong written and oral communication skills required.
  • Leadership & autonomy: Proven ability to lead work cross-functionally and influence with limited guidance.
  • AI: experience applying generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to data analysis, documentation, or workflow automation.
Qualifications
  • Strong written and oral communication skills required.
  • Bachelor`s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related discipline preferred.
  • Master`s in same or related disciplines strongly preferred.
  • 5-7 years experience using SQL and/or Python for data analysis and reporting in data warehouse or similar data environments; experience with Snowflake and SAS is a plus.
  • 5-7 years of experience in data research and process automation, with strong documentation skills.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Loss Control Consultant, Risk Management / Loss Control
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Under limited supervision, we provideloss prevention consulting services within the Property and Marine Loss Prevention department, specializing in equipment breakdown risk.Completes Boiler and Pressure Vessel inspection, conducts extensive research, data collection, evaluation, and analysis to make recommendations that help control customers sources of risk, loss, and costs. Serves as a technical expert in mechanical systems and equipment breakdown exposures.

  • Remote Role with 75% Travel

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Conducts on-site inspections of boilers, pressure vessels, and mechanical systems to identify hazards and assess risk.

  • Compiles facts from site visits, reports, and databases to evaluate existing processes, determine severity/frequency of issues, and identify improvement needs.

  • Assesses and benchmarks on customer performance against internal and industry standards, including NBIC requirements.

  • Interprets and analyzes data to determine best course of action and solutions that satisfy customer risk service needs.

  • Utilizes advanced software applications and Microsoft systems to develop innovative, cost-effective solutions.

  • Investigate cause-and-effect relationships and prepare technical reports summarizing findings and recommendations.

  • Organizes data into clear, actionable formats and presents reports outlining improvement plans and cultural/behavioral changes.

  • Maintains effective partnerships with customers, learning their business to identify risk management objectives and needs.

  • Provides technical support and training to assist with implementation of recommendations and action plans.

  • Actively pursues professional development to better meet customer expectations.

  • May participate in acquiring new business by following up on leads and presenting proposals.

Qualifications

  • PreferredEducation:Bachelors degree inengineeringor related field preferred.

  • Experience:Strong background in mechanical systems or loss control engineering.

  • Certifications:NBIC Commissionrequired for posted position, but trainee opportunities available; other relevant certifications a plus.

Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and general computer systems.

  • Ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Excellent communication and report-writing skills.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Attributes:

  • Familiarity with property and marine insurance risk assessment.

  • Knowledge of industry codes, standards, and best practices related to equipment breakdown.

  • Experience in client-facing roles with strong relationship-building skills.

Description

Under limited supervision, we provideloss prevention consulting services within the Property and Marine Loss Prevention department, specializing in equipment breakdown risk.Completes Boiler and Pressure Vessel inspection, conducts extensive research, data collection, evaluation, and analysis to make recommendations that help control customers sources of risk, loss, and costs. Job.JobTitle: Senior Technical Claims Specialist, Construction Complex
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Liberty Mutuals Specialized Claims group has an immediate opening on our Complex Construction Claims Team. Were seeking an experienced claims professional who thrives on challenging, high-exposure commercial casualty matters arising from construction operations including complex Commercial General Liability (CGL) and Construction Injury/Liability claims (all litigated or high-exposure losses $500,000+). You will own matters end-to-end, managing coverage and liability strategy, directing investigations and experts, coordinating litigation and outside counsel, and driving timely, defensible resolutions for our Construction Industry accounts. (Note: this role does not handle construction defect claims.)

Why this role is a great fit for you

  • Work exclusively on technically complex, high-exposure construction-related casualty claims that require advanced legal and claims judgment.
  • Autonomy to set strategy, reserves and resolution plans, with authority to direct investigations and manage outside counsel and experts.
  • Opportunity to influence outcomes across underwriting, product and legal teams and to be a recognized technical resource on construction liability issues.
  • Exposure to multi-party, catastrophic injury and cross-coverage matters valuable experience for senior claims leaders and litigators.
  • Flexibility with structure. This role is primarily remote, with a light-touch office cadence - just two in-office days per month for those who live within 50 miles of one of our hub locations in Boston, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Plano, TX; Suwanee, GA; Chandler, AZ; and Weatogue, CT. Policy is subject to change.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a caseload of complex, litigated construction-related losses ($500K+) from assignment through resolution: coverage analysis, liability assessment, investigation planning, reserving, negotiation, settlement or denial where appropriate.
  • Lead coverage interpretation and application for issues commonly encountered in construction claims: additional insureds, tenders, indemnity agreements, other insurance, SIR/deductible mechanics, primary vs. excess placement, and limits erosion.
  • Direct litigation strategy: analyze pleadings, manage discovery and depositions, evaluate venue and trial risk, prepare for mediations and settlement conferences, and recommend and implement resolution strategies.
  • Build and lead the working team for each matter: coordinate Home-Office Legal, defense counsel, SIU when appropriate, medical and causation experts, accident reconstructionist, engineers, and other technical consultants.
  • Select, supervise and evaluate outside counsel, including establishing budgets, staffing plans, billing guidelines expectations, and performance measures.
  • Set and adjust reserves based on defensible analysis and develop settlement strategies that protect the companys interests while advancing timely resolution.
  • Maintain accurate, complete file documentation and ensure secure handling of financial transactions and claim information.
  • Collaborate proactively with Underwriting, Risk Control, Reinsurance/Excess, Product and Subrogation teams; identify and communicate trends and technical insights.
  • Mentor and coach less-experienced claims professionals and contribute to team training, process improvements, and special projects.

What we seek in a candidate?

An experienced claims professional with a strong Commercial General Liability and/or Construction Liability background (preferably with claims $500,000 and above), sound judgment on complex coverage and liability questions, and the confidence to lead files, mentor others, and manage litigation strategy independently.

Qualifications

What were looking for Required

    • Substantial hands-on experience handling complex, litigated Commercial General Liability and/or Construction Liability claims at high exposure levels (preferably $500,000+).
    • Deep working knowledge of CGL and Construction Liability coverages and typical construction-related policy issues (additional insured wording, contractual indemnity, other insurance, primary/excess interaction, SIRs/deductibles).
    • Proven litigation management experience: selecting/managing defense counsel, directing discovery strategy, preparing for mediation/trial, evaluating exposure and settlement leverage.
    • Strong technical judgment and the ability to articulate and defend coverage and liability positions to legal, underwriting, and management partners.
    • Track record of using and directing experts (medical, causation, engineers, reconstruction) on complex causation and damages issues.
    • Excellent negotiation, communication and stakeholder management skills.
    • Ability to manage multiple high-priority matters and meet deadlines under pressure.
    • Bachelors degree (preferred) and relevant claims/insurance industry certifications or licenses as applicable.
    • Ability to obtain and maintain needed All-lines Adjuster license. Claims/Industry certifications a plus!

Description

At Liberty Mutual, were committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders rights and positively impacting our business. As a Senior Attorney at Liberty Mutual, youll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligibleperformance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If yourelooking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where youll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual is seeking a highly experienced Senior Attorney to lead the management of complex litigation matters involving substantial legal and financial exposure. This role requires mastery of advanced legal principles, regulatory expertise, strategic litigation management, budget oversight, and client relationship leadership. The Senior Attorney will leverage cutting-edge technology, mentor junior attorneys, and collaborate extensively with Claims Representatives, insured clients, and external partners to deliver favorable outcomes while minimizing risk and cost. This position plays a critical role in driving continuous improvement and upholding the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance.

Responsibilities:

  • Legal Strategy Development: Craft, implement, and continuously refine sophisticated legal strategies for complex litigation matters by applying advanced legal principles and comprehensive knowledge of the regulatory environment.
  • Litigation Execution & Management: Independently oversee all phases of complex litigation, including discovery, hearings, trials, and settlement negotiations, ensuring meticulous preparation and execution of legal documents and motions. Manage and co-chair trials with exposure typically exceeding $50,000, leading negotiation efforts to achieve optimal resolutions that safeguard client interests.
  • Technology Utilization: Champion the use of state-of-the-art e-discovery tools and case management technologies to enhance legal workflows, operational efficiency, and remote collaboration across teams.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Serve as a trusted legal advisor providing clear, authoritative opinions and strategic counsel to Claims Representatives and insured clients.
  • Risk Evaluation and Mitigation: Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate potential legal risks associated with complex cases.
  • Budget and Resource Management: Oversee litigation expenses, trial budgets, and case timelines to balance high-quality legal representation with fiscal responsibility.
  • Training, Mentorship, and Leadership: Design and lead comprehensive training programs for Legal, Claims, and other departments to enhance team competencies and legal knowledge. Provide mentorship, guidance, and support to junior and mid-level attorneys, paralegals, and law clerks, fostering professional development and a collaborative work environment.
  • Continuous Legal Knowledge Enhancement: Stay current on evolving legal developments, industry trends, and relevant medical, scientific, or engineering issues affecting cases.
  • Organizational Improvement & Collaboration: Actively contribute to initiatives that improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the Staff Legal and Global Legal & Compliance organizations.
  • Ethical Compliance Adherence: Uphold and promote the highest standards of legal ethics and professional conduct in all activities. Manage complex ethical issues and guide junior attorneys in compliance with the Model Rules of Professional Conduct (MRPC).
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in Arizona and in good standing; additional licensure for specialized courts or boards may be required.
  • Minimum of 8 years of successful trial attorney experience, with a focus on insurance law and complex civil litigation and as necessary, workers compensation and/or No Fault law.
  • Proven expertise managing high-stakes, complex litigation with substantial exposure (trials exceeding $50,000).
  • In-depth knowledge of insurance law, regulatory frameworks, and client business operations.
  • Exceptional legal research, writing, negotiation, and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency with advanced e-discovery platforms, case management software, and remote collaboration tools.
  • Demonstrated leadership and mentorship experience within a legal team.
  • Superior communication, interpersonal, and client relationship management skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple complex cases concurrently.
  • Commitment to ethical legal practice and regulatory compliance.
