About this job

Senior hands-on architect role leading the technical direction of DevOps Platforms & Engineering at Lincoln Financial Group. You'll own end-to-end architecture of the DevOps toolchain, set engineering standards, lead cross-functional initiatives, and drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering across the software delivery lifecycle.

Good fit if you have 12+ years in DevOps or platform engineering, expert depth in CI/CD or related disciplines, and experience leading complex technical initiatives without formal authority.

Full job description

Alternate Locations: Greensboro, NC (North Carolina); Charlotte, NC (North Carolina); Fort Wayne, IN (Indiana); Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania)

Work Arrangement:

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

The Role at a Glance

We're looking for a senior hands-on architect to lead the technical direction of our DevOps Platforms & Engineering organization. You'll shape how hundreds of application developers build, test, secure, and release software. That means bringing CI/CD, software supply chain, release automation, test automation, and performance engineering together into one coherent delivery platform.

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll set engineering standards, lead high-impact cross-functional initiatives, and advise leadership on technology strategy, while staying close to the work: designing solutions, automating, and solving the hardest production problems yourself. You'll also help lead our adoption of AI-assisted engineering across the software delivery lifecycle.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the end-to-end architecture of our DevOps toolchain and engineering services, from source control and CI/CD through artifact management, code quality, security scanning, testing, release, and deployment, and keep the target-state architecture current.
  • Stay hands-on with design, implementation, upgrades, migrations, automation, and troubleshooting across our platforms.
  • Define engineering patterns, reference pipelines, and the standards behind our enterprise CI/CD templates and SDLC practices. Lead design on complex, enterprise-wide initiatives.
  • Set direction for test automation, service virtualization, and performance engineering, including how they plug into pipelines through quality gates and shift-left practices.
  • Drive modernization: toolchain consolidation, pipeline-based deployment, infrastructure as code, observability, and self-service capabilities for development teams.
  • Shape software supply chain security, platform resiliency, and audit readiness in partnership with Information Security.
  • Lead the evaluation and adoption of AI-assisted engineering across the toolchain, testing, and operations, including emerging patterns such as MCP, agent-to-agent integration, and AgentOps.
  • Lead architecture and design reviews, represent the team in enterprise architecture and governance forums, and act as a senior escalation point for complex, systemic incidents.
  • Mentor engineers and build depth across critical platforms, and partner with technology, security, architecture, cloud, and AI teams across the enterprise.
  • Contribute to multi-year roadmaps and give leadership clear recommendations on risks, trade-offs, vendors, and total cost of ownership.

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Typically 12 or more years of progressive experience in DevOps, platform engineering, release engineering, software engineering, or test engineering, including significant time as an architect or senior technical lead.
  • Expert-level depth in one or more DevOps disciplines, such as CI/CD, artifact management and software supply chain, configuration management and infrastructure as code, or release automation.
  • Extensive hands-on experience engineering and supporting business-critical platforms such as GitLab, JFrog Artifactory, SonarQube, Puppet or Ansible, and enterprise release automation tools.
  • Practical experience with test automation (such as Selenium or Playwright) and performance testing (such as JMeter), and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong skills in automation, scripting, APIs, and pipeline orchestration, plus working knowledge of AWS and of Linux and Windows environments.
  • A track record of leading complex cross-functional technical initiatives and influencing technology direction without formal authority.
  • The ability to communicate complex recommendations clearly to senior leadership.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in a regulated industry, ideally insurance or financial services.
  • Experience running self-hosted enterprise platforms at scale.
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted engineering tools in software delivery, testing, or platform operations.
  • Exposure to service virtualization or mainframe test automation.

The Role at a Glance

As Retirement Sales Director, you will be responsible for driving growth through new retirement plan sponsor acquisition, with a primary focus on mid to large market plans ($50M+ in assets). In this role, you will develop and execute a territory business plan designed to achieve ambitious sales, AUM, and market share goals across your assigned geography. You will serve as a key external representative, building and expanding relationships with retirement plan consultants, advisors, brokers, and plan sponsors. This is a highly consultative, relationship driven sales role that requires deep retirement industry knowledge, disciplined pipeline management, and close collaboration with internal partners to deliver comprehensive retirement solutions and exceptional client outcomes.

What you'll be doing

Drive Growth & New Business Acquisition
• Lead new retirement plan sponsor acquisition with a focus on plans with $50M+ in assets
• Develop and execute a territory and prospecting strategy to meet or exceed annual sales and AUM targets
• Identify, qualify, and cultivate prospective plan sponsors through proactive outreach, referrals, networking, and consultant relationships
• Manage the full sales cycle, from initial engagement through finalist presentations, pricing, contract negotiation, and close.
Build and Deepen Influencer Relationships
• Build, maintain, and grow strong relationships with retirement plan consultants, advisors, brokers, and other centers of influence impacting mid to large market plan decisions
• Increase territory penetration by strengthening partnerships with influential specialists and consulting firms
• Position the organization as a preferred retirement provider through consistent engagement, education, and thought leadership
Deliver Consultative Retirement Solutions
• Conduct needs based discovery with plan sponsors to understand fiduciary objectives, plan design, investments, participant outcomes, and service expectations
• Present tailored retirement solutions, including recordkeeping, investments, managed accounts, and financial wellness offerings
• Clearly articulate value propositions around fiduciary governance, plan outcomes, fee reasonableness, and participant engagement
Territory & Sales Execution Excellence
• Manage a large geographic territory, executing external wholesale sales programs that drive revenue and market share growth
• Conduct in person and virtual meetings such as due diligence sessions, consultant updates, one on one meetings, and industry sponsorships
• Represent the organization at industry conferences, client events, and networking functions
• Maintain accurate pipeline, activity tracking, and forecasting in CRM and sales reporting systems
• Forecast sales activity and revenue with discipline, transparency, and accountability
• Effectively manage expense budgets to maximize territory coverage and sales impact
Collaboration & Operational Discipline
• Partner closely with internal stakeholders including operations, product, client service, core market counterparts, and consultant relations teams to support opportunities and ensure seamless onboarding and issuance
• Ensure sold business is properly processed from point of sale through implementation
• Uphold the highest standards of professionalism, ethics, and compliance, adhering to all policies, procedures, and cultural expectations

What we're looking for

Must-Haves:
• Minimum of 5+ years of experience in Defined Contribution retirement plan sales and/or relationship management, with direct alignment to the responsibilities of this role
• Bachelor's degree required, or equivalent professional experience (4 additional years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree)
• Ability to obtain FINRA Series 6, Series 63, and Life & Health licenses within 120 days of hire
• Confident and effective communicator with strong written and verbal communication skills
• Demonstrated ability to communicate credibly and knowledgeably with senior leaders, both internally and externally
• Strong presentation capabilities with a proven track record of influencing stakeholders at all levels through clear, logical, and well informed discussions
• Advanced relationship management skills, including the ability to partner collaboratively with internal teams and build trusted relationships with external clients
• Willingness and ability to travel up to 50%

Nice-to-Have:
• Strong working knowledge of ERISA rules and regulatory requirements governing retirement plans

Job.JobTitle: Lead Risk Data Engineer and Architect
Job.JobDescription:
Alternate Locations: Work from Home; Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania)

Work Arrangement:

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

Relocation assistance: is not available for this opportunity.

Requisition #: 76603

The Role at a Glance

As a Senior Lead Risk Data Engineer and Architect, you will architect and lead the design and implementation of new technology solutions for the Risk Investments and Technology team within the Chief Risk Office (CRO). You will own technical roadmaps, champion SDLC best practices, and build production grade systems that power analytics, machine learning, and cross-functional risk management.

Working on a centralized cloud data platform (AWS, Databricks or Dataiku), you'll design scalable data pipelines, implement data governance frameworks using modern cataloging tools, and develop advanced solutions. This role is critical to modernizing how we manage market risk, credit risk, and operational risk data on the enterprise scale.

You'll partner closely with risk analysts, quantitative researchers, and technology leaders to migrate business-owned processes into robust, production-controlled platforms while maintaining operational excellence.

What you'll be doing

•Architect cloud-native data solutions using AWS services (S3, Redshift, Glue, EMR, Lambda, Athena) and Databricks (Unity Catalog, Workflows, MLflow) or similar technology to support risk analytics at scale.
•Build and optimize data pipelines using Python, PySpark, and SQL to integrate structured and unstructured data from internal and external sources.
•Drive modernization initiatives by migrating legacy on-premises systems to cloud platforms while ensuring zero disruption to critical business services.
•Implement data governance frameworks including cataloging, lineage tracking, quality monitoring, and access controls aligned with internal controls and regulatory requirements.
•Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, risk managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions, drive change management and process improvements.
•Develop production-grade code following DevOps practices including CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, and infrastructure-as-code.
•Manage and optimize relational databases (MySQL, Aurora PostgreSQL, Redshift) for performance, cost efficiency, and data integrity.
•Integrate structured and unstructured data from various internal and external sources.
•Mentor and influence technical standards and architectural decisions across the Risk, Investments Technology organization.
•Monitor and troubleshoot production systems, implementing observability practices and proactive performance tuning.

What we're looking for

•Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or related field.
•5+ years of experience in data engineering or similar role implementing with a variety of on-premises and cloud data management, integration, and analytical technologies.
•Production experience with relational databases such as MySQL, and SQL Server, including designing schemas, writing complex queries, optimizing performance, and ensuring data integrity for a variety of business applications.
•Strong experience with end-to-end data architecture implementing systems that use AWS services related to data storage and management, must have advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, YAML and Bash.
•Thorough understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including DevOps practices, CI/CD processes, application resiliency, and security measures.
•Excellent communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts for business audiences.
•Data governance experience: catalog tools, data quality frameworks, lineage tracking, and compliance controls is a plus.
•AWS certifications such as SAA, Associate Developer, Data Analytics Specialty, or Databricks certification is a plus.

Leveraging data, analytics, and market insights, you will continuously optimize campaign performance to maximize ROI and deliver measurable business outcomes.


Working cross-functionally with line-of-business marketing leaders, sales organizations, analytics teams, digital marketing peers, and external agency partners, you will play a critical role in aligning marketing efforts with revenue objectives. You will own the growth strategy and performance of paid and ABM programs while partnering with internal stakeholders on campaign execution, funnel optimization, measurement, and reporting.


The ideal candidate is a results-driven digital marketer with deep expertise in performance marketing, demand generation, audience targeting, and account-based marketing. They possess a strong analytical mindset, a passion for experimentation, and a proven ability to transform complex business goals into scalable marketing programs that drive engagement, pipeline growth, and revenue impact.


What Makes Us Different?

This role combines performance marketing, account-based marketing, innovation, and enterprise collaboration. You will help shape go-to-market strategies, evaluate emerging technologies, and influence growth initiatives across multiple lines of business.


What Will Be My Duties and Responsibilities in This Job?

  • Manage media budgets, forecasts, vendor relationships, and agency partnerships to ensure efficient use of resources.
  • Evaluate marketing technologies, digital channels, and emerging advertising opportunities to drive innovation and improve performance.
  • Continuously refine marketing strategies, success metrics, and ABM capabilities to enhance business impact and support growth.

What Are the Requirements Needed for This Position?

  • A minimum of 7 years of experience in B2B marketing, performance marketing, ABM, demand generation, or related disciplines.
  • Experience leading complex digital campaigns from strategy through optimization.
  • Strong expertise in paid search, paid social, and display advertising.
  • Experience with Demandbase, 6sense, or similar ABM platforms.

  • Experience with AI tools including Microsoft Copilot.

Job.JobTitle: Account Executive II, Power & Renewables Practice - Aon Global Natural Resources
Job.JobDescription:
Job Description

Account Executive II, Power & Renewables – Aon Global Natural Resources

Are you energized by the transition to a low‑carbon future? Do you want to sit at the center of the global Power & Renewables market, advising some of the world's most sophisticated utilities and renewables companies on their most complex risks? If so, this could be the role for you!

Join Aon's industry‑leading Global Natural Resources team as a Senior Account Executive III focused on Power & Renewables, and help our clients make better decisions in an era of unprecedented change.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better—to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. We are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

In this role, you will be the strategic quarterback for a portfolio of major Power & Renewables clients. You will:

  • Own and grow key client relationships, engaging directly with senior decision-makers while remaining a trusted, day‑to‑day partner for client teams.
  • Lead the end‑to‑end renewal process, assembling and guiding cross‑functional Aon teams to craft and implement tailored renewal strategies.
  • Partner closely with Brokers to design and deliver innovative risk transfer and placement strategies that reflect current and emerging market dynamics.
  • Orchestrate critical relationships between clients, Aon account and risk services teams, and insurers to drive differentiated outcomes.
  • Ensure the client service team deeply understands each client's business, risk profile, and goals—and that our service model and economic framework are aligned to them.
  • Lead stewardship planning and delivery, clearly demonstrating the value Aon brings through insights, outcomes, and execution.
  • Manage overall account profitability, taking a value‑based approach to scope, pricing, and the Client Service Standards
  • Structure and negotiate Aon's compensation for services, whether fee‑ or commission‑based, ensuring transparency and alignment.
  • Educate clients on risk management and risk transfer options, market conditions, and key trends in the Power & Renewables landscape, supported by benchmarking and analyzer data.
  • Mobilize the right Aon experts and resources when clients face unusual or high‑severity situations, such as major claims or new project developments.
  • Collaborate across geographies (including international markets), functions, and business divisions to build coordinated solutions and capture growth opportunities.
  • Coordinate invoicing and receivables for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and a high‑quality client experience.

How this opportunity is different

This is a high‑impact, visible role at the intersection of global power, infrastructure, and risk. You will:

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for some of Aon's most important Power & Renewables clients.
  • Lead and mentor cross‑disciplinary client service teams to deliver outstanding service and unlock new value for clients.
  • Play a strategic role in helping clients navigate the energy transition, new technologies, evolving regulatory pressures, and increasingly sophisticated risk landscapes.
  • Build and grow a profitable book of business, with room to innovate on service, structure, and solutions in partnership with Aon's broader Global Natural Resources platform.

Through strategic advice, differentiated service, and compelling insight, you will showcase the full power of Aon to our clients—and help define what “best in class” looks like in the Power & Renewables sector.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 10–15+ years of Property & Casualty (P&C) experience, with a strong track record serving complex, multinational clients.
  • Deep experience managing large, sophisticated accounts in the Power, Renewables, and/or broader Natural Resources sector.
  • Proven ability to lead client relationship strategy, drive growth, and manage profitability across a portfolio of accounts.
  • Strong organizational, interpersonal, and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously.
  • Sharp critical thinking and executive‑level communication skills; able to translate complex concepts into clear, compelling narratives for a range of stakeholders.
  • High level of digital fluency, including advanced use of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and comfort with data‑driven insights.
  • Active Property & Casualty license required.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent years of relevant industry experience.

Pay Transparency Laws

The salary range for this position is $150,000 to $185,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on your education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Salary may also be adjusted based on geographic location.

This role is eligible to participate in one of Aon's annual incentive plans, including a discretionary bonus and production incentives in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus and production incentives varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.

If you're ready to help shape the future of Power & Renewables risk management—and to grow your career with a global leader—we encourage you to apply!

For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.

Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon's discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies.

About this job

Director role leading client solutions design, implementation, and optimization for OEM and Connected Living business. Bridges clients and internal teams across Product, Operations, Technology, Finance, and other functions to deliver scalable solutions and drive business growth.

Good fit if you have 7+ years in client solutions, program management, and team leadership with OEM or retail industry experience.

Full job description

At Assurant, we're seeking a strategic and execution-focused Director, Client Solutions Delivery to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of client solutions that drive growth, enhance customer experiences, and deliver measurable business results. This role serves as a critical bridge between clients and internal teams, translating complex business requirements into scalable solutions while ensuring flawless delivery and long-term success.


As a key leader within our OEM and Connected Living business, you'll collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Operations, Technology, Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain, Business Development, and Account Management while partnering with some of the world's most recognized brands.


What Makes Us Different?

At Assurant, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Influence growth strategies and client solutions for major global OEM and retail brands.
  • Lead highly visible initiatives that directly impact client satisfaction, retention, and business growth.
  • Operate with autonomy while partnering across a large, matrixed organization.
  • Help shape innovative programs, launches, and strategic initiatives that support evolving customer needs.
  • Work in a remote-friendly environment that values collaboration, flexibility, and results.

What Will Be My Duties and Responsibilities in This Job?

  • Lead the development and execution of client solution strategies that align business objectives, client needs, and product priorities.
  • Partner directly with clients to understand business challenges, identify opportunities, and design scalable solutions.
  • Drive complex client implementations, program launches, enhancements, and solution delivery from design through operational readiness.
  • Lead cross-functional teams across Product, Technology, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Account Management to ensure seamless execution.
  • Develop business cases, scope documents, requirements, solution recommendations, and executive-level communications.
  • Manage client relationships and build credibility with senior stakeholders while balancing client expectations with business objectives.
  • Monitor program performance, profitability, and key success metrics, implementing improvements as needed.
  • Lead and coach team members while influencing numerous matrixed resources across the organization.
  • Communicate risks, priorities, decisions, and progress clearly to executives, clients, and business partners.

What Are the Requirements Needed for This Position?

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in client solutions, implementation, program management, and team leadership.
  • OEM and/or retail industry experience required.
  • Demonstrated success leading large-scale client implementations and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Proven consulting, stakeholder management, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to influence across matrixed organizations and drive decisions in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
  • Experience developing scalable solutions and implementation strategies based on client needs.
  • Effective executive communication skills with the ability to engage clients, leaders, and cross-functional partners.
  • Analytical problem-solving skills with a focus on execution and results.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project.

What Other Skills/Experience Would Be Helpful to Have?

  • MBA or other advanced degree.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Strong solution design and implementation leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated success building consensus among diverse stakeholders and leading through influence.
  • Experience with AI-assisted documentation, business process improvement, journey mapping, or operational transformation initiatives.
  • Bilingual capabilities may be beneficial.

How Much Should I Expect to Travel?

  • This position requires approximately 20% travel based on client, business, implementation, and program needs. Travel may include client meetings, program launches, stakeholder workshops, and strategic planning sessions.

About this job

Handle inbound insurance sales calls for renters insurance and related products with no cold calling required. Remote position with flexible scheduling and quarterly performance-based shift bidding.

Good fit if you have one plus year of sales experience, one plus year of call center or insurance experience, and hold a Property and Casualty or Personal Lines license.

Full job description

Assurant is looking for Licensed Insurance sales agents to join our dynamic team. Come build a career with our team or grow your portfolio of work before you set out in new directions. We are a fast-paced, energetic environment where you drive the results while having the opportunity to connect remotely and enjoy competitive monthly bonuses and working from the comforts of home.


You will serve as the point of contact in fulfilling the insurance needs of our clients by assisting them with their sales process via inbound calls.


Work Schedule:

Our sales center is open from 8AM to 10PM ET on weekdays and 10AM to 5 PM ET on Saturdays. Individuals will have the ability to earn earlier shifts through our quarterly, performance-based shift bid process. Need flexibility to work any shift.



What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • 90% Handle inbound calls for multiple products with no prospecting or cold calling
  • 10% outbound calls to follow up on existing quotes
  • Establish a good liaison with our client's customers while selling Renters Insurance products.
  • Adopt and develop strategies while meeting departmental monthly sales goals
  • Track and monitor personal results to meet monthly sales and key performance goals
  • Follow underwriting requirements and corporate policies while negotiating sales
  • Navigate a computerized data entry system, internet, and/or other relevant applications for tracking, information gathering, troubleshooting and transaction processing
  • Complete mandatory licensure continuing education and other training sessions as appropriate
  • Remain positioned and well informed of changes implemented that affect your work
  • Our sales center is open from 8AM to 10PM ET on weekdays and 10AM to 5PM ET on Saturdays. Individuals will have the ability to earn earlier shifts through our quarterly, performance-based shift bid process.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • High school diploma or GED
  • One (1) plus year of sales related experience
  • One (1) plus years of call center and/or insurance experience
  • Solid computer, grammar, and multi-tasking skills
  • Must have a Property & Casualty or Personal Lines insurance license.
  • Ability to become appointed/licensed as a non-resident agent in all applicable states.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Strong analytical, listening, problem-solving, and negotiating skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to excellence
  • Ability to prioritize tasks with shifting deadlines and work on multiple projects simultaneously
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization internally and externally

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?

  • General office demands

About this job

Sr. Account Manager supporting employee benefits solutions for clients through renewals, plan analysis, presentations, and compliance coordination. Remote role partnering with clients and carriers to deliver custom benefits strategies.

Good fit if you have 3+ years client service experience, strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, and can work independently in a remote environment.

Full job description

Job Description

Posting Description

Who We Are:

NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit:https://www.NFP.com.

The Sr. Account Manager supports the delivery of employee benefits solutions by partnering with clients, carriers, and internal teams. This role is responsible for managing renewals, analyzing benefit plans, preparing client presentations, coordinating compliance activities, and providing ongoing client support. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong relationship management, analytical, and communication skills while serving as a key contributor to client satisfaction and strategic benefits planning.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Works proactively to build rapport with carrier and client contacts; may take active role in meetings.
  • Communicates directly with clients, carriers, and internal team members through phone, email, virtual meetings, and other remote collaboration tools, in collaboration with senior team members.
  • Prepare and send the request for proposals to applicable insurance carriers and spreadsheets results as they come in. First draft of renewal presentation.
  • Takes the lead on reviewing contracts, benefit plan summaries, and carrier source documents for accuracy in collaboration with the Account Executive or Advisor.
  • May serve as a mentor to more junior team members; assists with training more junior team members
  • Develops and maintains ongoing relationships with clients through regular remote communication. Takes more of an active role in client meetings and calls, including virtual meetings as appropriate.
  • May have direct contact with clients and relies on a growing knowledge of the details of various insurance coverages
  • Continues relationships with carrier representatives to better understand available products and services in the marketplace and recommend them to clients
  • Work with advisors or more senior team members to identify the strategies to meet client needs
  • Review & analyze request for proposals and insurance plan designs, negotiate with carriers and recommend renewal actions in drafts of presentations to be reviewed by Account Executives
  • Assist with client renewals and marketing and client meeting presentations; responsible for first draft of presentations
  • Update benefit guides, ensure client resources and communications are up to date following open enrollment or coverage change
  • Prepare document and data for annual client compliance audits to be presented by Account Executive
  • Attend to client requests including product or vendor service or performance challenges
  • Ensure 5500 form is filed and completed in a timely manner
  • Assembles updates for clients regarding appropriate industry trends and events, including all state and federal regulatory issues in conjunction with Account Executives or Advisors
  • Learns about alternative funding strategies.
  • General client service support in conjunction with the account management team
  • Maintains consistent availability and responsiveness during business hours while working remotely, including timely participation in scheduled calls, virtual meetings, and team communications.
  • Participate in client projects such as implementation of new business, open enrollment process, non-discrimination testing, etc.
  • May provide informal leadership to more junior team members, based on experience, without official supervisory responsibility.
  • Performs other duties as assigned and consistently makes independent judgments subject to general supervisor support.

Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities:

  • Knowledge of benefits administration, HealthCare Reform, industry trends, carrier products and services
  • Ability to work independently and anticipate client and team needs
  • Effective time management and decision making skills
  • Diligent follow up skills
  • Ability to express ideas clearly in both written and oral communications
  • Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills
  • Commanding presentation and public speaking abilities
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment, including strong self-management, proactive communication, and proficiency with virtual meeting and collaboration tools.

Education and/or Experience:

  • Associates degree (or equivalent), and BA/BS preferred
  • More than 3 years' client service and/or industry and product line experience

Certificates, Licenses, Registration:

  • Life, Accident and Health Insurance License required within six months.

Physical Demand:The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to handle or feel and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stand and walk. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and distance vision.

What We Offer:

We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $52,700 – $65,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

About this job

Director leads operations functions and teams for Berkley Alternative Markets IO, overseeing service, quality, cost, and controls across assigned areas. Role includes direct team management, project leadership for operating model changes, BPO governance, and process improvement work across finance, underwriting, claims, and operations.

Good fit if you have led insurance operations in regulated environments, managed managers and supervisors, and delivered measurable improvements in service, quality, or cost.

Full job description

Company Details

Berkley Alternative Markets IO (BAM IO) is a strategic enablement engine for certain Berkley businesses.

We bring together advanced analytics, data-driven insights, and operational expertise to help Berkley Businesses make faster, more informed decisions and run more efficient, scalable operations.

By standardizing capabilities and translating complex data into action, we reduce friction, increase consistency, and enable growth across the segment; so our businesses can focus on underwriting, distribution, and delivering results.

Responsibilities

The Director, Segment Operations leads operations functions, operating teams, and improvement work for BAM IO and the Berkley operating companies it supports. The role reports to the SVP, CFO, BAM IO.

The role has two parts. First, it directly leads operations functions and teams assigned to it by BAM IO or an operating company, with accountability for service, quality, cost, controls, and people results in those areas. Second, it leads project management, BPO and third-party governance, and process, automation, and AI-enabled improvement work at the operating company and segment level.

Assigned functions and teams will change over time as work moves among operating companies, BAM IO, and shared or third-party services. When the role is assigned to an operating company, the Director takes day-to-day direction and priorities from that operating company's President and is accountable for results in the assigned areas. BAM IO remains responsible for employment, compensation, and performance administration. The position works across Finance, Underwriting, Claims, Operations, IT, Compliance, and other functions to improve service, controls, scalability, cost, and decision-making.

Operations leadership (assigned functions)

• Lead operations functions assigned by BAM IO or an operating company. These may include policy services, premium audit, customer service, and claims operations support.

• Directly manage managers and supervisors and, through them, frontline staff. Set goals, coach, manage performance, allocate workload, and make hiring, staffing, and succession recommendations.

• Own service standards, service level agreements, workload and capacity, quality, cycle time, backlog, and issue escalation for assigned functions.

• For claims operations support, own non-technical claims work, meaning administrative, processing, and support workflows. Technical claims decisions, including compensability, reserving, settlement, and litigation strategy, remain with claims leadership.

• Manage premium audit operations and lead transitions to shared or enterprise audit services when approved.

Project and program management

• Lead project management for reorganizations, operating model changes, and cross-functional initiatives at the operating company and segment level, including workplans, milestones, decision logs, risks, dependencies, and status reporting.

• Lead approved organizational and operating model changes from design through implementation, staffing, and sustained adoption.

BPO and third-party governance

• Own BPO and third-party operational governance for assigned functions and initiatives, including scope, service levels, KPIs, performance reviews, escalation, risk management, and transitions of work in or out.

• Recommend, with business owners, which work stays in-house, moves to BPO, or moves to shared services, based on cost, quality, control, and risk.

Process, controls, data, and AI

• Design, document, and standardize processes, controls, and standard operating procedures to improve consistency, compliance, audit readiness, and scalability.

• Build operating metrics, dashboards, and executive-ready analysis on service, capacity, quality, cost, control, and progress against plan.

• Lead approved process improvement, automation, data, and AI-enabled workflow initiatives from diagnosis through implementation, adoption, and benefit realization.

• Own or support business continuity planning for assigned companies and functions, including documentation, testing coordination, remediation, and readiness reporting.

Segment enablement

• Partner with the VP, Operations Strategy & Transformation and segment leadership to translate priorities into workplans, decision points, measures, and accountability.

• Turn proven operating company practices into segment playbooks where a common approach adds value, while preserving clear ownership of results.

• Facilitate cross-company and cross-functional problem solving. Do not shift work or risk to another team without clear agreement on ownership.

• Develop change management, communication, and training plans so affected teams adopt and sustain new processes, tools, and ways of working.

• Perform other duties as assigned by the SVP, CFOO or, during an assignment, the operating company President.

This role may be aligned to any segment office.

Qualifications

• Extensive experience leading insurance operations, such as policy services, premium audit, customer service, or claims operations support, in a regulated environment. Workers' compensation experience preferred.

• Demonstrated leadership of managers and supervisors, including setting expectations, managing performance, and developing teams.

• Strong record of diagnosing operating problems and delivering measurable improvements in service, quality, cost, controls, or cycle time.

• Strong project and program management, including leading reorganizations or operating model changes through implementation.

• Strong background in BPO or third-party operational governance, including service level management, performance management, escalation, and risk mitigation.

• Experience with business continuity planning, operational resilience, or related governance.

• Experience designing processes, controls, standard operating procedures, and operational performance measures.

• Ability to translate automation and AI-enabled tools into practical workflows that teams adopt and sustain.

• Ability to work in a matrix, take direction from more than one leader, and keep priorities clear for teams. Strong judgment and written and verbal communication with senior leaders.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Finance, Accounting, or a related field. Relevant certifications are a plus.

Additional Company Details

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer.

Responsibilities

Berkley Southwest is seeking a Manager, Human Resources to join their team. This role is located in our Coppell, TX headquarters on a hybrid basis.

As Manager, Human Resources, you will be a key contributor within the Berkley organization, who partners with the VP of Human Resources and Operating Unit Leadership to support the execution of talent strategies and business initiatives. This role serves as a trusted advisor, providing guidance on key HR functions including recruitment, retention, performance management, talent development, succession planning, compensation, and employee relations.

In conjunction with the VP, Human Resources Manager

  • Guides and coaches leaders through actions related to formal disciplinary procedures, jointly determines appropriate course of actions; reviews and provides suggestions for performance improvement plans; and ensures legal compliance with aid of VP HR and/or legal counsel when necessary

NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com.

Summary of the Role

We are seeking an Investment Analyst to join our Wealth Management team. This is an excellent opportunity for an analytical, intellectually curious professional who is passionate about investments and interested in building a long-term career focused on leading client portfolios.

The Investment Analyst will interact directly with advisors and investment professionals to support portfolio analysis, investment research, client meeting preparation, and ongoing portfolio management activities. The role will initially focus on developing a strong understanding of our investment approach and supporting senior team members, with the opportunity to grow into a more client-facing position and participate directly in investment conversations with clients.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Investment Analysis & Portfolio Support

  • Conduct investigation and evaluation across a broad range of asset classes, investment strategies, funds, and managers.
  • Assist with portfolio construction, asset allocation, rebalancing, and implementation activities.
  • Supervise client portfolios, investment performance, allocations, and risk exposures.
  • Analyze public and private investment opportunities and help translate research into actionable recommendations.
  • Support investment due diligence and ongoing manager research.
  • Research capital markets, economic developments, and investment trends that may impact client portfolios.
  • Prepare investment analysis and recommendations for consultants and experienced investment professionals.

Advisor & Client Support

  • Partner closely with advisors to prepare for client meetings from an investment perspective.
  • Attend client meetings alongside advisors and senior portfolio management professionals.
  • Gain investment-related action items from meetings and ensure timely follow-through.
  • Prepare portfolio reports, investment materials, market commentary, and other information used in client discussions.
  • Assist with client investment inquiries by researching questions and developing thoughtful responses.
  • Build the knowledge and presentation skills necessary to gradually engage in direct financial discussions with clients.
  • Develop an understanding of each client's objectives, risk tolerance, liquidity needs, tax considerations, and overall financial goals.

Research & Investment Recommendations

  • Evaluate investment managers, funds, strategies, and other investment opportunities.
  • Prepare portfolio recommendations, investment proposals, and due diligence materials.
  • Synthesize complex investment information into clear insights for advisors, clients, and internal collaborators.
  • Give research and analysis to broader investment discussions.
  • Stay informed on financial markets, economic conditions, investment products, and industry developments.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities.
  • Genuine interest in investments, capital markets, portfolio management, and wealth management.
  • Understanding of fundamental investment concepts, including asset allocation, diversification, risk, and portfolio construction.
  • Ability to interpret financial and investment data and communicate findings clearly.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to lead multiple priorities and work optimally in a collaborative environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a curiosity about developing client-facing capabilities.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a willingness to learn from seasoned investment experts.
  • High level of integrity, judgment, and discretion when working with sensitive client information.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or a similar area of study, with equivalent experience also accepted.
  • 3-5 years of experience in wealth management, investment management, investment research, financial analysis, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience conducting investment or securities research is a plus.
  • Exposure to equities, fixed income, mutual funds, ETFs, alternative investments, or portfolio analytics is helpful.
  • Interest in advancing professional credentials, including the Series 65, with a willingness to pursue additional certifications such as the Series 7 and 66, CFP, or CFA.

What We Offer:

We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $85,000 to $100,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

Job Description

We are seeking a strategic, outcome-oriented Senior Product Manager, Servicing to lead the vision, strategy, and evolution of our Servicing product domain.

This is a virtual position, ideal candidate lives in Minnesota.

This leader will be responsible for transforming how customers, distribution partners, and colleagues manage insurance relationships throughout the policy lifecycle. The role spans policy servicing, account management, and claims, with an emphasis on creating connected, intuitive, and scalable experiences across a diverse portfolio of insurance products and businesses.

Operating in an evolving product organization, the ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity and complexity. Strategies, priorities, and requirements will not always be clearly defined or handed to them. This individual must proactively identify opportunities, bring structure to uncertainty, challenge assumptions, and create the clarity and momentum needed to drive meaningful outcomes.

This is a business-focused product leadership role requiring strong product management fundamentals, cross-functional influence, and the ability to connect customer needs, business capabilities, and technology investments.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like:

Product Strategy & Domain Leadership

  • Own and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Servicing domain, aligned with enterprise objectives and business priorities.
  • Lead the evolution of capabilities across policy servicing, account management, and claims, including policy management, endorsements, renewals, and related servicing interactions.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex insurance processes, increase self-service adoption, improve retention, and reduce operational costs.
  • Establish a scalable approach to servicing that supports diverse insurance products, business models, distribution channels, and brands.
  • Define meaningful product outcomes, success metrics, and investment priorities.

Product Discovery & Delivery

  • Translate business challenges, customer needs, and market opportunities into actionable product strategies and requirements.
  • Lead discovery to understand current-state challenges, validate opportunities, and define future-state capabilities.
  • Prioritize investments based on customer value, business impact, feasibility, and strategic alignment.
  • Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Experience, Intelligence, Operations, and business stakeholders to deliver cohesive solutions.
  • Balance near-term business needs with long-term capability development, reducing fragmentation and unnecessary customization.
  • Measure product performance and continuously refine priorities based on insights and results.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead, coach, and develop product managers and other product team members within the Servicing domain.
  • Establish strong partnerships with business leaders across multiple insurance businesses to align priorities and drive adoption.
  • Partner closely with other product domain leads, including Growth & Distribution, Payments, and Enterprise Capabilities, to align strategies, coordinate priorities, and deliver integrated capabilities and seamless end-to-end experiences.
  • Navigate cross-domain dependencies, shared ownership, and competing priorities to drive alignment, resolve trade-offs, and ensure cohesive product outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Experience to create consistent, intuitive customer, partner, and colleague journeys across digital and assisted channels.
  • Demonstrate initiative and urgency in identifying opportunities, addressing challenges, and driving decisions forward.
  • Communicate product direction, trade-offs, progress, and outcomes clearly to senior leadership.

Skills and experience that will lead to success:

Required:

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, including ownership of complex digital products or business capabilities.
  • Demonstrated experience defining product strategy, managing roadmaps, and delivering measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience leading product teams or providing leadership across multiple product initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of product discovery, prioritization, requirements definition, and iterative delivery.
  • Ability to translate complex business processes into scalable, customer-centered product capabilities.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
  • Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and complexity, independently establish direction, and drive progress without relying on predefined solutions or detailed instructions.

Preferred:

  • Experience in commercial property and casualty insurance, insurance distribution, or related financial services.
  • Familiarity with insurance policy administration, endorsements, renewals, claims, or servicing operations.
  • Experience supporting multiple business units, brands, or product lines through shared capabilities.
  • Experience modernizing legacy processes and transitioning organizations toward product-led operating models.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of industry experience.

Full job description

Job Description

Early Careers Launch - Broking

Commercial Risk - NPG Trucking

Launch Your Career in Broking

Aon is looking for soon-to-be graduates and recent graduates to join our Early Careers Launch Development Program as Brokers, with opportunities across Commercial Risk and Reinsurance. You do not need to be an insurance expert on day one. Through our Launch Program and on-the-job learning, you will learn how brokers help clients understand risk, navigate insurance and reinsurance markets, and make better decisions, that support resilience and growth.

Location: Little Rock, Arkansas

As a Broker, you will build the skills, confidence and market knowledge needed to translate complex risk exposures into structured insurance programs and serve as a credible intermediary between clients and insurers.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What is Commercial Risk

Commercial Risk Aon's Commercial Risk team helps organizations around the world identify, understand, and manage the risks that could impact their people, assets, and performance. We partner with clients across industries to design and deliver innovative risk and insurance solutions - from property and casualty to cyber and specialty risks - using data, analytics, and deep market insight to help them make better decisions and protect their business.

What You Will Do

As a Broker, you will build hands-on broking experience while developing an understanding of how risk, markets, clients and strategy come together to create value for clients. Technology, including AI, Aon's risk analyzers and global delivery teams increasingly support routine execution, allowing Brokers to focus earlier on commercial judgment, market strategy and client value.

Analyze Risk and Build Market Insight

  • Assess risk exposures using data, analytics and market intelligence while learning to validate results across coverage lines.
  • Conduct market analysis to benchmark pricing, identify coverage gaps and support effective program recommendations.

Support Market Strategy and Placements

  • Help prepare market submissions, renewal materials, placement documentation and client deliverables.
  • Engage insurers and underwriters to secure competitive pricing and terms, applying market knowledge where AI-suggested terms need tailoring.
  • Build experience coordinating renewals, reviewing contracts and maintaining accurate documentation for smaller placements and account activity.

Build Client Relationships and Advisory Skills

  • Participate in client meetings, presentations and follow-up materials with growing confidence.
  • Leverage technology, data analytics, and market insights to translate complex risk information into clear, actionable recommendations that help clients make informed business decisions.
  • Build trust as a credible point of contact while developing client and market relationships.

Coordinate Projects and Improve How Work Gets Done

  • Support placement workflows across broking, account management, analytics, operations, specialist teams and global delivery partners.
  • Review documents and client materials for accuracy, consistency and quality before they are used with markets or clients.
  • Identify opportunities to improve broking processes and support efficient client delivery.

Qualifications 

  • College Seniors graduating between Spring 2026 to Spring 2027 with a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0
  • Please Note: For this role you must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

The Launch Development Program

Launch is a structured 10-month Early Career development program that combines meaningful work, business learning, professional development and relationship-building across Aon. The program helps you build a strong foundation for a long-term broking and advisory career through:

  • On-the-job learning with brokers, client teams, account managers and solution line specialists.
  • Business and professional development in Commercial Risk, Reinsurance, client service, communication, collaboration, problem solving and commercial awareness.
  • Exposure to data, analytics and technology that support risk assessment, market analysis, workflow coordination and client-ready recommendations.
  • Networking, mentorship and coaching opportunities to build relationships across Aon and develop your career path.

What Will Help You Succeed and Grow

We are looking for candidates who are curious, motivated and excited to learn. Through the Launch Program, you will continue developing the same skills and capabilities that support a successful broking and advisory career, including:

  • An interest in business, risk, insurance, reinsurance, analytics, finance, economics, client service or global markets.
  • A desire to pursue a career in Commercial Risk and/or Reinsurance - Broking.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with a range of stakeholders.
  • Analytical and critical thinking, problem-solving ability and attention to detail.
  • A collaborative mindset, alongside initiative, adaptability and a willingness to contribute as part of a team.
  • Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Confidence using technology and a willingness to learn new tools, internal AI platforms and technology-enabled ways of working.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
  • Interpersonal skills and the ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues, clients and external partners.
  • Initiative and a commitment to continuous learning, growth and professional development.

Job Description

As part of an industry-leading team, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions as part of our Aon Risk Solutions – Health and Benefits Group.

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

This team is seeking an individual who will contribute to the team in a number of ways and help support certain aspects of Aon's clients. This individual will be asked to carry out the following:

  • Team members supporting day-to-day service initiatives for clients
  • Develops and maintains strategy plans for portfolio of clients
  • Broker, Negotiate, and evaluate the insurance markets to include self-funded, fully insured and level funding medical plans, dental, vision, life, disability and voluntary ancillary benefits to determine appropriateness of rates and rate components for client renewals.
  • Develop client or prospect RFP responses and results in a presentation deliverable
  • Work with the insurance markets to obtain client specific reports on all lines of coverage. Generates and produces client specific benefit analysis and reporting on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis.

Who We Are:

Principal Duties and Responsibilities / Essential Functions:

Lead the platform architecture and build

  • Own the design, build, and ongoing maintenance of our Microsoft Fabric medallion architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold), ensuring data flows optimally from raw ingestion through conformed, analytics-ready models.
  • Make and document key architectural decisions around ingestion patterns, storage, the serving layer, orchestration, and performance — balancing speed, reliability, and cost.
  • Establish the engineering practices that keep the platform healthy as it scales: version control, testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and documentation.

Lead and grow the team

  • Guide a small team of data engineers — setting coding and design standards, running code reviews, and unblocking day-to-day work.
  • Mentor engineers and help grow their technical skills, giving the team a clear sense of how “good” is defined.
  • Help shape hiring and team structure as the function grows.

Build and maintain the data pipelines

  • Develop and operate ingestion pipelines from multiple sources — pharmacy claims, eligibility, formulary, contract data, rebate and actuarial data, and public reference APIs (e.g., NADAC, NCPDP, CMS, 340B).
  • Normalize and conform data across differing PBM file specifications, formularies, and claims layouts so that downstream models are consistent and trustworthy.
  • Design and evolve the conformed data model and star schema that serve as the analytical source of truth.

Serve the business

  • Ensure the platform reliably feeds downstream consumers: Power BI, Excel reporting, internal web applications, and AI/Copilot-ready data services.
  • Serve as a point for complex reporting and data issues, guiding to resolution across reporting and data teams
  • Own data quality, governance, lineage, performance, and cost optimization end to end.
  • Partner with the platform architect, analytics, clinical, and product teams to align the technical roadmap with business and client priorities, and translate ambiguous requirements into concrete data solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to prioritize initiatives and allocate resources

Minimum Requirements for Education, Experience, and Certifications/Licenses:

  • 7+ years in data engineering, including 2+ years leading, mentoring, or acting as tech lead for other engineers.
  • Deep experience building lakehouse / medallion architectures. Microsoft Fabric strongly preferred; comparable experience with Azure Synapse, Databricks, or similar platforms will be considered.
  • Strong SQL and hands-on proficiency in Python and/or PySpark for large-scale data transformation.
  • Dimensional modeling expertise — you can design and maintain star schemas that hold up as reporting needs grow.
  • BI analytics fluency, including an understanding of the semantic/serving layer that makes BI performant and trustworthy.
  • A track record of taming messy data — ingesting and conforming heterogeneous sources and file formats into clean, reliable models.
  • Solid engineering fundamentals — data governance, data quality frameworks, and CI/CD for data pipelines.
  • Strong communication skills — able to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with pharmacy, PBM, healthcare claims, or payer data.
  • Familiarity with pharmacy data standards (NCPDP, claims file layouts) and healthcare reference data.
  • Experience enabling AI/Copilot or MCP-based data access on top of a data platform.
  • Broader Azure ecosystem experience (Azure SQL, data pipelines, security/RBAC, cost management).
  • Experience standing up a data platform or engineering function in an early or growth-stage environment.

What We Offer:

Job Description

Posting Description

Who We Are:

NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com

Position Overview

NFP is seeking an experienced Account Executive, Broker (P&C) for its South Central region. This position is responsible for broking new and renewal business for a varied portfolio of energy and non-energy clients, including middle-market and large, complex accounts. The broker will handle all aspects of the placement from strategy development through policy delivery, ensuring client needs are promptly and accurately addressed, deadlines are met, and service standards are achieved.

This is a full-time, hybrid position based in Austin or Houston, Texas. Regular in-office presence is required to support collaboration and strong partnerships across teams.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Lead marketing for a book of energy and non-energy P&C clients in the South Central region, partnering with account teams and clients to align on strategy, timelines, and execution.
  • Execute national and regional broking strategies to support optimal client outcomes, retention, and profitable growth.
  • Develop strategies for at-risk accounts and identify book-of-business optimization opportunities.

Operational Process

  • Drive placement strategy and execution, including client needs assessment, program design, carrier negotiation, and marketing execution.
  • Coordinate complete and timely submissions, respond to carrier questions, analyze quotes, and present clear recommendations to clients.
  • Determine appropriate coverage based on the client's risk profile, business objectives, and risk appetite.
  • Develop creative solutions for complex placement scenarios and manage the placement cycle in accordance with NFP's service standards and timelines.
  • Use NFP's strategic carriers, panels, and preferred wholesalers to secure appropriate coverage, terms, and pricing.
  • Prepare proposals, coverage and policy comparisons, and related client materials; review binders and policies for accuracy.
  • Use data and analytics to provide meaningful program insight and support informed placement decisions.
  • Support prospect activity, retention, and appropriate cross-sell and up-sell opportunities.

Talent Development

  • Promote consistency in broking standards and client delivery across the region.
  • Educate account executives and account managers on market dynamics, carrier trends, and how those factors affect clients and placement strategy.
  • Partner with account executives, account managers, and service teams to resolve client needs promptly.

Carrier Relationships

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with carrier and wholesale partners to enhance placement outcomes and market access.
  • Stay current on carrier appetites, market dynamics, and terms and conditions to ensure the right markets are approached for each risk.
  • Share relevant market insight with clients and internal partners to support informed risk-transfer decisions.
  • Operate as a steward of the broader NFP while engaging in the marketplace.

Qualifications

  • Five or more years of commercial P&C broking experience with middle-market, large-account, or similarly complex business.
  • Demonstrated success leading marketing discussions, negotiating with carriers and wholesalers, and managing complex new and renewal placements.
  • Strong technical knowledge and creativity in developing effective property and casualty solutions.
  • Strong client-facing, carrier-facing, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • TX P&C insurance license required.
  • Energy industry experience is preferred but not required; candidates with strong non-energy commercial P&C experience will also be considered.
  • Experience with Epic, the agency management system, is a plus but not required.
  • Ability to travel as required for client, prospect, and industry events.

What We Offer

We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $98,000–$150,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Job Description

Aon is seeking an Enterprise Client Group Industry Leader for our Natural Resources Industry across our global Enterprise Client Group and individuals serving these clients. The Natural Resources Industry Leader will be responsible for taking industry insights, content and capability to Enterprise clients globally, providing feedback from clients on trends and themes in the industry—both current and emerging. This role will be responsible for the growth of revenue across the portfolio of Enterprise Clients as well as retention and accelerated growth of the Enterprise Portfolio as well their own clients within the industry. The role will support and coach Enterprise Client Leaders to grow relationships with Aon's largest global clients within the industry.

This role involves collaborating with the Industry work done in Region and Solution Line related to Natural Resources specialty. It ensures content, insights, and innovation are used to bring our best insights, content, and capability to our Enterprise Client Group. The Industry Leader will have responsibility and accountability to implement the Industry playbook and work in collaboration with other Industry Leaders, Regional Leadership, Sales Enablement, and Marketing.

The Natural Resources Industry Leader will report directly into the Global ECG Industry Leader. This role ideally should be based in a major Aon office and will be in-office or with clients at least three days a week (hybrid).

The Natural Resources Industry Leader will require distinct capabilities in following areas:

Insights

  • Deep understanding of industry-specific issues that are top of mind for senior executives
  • Ability to connect these issues to Aon Solutions and offerings to customize products and services
  • Support industry specific content creation working closely with the Natural Resources content, capability team and solution lines
  • Bringing insights to relevant client events both hosted by Aon and where Aon is sponsor/participant
  • Build two case studies per month for use in presentations, RFPs and use with monthly Steering Committee calls and ECL calls

Relationships

  • Leverage a broad senior relationship network to open doors with new buying centers at ECG clients
  • Build deeper relationships with Enterprise Client Leaders to expand Aon's relevance and buying centers across Natural Resources Enterprise clients
  • Mentor ECLs in connecting relationship dots at clients and building trusted client relationships, including through AEC, ELT and relationship mapping
  • Maintain own book of Natural Resources clients (2–3)

Collaboration

  • Identify trends and themes to build a multi-year industry strategy and execution plan focused on 3-4 growth plays
  • Lead the Natural Resources Steering Committee, including solution line and regional representation
  • Build a Natural Resources community, partnering with industry analysts, centers of excellence and Sales Enablement to build ECL & ACL skills around relationship, relevance and scalable revenue growth
  • Support solution sprints that create value across Natural Resources ECG clients
  • Participate in Global/Regional councils to discuss external events and help ECLs bring solutions/content to market
  • Partner with Natural Resources Solution Line leaders to ensure client feedback advises thought leadership and product innovation
  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement to support Bid Engine
  • Collate ECL client feedback on trends and themes as well as any gaps in solution offerings.

Operational Excellence

  • Assess the current industry and sub-industry landscape, including white space, client plans and competitive positioning
  • Help determine which Natural Resource clients should be part of ECG, with input to regions on client assignment based on ECG profile and assignment guidelines
  • Participate in portfolio optimization for existing Natural Resource clients, including review of underperforming and uncovered clients for reassignment/assignment
  • Participate, where relevant, in interviewing ECL candidates
  • Evaluate Aon's relevance, events and thought leadership to ensure ECLs have clarity on client content, go-to-market strategy and regional alignment
  • Maintain knowledge of the industry pipeline, including offensive, defensive and value-articulation opportunities
  • Replicate and scale wins and use the jeopardy process to manage revenue at risk
  • Conduct quarterly win/loss reviews and provide input to ECG and solution lines
  • Work with the ECG talent development team to develop balanced tools that enable ECLs to deliver industry specialty relevance to clients
  • Partner with direct managers of ECLs to provide performance feedback throughout the year and during the annual performance review cycle
  • Ensure industry ECLs remain in regional and sub-regional ECG teams while helixing into the Natural Resources Industry Leader role
  • Own and drive growth sprints within Natural Resources with the Global ECG Industry Leader and Chief Commercial Officer for ECG
  • Contribute to the Quarterly Business Review for Global Industry with the CEO of ECG, CFO , Global Industry Leader and CCO

Core Skills

  • At least 10 years of industry-specific experience
  • Displays Aon United behaviors and drives value through the current operating model
  • Consulting skills: Identifies client needs, articulates the problem to be solved, recognizes barriers and assembles internal resources to achieve the desired client outcome
  • Financial acumen: Builds solid understanding of Natural Resources clients' financials and strategy and discusses these effectively with clients and internal teams
  • Effective communication: Listens and communicates with a client-centric, strategic focus; adapts to the client's style; and clearly articulates needs and actions internally
  • Team management: Influences effectively, ensures progress across client projects, aligns internal teams and actively supports RFP finalist prep, jeopardy, Articulating Value and Client Discovery sessions
  • Management information: Leverages management information to identify white space opportunities for industry growth

The Natural Resources Industry Leader will lead with a player/coach model — serving and growing their own clients (2-3) among the largest ECG Natural Resources clients while enabling industry-aligned ECLs to incrementally grow revenue.

Leadership Qualities

  • Committed as one firm to our purpose
  • United through trust as one inclusive, diverse team
  • Passionate about making our colleagues and clients successful
  • Committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

Education/Licensing

  • Holds all regulatory licenses, permissions and technical or other requirements applicable under local legislation
  • MBA or equivalent graduate degree preferred; Bachelor's degree required
