Job Description

Positioned uniquely between strategic advisory and brokerage functions, this role is part of Aon's well-known construction and infrastructure platform. As a Senior Account Executive, C&I - South Region, you will employ Aon's rich data, analytics, and market connections to develop and execute integrated, multi-line insurance solutions for complex projects. You will lead specialist teams in different regions, influence risk management from project launch through completion, and provide outstanding solutions that surpass standard placements.

This position is hybrid, offering the option to work from Atlanta, GA, Houston, TX or one of our Florida offices in Tampa, Jacksonville, or Miami.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

As a Senior Account Executive, you will advise clients on effective risk transfer, insurance design, and contract risk oversight to deliver outstanding results. The position also acts as a client representative with contracting and financing partners and leads collaborative brokerage teams across various insurance lines, including Workers' Compensation or equivalent experience, General Liability, Professional Liability, Environmental Liability, and Builders Risk.

Strategic Advisory & Risk Management

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on construction-phase risk transfer, risk financing, and risk control strategies
  • Evaluate project-specific risks and provide assessments of risk allocation, insurability, and market appetite
  • Advise clients on value-for-money risk transfer strategies applying Aon's proprietary data, benchmarking, and analytics
  • Provide guidance to ensure seamless and effective risk transfer among all project collaborators

Client Advocacy & Contract Advisory

  • Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for clients in discussions with contractors, lenders, and joint venture partners

  • Deliver thought leadership and client education sessions, including insights on U.S. versus international construction risk and insurance practices

Insurance Program Development & Brokerage Delivery

  • Lead the design and placement of best-in-class, project-specific insurance programs in collaboration with Aon product and specialty leaders
  • Coordinate brokerage teams across multiple lines of coverage to provide integrated, efficient insurance solutions
  • Prepare and lead insurance market presentations and insurer engagement strategies
  • Collaborate with internal analytics teams and external experts on EML/PML analyses and related risk modeling

Project & Collaborator Management

  • Act as the project manager across Aon's brokerage, advisory, analytics, and global service teams
  • Drive alignment across geographies, fields, and service lines to deliver consistent client outcomes
  • Translate complex insurance structures and coverage concepts into clear, practical guidance for non-insurance collaborators

How this opportunity is different

This role sits at the dynamic intersection of strategic advisory and brokerage execution within Aon's global construction and infrastructure platform. As a Senior Account Executive, you will use Aon's comprehensive data, analytics, and market relationships to design and place integrated, multi-line insurance solutions for complex, large-scale projects. You'll coordinate specialist teams across geographies, influence risk outcomes from project inception through delivery, and deliver distinctive, impactful solutions that go well beyond traditional placement.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 10–15+ years of experience in construction risk advisory, insurance brokerage, or related project risk roles
  • Deep expertise across multiple construction-related insurance lines
  • Experience advising senior client collaborators on complex, large-scale construction and infrastructure projects
  • Strong understanding of construction contracts, risk allocation, and delivery models
  • An active P&C License is required, or you must be willing to obtain one within 90 days of your hire date.

Education: Bachelor's degree or relevant experience considered equivalent.

Alongside our extensive benefits package, we promote a diverse and welcoming workforce. Additionally, our flexible work setting enables you to prioritize your wellbeing and maintain a healthy work/life balance, helping you be your best self at Aon. Moreover, every team member receives two “Global Wellbeing Days” annually, giving you the opportunity to concentrate on your personal needs. We also provide several options for different working styles to support our colleagues.

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Job Description

We are seeking a Sr. Director of Internal Consulting to lead central initiatives for Aon. The role starts with building and carrying out a multi-year strategic overhaul of our Operating Model. Reporting to the leadership team of Aon Business Services (ABS), this role leads internal consulting and program management teams. It involves crafting, orchestrating, and scaling the transformation of the enterprise operating model at Aon. The goal is to improve how we deliver value to clients, colleagues, and other interested parties. This role will engage with senior leaders across Solution Lines, Regions, and Functions. It will also lead a cross‑functional group of internal advisors, project managers, and subject matter experts to deliver measurable performance outcomes.

This role is open to a Virtual or Hybrid colleague based in Central or Eastern Time Zone.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Vision

  • Partner with ABS leadership as well as business leaders, key collaborators, and cross-functional partners to advance the vision, objectives, and scope related to operating model transformation efforts
  • Translate strategic priorities into a clear transformation roadmap with defined business outcomes, benchmarks, and value realization targets
  • Apply structured consulting methodologies (e.g., problem framing, analytical reasoning, benchmarking, argument development) to advise recommendations
  • Develop and validate arguments for operating model changes, including financial, operational, and qualitative benefits

Operating Model Design & Alignment

  • Lead the end‑to‑end diagnostic, build and transition of the target operating model across Aon's Business Units, geographic areas, and departments
  • Translate enterprise strategy into detailed organizational framework components, including capabilities, organizational structure, roles and responsibilities, governance models, and cross functional interaction patterns
  • Be responsible for phased implementation, including pilots, scaling strategies, and stabilization, ensuring alignment with regional and solution line needs
  • Build and maintain operating model blueprints, ensuring all components (capability models, interaction models, RACIs, team structures, decision rights, important metrics) integrate across the enterprise

Stakeholder Engagement & Program Leadership

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior executives. Provide insight on opportunities, trade-offs, and risks related to the operating model. Ensure agreement and engagement in strategy and roadmap.
  • Shape and deliver a compelling change narrative that articulates the “why,” “what,” and “how” of the transformation for different audiences
  • Work closely with executive sponsors and the PMO to establish and maintain robust governance, decision‑making, and blocking issue mechanisms
  • Partner with Change & Communications teams to define implications of design changes, highlight required behavior shifts, and identify points of resistance or adoption needs
  • Facilitate executive and working‑level forums to align decisions, resolve conflicts, and maintain momentum

People Leadership & Capability Building

  • Recruit, develop, and mentor a high‑performing team members with capabilities in strategy, transformation, operations, change, and analytics
  • Lead a team of internal consultants and business analysts to diagnose current‑state challenges, define solutions, and support implementation
  • Build consulting capabilities within the broader organization by sharing methodologies, tools, and guidelines
  • Promote a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement
  • Bring together and embed lessons learned into subsequent waves of organizational build changes

Skills and experience that will lead to success

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations, Technology, or related field; advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) strongly preferred
  • Proven experience in management consulting, internal strategy/consulting or equivalent internal consulting function, including significant experience at the Director level or above
  • Demonstrated experience leading sophisticated, multi‑workstream operating model or large‑scale transformation programs in a global, matrixed organization, including design, process transition and governance framework setup
  • Experience working in or with professional services, insurance, or financial services environments is highly desirable

Skills & Competencies

  • Demonstrated ability to build and coach high‑performing, complementary teams and work effectively across cultures and geographies
  • Ability to operate as a generalist across strategy development, organizational framework building, and execution support
  • Ability to roll up the sleeves and problem solve
  • Strong strategic and conceptual abilities; able to connect enterprise strategy to detailed building and implementation
  • Expertise in building operating frameworks, process re‑engineering, and organizational development
  • Excellent collaborator management and influencing skills, including experience engaging C‑suite and senior executives
  • Outstanding ability to present complex topics clearly and build engaging narratives and materials
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities; comfortable with data, financial modeling, and performance metrics
  • Growth mindset toward emerging technologies, with the ability to incorporate AI into daily work and support others in embracing new digital tools with confidence and ease. Proficiency in MS

Job Description

Aon is looking for a Risk Consultant for our Property Consulting Group

We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a Property Risk Control Consultant. This position will support Aon's Property Risk Consulting Group.

To strengthen Aon's construction risk engineering capability across the US, with a particular focus on digital infrastructure and data center projects, while also supporting broader construction-related opportunities across the region.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

  • Conduct and lead project risk reviews, design reviews, construction site surveys, underwriting surveys, construction-phase risk assessments and loss estimate assignments.

  • Support growth activity by helping country and regional leaders assess pipeline opportunities, resource needs and the technical feasibility of construction / digital infrastructure assignments.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Strong background in construction risk engineering, project risk engineering, construction insurance engineering or a closely related technical engineering discipline.
  • Experience with construction-phase risk reviews, design advisory / review work, site surveys, underwriting reports and technical risk recommendations.
  • Ability to review and interpret engineering reports, drawings and interfaces between design disciplines, particularly where assignments require short turnaround times.
  • Good understanding of data center / digital infrastructure risk drivers would be highly beneficial, including power supply, redundancy, cooling, commissioning, integrated systems testing and handover risks.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent years of industry experience and professional certifications.

Job Description

Senior Risk Consultant - Real Estate

Work Style and Location

This is a hybrid role, with an expectation of working from the office 2 to 3 days per week.

The preferred locations are Chicago, IL, or Denver, CO. Remote candidates may be considered on a case-by-case basis.

Regular travel, primarily within the United States, is required.

Role Overview

Join Aon in a highly consultative role supporting clients and prospects across our Real Estate & Hospitality practice. You will provide outsourced risk management and insurance advisory services, helping complex organizations understand their exposures, strengthen risk-management practices and make informed business and insurance decisions.

This is not a broking or account-management position. The role focuses on business risk consulting, risk analysis and risk assessments, translating complex insurance and operational risks into practical recommendations and solutions.

You will collaborate closely with the National Real Estate & Hospitality Leader and colleagues across Aon to support client engagements and practice-wide initiatives.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as a trusted consultant to real estate and hospitality clients, providing strategic risk management and business risk consulting across insurance, operational risk, risk financing and related business challenges.
  • Conduct comprehensive risk assessments and risk analysis, using established auditing procedures to evaluate exposures, controls and insurance programs and recommend practical risk-mitigation strategies.
  • Review contracts, lender requirements, property-management agreements and insurance policies to identify risk-management and regulatory compliance considerations. Evaluate property risk-control practices, including physical access controls where relevant.
  • Advise clients on claims management, loss prevention, captive insurance and alternative risk solutions, including parametric insurance and structured risk solutions. Assess existing practices and support business process design improvements that strengthen efficiency and risk mitigation.
  • Translate complex findings into clear, executive-ready reports and actionable recommendations, maintaining accurate client records, risk assessments and deliverables through effective report writing and document management.
  • Lead multiple client engagements and practice initiatives using effective project management, balancing priorities, milestones and deliverables while working closely with the National Real Estate & Hospitality Leader and colleagues across Aon.
  • Build trusted client relationships through strong customer relationship management (CRM) and clienteling practices, understanding evolving business needs and connecting clients with the right capabilities across Aon, including AGRC.

Skills and Experience That Will Lead to Success

  • Extensive risk management and insurance experience supporting complex commercial real estate operations, with a strong understanding of industry risks, mitigation techniques and Property and Casualty insurance.
  • Experience developing risk-mitigation strategies across claims management, property risk control and loss prevention, with knowledge of captive insurance, parametric insurance and other alternative risk solutions.
  • Strong consulting and analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate complex information, ask insightful questions and communicate practical recommendations to clients and senior stakeholders.
  • Experience managing multiple client relationships, projects and priorities while building collaborative relationships with clients and internal partners.
  • Strong written communication skills, including experience preparing client-facing or executive-level risk reports and interpreting contracts, lender requirements, property-management agreements and insurance policies.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree preferred; a professional qualification or designation in insurance or risk management is also desirable.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in commercial real estate risk management, insurance, brokerage, corporate risk management or a closely related environment.
  • Strong technical insurance background, including experience working within or closely with a corporate Risk Management function.

Job Description

Aon is looking for a Property Risk Consultant for our Property Consulting Group

We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a Property Risk Control Consultant. This position will support Aon's Property Risk Consulting Group.

The successful candidate can expect to work with colleagues and clients to develop an understanding of the many property risks posed by fire, earthquake, flood, and other Natural Catastrophes.

This is a remote opportunity but there will be some travel involved.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like:

  • The successful applicant should be familiar with the following:
  • Assembly of Construction, Occupancy, Protection and Exposure (COPE) Data.
  • Brokerage submission information
  • Data assembly
  • Summary documents
  • Broker renewal support
  • Attendance & participation at carrier meetings
  • Vendor management
  • Recommendation review & analysis

Complete property risk control surveys and develop property underwriting reports for a variety of occupancies:

  • Conduct Nat Cat surveys and populate primary and secondary modeling characteristics for modeling.
  • Review of available data to determine natural catastrophe exposure at client locations. Use of available online tools to analyze flood exposures in accordance with NIFP and FEMA guidelines.
  • Coordination of vendor RFPs
  • Knowledge of B&M Jurisdictional inspection requirements
  • Development and review of Maximum Foreseeable (MFL), Probable Maximum (PML) and Normal Loss (NLE) estimates.
  • Hazards associated with a variety of occupancies including manufacturing, warehousing, soft occupancies, etc.
  • Problem solving using the application of Client Standards, NFPA, FM Global or other best practices to resolve technical fire protection issues.
  • 30 to 40% travel will be involved as you may have to visit client sites.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 8 to 10 years with a Highly Protected Risk insurance carrier or vendor.
  • Technically proficient in understanding, interpreting, and applying NFPA and/or FM Global standards; and, evaluating fire protection systems (automatic sprinklers, special extinguishing systems, etc.)
  • Ideal candidate is self-sufficient, organized, and has good written and oral communication skills.
  • Must be physical fit and able to climb ladders and stairs and transition to and from ladders or stairs to access building roof areas and upper or lower floors within a customer site during surveys.
  • Ability to work from home.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent years of industry experience and professional certifications.

  • Fire protection certification preferred but not required.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and/or support other advisors in the management of client engagements.

  • Pursue professional development opportunities to include additional licenses and/or designations, and actively participate in internal and external training sessions and networking events.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Minimum 5 years of wealth management experience (other or additional experience will be considered).
  • CFP designation required.
  • Ability to independently manage and prioritize multiple projects.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to effectively manage task lists.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Flexible team player who is highly adaptable to change and open to new ideas.
  • Ability to think creatively.
  • Reliable, follows through on commitments.
  • Personal integrity and professional initiative.
  • Previous supervisory experience managing teams is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and influence/consensus-building skills.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work through questions and concerns collaboratively
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with CRM, portfolio management and financial planning software is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher preferably in financial planning, business, accounting, finance, economics, law or related experience.

REQUIRED: Strategic Consulting - Expert; Client Relationship Management - Advanced; Customer Relationship Management (CRM) - Expert; Market Research - Advanced; Meeting Facilitation - Advanced; Portfolio Management - Advanced; Project Management - Advanced; Quality of Service (QoS) - AdvancedOPTIONAL: Sales - Expert; Business Development - Intermediate; Financial Services - Experienced; Investment Management - Experienced; Investments - Experienced; Process Improvements - Advanced; Risk Management - Experienced

  • Ability to establish effective working relationships and collaborate with internal colleagues and external business partners.

Overview

The AVP, Business Line Marketing & Growth is a senior marketing leader responsible for driving enterprise-wide growth initiatives across Wealthspire's business lines and client segments, including private wealth and institutional audiences. This role serves as the primary marketing partner to Business Line Leaders, Sales, and Sales Enablement, while directly managing Marketing Managers and ensuring consistent, high-quality execution across the organization.

Reporting to the SVP, Business Line Marketing, this individual combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, translating firm and business-line priorities into actionable marketing plans that deliver measurable results. This role requires strong people leadership, communication skills, cross-functional collaboration, and a deep understanding of how marketing performance supports business growth.

Role Description

The AVP, Business Line Marketing & Growth owns the development and execution of integrated marketing strategies that support Wealthspire's growth objectives across all business lines. This role leads and prioritizes marketing efforts enterprise-wide, balancing long-term strategy with near-term execution in close partnership with Sales, Sales Enablement, and Business Line leadership.

As a manager of marketing coordinators, this role is responsible for setting direction, establishing priorities, and ensuring alignment and accountability across Marketing Managers. While this position provides oversight and leadership, it is also expected to remain execution-capable, stepping in directly on high-impact initiatives, institutional opportunities, and strategic campaigns as needed.

This individual brings a strong understanding of both institutional and private client marketing and acts as a connective leader across Wealthspire, helping unify offerings, messaging, and go-to-market execution across the firm.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enterprise & Business Line Leadership
    • Serve as the senior marketing partner to Business Line Leaders, collaborating closely to translate business objectives into integrated marketing strategies.
    • Partner with Sales and Sales Enablement to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals, pipeline development, and client acquisition strategies.
    • Contribute to enterprise-level growth planning by helping prioritize initiatives, allocate marketing resources, and sequence execution in alignment with firm strategy.
  • People Management & Team Leadership
    • Directly manage and develop multiple Marketing Managers, providing clear direction, coaching, and performance oversight.
    • Set priorities and standards across the marketing organization to ensure consistency, quality, and accountability.
    • Act as an escalation point for complex initiatives, resource constraints, and cross-functional challenges.
  • Strategy-to-Execution Ownership
    • Lead the planning and execution of enterprise and business-line marketing initiatives, including lead generation programs, institutional campaigns, strategic partnerships, and integrated go-to-market efforts.
    • Maintain the ability to execute directly on high-priority projects, ensuring momentum and excellence where senior involvement is required.
    • Oversee the development of integrated marketing plans that span channels such as events, sponsorships, advertising, content, digital campaigns, and client communications.
  • Institutional & Private Client Marketing
    • Support marketing efforts across both institutional and private client segments, ensuring strategies and messaging are appropriately tailored while aligned under a cohesive firm narrative.
    • Provide guidance on positioning, thought leadership, and campaign development to support institutional relationships and complex client needs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Work closely with the SVP and other leaders across Wealthspire to ensure marketing initiatives reflect a deep understanding of the firm's services, capabilities, and operating model.
    • Collaborate with corporate and centralized marketing teams to align brand standards, messaging frameworks, and campaign execution.
    • Engage and manage external vendors and partners to support large-scale initiatives and events as needed.
  • Performance, Metrics & Optimization
    • Establish clear success metrics for enterprise and business-line marketing initiatives in collaboration with stakeholders.
    • Review performance data and insights to optimize strategies, inform decision-making, and report results to senior leadership.
    • Ensure Marketing Managers are tracking and reporting outcomes consistently across initiatives.

Qualifications and Experience

  • 5+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience supporting both institutional and private client audiences.
  • Demonstrated success managing and developing people, preferably managing managers in a matrixed or enterprise environment.
  • Strong strategic marketing background with the ability to translate complex business goals into actionable plans.
  • Proven execution skills, with experience leading multiple, concurrent initiatives under tight timelines.
  • Experience partnering closely with Sales and Sales Enablement teams.
  • High level of comfort working cross-functionally and influencing senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and prioritization skills.
  • Financial services or professional services experience strongly preferred.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Business Line Leaders and Sales teams view marketing as a strategic growth partner.
  • Marketing Managers are aligned, empowered, and executing consistently at a high level.
  • Enterprise marketing initiatives are clearly prioritized, well-executed, and measurable.
  • The firm presents a cohesive, differentiated marketing presence across private and institutional audiences.
  • The SVP, Business Line Marketing can operate at a higher strategic level, confident in executional excellence beneath them.

Summary:

Wealthspire is seeking a highly skilled Network Architect to compose, build, and operate a secure, resilient, and scalable enterprise network environment. This role is critical to supporting Wealthspire's modern cloud-first strategy, hybrid workforce, and ongoing growth initiatives, including carve-outs and future M&A integrations.

The Network Architect will act as the technical lead for connectivity, networking standards, and network security. They will collaborate closely with Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Cloud, and End User Computing teams to deliver reliable and high-performing services throughout the firm.

Key Responsibilities:

Network Architecture & Engineering

  • Build and maintain enterprise network architecture, including LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, cloud connectivity (Azure), and telephony/network integrations.
  • Establish architecture standards, documentation, and roadmaps for routing, switching, segmentation, firewalling, and zero-trust networking.
  • Architect, implement, and support enterprise network solutions across corporate offices, data centers, and cloud environments.
  • Support Microsoft-centric environments (Azure, M365, Intune) with secure and optimized connectivity.

Operations & Reliability

  • Coordinate network monitoring, performance tuning, high availability, and incident response.
  • Ensure redundancy, failover, and disaster recovery capabilities are tested and maintained.
  • Act as a point of contact for complex network issues and customer concerns.
  • Drive configuration, change, and lifecycle management guidelines.

Security & Compliance

  • Partner with the CISO organization on IAM integration, firewall policies, endpoint connectivity, and secure remote access.
  • Support regulatory and compliance requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27001, SEC, GDPR, NYDFS).

Carve-Outs & M&A

  • Complete network separation and integration activities aligned to carve-out timelines.
  • Lead network-related activities for carve-outs, separations, and M&A integrations, including developing repeatable playbooks.

Vendor & Collaborator Management

  • Manage network service providers, ISPs, telecom vendors, and MSPs, including day-to-day Technology operations and vendor relationships.
  • Drive SLA performance, cost optimization, and vendor consolidation where appropriate.
  • Work together with Infrastructure, Service Desk, Cloud, and End User Computing teams to provide smooth employee experiences.

Qualifications:

  • 8–12+ years of experience in enterprise networking and infrastructure roles.
  • Proven experience as a Network Architect or Senior Network Engineer in a complex environment.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with SD-WAN, firewalls, VPNs, routing/switching, and cloud networking (Azure).
  • Experience supporting hybrid workforces and multi-site enterprise environments.
  • Exposure to carve-outs, integrations, or M&A activity strongly preferred.
  • Strong documentation, communication, and collaborator engagement skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Azure Networking) are a plus.

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Opportunity to build and modernize enterprise network architecture in a growing wealth management firm.
  • High visibility role with impact across security, cloud, and end-user experience.
  • Collaborative culture passionate about operational excellence, resilience, and innovation.
  • Hybrid work environment with flexibility and career growth opportunities.

Are you ready to shape how sophisticated health analytics advise executive decision-making? Join Aon and help bring our analytics capabilities together to deliver clearer insights and greater impact for clients!

Your role sits at the intersection of client advisory, analytics content strategy, financial measurement, and health economics. It also involves total-cost-of-care optimization and advancing Aon's data-driven, AI-enabled client delivery model.

You will be the trusted voice clients and consultants rely on to interpret sophisticated analytics across many domains. You will also connect our financial, predictive modeling, health economics, clinical, pharmacy, network, and care delivery analytics into one clear set of client content and solutions.

  • Advise clients and prospects on sophisticated, cross-domain analytics, translating financial, predictive, clinical, pharmacy, network, and cost-of-care analyses into actionable guidance for HR, Finance, and C-suite audiences.

You'll partner closely with analytics domain leaders, consultants, and client leaders to bring together repeatable, scalable analytics with deep-dive domain expertise — building a shared content capability that raises the quality, consistency, and client impact of everything Aon delivers.

You'll shape how we progressively deliver insight across the full client spectrum: from early-stage prospects with limited available data, to established clients with rich, longitudinal data ecosystems — and across employer segments of every size.

Success in this role depends on deep credibility in health and benefits analytics. It also requires a genuine passion for client advisory, positive relationship skills, and rigor to turn sophisticated analysis into scalable content.

The right candidate will have a track record of advising clients directly on sophisticated analytics decisions including evaluating health carriers, vendors, and point solutions, and bridging technical domains to produce unified, scalable models and deliverables.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Responsible for broking/placing primarily Clinical Trials Liability as well Products Liability, Errors & Omissions Liability, and Excess Liability
  • Market new and renewal business, handling all aspects of the placements from initial market selection through the long-term servicing until the clinical trials these policies are covering are over.
  • Demonstrate effective negotiation skills on behalf of clients and prospects.
  • Ensure that placements are handled timely and correctly
  • Develop productive business relationships with key insurance underwriters and Aon local office teams
  • Identify and analyze prospect and client exposures.
  • Coordinate activities with other internal units as required to meet customer needs.
  • Create presentations such as Renewal Strategies and Coverage Proposals.
  • Responsible for planning, scheduling, resourcing and executing complex projects/programs.
  • Frequently interacts with senior level colleagues and clients, normally involving matters between functional areas, other company divisions or units, or clients and the company.

How this opportunity is different

Join Aon's industry-leading team in the Life Sciences sector, where you'll provide innovative Clinical Trial Liability solutions to clients in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries. This role offers flexibility for hybrid work, with opportunities to work from Philadelphia or other East Coast locations. You'll manage complex insurance placements, build key relationships with underwriters, and contribute to vital clinical trials that support the approval of life-saving drugs and devices. With a focus on collaboration, trust, and professional growth, this is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact in healthcare.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

Unlike most insurance programs, the primary purpose of Clinical Trial Liability insurance is to support Pharma and Biotech companies through regulatory approvals and contractual compliance while simultaneously protecting these trial sponsors and their research partners from financial liability in case of injury or harm.

Clinical trials are essential for the approval of new drugs and medical devices, as they provide the data needed to assess safety and efficacy in humans, a requirement for regulatory approval by agencies like the FDA. To generate this volume of data, clinical trials must take place in many countries who closely regulate the activity including the clinical trial liability insurance. Our team of specialized brokers, through global and local insurance partners, provides the necessary local insurance ensuring no trial is ever delayed due to insurance reasons thus supporting our clients in their mission of saving and improving lives.

  • Attention to detail, ability to multi-task, exceptional organizational skills, ability to present complex insurance programs.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of insurance brokerage and/or underwriting experience (preferred Life Sciences in Clinical Trials Liability and/or Casualty Line experience)
  • Effective working knowledge of carrier underwriting practices & processes.
  • Proven client facing skills including effective presentations & communications.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively at various levels in the organization.
  • Ability to independently manage a dynamic book of clients
  • Successfully operates in a fast-paced driven environment that requires the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Must maintain appropriate broker's and Surplus Lines licenses.

Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of industry experience.

  • A Property and Casualty Brokers License is required or must be obtained within 90 days of hire if not already active.

Summary:We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Compensation Manager to lead the design, execution, and governance of our compensation programs. This role will partner closely with HR and business leaders to ensure competitive, equitable, and data-driven pay practices that support organizational growth and talent strategy.

What You'll Do

Own Compensation Strategy & Program Design

  • Partner with the CPO to define and evolve the company's compensation philosophy and pay practices.
  • Design, implement, and continuously refine compensation structures including base pay, incentive plans, bonus programs, and special pay arrangements.
  • Develop and maintain salary structures, pay grades, and job architecture frameworks.
  • Conduct market benchmarking and external salary survey analysis to ensure competitiveness and alignment with business strategy.
  • Evaluate and recommend enhancements to compensation programs based on workforce trends, market conditions, and organizational growth.

Lead Annual Compensation Cycles

  • Own the end-to-end annual merit, bonus, and promotion cycles — including planning, modeling, budgeting, system configuration (Workday), manager enablement, and final approvals.
  • Develop compensation modeling scenarios and provide executive-ready analytics and recommendations.
  • Ensure timely and accurate implementation of approved changes within HRIS and payroll systems.
  • Partner with Finance on budget alignment and accrual forecasting.

Ensure Pay Equity & Governance

  • Conduct internal equity analyses to prevent compression and ensure fairness across functions and levels.
  • Analyze compensation data to identify disparities, trends, and risk areas; provide data-driven recommendations.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, including pay transparency requirements.
  • Maintain documentation and governance standards for compensation processes and decisions.
  • Establish internal controls to mitigate risk and ensure consistency in pay decisions.

Support Talent Acquisition & Offer Governance

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR Business Partners to evaluate offers, sign-on bonuses, and promotional increases.
  • Review and approve compensation packages to ensure alignment with internal equity and market positioning.
  • Provide guidance on job leveling, salary bands, and offer strategy.
  • Verify compensation-related components of offer letters and ensure accurate system entry.

Oversee Compensation-Related Payroll & Adjustments

  • Partner with Payroll to ensure accurate processing of compensation changes, where applicable.
  • Review payroll data to validate compensation-related changes prior to final disbursement (e.g, mass merit uploads)
  • Collaborate with HR and Legal on severance modeling and payment processing.

Deliver Data-Driven Insights

  • Develop executive-level reporting and dashboards related to compensation trends, budget utilization, pay equity, and workforce analytics.
  • Conduct scenario modeling to support workforce planning and strategic decision-making.
  • Maintain data integrity within Workday and ensure alignment between HRIS and payroll systems.

Drive Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to streamline compensation workflows and enhance automation within Workday.
  • Develop SOPs and documentation to ensure consistency and audit readiness.
  • Stay current on compensation best practices, regulatory changes, and emerging market trends.
  • undefined

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business, or related field preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive compensation experience, including ownership of compensation cycles.
  • Experience designing and managing salary structures and incentive programs.
  • Strong expertise in market benchmarking and salary survey analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting pay equity and internal compression analyses.
  • Advanced analytical skills with strong Excel and data modeling capability.
  • Experience working within Workday Compensation module or similar HRIS platforms preferred.
  • Strong understanding of payroll processes and compensation compliance requirements.
  • Exceptional discretion and ability to manage highly confidential information.
  • Ability to operate independently as a function-of-one while influencing senior stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

  • CCP (Certified Compensation Professional)
  • PHR/SPHR or SHRM-CP/SCP

Be part of the industry-leading team bringing Aon's innovative defined contribution 401(k) savings plan to employers across the U.S. – the Aon Pooled Employer Plan (Aon PEP).   • Achieve annual Aon PEP sales goals.

Job Description

Posting Description

Who We Are

Lenox Advisors brings together sophisticated solutions in wealth management and insurance services to high-net-worth individuals and their families. As a wholly owned subsidiary of NFP Corp., an Aon Company, we combine the culture of a boutique firm with the stability and backing of a large corporation to create an environment that's truly unique. NFP is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We're a recognized Elite Agency award winner and a leading property and casualty broker, benefits consultant, wealth manager, and retirement plan advisor. NFP provides solutions enabling client success through the expertise of over 8,000 global employees, investments in innovative technologies, and enduring relationships with highly rated insurers, vendors and financial institutions. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com.

Position Summary

Supports the Relationship Manager by scheduling and coordinating activities and initiatives that facilitate the new policy and client service processes. The Client Services Associate must provide superior client service by identifying the client's wants and needs, acting on, and/or delegating items and following through to completion while keeping all parties informed throughout the process.

Responsibilities

Pre-Sale and New Business

  • Assembles meeting preparation documents pertaining to the client/prospect prior to sales meetings, including but not limited to, illustrations, policy and product summaries, reports, presentations, and marketing packets
  • Performs all insurance underwriting duties, including preparation and completion of multi-life and individual disability, life, and long term care applications
  • Schedules medical insurance exams and orders all Attending Physician Statements based on insurance underwriting guidelines
  • Follows up with the client and Relationship Manager during the underwriting process, keeps notes on the process and conversations in MOSAIC
  • Collaborates with the New Business Team to manage all new business arguments using MOSAIC as the system of record for status, notes, and tasks. Communicates with RM and client as necessary.
  • Participates in Relationship Manager/New Business case management calls
  • Reviews insurance policies and prepares them for delivery; follows up on delivery requirements when needed
  • Ensures Relationship Manager has appropriate Licensing and Appointments and works with internal contracting and licensing contact to obtain and renew licenses
  • Partners with Advanced Sales to acquire and/or generate the appropriate illustrations/one-pagers
  • Processes all policy changes including reinstatement of lapsed cases, smoker rating changes, addition or removal of policy riders, and face amount reductions
  • Partners with Private Wealth Management Team to process individual asset management applications, service requests, and performance summaries
  • Coordinates tasks and responsibilities for all joint work

Client Service

  • Processes all insurance policy service requests, including address, beneficiary/ownership changes, premium mode changes, and dividend option changes
  • Provides outstanding client service through recognizing client's wants and needs, acting on, and/or delegating items and following through to completion, keeping all parties informed throughout the process
  • Coordinates all collateral assignments, death or disability claims, and fund allocation changes with the assistance of the Relationship Manager
  • Interacts with insurance carriers and vendors daily to ensure accurate and timely execution of client service requests
  • Takes a proactive lead on conserving the Relationship Manager's existing block of business by advising clients of overdue insurance premiums and coverage in danger of lapsing, tracking all attempts and progress, and keeping the Relationship Manager informed of problematic cases
  • Ability to follow through on a variety of requests and ability to resolve client and/or service related matters.
  • Crafts client correspondence as needed according to the Lenox Style Guide

Business Operations

  • Responsible for greeting clients, fielding phone calls, reviewing incoming mail, managing office supplies, ordering client gifts, and maintaining client files
  • Manages the Relationship Manager's calendar, scheduling and confirming client meetings, registering visitors with security, and booking conference rooms
  • Ensures data accuracy by regularly and routinely updating information in MOSAIC and maintaining client files. This includes, but is not limited to, fact find information and notes, case management (individual and MultiLife), task management, and client and policy information
  • Participates in occasional training and development sessions as directed by department(s) and Regional Manager
  • Builds feeder lists as requested
  • Partners with the Relationship Manager when participating in Lenox marketing campaigns, including MOSAIC list updates as well as updating client email addresses

Job Competencies

Required Knowledge

  • Knowledge of office equipment operations (copier, scanner, printers) and electronic calendaring programs (Microsoft Outlook)
  • Familiarity with business principles and practices
  • Familiarity working with Client Database Management systems
  • Knowledge of customer support principles

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written (email, written memos, telephone, voicemail, etc.)
  • Ability to interact with clients diplomatically and professionally
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast paced sales environment
  • Ability to work independently and also to collaborate with teams
  • Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
  • Organizational, planning and critical thinking skills
  • Ability to multitask

Required Behaviors/Attitudes

  • Demonstrates initiative, dependability, confidences and assertiveness
  • Team oriented; demonstrates a service attitude
  • Cares about delivering quality
  • Excels in planning & organizing
  • Take personal ownership for delivery of superior results; conscientious
  • Demonstrate strong dedication to meeting the needs of internal and external clients

Education/experience/license requirements

Education

  • High School Diploma Required
  • College Degree Preferred

Experience

  • 1-3 Years of Customer Service Experience
  • 3-5 Years of Industry Experience Preferred

What We Offer

We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

Job Description

Partner, Head of Rewards Advisory, North America

Role Overview

As the Head of Rewards Advisory, North America, you will lead Aon's Rewards business across the region, shaping strategy, driving growth and delivering market-leading rewards solutions to Aon's clients across enterprise and mid-market segments! This role combines deep rewards expertise with strategic business leadership, commercial acumen, and a strong understanding of how total rewards can create measurable value for clients.

In addition to serving as a trusted advisor to executive leadership teams, you will be accountable for the growth, profitability, talent strategy, and market leadership of the North America Rewards practice, while partnering closely with Rewards & Workforce Analytics colleagues to connect rewards, workforce transformation, and talent advisory opportunities across the market!

Key Responsibilities

Practice Leadership & P&L Accountability

  • Lead the North America Rewards business with full accountability for revenue growth, profitability, forecasting, budgeting, resource deployment, and overall business performance across mid-market and enterprise rewards offerings.
  • Develop and implement the strategic vision and growth agenda for the practice, making sure it aligns with broader Human Capital objectives and Aon's business strategy. Coordinate this with the priorities of the North American Talent group.
  • Provide leadership for the continued evolution, positioning, and operational execution of both the mid-market rewards and enterprise rewards solutions, ensuring each offering is clearly differentiated, scalable, and connected to broader client needs.
  • Monitor market trends, client demand, competitive dynamics, and emerging workforce challenges to find opportunities for innovation, expansion, and investment across compensation, total rewards, organizational change, and talent consulting solutions.
  • Drive disciplined business management, operational excellence, and performance accountability across the practice, including active collaboration with the Head of Rewards & Workforce Analytics, NA Talent Solutions on shared growth priorities, integrated offerings, and cross-practice execution.

Business Development & Market Leadership

  • Act as the senior market leader for Rewards in North America, driving the growth of existing client relationships and originating new opportunities with large multinational organizations, middle-market companies, and other priority client segments.
  • Establish trusted advisor relationships with CHROs, CFOs, Boards of Directors, Compensation Committees, and Executive Leadership Teams.
  • Develop and enact go-to-market strategies, drive market visibility, and shape Aon's Rewards value proposition across both mid-market and enterprise client needs.
  • Identify and advance total rewards opportunities with clients, including compensation strategy, benefits integration, wellbeing, recognition, pay transparency, career frameworks, workforce analytics, and broader talent transformation needs.
  • Champion Aon's United model by partnering across Human Capital, Health, Wealth, Risk Capital, and Talent Solutions to deliver integrated client solutions that connect rewards, workforce transformation, and broader talent advisory capabilities.
  • Represent Aon externally through thought leadership, speaking engagements, industry forums, research initiatives, and client events to strengthen the firm's market position in rewards and total rewards advisory.

Client Leadership & Advisory

  • Lead large-scale, enterprise rewards transformations spanning multiple geographies and business units, while also supporting scalable mid-market rewards solutions that meet evolving client needs.
  • Orchestrate complex consulting engagements involving global job architecture, position management, job evaluation, market benchmarking, incentive program development, rewards governance, pay transparency, and total rewards strategy.
  • Advise clients on compensation strategy, pay competitiveness, internal equity, workforce effectiveness, and the broader employee value proposition created through total rewards.
  • Support clients in integrating rewards strategies into broader talent, workforce, analytics, and business transformation initiatives, in partnership with relevant leaders across NA Talent Solutions.

Talent & Team Leadership

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of rewards consultants across North America with the capabilities required to serve mid-market and enterprise clients.
  • Drive colleague engagement, capability development, succession planning, and leadership pipeline growth within the practice.
  • Mentor and coach senior leaders and consultants to strengthen commercial insight, consulting excellence, technical expertise, and the ability to identify total rewards opportunities with clients.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and leading from the middle, including strong partnership with the Head of Rewards & Workforce Analytics, NA Talent Solutions and other cross-solution leaders.
  • Ensure effective workforce planning and prioritisation throughout the practice, aligning talent deployment to client demand, growth priorities, and the needs of both mid-market and enterprise rewards solutions.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Extensive experience in total rewards consulting or senior in-house rewards leadership within large, complex, multi-national or global organizations, including significant experience advising executive leadership teams.
  • Demonstrated success leading a consulting practice, business unit, or significant portfolio with direct accountability for revenue, profitability, forecasting, and strategic growth across multiple client segments.
  • Proven track record of originating, leading, and closing complex, multi-year consulting engagements and consistently achieving growth objectives in rewards, total rewards, and adjacent talent advisory solutions.
  • Deep expertise in global rewards strategy, compensation program design, incentive plan development, rewards governance, workforce analytics, pay transparency, and talent strategy.
  • Strong commercial and financial competence, including experience managing P&L performance, building scalable market offerings, and driving sustainable business growth.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing high-performing teams, building leadership pipelines, implementing succession strategies, and collaborating across matrixed teams to deliver integrated client solutions.
  • Outstanding executive presence, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to establish credibility and build relationships with senior stakeholders across complex organizations.
  • Established success navigating global and matrixed environments while leading multiple strategic priorities and delivering exceptional client outcomes.

This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work 3 days in our New York City Office and 2 days from home.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

Aon STG Strategy Advisory provides consulting services to firms who operate across the insurance landscape, which include many of the most prestigious companies in the Global Property, Casualty, Insurtech, Digital Platforms, and Health and Benefit (re)insurance market. We help our clients to navigate a fast-changing market environment to drive profitable and sustainable growth and business results. We have privileged access to Aon's proprietary data and its global network of (re)insurance industry experts to derive unique and compelling insights into the sources of competitive advantage in our industry. Most importantly we help our clients to turn insights into practical actions and into tangible outcomes.

As a Strategy Consulting Director you will:

  • Lead the full lifecycle of complex client engagements from ideation to project scope definition to project management, delivery and presentation to C-suite
  • Manage the overall client relationship building credibility and trust
  • Be responsible for project delivery and managing Associate, Senior Associate and Manager team members within the project team

  • Lead by strong example, mentor, coach, and potentially line manage Associates and Senior Associates
  • Support and lead additional function (talent, data, operations, etc) in support of STG's growth including data management, operations, compliance, etc.

How this opportunity is different

As a Strategy Consulting Director, you will be in a client-facing role working directly with Client Leaders and Aon Leadership to develop strategies and solutions to help our clients turn insights into practical actions, and into tangible returns. Your role will involve leading consulting teams to deliver business focused initiatives and strategic recommendations for our clients through understanding their objectives, addressing their challenges, developing an understanding of market conditions and issues, and defining strategies that drive growth opportunities and competitive market advantages. In addition to Client delivery, you will be responsible for managing Client relationships and Aon network relationships, coaching, mentoring, and developing the staff, contribute to expanding STG's market presence, and supporting the growth of our organization.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 10+ years of work experience in corporate strategy or management consulting (prominent advisory firm experience is preferred) and experience in the P&C insurance industry
  • Experience leading projects and managing teams of professionals to deliver quality and insightful work to Executive stakeholders
  • Experienced in business storytelling and formulating strategic narratives
  • Ability to develop robust and impactful Client & Executive presentations
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong analytical abilities and a track record of business success
  • Strong attention to detail and a critical eye in overseeing work of more junior team members
  • Ability to perform well under pressure, on multiple work streams, and with tight deadlines
  • Fluency in Microsoft Office applications (PowerPoint and Excel)
  • Willing to travel (typically less than 20%)

Job Description

Program Consultant, Worker's Compensation

The Workers' Compensation Program Consultant is responsible for the comprehensive management, oversight, and optimization of complex workers' compensation programs. This role requires deep expertise in program design, implementation, continuous monitoring, and process improvement.

The Consultant acts as a key liaison between internal stakeholders, third-party administrators (TPAs), insurance carriers, and external vendors to ensure effective claim management, compliance, and cost containment.

This is a remote opportunity.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

Workers' Compensation Program Management

  • Design, implement, and oversee workers' compensation programs, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate and lead regular claim reviews (multiple times per year) and manage follow-up action items per agreed plans of action.
  • Monitor and review new claims, subrogation opportunities, claim delays, denials, and reserve changes, and recommend corrective action as necessary.
  • Liaise with local operations and TPA to facilitate information exchange, address program issues, and ensure service quality.
  • Oversee state-specific programs, including monopolistic state oversight and premium payment coordination (e.g., Ohio BWC).

Claims Oversight and Litigation Management

  • Provide continuous oversight and monitoring of claim activity, including significant loss cases and legal calendar management.
  • Manage litigation processes, including defense attorney panel management, performance monitoring, and implementation of changes as needed.
  • Stay current on technical, legislative, and legal changes affecting workers' compensation programs and communicate relevant updates to local operations.
  • Coordinate and monitor all legal plans of action (POAs) related to workers' compensation claims.

Program Advocacy and Stewardship

  • Act as a program advocate, coordinating stewardship programs and benchmarking exercises to measure and enhance program performance.
  • Develop and provide educational materials and training sessions to local operations on program-specific topics, technical changes, and best practices.

Vendor and Provider Management

  • Manage relationships with medical provider networks, including quality monitoring, provider changes, and conducting provider interviews.
  • Field and resolve vendor inquiries, research issues, and coordinate resolution of unpaid invoices.
  • Modify service level agreements and special account handling instructions as necessary to optimize service delivery.

Data Analytics and Program Improvement

  • Review and analyze loss data and claims analytics to identify cost-saving opportunities and areas for program improvement.
  • Coordinate claims audits and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Gather and report relevant data to support program objectives and drive decision-making.

Additional Program Support

  • Support manufacturing and owner-controlled insurance program (OCIP) claim oversight, including business unit claim reviews and annual stewardship.
  • Develop and update service instructions and program documentation as needed.
  • Coordinate efforts with the Safety and Human Resources departments to align claims management with organizational safety initiatives as well as remain compliant within each jurisdiction.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 7+ years in workers' compensation program management, consulting, or claims administration.
  • In-depth knowledge of state and federal workers' compensation laws, regulations, and program requirements.
  • Proven ability to manage complex claims, litigation, and vendor/provider relationships.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience with claims data analytics and program benchmarking.
  • Excellent communication, training, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience with monopolistic state programs (e.g., Ohio BWC) and multi-state program oversight preferred.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Insurance, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree or professional certifications (e.g., ARM, CPCU) are a plus

Wealthspire has a long and successful history of serving ultra-high net-worth multi-generational families. As a Senior Wealth Strategist, this role will join an experienced team in shaping Wealthspire's approach to helping multi-generational families understand the challenges and opportunities of managing their wealth through financial, estate and tax planning. This role partners with colleagues across the organization, as well as outside advisors, in strategically advising UHNW clients with estate planning, tax planning and multi-generational planning.   • Propose special needs planning strategies to enhance a disabled family member's life while maintaining eligibility for government services and benefits.
  • Educate clients on potential asset protection strategies to protect family members from divorcing spouses or other creditors.

  • Initiative-taking thought leader regarding estate and tax planning and active leader within the advisor team for clients.

  • Raise the profile of the firm through publishing and speaking externally.
  • Work collaboratively with the Director of Wealth Strategy on strategy for building and growing the business.

  • Advisor to high-net-worth clients at a wealth management firm a plus.
  • Specific expertise in philanthropy or business succession planning a plus.

Job Description

Posting Description

Who We Are

NFP, an Aon company, is a leading insurance broker and consultant providing property and casualty, employee benefits, wealth management and retirement solutions. We combine specialized expertise, strong carrier relationships and a people-first culture to help clients address complex risk and business challenges. NFP has been recognized by Business Insurance as a Best Place to Work in Insurance for ten consecutive years.

About NFP's Safety & Risk Consulting (SRC)

NFP's Safety & Risk Consulting (SRC) practice is a national team of safety, loss control and risk management professionals who support clients across industries and geographies. The team provides practical, client-specific consulting focused on protecting people, strengthening operations, reducing loss drivers and improving risk quality. SRC works collaboratively with clients, NFP account teams, producers, insurance carriers and other technical specialists to connect field-based risk improvement with broader insurance and business objectives.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Construction Safety Consultant to provide hands-on safety and risk control consulting to construction clients primarily throughout the New York, New Jersey and Connecticut Tri-State area, while also supporting national clients and projects. The consultant will evaluate jobsite and operational exposures, develop practical risk improvement strategies, deliver training, and serve as a technical resource to client leadership, field teams, NFP colleagues and insurance partners.

This is a full-time, field-based position with remote flexibility when not traveling. Approximately 60% travel is expected, including local jobsite travel and periodic overnight national travel. The ideal candidate will live in or near the New York City metropolitan area with convenient access to a major airport.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct construction jobsite safety assessments, loss control surveys and management-system reviews for general contractors, owners, developers and trade contractors.
  • Evaluate high-hazard construction exposures and controls, including falls, scaffolds, ladders, excavation and trenching, cranes and rigging, electrical work, hot work, confined spaces, temporary structures, material handling, public protection and contractor management.
  • Review and help strengthen corporate and project-specific safety programs, site safety plans, emergency action plans, job hazard analyses, pre-task plans, subcontractor controls and written compliance programs.
  • Analyze loss runs, incident trends, experience modifiers and other available risk data to identify loss drivers, prioritize resources and develop measurable service plans.
  • Perform incident and near-miss reviews, support root-cause analysis, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. This role does not replace the client's legal, claims or regulatory counsel.
  • Deliver practical training, executive briefings, supervisor coaching and toolbox-style education on construction safety, regulatory compliance and risk improvement topics.
  • Prepare clear, timely reports that document observations, identify priority hazards, recommend corrective actions and communicate risk implications to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Partner with NFP producers, account teams, claims professionals and carrier risk control representatives to support client stewardship, renewal strategy, prospect evaluations and coordinated service delivery, including Owner Controlled Insurance Program (OCIP) and Contractor Controlled Insurance Program (CCIP) safety and loss-control activities.
  • Support OCIP and CCIP program activities, including preconstruction safety reviews, contractor and subcontractor safety qualification, project-specific safety planning, orientation and training coordination, site audits, loss-trend review, corrective-action tracking, stewardship reporting and collaboration with program sponsors, administrators, carriers and claims partners.
  • Participate in client meetings and business development activities as a construction safety subject matter resource, including service-plan development and presentation of findings to senior leadership.
  • Maintain current knowledge of applicable federal, state and local requirements and accepted industry practices, including OSHA construction standards and relevant New York City construction and local regulations safety requirements.
  • Manage multiple client engagements independently, document activity in designated systems and consistently meet agreed timelines and service expectations.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of progressive construction safety, loss control or construction risk consulting experience, with substantial field-based jobsite experience.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting Owner Controlled Insurance Programs (OCIPs) and Contractor Controlled Insurance Programs (CCIPs), including project safety oversight, contractor coordination, loss-control activities and program reporting.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in occupational safety, construction management, engineering, risk management or a related subject area, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • OSHA 510, Occupational Safety and Health Standards for the Construction Industry.
  • Completion of applicable New York City Department of Buildings Site Safety Training (SST) requirements and other NYC construction safety training required for the consultant's assigned project duties.
  • Working knowledge of OSHA 29 CFR 1926 and the ability to interpret and apply applicable federal, state and local construction safety requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify hazards, evaluate controls, analyze incidents and losses, and translate findings into practical recommendations.
  • Strong written, presentation, facilitation and client relationship skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with executives, project managers, superintendents, safety professionals and craft employees.
  • Valid driver's license, an acceptable driving record consistent with company requirements, and the ability to drive to client and project locations and travel approximately 60%, including local travel and overnight national travel.
  • Ability to perform field-based construction work while wearing required safety PPE. The position requires walking active jobsites; climbing stairs and ladders; accessing elevated, confined, uneven or unfinished work areas; standing for extended periods; bending, stooping, kneeling and reaching; and lifting or carrying up to 25 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and comfort using web-based safety, risk control and client-management platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or Construction Health and Safety Technician (CHST). Associate Safety Professional (ASP) may be considered for candidates actively progressing toward the CSP.
  • OSHA 500 authorized trainer status is strongly preferred for candidates who will deliver OSHA Outreach training.
  • Experience supporting complex commercial, infrastructure, civil, high-rise, healthcare, industrial or large general-contractor construction programs.
  • Experience within a property and casualty insurance carrier, insurance brokerage, risk consulting firm or owner-controlled/contractor-controlled insurance program environment.
  • Familiarity with workers' compensation, general liability, auto/fleet and builders risk loss drivers, as well as insurance-related stewardship and carrier risk control processes.
  • Bilingual communication skills, particularly English and Spanish, are a plus.

Work Environment and Travel

This position is virtual when not at client or project locations. The consultant will primarily assist clients in the New York, New Jersey and Connecticut Tri-State area and will also support national clients as business needs require. Approximately 60% travel is expected. Residence in or around New York City, with convenient access to John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport or another major airport serving the region, is preferred. The work includes active construction environments and requires use of appropriate PPE, ladder and stair access, regular walking and standing, and occasional lifting or carrying up to 25 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Our PeopleFirst culture is focused on building meaningful relationships, supporting employee wellbeing and creating opportunities for colleagues to grow and make an impact.
