What Is the Opportunity?

As an Outside Auto Appraiser, you are responsible for physically inspecting damaged vehicles, estimating repair costs, working closely with repair facilities, and determining and settling the actual cash value of total loss vehicles to ensure accurate and timely claim settlements. In this customer-facing role, you will need to have a high level of technical expertise in vehicle damage assessment, strong customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. This position will serve as a technical resource for auto claim staff and will provide advice and direction to claim professionals on claim damages to achieve optimal outcomes. This position is based remotely with work at residential and/or commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

What Will You Do?

  • Inspect and assess vehicle damage resulting from accidents, weather events, or other covered losses by conducting thorough virtual or on-site inspections at body shops or customer locations.
  • Perform estimate review work, conduct virtual inspections, and collaborate with repair facilities to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality across claims.
  • Prepare accurate repair estimates using industry-standard estimating software to determine the cost of parts, labor, and materials required to restore vehicles to pre-loss condition.
  • Evaluate and settle vehicle total losses by determining actual cash value (ACV) through market research, comparable vehicle analysis, and application of appropriate valuation tools and methodologies.
  • Negotiate repair costs and settlements with body shops, customers, and third-party claimants to reach fair and timely resolutions while maintaining quality repair standards.
  • Identify and document pre-existing damage, prior repairs, and potential fraud indicators to ensure accurate claim evaluation and protect company interests.
  • Collaborate with claim representatives, body shops, and vendors to coordinate repairs, authorize supplements, and resolve coverage or repair-related issues.
  • Provide exceptional customer service by explaining the appraisal process, answering questions, assisting in moving claims towards timely resolution, and keeping vehicle owners informed throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Two years of auto physical damage appraisal experience.
  • Proficient in claims management and estimating software, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers throughout the claim process.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution skills; ability to facilitate productive discussions and reach equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Basic understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations and claim handling requirements.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • One year of auto physical damage appraisal or comparable claim related experience or successful completion of required Travelers Claim Representative training program.

As a Technical Specialist, General Liability, you will be responsible for managing and investigating moderate complexity injury and/or property damage claims including customer contact, determining coverage, evaluating liability, assessing damages, establishing timely reserves, and issue timely and accurate payments within appropriate authority and oversight. In this technical role, you will leverage your expertise in claims management, investigative techniques, coverage evaluation, and settlement negotiation to ensure timely and fair resolution. You will foster positive, professional relationships with customers and stakeholders on claims that may involve significant litigation or span extended periods. You will provide guidance and mentorship to Claim Reps and Associate Claim Reps, sharing knowledge and best practices to support their development.

What Will You Do?

  • Independently manage an active caseload of injury and/or property damage claims and litigation from first notice of loss through resolution within level of authority. Typically, handles personal and/or business insurance high complexity liability claims which may include coverage disputes and contractual indemnity issues.

  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Identify areas in which we can improve or enhance current best practices and offer creative solutions.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers' requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • May require travel, including overnight stays, to attend mediations, trials, arbitration, etc.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Is the Opportunity?

Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning in October. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role. Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Are you curious by nature? Do you enjoy managing relationships and employing your critical thinking skills? Underwriters perform the critical function of evaluating the acceptability of risk and determining appropriate pricing for insurance products. The Business Insurance (BI) Underwriting Professional Development Internship Program provides students with an amazing opportunity to gain exposure to this critical function at Travelers. The 10-week program (running from early June to mid-August) provides qualified interns with an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand commercial insurance underwriting experience, receive valuable on-the-job training, and learn more about the property and casualty insurance industry from industry professionals. Given that, we are seeking interns that are serious about entering the insurance industry and who are excited about the prospect of making underwriting their future career choice. This role is a potential pathway to our full-time Underwriting Professional Development Program (UPDP). Housing assistance is not provided.

What Will You Do?

  • Within your assigned business unit, each intern will be given a designated coach and be expected to:
  • Complete core assignments and training modules geared toward insurance and underwriting principles.
  • Participate and complete self-paced professional development courses in time management, presentation skills, and other key areas.
  • Complete challenging and meaningful project work over the course of this program at the discretion of your manager. You may work independently or with other interns and will be asked to present your findings to local leadership. Sample projects include a territorial risk assessment to determine profitability and underwriting opportunities as well as a business process analysis to determine underwriting gaps.
  • Learn to leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
  • Learn about other areas at Travelers such as Risk Control, Claims, and related corporate functions. Interns may also engage in agency visits with Account Executives.
  • Participate in the Enterprise Internship experience which includes Executive Speaker Series, Networking events, and Rising Senior Intern Symposium.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Obtained or pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Liberal Arts (with business focus preferred), Management, Marketing, Risk Management and Insurance.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

What is a Must Have?

  • Pursuing or obtained a Bachelor's degree.

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Salary Range

$87,800.00 - $144,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Select Accounts provides a broad array of competitive products and coverages that offer agents and insureds value and flexibility. Select Accounts' core product, the Business Owner's Policy (BOP), provides property and liability coverage for small businesses of all types, from Main Street retailers to small manufacturers and property owners. The Account Executive (AE), Select will partner with agents to provide property, general liability, commercial auto, workers' compensation, and/or umbrella coverage for new business based on customers' needs. As an AE, you are decisive, detail-oriented, and know how to build relationships internally and externally to drive results. Your ability to assess risk and sell our products in a high-volume, fast paced environment will contribute to the profitability and success of Travelers.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage the profitability, growth, and retention of an assigned book of business in a high-volume, fast paced environment. Balance individual account underwriting within an assigned portfolio of business.
  • Underwrite and skillfully negotiate property and casualty accounts to minimize risk and maximize profitability.
  • Ensure underwriting quality and profitability through application of the appropriate level of underwriting analysis based on risk complexity to accept, decline, modify, or rate and quote accounts.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal partners within the business unit and across the enterprise to create sales plans and identify cross-selling opportunities.
  • Foster and maintain relationships with external partners by regularly meeting in person with agents and brokers to market and sell Travelers products with a goal of writing and retaining accounts consistent with our risk appetite. Must be able to travel to such meetings.
  • Partner with Sales Executives to identify and write new business opportunities using consultative marketing and sales skills.
  • Collaborate effectively with underwriting leadership, as appropriate.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Three to five years of relevant underwriting experience with experience in commercial lines.
  • Knowledge of commercial lines products.
  • Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to proactively identify underwriting, marketing, or financial challenges and analyze available information to make timely decisions in alignment with our risk appetite.
  • Communication skills with the ability to successfully negotiate with agents and brokers.
  • CPCU designation.

What is a Must Have?

  • Two years of underwriting, claim, operations, risk assessment, actuarial, sales, product, or finance experience.

About this job

Remote quality assurance role in Financial Services focused on improving customer service call center performance through monitoring, coaching, and root cause analysis. Good fit if you have 3+ years quality assurance experience, intermediate Microsoft Office skills, and strong analytical abilities with interest in coaching and performance improvement.

Full job description

This position will be in our Financial Services Department. This job is responsible for identifying training and development needs for our Customer Service call center reps, servicing multiple clients. The Associate Quality Assurance Coordinator focuses on improving individual performance and the overall customer experience through call monitoring, side-by-side coaching, client call calibrations, and monitoring quality results.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Identify QA deficiencies through root cause analysis

  • Partner with Training and Management to identify programs that reduce errors and improve both individual and department results

  • Develop tools, resources, and job aids to improve individual and overall results

  • Balance priorities to achieve deadlines and key target expectations

  • Provide statistical data and patterns of top errors by client and department

  • Develop action plans to target deficiencies and improve results

  • Ability to work with various skill sets, personalities, and working styles

  • Work in conjunction with the Call Center Management team to improve the overall associate and department QA scores

  • Attend and provide feedback for internal/external client calibration sessions for Customer Care

  • Complete monthly side by side & silent monitoring based on established KPI's

  • Maintain positive, productive, and effective relationships with management and call center employees

  • Liaison both internally and externally with clients, management, associates, and quality assurance

  • Review and evaluate claim decisions

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • High school diploma or GED

  • 3 years related experience for quality assurance in any industry

  • Intermediate skill level in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

  • Ability to quickly develop rapport with clients and/or customers over the phone in a professional and friendly manner

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced metric driven environment with proficient multitasking and navigation in a Windows environment

  • Strong analytical skills

  • General knowledge of QA systems and tools preferred

  • Detail and project oriented

  • Displays strong organizational and time management skills

  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously with priorities and work under pressure to meet deadlines

  • Willingness to adapt to a constantly evolving product and work environment

  • Ability to work independently and communicate in a conversational manner that promotes dialogue and establishes rapport

  • Ability to coach call taking representatives

  • Ability to develop relationship/partnership-building skills - listen attentively, solve problems creatively, and use tact and diplomacy to find common ground and drive positive outcomes

  • Ability to effectively assess and diffuse difficult situations and then escalate issues to appropriate leadership as needed

  • Success requires obtaining an intimate knowledge in the products and services.

  • Bi-lingual preferred (English/Spanish)

About this job

Underwriter for Glatfelter Ministry Care program, qualifying and pricing new and renewal business for religious organizations and other specialized accounts. Role includes independent underwriting decisions, producer relationship management, and file documentation within delegated authority.

Good fit if you have 2+ years of property and casualty underwriting experience or 3+ years in underwriting support roles, plus current or obtainable P&C license.

Full job description

Who We Are

For over 70 years, Glatfelter Insurance Group has believed in doing the right thing for our clients, agents, communities and associates. This founding principle has enabled Glatfelter to grow from the kitchen-table, one-man-operation as it began, to one of the largest managing general agencies in the U.S. with nearly 500 associates across the country, a distribution network of over 4,500 independent brokers and more than 30,000 clients. It is what drives us to innovate—the desire to deliver the best for our clients. Founded as The Glatfelter Agency, which is still in operation, the program basis of Glatfelter Insurance Group, Volunteer Firemen's Insurance Services (VFIS), was founded in 1969. Throughout the years, Glatfelter has expanded to include specialized program business inclusive of public entities, educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and religious organizations. Glatfelter provides their insureds with comprehensive insurance solutions including property, casualty, life insurance, and more. In 2018, Glatfelter joined American International Group (AIG) and is now part of the AIG family.

About the Position

Glatfelter Insurance Group is seeking an Underwriter for our Glatfelter Ministry Care Underwriting Department. Working within a specific delegated underwriting authority and territory, the underwriter independently qualifies and prices new and renewal business consistent with program underwriting guidelines and pricing directives. The underwriter is also responsible for servicing accounts in accordance with service standards.

This position is required to be onsite at our York, PA office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Completes underwriting qualification and pricing of new business and renewal submissions, using discretion and independent judgment to accept, reject or modify submission proposal.
  • Requests additional information when needed to qualify submission and communicates acceptance or declination to producer.
  • Underwriter is responsible for producers and/or account relationship building and is the primary point of contact for producers in his/or her assigned territory.
  • Analyzes and reviews underwriting information including applications, loss notifications, loss runs, inspections, financial reports, websites, supplemental applications, budgets, and audits
  • Prepares and communicates underwriting approach to large renewals and new business.
  • Handles all business in a proficient, timely manner, and fully adheres to underwriting authority as delegated by GUS management
  • Demonstrates working knowledge of program forms and endorsements, including various manuscript forms required on more complex accounts and program rating methodology.
  • Meets all file documentation standards, and passes all audits (both internal and external).
  • Responsible for accuracy of final policy product and complies with all quality control and state filing requirements
  • Provides instructions to Underwriting Assistants to rate risk according to company guidelines and current market conditions.
  • Requests any additional underwriting information required including risk control surveys, insurance to value, driver information and compliance with outstanding recommendations.
  • Monitors risk control and claims activities.
  • Reviews and takes appropriate action on any transactions which exceed the written underwriting authority of the Underwriting Assistants.
  • Refers and suggests action on any unusual exposures to Underwriting Supervisor for approval.
  • Refers all accounts exceeding designated authority level to higher level for approval.
  • Provides support to sales staff. Attends agent meetings, conventions, trade shows, and visits agents as requested.
  • Maintains OnBase files consistent with standard file procedures
  • Evaluates and compares competitor's forms and coverages.

What We're Looking For

  • BA degree in insurance, business or related field preferred. Must attain or be working toward AU, CPCU, ARM designation or comparable higher insurance education.
  • Must have a minimum of 2 years of experience as a Property & Casualty Underwriter, or 3 years of industry experience as an underwriting assistant, CSR or agent/ agency management.
  • Must have or attain within three (3) months current property-casualty license for state of residence and other licenses as may be required.
  • Has proven performance as an underwriter and/or agency management skill.
  • Must have a working knowledge of all commercial insurance.
  • Analytical ability is required to exercise underwriting judgment and make decisions.
  • Organizational skills and ability to handle tasks on a priority basis required to maintain consistent high quality and quantity of work.
  • Effective negotiation skills.
  • Good research skills and detail oriented.
  • Proficient in IT tools, and software applications.

Why Choose Glatfelter?

Glatfelter is honored to have been named a Best Place to Work in PA since 2005. We are proud to offer a range of employee benefits and resources that help you protect what matters most - your health care, savings, financial protection and wellbeing. In addition to 17 paid holidays, (which includes a personal holiday and mental health and wellness day) we provide a variety of leaves for personal, health, family, and volunteer needs.

We believe in fostering our associates' development and offer a range of learning opportunities for associates to hone their professional skills to position themselves for the next steps of their careers. We have a tuition reimbursement program for eligible associates to enhance their education, skills, and knowledge in areas that relate to their current position or future positions to which they may transfer or progress.

Equal Opportunity Employer

It has been and will continue to be the policy of Glatfelter Insurance Group to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal opportunity to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender expression, national origin, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected categories. At Glatfelter, we believe that diversity and inclusion are critical to our future and our mission – creating a foundation for a creative workplace that leads to innovation, growth, and profitability. Glatfelter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants and employees with physical or mental disabilities. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to complete any part of the application or hiring process, please contact Human Resources. Reasonable accommodations will be determined on a case-by-case basis.

About this job

Lead Data Engineer for Lincoln's Data & Analytics platform on AWS, designing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and optimizing systems using Aurora PostgreSQL and Amazon Redshift. Hybrid role (3 days/week in office) with locations in Radnor PA, Charlotte NC, Fort Wayne IN, or Greensboro NC.

Good fit if you have 7+ years AWS data engineering experience, strong Aurora PostgreSQL and Redshift expertise, and proven ability to mentor engineers.

Full job description

Alternate Locations: Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania); Charlotte, NC (North Carolina); Fort Wayne, IN (Indiana); Greensboro, NC (North Carolina)

Work Arrangement:

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

Relocation assistance: is not available for this opportunity.

Requisition #: 76901

The Role at a Glance

The Lead Data Engineer provides technical leadership for Lincoln's Data & Analytics platform on AWS. This role designs, builds, and maintains scalable data pipelines and optimizes data systems, with deep experience in Aurora PostgreSQL and Amazon Redshift and strong knowledge of AWS services including Glue, Lambda, S3, Athena, and EC2. The role leads ETL development within an Agile team and partners with business, IT, and analytics stakeholders to deliver secure, governed, high-quality data that enables advanced analytics and reporting across Lincoln.

What you'll be doing

  • Design, build, and maintain robust batch and streaming data pipelines (including change data capture, for example AWS DMS) to support business intelligence and analytics.
  • Integrate structured and unstructured data from internal and external sources.
  • Develop ETL workflows using AWS Glue, Lambda, custom Python, PySpark, and SQL-based scripts.
  • Analyze database workloads and optimize queries, indexing, partitioning, and storage in Aurora PostgreSQL and Amazon Redshift for integrity, performance, and cost.
  • Build S3-based data lake and warehouse layers (Glue Data Catalog, Athena, Parquet) with fine-grained access controls.
  • Own end-to-end data flows from source to consumption; traces and resolve issues across the full chain.
  • Apply data modeling standards (normal form, star, snowflake) and create technical designs from business requirements.
  • Orchestrate and schedule workflows (Stonebranch, Step Functions, Airflow) and monitor them with CloudWatch and automated data quality checks.
  • Ensure data security, governance, and compliance; monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data workflows.
  • Integrate with upstream and downstream applications and collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality datasets; help shape data infrastructure strategy on AWS.
  • Set team standards, review code, mentor engineers, and own production support and process improvement.

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years in AWS data engineering or a similar role.
  • Strong expertise in Aurora PostgreSQL and Amazon Redshift, including database analysis, query optimization, advanced SQL, execution plans, indexing, distribution and sort keys, and workload tuning.
  • Holistic view of end-to-end data processing, from source to consumption, including dependencies, bottlenecks, and downstream impact.
  • Data and application integration experience with upstream source systems and downstream consumers (APIs, files, messaging, and reporting layers).
  • Hands-on AWS experience: Glue, Lambda, S3, Athena, EC2, and IAM.
  • Python / PySpark and SQL development for ETL and data integration in Agile, SDLC-based environments.
  • Data modeling, data governance, data quality, and data security practices.
  • DevOps and scheduling: Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, CloudFormation or similar, and Stonebranch scheduling knowledge (or a similar scheduler such as Autosys).
  • Hands-on use of approved AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot or Claude Code), with validation of AI output and adherence to Lincoln data privacy and responsible AI requirements.
  • Proven ability to mentor engineers and lead delivery of complex projects.

Nice-to-haves:

  • AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate, Solutions Architect, or an AWS specialty certification.
  • EMR, Kinesis, Lake Formation, DynamoDB, and Apache Iceberg experience.
  • Microsoft 365 Copilot and Claude Cowork experience; coaching teams on safe AI use.
  • RAG data preparation, embeddings, vector stores, and AWS AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Amazon Q).
  • Salesforce CRM and MuleSoft (API-led integration) as upstream or downstream systems; MicroStrategy and Tableau reporting and BI background.
  • Financial data experience is a plus, especially Investment products like Mutual Funds, Alternative Funds and Fund Data management.

Core Competencies:

  • Technical leadership and AWS data engineering expertise.
  • Collaboration and Agile delivery with business, IT, and analytics teams.
  • Analytical depth, operational ownership, and a data-centric mindset (quality, governance, security).
  • AI fluency: responsible, validated use of AI tools.

Quick facts

  • Pay: $170,800 to $285,000 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Irving, TX
  • Experience: 15+ years

About this job

VP leads strategy and growth for a major client's supply chain relationship at Assurant, developing plans across device lifecycle, logistics, repair, and inventory management. The role involves senior stakeholder engagement, cross-functional team leadership, and translating client needs into commercial solutions.

Good fit if you have 15+ years in sales or marketing, deep mobile industry supply chain experience, and at least 7 years leading teams.

Full job description

The VP, Client Supply Chain Solutions leads the development, execution, and expansion of the strategic account plan for the client, with specific responsibility for identifying, positioning, and selling Assurant's supply chain capabilities as a core value driver within the broader client relationship. This senior commercial leader serves as a trusted advisor, connecting client's business priorities with Assurant solutions across supply chain, device lifecycle, logistics, reverse logistics, repair, refurbishment, fulfillment, inventory management, and operational optimization.

This role is accountable for expanding the relationship beyond existing programs by shaping growth opportunities, influencing senior client stakeholders, and translating Assurant's operational capabilities into compelling commercial solutions. The successful candidate will improve client outcomes, support profitable revenue growth, and strengthen the long-term strategic partnership.

The VP will engage senior and mid-level client leaders across business, operations, supply chain, finance, product, and executive stakeholder groups, while leading direct and matrixed teams across Assurant. This role will be based on site at our Irving, Texas location.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Lead the creation and execution of the strategic account plan for the client, with a focus on expanding revenue, strengthening executive engagement, and identifying new opportunities to position Assurant supply chain capabilities.
  • Build and cultivate senior-level relationships across the client business, operations, supply chain, finance, product, and executive stakeholder groups to understand priorities, anticipate needs, and position Assurant as a strategic partner.
  • Identify, develop, and advance commercial opportunities related to device lifecycle management, logistics, reverse logistics, repair, refurbishment, fulfillment, inventory management, operational efficiency, and related value-added services.
  • Translate client business objectives and operational challenges into compelling solution opportunities, partnering with internal supply chain, operations, product, finance, legal, pricing, and implementation teams to develop client-ready proposals and business cases.
  • Lead cross-functional selling efforts for new supply chain solutions, clearly articulating client value, financial impact, service performance, scalability, and alignment with the client's strategic priorities.
  • Guide direct and matrixed teams in the development of annual business plans, client business reviews, growth roadmaps, and executive-level presentations that demonstrate performance, highlight operational value, and advance mutual revenue goals.
  • Develop, negotiate, and execute complex commercial agreements, renewals, expansions, and amendments that support Assurant growth objectives and the client's evolving supply chain and customer experience needs.
  • Partner with operational leaders to ensure sold solutions are executable, scalable, and aligned with contracted service expectations, while driving accountability for performance, service utilization, and client satisfaction.
  • Lead the prioritization and coordination of client initiatives, including supply chain capability launches, operational enhancements, product or service expansions, and implementation of new client solutions.
  • Anticipate and resolve client issues by engaging appropriate cross-functional leaders, driving operational process improvements, and ensuring supply chain performance supports the overall health and growth of the relationship.
  • Monitor account financial performance, opportunity pipeline, margin considerations, contract economics, and mutual business outcomes to ensure growth opportunities are commercially sound and strategically aligned.
  • Mentor account management leaders and cross-functional partners on strategic client engagement, executive communication, consultative selling, and positioning supply chain capabilities as part of an integrated client growth strategy.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • BS/BA degree; MBA preferred.
  • 15+ years of sales and/or marketing experience.
  • 15+ years of experience interacting with large, complex mobile industry clients and developing strategic relationships.
  • 7+ years of experience directly leading the work of others, including direct people leadership and supervision.
  • Demonstrated industry experience and deep knowledge of mobile supply chain, device lifecycle, logistics, reverse logistics, repair, refurbishment, fulfillment, inventory management, or related services.
  • Experience developing and executing long-term strategic plans spanning three or more years.
  • Experience managing complex commercial opportunities, account financial performance, pricing, margin considerations, contract economics, and revenue growth.

Core Capabilities

  • Deep understanding of complex deals and contracts, with advanced negotiation skills.
  • Advanced business and financial acumen, including the ability to build and evaluate compelling business cases.
  • Expert ability to cultivate strategic relationships and influence senior and C-suite leaders.
  • Advanced written and verbal communication skills, including executive presentations and commercial pitches.
  • Ability to translate client needs and operational challenges into clear, scalable, and financially viable solutions.
  • Strong organizational skills and disciplined management of multiple priorities, stakeholders, and initiatives.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and collaborate effectively at all levels of the organization.
  • Strong judgment balancing client advocacy, operational feasibility, commercial value, and long-term partnership objectives.

Communication & Leadership

  • Proven ability to serve as a trusted advisor to senior client and internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to influence without authority and align direct and matrixed teams around shared priorities.
  • Confidence leading difficult conversations, resolving escalations, and presenting recommendations to executives.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor account management leaders and elevate consultative selling and executive engagement capabilities.

Analytical & Operational Skills

  • Ability to assess account performance, opportunity pipeline, financial trends, operational data, and client feedback to identify risks and growth opportunities.
  • Ability to connect service performance and operational capabilities with measurable client and financial outcomes.
  • Proficiency with business software, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and project management tools.

Job.JobTitle: Operational Risk Analyst (Group Benefits and Retirement)
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Risk Manager, Risk Management / Loss Control
Job.JobDescription:
Alternate Locations: Charlotte, NC (North Carolina); Fort Wayne, IN (Indiana); Omaha, NE (Nebraska); Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania)

Work Arrangement:

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

Relocation assistance: is not available for this opportunity.

Requisition #: 76612

The Role at a Glance

As an Operational Risk Analyst within our Group Protection and Retirement Plan Services (RPS) organization, you will provide subject matter expertise on design and effectiveness of financial and operational controls for various vendor services. You will partner with internal and external stakeholders and auditors to ensure the control environment aligns with the service vendor audit program. You will develop and execute on more complex audit testing to evaluate the effectiveness and efficiency of operations and controls, reliability of SOC-1 reporting, and compliance with applicable law. You will also provide control expertise, risk assessment analysis, and implement risk mitigation recommendations for complex projects, processes, and major financial and operational control initiatives.

Success in this role requires a balance of technical depth, cross-functional influence, and clear communication as well as strong accountability to deliver positive outcomes. You will drive the evaluation of the control environments, coordinate closely with external auditors on SOC-1 outcomes, and shape risk assessments for senior audiences. From executing complex audit testing to driving risk mitigation across major initiatives, you'll play a key role in keeping the ORM team's control environment sound, informed, and audit ready.

What you'll be doing

  • You will serve as the business unit SOC 1 Program Owner, responsible for maintaining accurate control inventories, ensuring control ownership is appropriately documented, and leading interactions between external auditors and internal control owners and subject matter experts.
  • Serves as the liaison for the annual SOC1 & SOC2 audit work between the business and external stakeholders by working with internal partners to develop action plans as needed, updating the report for issuance, and communicating report outcomes with business partners and management.
  • You will manage report development, review, and issuance; manage report validation and distribution process; and maintain all business records.
  • You will assist internal stakeholders to strengthen the control environment by establishing complex action plans to address financial & operational control deficiencies. You will track and monitor progress against these action plans to ensure timely risk mitigation resolution.
  • You will act as the Internal Audit liaison for the business units by ensuring business engagement, responsiveness to audit requests, issue management, communication management, and management action plan execution.

The Role at a Glance

We are looking to add a Senior Associate to our Commercial Mortgage and Real Estate Investments Team to work in the Charlotte or Greensboro office 4 days per week with an option to work remotely on Fridays. In this role, you will provide day-to-day administration and servicing of our commercial mortgage loan portfolio, working closely with relationship managers, mortgage bankers, production, closers, legal, and accounting to keep loan operations running smoothly. Beyond the core servicing work, we're looking for someone who is genuinely comfortable with technology and change — someone who can learn our current systems and processes quickly, get fluent with the AI and automation tools we use, and, once up to speed, feel empowered to point out where things could work better. As the ideal candidate, you will bring both strong servicing fundamentals and a fresh, tech-forward perspective to a well-established commercial mortgage servicing team managing a multi-billion-dollar loan portfolio.

What you'll be doing

•Administering and servicing the commercial loan portfolio, including processing payments, advances, and payoffs.
•Monitoring loan covenants, insurance, and other compliance requirements throughout the loan lifecycle.
•Maintaining and updating loan documentation and records in our loan servicing system(s).
•Managing escrow accounts and insurance/tax tracking.
•Preparing and distributing reports for management, investment accounting, and regulatory agencies.
•Coordinating with borrowers, correspondents, relationship managers, and internal teams to identify and resolve servicing issues.
•Processing requests for lender consent, loan modifications, renewals, extensions, and payoff calculations.
•Responding to borrower, correspondent and internal inquiries accurately and in a timely manner.
•Assisting with audits and regulatory examinations as needed.
•Learning and actively using AI-enabled and automation tools (e.g., document extraction, data validation, reporting assistants) as part of day-to-day servicing work.
•Identifying inefficiencies or gaps in current servicing workflows and proposing practical improvements, drawing on prior experience and available technology.
•Supporting the evaluation and rollout of new servicing tools, templates, or process changes as the team modernizes its workflows.
•Working on projects and team initiatives as requested.

What we're looking for

•4 Year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of Bachelor's) – Minimum Required
•3+ Years' experience in commercial loan servicing, commercial mortgage servicing, or commercial banking that aligns with the specific responsibilities for this position.
•Able to work a minimum of 40 hours per week, with a minimum of 4 days in the office.
•Working knowledge of commercial lending practices, loan documents, and applicable regulations.
•Working knowledge of escrow administration and insurance/tax tracking requirements.
•Critical thinking skills.
•Must be detail oriented.
•Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple loans and work independently in a time-sensitive environment where meeting established deadlines is critical.
•Strong interpersonal/customer service skills with the ability to create/build and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
•Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
•Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook).
•Demonstrated adaptability — comfortable with change, new systems, and evolving processes, with a track record (or clear inclination) of suggesting process improvements once familiar with how a team operates.
•Experience with AI platforms (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude, etc.) is preferred.
•Familiarity with regulatory and reporting requirements relevant to insurance company general account lending (e.g., NAIC schedules) is preferred.

In office Monday - Thursday with flexibility to work from home on Friday

We are looking to add an Associate Director to the Commercial Mortgage and Real Estate Investments team.


In this position, within the Loan Production Team, you will provide experienced support in the annual origination of $2 billion of commercial mortgage investments throughout the United States. Additional responsibilities involve the ongoing management of the $17 billion commercial mortgage portfolio. The ideal candidate is looking for increased origination responsibilities including credit analysis and business development.

What you'll be doing

•Support Managing Directors in business development through correspondent relationships and new transactions for assigned territory; actively manage and develop relationships with correspondent mortgage bankers. Manage transactions from origination through closing.
•Underwrite new commercial real estate loan investment opportunities providing analysis and recommendations to the Managing Directors.
•Draft term sheets, application/commitment letters, and other transaction related documents for review by senior team members.
•Complete due diligence analysis including review of leases, rent rolls, third party reports, estoppels, and other business-related matters.
•Work with senior team members and legal counsel in the negotiation of loan terms and documentation.
•Prepare investment committee memos working collaboratively with senior team members, while leading the due diligence process for loans in the application stage.
•Serve as business liaison throughout the loan closing process working with appropriate internal/external stakeholders to effectuate a timely closing.
•Act as a resource in the training and mentoring of junior team members.
•Travel for due diligence and business development trips.
•Perform quarterly reviews, including operating statements and leasing updates, for existing loans.
•Additional investment support may include real estate equity and credit fund investments.
•Handle special servicing requests as requested.

What we're looking for

Must- have experience:
•4 Year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of Bachelor's) - Minimum Required
•3-5+ Years' experience required in commercial real estate finance and/or commercial real estate investment and analysis that aligns with the specific responsibilities for this position.
•Experience analyzing asset lending transactions.
•Knowledge of commercial real estate principles and valuation methods.
•Knowledge of national commercial real estate and mortgage markets and macro-economic trends that affect those markets.
•Ability to understand and evaluate real estate financial statements.
•Knowledge of real estate legal concepts and understanding of loan documents.
•Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
•Experience with Costar and Argus preferred.
•Advanced degrees and/or certifications strongly preferred.

Travel: 20%-30% (intermittent)

Manage workers' compensation claims for the Rio Grande LNG Project in Brownsville, TX, coordinating with insurers, medical professionals, and project leadership. The role involves claims processing, program administration, return-to-work coordination, and compliance oversight for a large-scale construction project.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of workers' compensation experience and a bachelor's degree or equivalent industry experience

Full job description

Job Description

We're seeking a Project Workers Compensation Administrator!

This is an exciting opportunity to help manage complex workers' compensation programs supporting large-scale projects while partnering with project leadership, insurers, medical professionals, and legal teams to deliver positive claim outcomes and reduce organizational risk.

*******This is a fully onsite role, working directly with the client at their Brownsville, TX location.*******

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

How this opportunity is different

The Claims Administrator is responsible for implementing all aspects of the project workers' compensation program (statutory and USL&H) for Rio Grande LNG Project and all Contractor Coordinated Insurance Program (CCIP) enrollees. This position will also assist with the administration of auto and other insured claims. The osition is located at the project construction site, in Brownsville, TX with an anticipated work schedule of 48 hours per week.

While this is an Aon position, the employee is seconded to Bechtel. The Claims Administrator works under the direction of Bechtel's Head of Workers' Compensation and the Aon Claims Director, acting independently to manage routine matters while keeping Bechtel Insured Claims team fully informed at all stages.

What the day will look like

  • Communicates effectively with injured workers, medical professionals, insurers, brokers, internal/external counsel, corporate management, and various related regulatory agencies.
  • Develops and maintains project-specific workers' compensation claims manual, medical panel, related processes and procedures for statutory and USL&H claims. Implements improvements based on lessons learned, legislative changes or Court decisions, and Bechtel operating imperatives.
  • Assists with subcontractor CCIP enrollment and provides workers' compensation orientation to subcontractors.
  • Develops and provides onsite training related to workers' compensation.
  • Under the guidance of the Workers' Compensation Risk Manager, develops and prepares regular reports outlining project claims performance. Monitors claims activity to identify early negative claim trends or other issues that may negatively impact project performance.
  • Is responsible for oversight and processing of workers' compensation claims:
  • Responsible for initiating, preparing, and maintaining all documentation associated with claims.
  • Investigates and documents eligibility for workers' compensation benefits and communicates same to insurer and related interested parties.
  • Assists with investigation and coordination of issues surrounding subrogation.
  • Interprets laws and regulations, determines appropriate courses of action, and presents solutions to resolve the claims.
  • Identifies potential subrogation issues.
  • Monitors claim resolution activities implemented by insurer(s) and employers.
  • Maintains Project Risk Management Information System (RMIS).
  • Directs and monitors the activities and performance of Bechtel's insurance provider to ensure compliance with applicable regulations.
  • Implements, monitors, and ensures compliance of “Special Account” requirements.
  • Conducts regular claim reviews, claim audits and prepares related reports.
  • Interfaces with insurer to effectively manage claims, including but not limited to authorizing claim reserve changes, authorizing insurer referral to outside counsel, and assessing and approving settlement strategies.
  • Coordinates and supports early return to work.
  • Manages relationships with onsite clinic, panel/network physicians and other medical providers, to ensure effective claims management and return to work.
  • Works with injured worker and supervision on developing and implementing return to work plan.
  • Assists in management fitness for duty and ADA accommodation issues as needed.
  • Assists Bechtel Risk Management in the defense of litigation or other complex case support. (i.e., responding to interrogatories and other discovery requests).
  • Assists with gathering information and filing auto and other insured claims. Assists with administration of auto and other insured claims as needed.
  • Performs other tasks as required by Bechtel Risk Management.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 5+ years of experience in the field or in a related area or in a related area.
  • Extensive knowledge of / experience with workers' compensation and occupational rehabilitation procedures, practices and processes.
  • Extensive knowledge of claim's resolution techniques and strategies, legal principles related to claim resolution and familiarity with all phases of the litigation process.
  • Working knowledge of / experience with bodily injury and 1st and 3rd party property damage claims practices and processes.
  • Working knowledge of / experience with auto and other insured claims practices and procedures.
  • Relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
  • Highly skilled in written and verbal communication.
  • Bilingual language proficiency (i.e., English and Spanish) is a plus.

Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of industry Workers' Compensation experience.

For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.

Full job description

Job Description

Aon is looking for a Managing Director, Catastrophe Management Analytics to join our Client Delivery team in Chicago, Bloomington, New York, or Boston!

As a senior leader within the Catastrophe Management team, you will play an integral role in delivering catastrophe analytics, risk insights, and strategic consulting to Aon Reinsurance Solutions clients. You will serve as a trusted advisor to clients and brokers, providing strategic and analytical leadership across significant client relationships and helping translate complex catastrophe risk into actionable business and reinsurance strategies.

You will also provide leadership across Catastrophe Management, developing colleagues, connecting clients with expertise and capabilities across Aon, and helping advance our analytical solutions, tools, and client delivery.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight of catastrophe analytics across significant and/or complex client relationships, ensuring analytics are aligned with client objectives, reinsurance strategy, and broader risk management needs.
  • Serve as a trusted analytics advisor and key member of client teams, building strong relationships with clients and brokers and providing perspective on complex catastrophe risk and analytical issues.
  • Translate catastrophe modeling, exposure, portfolio, and financial analyses into strategic insights supporting reinsurance decisions, portfolio management, risk selection, and other client risk management objectives.
  • Provide senior technical and analytical judgment on complex client challenges, including model assumptions and uncertainty, data quality, model interpretation, and appropriate application of catastrophe analytics.
  • Develop a deep understanding of clients' businesses, risk profiles, and strategic priorities to identify needs and develop customized analytical approaches and solutions.
  • Connect client needs with expertise, capabilities, products, and solutions across Aon, bringing together the appropriate resources to deliver integrated client solutions.
  • Provide leadership across client teams, establishing priorities, maintaining high standards for analytical delivery, and anticipating and addressing resource and capability needs in partnership with Catastrophe Management leadership.
  • Develop colleagues and future leaders through coaching, mentoring, technical and client guidance, and ongoing feedback.
  • Lead or sponsor the advancement and adoption of analytical capabilities, technologies, tools, workflows, and products that improve client outcomes and organizational effectiveness.
  • Provide leadership across Catastrophe Management through segment, client, capability, or subject matter leadership and contribute to broader organizational priorities.

Skills and experience that will lead to success:

  • 12+ years of relevant experience in catastrophe modeling, catastrophe risk analytics, reinsurance, insurance, or a closely related field.
  • Deep understanding of catastrophe modeling concepts, exposure data, model assumptions and uncertainty, and the application of catastrophe analytics to insurance and reinsurance decision-making.
  • Experience using leading catastrophe modeling platforms and interpreting model output, along with strong working knowledge of the tools used to deliver and communicate catastrophe analytics.
  • Strong understanding of reinsurance structures and demonstrated ability to connect catastrophe analytics with reinsurance strategy and broader client risk management objectives.
  • Demonstrated experience leading analytics for significant and/or complex client relationships and developing trusted relationships with senior client and broking stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to communicate complex analytical concepts, implications, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated leadership across teams, accounts, or analytical initiatives, with the ability to influence outcomes and work effectively across organizational boundaries.
  • Experience developing colleagues through mentoring, coaching, feedback, and leadership of multidisciplinary client teams.
  • Experience contributing to broader analytical, capability, technology, or organizational initiatives beyond individual client assignments.
  • BA/BS degree in a quantitative, analytical, scientific, actuarial, engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

Desired Skills (not required, but would help you stand out)

  • Experience supporting global and/or complex commercial accounts with sophisticated catastrophe risk and analytics needs.
  • Experience leading significant analytical capabilities, products, technology, or organizational initiatives.
  • Industry certifications such as ARe, CPCU, CCRMP, or CCRA are a plus, but not required.

Full job description

Job Description

Early Careers: Human Capital Mergers & Acquisitions – Associate Project Manager

Interested in a career in Mergers & Acquisitions? If you enjoy building relationships with clients and colleagues, analyzing data, and driving innovation, apply today to join Aon's Mergers & Acquisitions team!

We are hiring a Human Capital M&A Associate Project Manager for our St. Louis Mergers & Acquisitions human capital diligence team. As part of an industry-leading team within our M&A and Transaction Solutions business group, you will help advise clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions.

Location: St. Louis, MO

Recently voted one of the Best Employers for New Grads by Forbes, we are a leading global professional services firm providing a broad range of risk, reinsurance, and health and wealth solutions to our clients. Over 60,000 colleagues in over 120 countries empower results for clients by using proprietary data and analytics to deliver insights that reduce volatility and improve performance.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Assist with leading and supporting M&A human capital due diligence engagements
  • Work directly with private equity or corporate clients as well as their other outside advisors which include tax, legal and financial advisors.
  • Coordinate with internal resources including health, retirement and talent teams, actuarial and financial experts, originators and other team members to develop diligence findings and solutions
  • Assist with managing and executing client deliverables including an end-of-project report, interim email updates, and phone conversations
  • Analyze employee demographics, health plan insurance coverage and claims history, retirement programs, executive compensation, worker classification, ERISA compliance, and the people-related matters of the draft purchase agreement and disclosures
  • Work with and assist originators in establishing client relationships, developing new business opportunities, and converting due diligence targets to ongoing clients
  • Assist with providing ongoing relationship management oversight to private equity clients
  • Help prepare proposals and make presentations to clients

How this opportunity is different

These roles fall under Aon's Early Career Development program, known as Launch. Building on the development colleagues receive in the role they are hired into, the Launch program is a supplemental development program for recent college recruits to mentor and develop future leaders of the firm. This 10-month development program begins every summer and includes in-person sessions, networking opportunities, self-study and global leader calls.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

We are looking for collaborators, critical thinkers, problem solvers, excellent teammates, effective communicators, relationship builders, and future leaders.

We strive to recruit a diverse group of hardworking individuals who offer varying experiences, backgrounds, and strengths to ensure we can continue to offer the most innovative solutions. Additionally, we take into consideration the following:

  • Ability to work on multiple projects at one time
  • Project management – coordinate activities and information flow from a group of people within specified time frames
  • Strategic and analytical skills – attention to detail while also being able to draw connections in order to provide overall conclusions
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills – ability to communicate well and at the appropriate level with a wide range of colleagues
  • Interest in learning about human capital solutions and how they apply to businesses of all sizes and industries
  • Ability to perform under stress / tight time frames
  • Ability to develop relationships / build confidence of others (both internally and externally) based upon work performed
  • Financial – basic understanding of financial statements, reports, and accounting
  • Results oriented
  • Proficiency with Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

Preferred Experience

  • Background in human resources, M&A, health and benefits analytics, or business administration and management
  • Experience working in both office and virtual settings

Education & Application Information

Bachelor's degree preferred, ideally with a major in Business Administration, Business Management, or HR Management, though all majors are welcome. Applicants should graduate between Winter 2026 – Summer 2027 with a GPA of 3.0 or higher.

Job.JobDescription:
Job Description

Are you an accomplished FP&A Finance Technology Leader? We are seeking talent in this position to implement the global strategy and roadmap for our enterprise planning, forecasting, performance management, cost transparency, and financial analytics platforms. This role has deep expertise across Workday Adaptive Planning, IBM Planning Analytics (TM1), Apptio applications, finance data and analytics, AI enabled automation, and global finance operating models. They will be able to translate FP&A priorities into scalable, well-governed, insight driven technology solutions that improve planning agility, forecast accuracy, cost transparency, and executive decision-making.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world!

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed!

What the day will look like

Responsibilities:

Serve as the senior technology leader for FP&A, partnering with the Finance organization to define the strategy and roadmap for Aon's global planning, forecasting, performance management, cost transparency, and financial analytics technology ecosystem.

Manage the portfolio of FP&A technologies, including:

Enterprise Planning & Forecasting: Workday Adaptive Planning and IBM Planning Analytics (TM1), including budgeting, forecasting, scenario modeling, workforce planning, long-range planning, management reporting, and multidimensional analysis.

Technology Business Management & Cost Transparency: Apptio applications supporting technology financial management, cost allocation, planning, reporting, and business value insights.

Financial Data & Analytics: Finance data platforms, enterprise reporting, Power BI, executive dashboards, predictive analytics, and insights generated by technology.

Finance Operations & Workflow: Planning workflows, approvals, controls, automation, workflow orchestration, and process optimization.

Data Management & Governance: Financial hierarchies, master data, chart of accounts. Planning dimensions, organizational structures, allocation structures, and reference data management.

Integration & Enterprise Platforms: ERP, HR, financial data, reporting, and other enterprise platforms supporting end-to-end FP&A processes.

Ensure end-to-end process integrity and data consistency across annual planning, long-term planning, rolling forecasts, workforce planning, cost allocation, management reporting, variance analysis, and executive decision support.

Partner closely with senior leaders across FP&A, Corporate Finance, Operations Finance, Accounting, Data, Technology, and business functions. Align platform capabilities with enterprise financial objectives and transformation strategies.

Lead and develop a team spanning product ownership, solution architecture, business analysis, development, integration, and platform administration.

Clear accountability for delivery, operations, controls, and continuous improvement.

Collaborate with peer Finance Technology leaders across the organization to align roadmaps, architecture, delivery priorities, data standards, support models, and shared business outcomes.

Define and maintain the governance model for the FP&A Technology portfolio, including demand intake, prioritization, change control, release management, testing, deployment, and collaborator communications.

Responsible for the evaluation, adoption, and rollout of new capabilities across Workday Adaptive Planning, IBM Planning Analytics (TM1), Apptio, and supporting FP&A technologies; perform impact assessments and guide configuration, testing, deployment, and operational readiness.

Drive adoption and change management for new capabilities, ensuring FP&A and business finance teams are equipped to employ technology effectively to improve planning, forecasting, analysis, and decision-making.

Champion finance data quality, governance, standardization, security, and controls across the FP&A technology landscape; collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Audit, and Data Governance teams to meet internal requirements.

Ensure effective integration and data flows between FP&A platforms and adjacent ecosystems including ERP, HR, enterprise data warehouses, analytics platforms, collaboration tools, and corporate reporting solutions.

Lead FP&A Technology modernization initiatives including integrated business planning, connected planning, predictive forecasting, AI-enabled analysis, self-service reporting, and finance process automation.

Establish measurable product and service outcomes, including platform reliability, delivery performance, user adoption, data quality, control effectiveness, and business value realization.

Act as the technology leader responsible for ensuring Aon has the accurate financial data available.

How this opportunity is different

This role goes well beyond maintaining current tools. You will:

  • Drive the strategic vision for Aon's FP&A Technology ecosystem, including how enterprise planning, cost transparency, reporting, analytics, and finance data work together to provide a trusted performance management platform.
  • Play a central role in enterprise-wide transformation programs, including:
    • Global FP&A modernization and connected planning initiatives
    • Workday Adaptive Planning and IBM Planning Analytics (TM1) platform optimization and rationalization
    • Apptio-enabled cost transparency and technology financial management
    • AI-enabled forecasting, variance analysis, scenario modeling, and decision support
    • Enterprise finance data governance and reporting transformation
  • Blend executive-level influence with hands-on leadership by driving multi-year roadmaps and major transformation programs while engaging in architecture reviews, vendor strategy discussions, and emerging technology evaluations.
  • Shape the day-to-day experience of FP&A and business finance teams around the world by providing scalable, reliable, and innovative technology capabilities.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Extensive experience (typically 8+ years) leading Finance Technology, FP&A Technology, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Technology Business Management, or Corporate Finance Systems portfolios within a global, matrixed organization.
  • Deep hands-on and strategic experience with:
  • Enterprise planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management platforms
  • Financial analytics, reporting, and data platforms
  • Financial data, integration, security, and control architectures
  • Understanding of-Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Budgeting and forecasting, Long-range planning. In addition, workforce planning, scenario modeling and variance analysis.
  • Management reporting and performance analytics
  • Proven success leading sophisticated, multi-year transformation programs across planning, performance management, reporting, cost transparency, data, and integration domains, including global deployments and process standardization.
  • Experience driving adoption of AI, automation, and analytics within finance use cases including forecast recommendations, variance analysis, scenario modeling, planning optimization, and executive dashboards.
  • Strong track record partnering with Finance executives to translate financial strategies, key performance indicators, and business objectives into scalable technology capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing, global teams. Direct responsibility for people leadership, performance management, succession planning, mentoring, and capability development.
  • Demonstrable ability to lead through influence across peer teams and matrixed organizations, aligning collaborators who do not directly collaborate with the role around shared roadmaps, standards, and outcomes.
  • Excellent collaborator management and communication skills. Ability to influence and collaborate with senior leaders across FP&A, Finance, Accounting, Data, Risk, Audit, business functions, and Technology.
  • Experience managing portfolio prioritization, budgeting, resource planning, and delivery capacity across multiple concurrent products, projects, and operational commitments.
  • Strong vendor and partner leadership skills, including negotiating contracts, managing performance, supervising managed service providers, and aligning partner roadmaps with enterprise objectives.
  • Experience operating within a product-centric delivery model and driving accountability through measurable business outcomes.

Strategy and Innovation

  • Strategic problem solver who can connect FP&A technology, data, and process capabilities to business outcomes. This includes planning agility, forecast accuracy, cost transparency, financial insight, and operational efficiency.
  • Proven track record of identifying and implementing automation, AI/ML, predictive analytics, and advanced reporting capabilities across planning and performance management processes.
  • Experience establishing governance, operating models, architecture principles, and decision-making frameworks that balance innovation, risk management, standardization, and business agility.
  • Comfortable operating in a matrixed, global environment, balancing enterprise standards with regional and business requirements.
  • Finance Data Strategy and the role data governance plays in enabling trusted planning, reporting, analysis, and decision-making capabilities.

Education & credentials

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

MBA, CPA, CFA or equivalent experience, PMP, or other advanced certification preferred.

Workday Adaptive Planning, IBM Planning Analytics (TM1), and/or Apptio certifications preferred.

Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and knowing the latest with emerging finance technologies, AI capabilities, enterprise planning, technology financial management, and performance management standard processes.

Job Description

We're seeking a Project Workers Compensation Administrator!

This is an exciting opportunity to help manage complex workers' compensation programs supporting large-scale projects while partnering with project leadership, insurers, medical professionals, and legal teams to deliver positive claim outcomes and reduce organizational risk.

*******This is a fully onsite role, working directly with the client at their Cameron, LA location.*******

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

How this opportunity is different

The Claims Administrator is responsible for implementing all aspects of the project workers' compensation program (statutory and USL&H) for Sabine Pass LNG Project and all Contractor Coordinated Insurance Program (CCIP) enrollees. This position will also assist with the administration of auto and other insured claims. Position is located at the project construction site, in Cameron, LA with an anticipated work schedule of 48 hours per week.

While this is an Aon position, the employee is seconded to Bechtel. The Claims Administrator works under the direction of Bechtel's Head of Workers' Compensation and the Aon Claims Director, acting independently to manage routine matters while keeping Bechtel Insured Claims team fully informed at all stages.

What the day will look like

  • Communicates effectively with injured workers, medical professionals, insurers, brokers, internal/external counsel, corporate management, and various related regulatory agencies.
  • Develops and maintains project-specific workers' compensation claims manual, medical panel, related processes and procedures for statutory and USL&H claims. Implements improvements based on lessons learned, legislative changes or Court decisions, and Bechtel operating imperatives.
  • Assists with subcontractor CCIP enrollment and provides workers' compensation orientation to subcontractors.
  • Develops and provides onsite training related to workers' compensation.
  • Under the guidance of the Workers' Compensation Risk Manager, develops and prepares regular reports outlining project claims performance. Monitors claims activity to identify early negative claim trends or other issues that may negatively impact project performance.
  • Is responsible for oversight and processing of workers' compensation claims:
  • Responsible for initiating, preparing, and maintaining all documentation associated with claims.
  • Investigates and documents eligibility for workers' compensation benefits and communicates same to insurer and related interested parties.
  • Assists with investigation and coordination of issues surrounding subrogation.
  • Interprets laws and regulations, determines appropriate courses of action, and presents solutions to resolve the claims.
  • Identifies potential subrogation issues.
  • Monitors claim resolution activities implemented by insurer(s) and employers.
  • Maintains Project Risk Management Information System (RMIS).
  • Directs and monitors the activities and performance of Bechtel's insurance provider to ensure compliance with applicable regulations.
  • Implements, monitors, and ensures compliance of “Special Account” requirements.
  • Conducts regular claim reviews, claim audits and prepares related reports.
  • Interfaces with insurer to effectively manage claims, including but not limited to authorizing claim reserve changes, authorizing insurer referral to outside counsel, and assessing and approving settlement strategies.
  • Coordinates and supports early return to work.
  • Manages relationships with onsite clinic, panel/network physicians and other medical providers, to ensure effective claims management and return to work.
  • Works with injured worker and supervision on developing and implementing return to work plan.
  • Assists in management fitness for duty and ADA accommodation issues as needed.
  • Assists Bechtel Risk Management in the defense of litigation or other complex case support. (i.e., responding to interrogatories and other discovery requests).
  • Assists with gathering information and filing auto and other insured claims. Assists with administration of auto and other insured claims as needed.
  • Performs other tasks as required by Bechtel Risk Management.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 5+ years of experience in the field or in a related area or in a related area.
  • Extensive knowledge of / experience with workers' compensation and occupational rehabilitation procedures, practices and processes.
  • Extensive knowledge of claim's resolution techniques and strategies, legal principles related to claim resolution and familiarity with all phases of the litigation process.
  • Working knowledge of / experience with bodily injury and 1st and 3rd party property damage claims practices and processes.
  • Working knowledge of / experience with auto and other insured claims practices and procedures.
  • Relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
  • Highly skilled in written and verbal communication.
  • Bilingual language proficiency (i.e., English and Spanish) is a plus.

Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of industry Workers' Compensation experience.
