Job Description

Early Careers Launch - Investment Banking Trainee

Are you ready to elevate your career in the investment banking sector? Do you possess the skills to contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment? This is your chance to create a significant impact at Aon Reinsurance!

This is role out of our New York City Office.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we build decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

Join a team of professionals at Aon dedicated to providing corporate finance and investment banking advisory services to Aon's (re)insurance clients. This client-facing position includes modeling financial and valuation impacts of strategic choices clients evaluate. These include buyside and sellside M&A, restructuring, raising capital, structuring reinsurance programs, applying captives and alternative risk management strategies, and entering or exiting business lines or geographies.

You will collaborate within a group setting on a variety of tasks, including:

  • Financial Modeling – building three statement financial models and projections, discounted cash flow models and M&A combination analyses.
  • Financial Analysis – reviewing both public and confidential information about companies, their peers, and information about precedent transactions to identify trends relevant to our clients and their goals.
  • Valuation Analyses – conducting comparable company, comparable transaction, regression, and discounted cash flow analyses.
  • Presentation Development – assisting in crafting investment banking marketing materials, presentations for senior management, and board-level client presentations summarizing findings and recommendations.
  • Synthesizing information and making recommendations involves combining data from clients and colleagues to inform financial projections. It also includes proactively identifying alternative ideas and solutions to meet client goals.
  • Industry Research – tracking (re)insurance industry trends and translating that information into insights that aid client recommendations.
  • Maintaining and Establishing Client Relationships – developing relationships within the Aon organization and growing existing client relationships.

How this opportunity is different

The Corporate Finance team is an integral part of the broader U.S. Aon Capital Advisory group, a firm-wide collaboration that combines expertise across Aon's fields, including Corporate Finance, Analytics, Reinsurance Solutions, and Investment Banking practices.

The group's goal is to bring to bear our collective experience to provide tailored, objective, and comprehensive advice on the capital supporting clients' business. They also focus on how this capital can be optimized. The group is led by a senior Aon executive with oversight from the Chief Strategy Officer and Global Head of Analytics for Aon Reinsurance Solutions.

We work with insurers, reinsurers, investment firms, banks, and corporations to manage complex commercial issues through the provision of corporate finance advisory services, capital markets solutions, and innovative risk management products.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Interest in the financial services or (re)insurance, ideally in corporate finance, financial planning , financial analysis, and/or accounting
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Financial modeling experience is required
  • Knowledge of accounting and finance concepts, with knowledge of balance sheet concepts for financial institutions a plus
  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
  • Prior experience with data analysis concepts, including reproducibility and version control
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Flexible, adaptable in work tasks and approach
  • Ability to operate effectively in a cooperative and matrixed setting
  • Focused, with strong organizational abilities and attention to detail
  • Good interpersonal skills, client management and communication abilities

Qualifications

  • College Seniors graduating between Spring 2026 to Spring 2027 with a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0
  • Please Note: For this role you must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

The Launch Development Program

Launch is a structured 10-month Early Career development program that combines meaningful work, business learning, professional development and relationship-building across Aon. The program helps you build a strong foundation for a long-term broking and advisory career through:

  • On-the-job learning with brokers, client teams, account managers and solution line specialists.
  • Business and professional development in Commercial Risk, Reinsurance, client service, communication, collaboration, problem solving and commercial awareness.
  • Exposure to data, analytics and technology that support risk assessment, market analysis, workflow coordination and client-ready recommendations.
  • Networking, mentorship and coaching opportunities to build relationships across Aon and develop your career path.

What Will Help You Succeed and Grow

We are looking for candidates who are curious, motivated and excited to learn. Through the Launch Program, you will continue developing the same skills and capabilities that support a successful broking and advisory career, including:

  • An interest in business, risk, insurance, reinsurance, analytics, finance, economics, client service or global markets.
  • A desire to pursue a career in Commercial Risk and/or Reinsurance - Broking.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with a range of stakeholders.
  • Analytical and critical thinking, problem-solving ability and attention to detail.
  • A collaborative mindset, alongside initiative, adaptability and a willingness to contribute as part of a team.
  • Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Confidence using technology and a willingness to learn new tools, internal AI platforms and technology-enabled ways of working.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
  • Interpersonal skills and the ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues, clients and external partners.
  • Initiative and a commitment to continuous learning, growth and professional development.

Summary:

As a New Business Coordinator, you will support the New Business team in handling life insurance underwriting requirements, reviewing medical records, and coordinating policy implementation activities. This role is responsible for tracking underwriting cases, preparing medical summaries, maintaining accurate documentation, and working with carriers, advisors, medical providers, and internal stakeholders to facilitate timely case progression and policy placement. The New Business Coordinator will also gain exposure to insurance portfolio implementation and progressively assume responsibility for handling straightforward cases and smaller portfolios independently. This position offers an opportunity to develop technical expertise in life insurance underwriting, case management, and portfolio implementation while contributing to a collaborative, service-oriented team.

Principal Accountabilities:

  • Order and manage Attending Physician Statements (APS), medical records, and other underwriting requirements for active cases.
  • Monitor outstanding underwriting requirements and coordinate follow-up activities to ensure timely case progression.
  • Maintain accurate case notes, underwriting updates, and supporting documentation within Salesforce and other internal systems.
  • Coordinate with medical providers, insurance carriers, examination vendors, and third-party partners to obtain required information.
  • Assist in preparing underwriting submissions and supporting documentation for carrier review.
  • Review and organize medical records received from physicians, hospitals, and other healthcare providers.

  • Support the New Business team throughout the insurance portfolio implementation and policy placement process.

  • Coordinate communication between carriers, advisors, and internal collaborators to facilitate efficient policy implementation.
  • Participate in implementation meetings and collaborate with senior team members to develop an understanding of portfolio management.
  • Develop working knowledge of carrier processes, underwriting practices, and insurance implementation workflows.
  • Progressively assume responsibility for managing straightforward insurance cases, term insurance placements, and smaller portfolios.
  • Maintain high service standards while managing assigned underwriting and implementation responsibilities.
  • Communicate case updates, outstanding requirements, potential delays, and operational concerns proactively to management.

  • Strong follow-up skills with a proactive approach to managing outstanding requirements.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and professional judgment.
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, CRM systems, and related business technology.
  • Service-oriented mentality with a commitment to delivering a positive client and advisor experience.
  • Willingness to learn new processes, develop technical expertise, and take on additional responsibilities.

  • Working knowledge of life insurance underwriting concepts, carrier requirements, and policy implementation processes preferred.

Job Summary

The Director, Decision Science leads a team of analytics and decision science professionals responsible for transforming data into actionable business insights that drive strategic decision-making across the enterprise. This role partners closely with executive leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex business challenges, identify growth opportunities, improve operational performance, and enhance profitability.

The Director oversees the development and application of advanced analytics, statistical modeling, experimentation, forecasting, and machine learning techniques to inform critical business decisions. This leader establishes the vision and strategy for decision science initiatives, ensures the delivery of high-impact analytical solutions, and fosters a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. The position leads other people leaders, acts as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, and serves as a subject matter expert in analytics and data-driven decision making.

Essential Job Functions

  • Partner with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to identify strategic business opportunities and develop data-driven solutions that improve business outcomes.

  • Lead the development and execution of the Decision Science strategy, ensuring alignment with enterprise objectives and business priorities.

  • Provide consultative leadership on complex business questions by leveraging advanced analytics, statistical methodologies, predictive modeling, forecasting, and machine learning techniques.

  • Translate business objectives into analytical frameworks and actionable recommendations that influence strategic decisions.

  • Guide large-scale exploratory analyses to uncover trends, risks, opportunities, and drivers of performance across the organization.

  • Oversee the design, execution, and interpretation of experiments, hypothesis testing, and causal inference analyses to evaluate business initiatives and optimize outcomes.

  • Direct the development, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of predictive and prescriptive analytics solutions.

  • Leverage modern analytics, visualization, and decision-support tools to communicate insights effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Present findings and recommendations to senior and executive leadership, influencing decisions through compelling data storytelling and business-focused communication.

  • Partner with Data Engineering, Data Science, Technology, Product, Finance, and Business Operations teams to ensure data integrity, governance, and scalable analytical solutions.

  • Establish best practices for analytical rigor, model governance, data quality, and performance measurement.

  • Drive the adoption of emerging analytical technologies, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and industry best practices to enhance business capabilities.

  • Lead, develop, and mentor leaders and teams within the Decision Science organization, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, inclusion, and high performance.

  • Manage workforce planning, performance management, employee engagement, talent development, succession planning, and organizational effectiveness initiatives.

  • Serve as a thought leader and trusted advisor, promoting data literacy and analytical decision-making throughout the enterprise.

  • Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in decision science methodologies.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Experience Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in analytics, decision science, data science, business intelligence, statistics, actuarial analytics, operations research, or related quantitative disciplines.

  • 5+ years of progressive people leadership experience, including leading managers and developing high-performing analytics organizations.

  • Demonstrated experience influencing senior leaders and driving enterprise-level business decisions through analytics and insights.

  • Experience applying advanced statistical techniques, predictive modeling, experimentation, forecasting, machine learning, and optimization methodologies to solve business problems.

  • Strong executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and collaborating with business, technology, and data teams.

Education Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Economics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline preferred.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Frequently sits for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including, navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and/or places objects or materials weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Rarely performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category require rare, if any, travel.

Job Summary

The Principal Data & Analytics Leader is a senior leadership role responsible for defining and executing enterprise data and analytics, and AI strategies that drive business performance, customer and agent experience, operational excellence, profitability, and growth. This leader partners closely with business stakeholders, the data and analytics organization, and IT leadership to transform insight into actionable recommendations, scalable products, and strategic capabilities that influence decision-making across the organization. As a strategic partner to our stakeholders this role provides a clear vision to leadership on design, development, implementation, and governance of enterprise data and analytics solutions, while fostering a culture of innovation, data-driven decision making, and continuous improvement. The position will lead a high-performing team responsible for aligning capabilities to the requirement of the organization in meeting its key performance indicators and goals. Focusing on data engineering, analytics, reporting, governance, and advanced analytical capabilities to deliver measurable business value.

Essential Job Functions

  • Identifies and drives opportunities to leverage advanced analytics, predictive modeling, machine learning, and emerging technologies to create competitive advantages and business value.
  • Develops and communicates strategic roadmaps, priorities, and investment recommendations while ensuring successful execution of large-scale initiatives.
  • Partners with business leaders to establish meaningful performance metrics, measurement strategies, and actionable insights that improve operational and financial outcomes.

  • Leads the design and implementation of highly complex data and analytics products, platforms, and capabilities that support strategic decision-making and business transformation initiatives.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Application Subject Matter Expert III to support the Direct Sales business and customer contact center operations. This role is responsible for ensuring the stability, reliability, and performance of critical production applications, with a strong focus on incident management, root cause analysis, system monitoring, and continuous improvement.

The successful candidate will serve as the primary escalation point for production issues, collaborate with business and IT stakeholders, and drive timely resolution of incidents impacting business operations. This individual will also leverage technical expertise across applications, APIs, databases, integrations, and monitoring tools to identify opportunities for automation and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and lead incident response efforts to ensure timely issue resolution and business communication.
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex production support issues.
  • Monitor production environments using observability and monitoring tools to proactively identify risks and system anomalies.
  • Own and manage high-priority incidents, driving root cause analysis and permanent remediation.
  • Lead post-incident reviews and implement preventive measures.
  • Collaborate closely with Direct Sales business teams, contact center leadership, and cross-functional IT teams.
  • Provide clear and timely communication regarding incident status, business impact, and resolution plans.
  • Identify recurring production issues and recommend process improvements.
  • Develop and maintain support documentation, operational runbooks, and automation opportunities.
  • Review and approve system changes impacting production environments.
  • Validate testing activities prior to production deployments.
  • Analyze application architecture, integrations, APIs, middleware components, databases, and data flows to troubleshoot issues effectively.
  • Support implementation activities and provide technical guidance to stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior team members and share best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4–6 years of overall IT experience.
  • 4–6 years of experience in application support, application development, system analysis, or production support environments.
  • Experience managing production incidents and troubleshooting enterprise applications.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, system integrations, databases, and application architecture.
  • Experience working with monitoring and observability platforms.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with Salesforce.
  • Fluent English proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using Dynatrace or similar monitoring tools.
  • Knowledge of ITIL processes and incident/problem management practices.
  • Experience working in large enterprise environments.

Technical Skills

  • Salesforce
  • Dynatrace (nice to have)
  • Incident Management (supporting incident management calls)
  • Root Cause Analysis
  • API Troubleshooting
  • Database Analysis
  • Production Support
  • Application Monitoring
  • System Integration Support
  • Change Management

  • Also establishes and maintains research and reference material files related to newly created personal lines insurance products that originate in the product division of Personal Lines Product Development.
  • Assists the Sales/Agencies Departments in the development and preparation of material interpreting or explaining newly created personal lines insurance products.
  • Provides support for the computer system in product division and recommends and maintains current software to meet the needs of the division. Maintains contact with various organizations and individuals beneficial to research activities.

    Tools:
  • Data Tools- Excel, Power BI, Data Warehouses - Intermediate (4-6 Years)
    Microsoft Suite - Intermediate (4-6 Years)

Benefits

This position offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and work–life balance. Any ownership, partnership, directorship, or participation in other businesses or companies must be fully disclosed and formally reviewed in accordance with FBS internal conflict‑of‑interest and external engagement policies prior to the start date or as soon as such circumstances arise.

Failure to comply with these conditions may impact the hiring decision or employment continuation.

About Farmers Insurance
"Farmers Insurance®" and "Farmers®" are tradenames for a group of insurers providing insurance for automobiles, homes and small businesses and a wide range of other insurance and financial services products. Farmers Insurance Exchange, the largest of the three primary insurers that make up Farmers Insurance, is recognized as one of the largest U.S. companies on the 2025 Fortune 500 list. For more information about Farmers Insurance, visit Farmers.com.

Job.JobTitle: Field Territory Manager - Nor cal - Commercial Auto
Job.JobDescription:
We are Farmers – where ambition meets opportunity.

At Farmers, we're not just known for unforgettable jingle – we're a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people's lives. We deliver peace of mind when it matters most. Our results-driven, high-performance culture thrives on creativity, accountability and bold solutions. Here, growth isn't just a goal – it's a way of life for both the organization and every individual on our team. We tackle challenges head-on, learn from every experience and measure our impact on the customers who trust us.

Join an award-winning, equal opportunity employer, where you'll find more than a job – you'll find a supportive community. Enjoy competitive benefits, take part in meaningful volunteer projects, and help shape the future alongside talented colleagues across all backgrounds. At Farmers, helping others is at the heart of what we do.

Ready to make your mark? Discover our vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate. Connect with us on Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok, and let's build something incredible together!

Workplace: Field-based within territory (No. Cal.)

Job Summary

  • This position manages an assigned territory of core Foremost Independent Agencies, including responsibilities to prospect and appoint new agencies with guidance, drive profitable premium growth, and achieve financial and operational goals. This role develops and manages agency partnerships and serves as the primary relationship between the agency and the company.
  • The position develops and successfully promotes and supports the available suite of Foremost products and services, including a portfolio of moderately complex accounts, within an assigned territory. This role is at the forefront of building premium growth through relationships with agents to ensure market share is built successfully.
  • This position is an individual contributor who receives moderate guidance and direction from management and field distribution partners while performing work with business unit and enterprise impacts. The position is remote with required weekly field travel.

Essential Job Functions

  • Owns and manages assigned territory driving profitable growth to achieve financial and operational targets. With moderate guidance from management and field distribution partners, assists in leading, developing, and executing territory tactical plan and agency management processes (example business planning, training, compensation) to support financial and operational targets, measure results, and pivot as necessary. With coaching, builds and cultivates mutually beneficial agency partnerships in person with agency ownership, management, and frontline staff using a consultative sales framework. Establishes position as a trusted advisor while delivering product, underwriting philosophy, appetite, and system training, to support retention and new business development to increase depth and maximize agency revenue.
  • With moderate guidance, creates, maintains, and executes high quality agency strategies and plans, including holding agents accountable, to achieve written premium, profit, and new business goals. Coordinates plans with field distribution partners, including strategic and tactical components, to align with business strategies such as carrier consolidation (agency book consolidation), agency storefront expansion, and new product or program rollout support. With coaching, drives and ensures quality of new business flow, appropriate mix of business, and overall risk management of both ind ividual agency books and overall assigned territory. Provides appetite and target market clarity, identifies and addresses profit or quality of business concerns to ensure profitability across territory.
  • Strategically utilizes internal reporting and tools designed to support the Independent Agent channel including all Marketing and Development programs, business development tools and internal production/profitability data and analysis. Performs other duties as ass igned.

Physical Actions

  • Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. Job may include work performed at field locations. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Field work performed outdoors may include exposure to weather elements. Frequently sits or stands for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and places objects or materials weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Occasionally performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category may require regular travel between Farmers offices, alternative work locations, and/or field locations.

Education Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred. CIC, CPCU, or insurance licenses preferred upon hire.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum three years of insurance sales and management work experience.
  • Experience achieving profitable premium growth and sales success.
  • Commercial auto experience is required.
  • Territory management is preferred.

Benefits

  • Farmers offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications and location.

About this job

Field Property Claims Adjuster conducting on-site and virtual investigations of property damage for Tucson, AZ policyholders. Role includes damage assessment, liability evaluation, settlement negotiation, and 1-3 catastrophe deployments per year.

Good fit if you have a high school diploma, valid driver's license, customer service experience, and can climb ladders and work in confined spaces.

Full job description

Workplace: Remote ( #LI-Remote )

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered.

If you are looking for the following in your next career...

  • Paid training through the award-winning and industry-leading University of Farmers.
  • Flexibility and independence to work outside the confines of a desk job.
  • Total Rewards Benefits Package: 401K and a competitive starting salary.
  • Rapid growth potential and management opportunities for success-oriented people through education, mentorship programs, and inspirational leadership at a company you can be proud of.

… Then Farmers Insurance is the place for you!

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Claims Adjuster

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders' residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days.

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

If You Have the Following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable. Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

... then this could be a great career opportunity for you!

Final candidate qualifications may be reviewed against the requirements for the associated level of this role.

Candidates Must be Willing and Able to:

  • Climb Ladders to inspect roofs, and be comfortable working on rooftops, multiple times per day,
  • Work in small, confined spaces that have been damaged; such as attics and crawlspaces.
  • Achieve a minimum passing score on all claims training exams.

Physical Actions and Environment

  • Bending, Kneeling, Pulling, Pushing, Sorting, Carrying up to 50 lbs., Climbing, Reaching, Standing, Walking, Seeing
  • Speaking (English), Reading (English), Writing (English), & Key Entering

Required job duties are performed in the field and an in-home office environment. Exposure to some or all of the following environments when in the field: Uncontrolled outside environmental conditions, Excessive noise levels, Chemicals Chemical/Biological conditions, Moving mechanical parts, Areas considered dangerous, Conditions which could affect the respiratory system or skin such as fumes, odors, dust, mists, gases, oils, smoke, soot, or poor ventilation.

Sell home, auto, and specialty insurance products to local customers in person and by phone for National General, part of Allstate. Role involves generating new business, cross-selling, and building community relationships to drive growth.

Good fit if you have 0-2 years of experience and P&C licensing or can obtain it within 90 days

Full job description

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making adifference, then apply to join our team today!

As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

  • Achieve sales goals through new business, cross-sell, and retention
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals
  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

What makes Direct Auto Insurance unique?

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Tuition Reimbursement, Pension & so much more

  • Ability to sell a multitude of industry-leading products through retail stores andphone
  • Entrepreneurial, performance-based, and results-focused culture
  • Multi-tiered and comprehensive paid training program

Job.JobTitle: Comprehensive Personal Liability Represented Claims Adjuster -Remote
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

This role is responsible for investigating moderately complex and complex comprehensive personal liability (CPL) claims, including representative moderate and major CPL losses. Responsibilities include analyzing coverage, obtaining recorded statements, evaluating liability and damages, handling demands, issuing payments to appropriate parties, and negotiating settlements. Claims involving requiring additional expertise are referred to for further handling litigation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Negotiates and settles claims in accordance with business unit best practices.
  • Review policy language and analysis determine coverage.
  • Reviews of medical reports in preparation for claims settlement evaluation.
  • Coordinate the appraisal process for highly complex, disputed claims, ensuring adherence to policy provisions.
  • Determines and explains coverage limits in moderately complex and complex claims involving single or multiple claimants, also determines claim value.
  • Sets initial reserve, updates reserve, documents rationale and claim summary notes.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for policyholder attorneys, leading direct negotiations to resolve disputes efficiently.
  • Draft and respond to attorney correspondence, requests for information, and demands to maintain compliance and mitigate legal exposure.
  • Researches and responds to moderately complex and occasionally complex customer communications, concerns, conflicts or issues.
  • Summarizes documents and enters into claim system notes, documenting a claim file with notes, evaluations and decision-making process.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2 or more years of experience.
  • Adjuster License.
  • Strong negotiating experience and policy interpretation experience.
  • Experience handling third-party bodily injury claims arising from homeowners, renters, landlord, ATV, boat, and golf cart insurance policies.

Work Location:

Remote Home-Based Work:


This position is a permanent remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States. This position is not available for California, Alaska, Washington and Hawaii residents.


When you work from home full time, youll need:

  • a home office a dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions
  • a minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up
  • appropriate work surface and seating


What will Allstate provide?

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse)
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

As a condition of employment, you will be required to obtain an adjuster's license. Your manager will work with you along with the centralized licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Compensation Data:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign-on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designate Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

Candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Skills

Bodily Injury Claims, Complex Claims, Critical Thinking, Homeowners Claims, Information Collection, Multitasking, Negotiation, Third Party Claims, Time Management

Compensation

Compensation range for this position is $56,000 - $111,550 per year, based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

The ideal candidate combines strong process auditing expertise with advanced data analytics and technology skills to improve operational effectiveness and control quality. This individual leverages tools such as Excel to analyze large datasets, identify trends, anomalies, and control gaps, and support risk-based audit approaches. They have experience translating business rules into audit criteria, evaluating workflows for automation opportunities, and partnering across business and technology teams to implement meaningful process improvements.

Job Summary

Serves as the first line of defense to ensure overall effectiveness of quality programs and business operations controls. Ensures adherence to established quality framework and ongoing evaluation of business operations control activities in an effort to minimize exposures and strengthen the overall business control environment. Identifies problems in quality system process and presents effective solutions to leadership.

Essential Job Functions

  • Supports business operations in the implementation of quality related initiatives by providing procedures/process oversight, business control assessments and procedure evaluation.
  • Troubleshoots quality concerns, identifies trends and recommends action items to the business for handling to ensure compliance, reduce risk and improve customer experience.
  • Provides oversight to ensure business operations complies with applicable underwriting, compliance, financial controls and/or company policy through communication, change management, process design, and/or project participation.
  • Identifies key data-driven insights tied to first line of defense, translates data into compelling stories and makes effective recommendations for improvement.
  • Ensures execution of the quality assurance plan based on scope, analyzes audit results and creates audit summaries.
  • Provides facilitation of business operations engagement with Legal, Compliance, Finance, Product and Underwriting.
  • Partners and collaborates with various business stakeholders to support programs and controls.
  • Communicates effectively with process owners to identify business control failures in order to make sound recommendations.
  • Participates in remediation process through business action plan coordination and support.
  • Advises on corrective action measures based on audit results, compliance reviews and advanced understanding of customer needs.
  • Routinely monitors business controls and applies knowledge of controls to review and validate them.
  • Configures, updates, and maintains data and processes within quality database.
  • Collaborates with and builds relationships across organization, bridges gaps between teams and influences key stakeholders based on increased business acumen.
  • Mentors new team members and serves as a lead to guide other team members.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Physical Environment

This position operates in an open office working environment which will include normal and customary distractions, noise, and interruptions. Sits or stands for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift. Occasionally reaches overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Occasionally moves, lifts, carries, and places objects and supplies weighing 0-10 pounds without assistance. Listens to, interprets, and differentiates auditory information (e.g. others speaking) at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Visually verifies and reads information. Visually locates material, resources and other objects. Ability to operate a computer for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift. Physical dexterity sufficient to use hands, arms, and shoulders repetitively to operate keyboard and other office equipment up to a full work shift.

Education Requirements

High school diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor's degree preferred.

Experience Requirements

3-5 years related work experience required. Experience in a team lead or leadership role preferred.

Preferred experience includes:

  • Advanced Excel, including PivotTables
  • Working knowledge of Power BI for dashboards, audit trends, exception reporting, and root-cause analysis.
  • Experience querying or manipulating data
  • Ability to work with large transaction datasets and reconcile information across systems.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, validation, and controls.

Benefits

  • Farmers offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications and location.
  • Bonus Opportunity (based on Company and Individual Performance)
  • 401(k)
  • Medical
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Life Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Tuition Assistance
  • For more information, review “What we offer” on https://www.farmers.com/careers/corporate/#offer

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

We are seeking a Managing Engineer to lead high-performing software engineering teams responsible for building and modernizing enterprise applications that support Allstate's Roadside Services critical business operations.

This is a hands-on leadership role that includes active Java coding and technical contribution alongside people leadership. This leader will drive technical strategy, partner with product and business stakeholders, and foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with deep technical expertise in modern software engineering practices. You will develop engineering talent, contribute directly to the design and development of Java-based solutions, deliver scalable and reliable applications, and help shape the technical direction of key products and platforms.

The internal job title for this is role is Software Engineer-Manager.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop software engineering teams, providing mentorship, career guidance, and ongoing performance feedback.
  • Remain hands-on with Java engineering by contributing production-quality code, reviewing code, troubleshooting complex issues, and supporting technical delivery.
  • Partner with Product Management, Architecture, Security, and business leaders to translate strategic goals into technology solutions.
  • Guide teams through product discovery, planning, prioritization, and delivery activities within Agile environments.
  • Establish and evolve application architectures, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards.
  • Drive engineering excellence through modern development practices, including automated testing, CI/CD, DevOps, observability, and secure coding.
  • Ensure applications are scalable, secure, reliable, and effectively supported in production.
  • Remove technical and organizational obstacles, helping teams effectively execute against priorities and commitments.
  • Lead retrospectives and continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen delivery, quality, and team effectiveness.
  • Foster collaboration across engineering teams to improve consistency, reusability, and organizational alignment.
  • Support workforce planning, recruiting, onboarding, succession planning, and talent development activities.
  • Define and monitor key engineering metrics related to quality, delivery, reliability, and operational performance.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to technology and business stakeholders on software engineering best practices and emerging technologies.

Essential Qualifications

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including experience leading engineering teams delivering enterprise applications and services. (Or Equivalent)
  • Experience managing or leading software engineers in Agile development environments. (Or Equivalent)
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to remain hands-on with coding while leading and developing an engineering team.
  • Strong hands-on Java and Spring Boot development experience, including designing, coding, testing, and troubleshooting enterprise applications.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, microservices, distributed systems, APIs, and cloud-native application development.
  • Experience with relational database technologies.
  • Experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices.
  • Experience supporting applications in production with a focus on reliability, monitoring, and operational excellence.
  • Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience leading technical planning, estimation, prioritization, and execution activities.
  • Proven success attracting, developing, mentoring, and retaining engineering talent.
  • Experience partnering with Product Management and business stakeholders to deliver customer-focused solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading development teams utilizing React, Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Oracle, and microservices architectures.
  • Experience supporting distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and high-volume transactional applications.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Kubernetes-based environments.
  • Knowledge of object-oriented design, domain-driven design, API-first development, and secure coding principles.
  • Experience implementing automated testing strategies, infrastructure automation, and DevOps practices.
  • Experience with messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, or similar platforms.
  • Experience leading application modernization initiatives, including cloud migrations and monolith-to-microservices transformations.
  • Strong understanding of application monitoring, logging, performance optimization, and reliability engineering.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional technology and business leaders to define roadmaps and deliver strategic outcomes.
  • Experience within insurance, claims, financial services, warranty services, or other highly regulated industries.

Leadership Responsibilities

This position includes direct people leadership responsibilities and is accountable for:

  • Managing and developing software engineering talent.
  • Performance management, coaching, and career development.
  • Hiring and onboarding team members.
  • Succession planning and talent retention.
  • Building and maintaining a high-performing, inclusive engineering culture.

Success Profile

The successful candidate is a hands-on servant leader who balances active technical contribution, people development, and business outcomes. They are comfortable contributing Java code and guiding technical decisions while building strong engineering teams, modernizing technology platforms, and delivering reliable solutions that create value for customers and the business.


Experience

  • 7 or more years of experience (Preferred)

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job has supervisory duties

#LI-MF1

Skills

Agile Software Development, Coaching, Collaborative Development, Engineering Practices, Java (Programming Language), People Development, People Leadership, Software Development, Spring Boot, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Talent Development

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 120,000.00 - 193,725.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making adifference, then apply to join our team today!

As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior PostgreSQL Database Administrator to join the Database Engineering team and help build, operate, and modernize our enterprise PostgreSQL platform. This role will be responsible for the design, implementation, automation, security, performance, high availability, backup and recovery, and operational support of PostgreSQL environments across on-premises and cloud platforms.

The ideal candidate will have deep PostgreSQL expertise, strong Linux administration skills, hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery technologies, and the ability to partner effectively with application, infrastructure, security, SRE, and cloud engineering teams.

Lead to Expert level is considered, Expert level is desired.

Key Responsibilities

PostgreSQL Platform Engineering

  • Design, build, deploy, administer, and support enterprise PostgreSQL environments across production and non-production landscapes.
  • Lead PostgreSQL installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, migrations, and lifecycle management activities.
  • Define and maintain PostgreSQL engineering standards, reference architectures, build procedures, operational controls, and best practices.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and advise application teams on database design, scalability, resilience, and operational readiness.

High Availability and Disaster Recovery

  • Design and support PostgreSQL high-availability solutions using technologies such as Patroni, etcd, HAProxy, Keepalived, and streaming replication.
  • Implement and maintain disaster-recovery strategies across multiple sites or regions.
  • Plan and execute failover, switchover, recovery, and resiliency tests.
  • Work with stakeholders to define, validate, and maintain recovery time and recovery point objectives.

Backup and Recovery

  • Design, implement, and operate enterprise PostgreSQL backup and recovery solutions.
  • Administer pgBackRest, WAL archiving, point-in-time recovery, retention, and recovery validation processes.
  • Conduct regular restore testing and support disaster-recovery exercises to verify recoverability.

Performance and Reliability

  • Monitor database availability, capacity, health, and performance.
  • Analyze and optimize SQL queries, indexes, execution plans, database configurations, and workloads.
  • Troubleshoot complex production incidents, lead root-cause analysis, and implement preventive actions.
  • Drive database reliability, observability, capacity planning, and operational excellence initiatives.

Security and Compliance

  • Implement database security controls, access-management standards, and least-privilege practices.
  • Manage roles, privileges, authentication, encryption, auditing, and credential-management integrations.
  • Support compliance reviews, vulnerability remediation, security assessments, and evidence requests.

Automation and DevOps

  • Develop automation for database provisioning, configuration, deployment, patching, validation, and routine operations.
  • Use Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, source control, and CI/CD practices to improve consistency and repeatability.
  • Partner with engineering teams to expand safe self-service capabilities and reduce manual operational effort.

Platform Operations and Technical Leadership

  • Provide support for mission-critical production and non-production PostgreSQL environments.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, major incident response, change management, and problem management.
  • Create and maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, standards, and operational documentation.
  • Mentor engineers, review technical solutions, and provide technical leadership for PostgreSQL initiatives.

Required Qualifications

Lead Level

  • 7+ years of database administration experience. (preferred)
  • 7+ years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration experience supporting mission-critical production environments. (highly desired)
  • Plus the Technical Skills listed below.

Expert Level

  • 10+ years of database administration experience.
  • 8+ years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration experience supporting mission-critical production environments.
  • Plus the below Technical skills listed below

Technical Skills

  • Strong Linux administration experience; RHEL or a comparable enterprise Linux distribution is preferred.
  • Deep understanding of PostgreSQL architecture, internals, configuration, security, maintenance, and performance tuning.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL streaming replication, high availability, disaster recovery, backup and recovery, point-in-time recovery, WAL management, and capacity planning.
  • Strong SQL, execution-plan analysis, indexing, and query-optimization skills.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex database, operating system, storage, and connectivity issues in production environments.
  • Experience planning and executing database upgrades, migrations, patching, and production changes.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and work effectively across organizational boundaries.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Percona Distribution for PostgreSQL or Percona-supported PostgreSQL environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Patroni, etcd, HAProxy, Keepalived, pgBackRest, and PostgreSQL-native monitoring and diagnostic tools.
  • Experience with cloud database and infrastructure platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management.
  • Experience with automation and delivery tools such as Ansible, Terraform, GitHub, GitLab, or CI/CD pipelines.
  • Exposure to other database technologies such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB, or Neo4j.
  • Experience leading technical initiatives, mentoring team members, and influencing platform standards.

Desired Attributes

  • Strong ownership, accountability, and customer focus.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and drive technical initiatives to completion.
  • Strong collaboration, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Experience working in large-scale, highly available, and regulated enterprise environments.


Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

Skills

Access Management, Access Management, Accountability, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Authentication, Backup and Recovery, Cloud Computing, Cloud Engineering, Cloud Platform, Collaboration, Communication, Compliance, Computer Science, Continuous Integration Software, Credential Management, Database Administration, Database Design, Database Engineering, Database Management Systems (DBMS), Database Performance, Database Security, Database Technologies, Datadog, Data Modeling, DevOps {+ 48 more}

Job.JobTitle: Large Loss Adjuster - UM/UIM - National General
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Atlanta, GA

About this job

Handle complex bodily injury claims with UM/UIM focus, ranging from policy limits of 15/30 to 100/300. Provide settlement authority on highly complex claims, review files, and collaborate with field teams on coverage, liability, and damages issues.

Good fit if you have strong coverage analysis and liability investigation skills, experience with complex bodily injury claims, and can work independently on high-exposure cases.

Full job description

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

The Senior Consultant II is responsible for granting settlement authority on highly complex claims valued in excess of Market Claim Office (MCO) and Regional Claim Office (RCO) limits, providing recommendations on requests to go to trial on cases where the gross exposure is in excess of MCO authority, and general oversight of all large losses for a specific CSA or CSAs. The individual may also provide discretionary referrals on coverage issues, opinions and research. In addition, the Sr Cons II may provide approval on Closed Without Payment (CWP) requests where liability is disputed, and the value is in excess of Field authority.

We are seeking a Large Loss Bodily Injury Adjuster with a focus on UM/UIM claims. This role involves handling complex BI claims across a range of policy limits, from 15/30 and 35/70 up to 100/300. Claims may involve injuries ranging from soft tissue to fatalities. The ideal candidate will posses strong skills in coverage analysis, liability investigations, and injury evaluation, along with the ability to effectively negotiate and resolve high exposure claims. Litigation experience is preferred but not required. Apply today and join our growing team!






Key Responsibilities

Performs file reviews for various complex projects or for cases in litigation, analyzes data, and reports findings

May review cases to determine if CWP is appropriate given gross tort value exposure

Supports the Field with discretionary referrals on complex coverage issues and engages Home Office Claim litigation for involvement and direction as needed

Reviews coverage, liability, and/or damages on highly complex cases referred for authorization and collaborates with Field leadership on addition steps to be taken and other feedback and direction

Collaborates with Frontline Performance Experts (FPEs), Frontline Performance Leaders (FPLS), and Claim Process Specialists (CPSs) to share experience and trends identified in referred cases

Works with Product, Protection, Law, and Claims on new products introduced to the Field and the sales force, and develops Claim Bulletins to provide new forms and/or endorsements that impact claim handling practices


Supervisory Responsibilities

This job does not have supervisory duties.



As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.



#LI-KR1

Client Counseling, Complex Claims, Conflict Management, Coverage Analysis, De-Escalation, File Reviews, Industry Trend Analysis, Insurance, Insurance Claims, Large Loss Claims, Liability Investigations, Litigation, Negotiation, Personal Injury Claims

Job.JobTitle: Inside Auto Claims Adjuster - Hybrid (Nashville, TN)
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Nashvle, TN
  • Experience: 2+ years
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off, tuition assistance

About this job

Inside Auto Claims Adjuster investigating basic to moderately complex auto insurance claims. Hybrid role in Nashville based in office Tuesday-Thursday and remote Monday-Friday, with training conducted fully in office.

Good fit if you have 2+ years of claim handling experience and can obtain an adjuster license within 60 days.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Inside Auto Claims Adjuster is responsible for investigating basic and occasionally moderately complex auto insurance claims. This role may handle non-represented claims and requires evaluating coverage, determining liability, and negotiating settlements. The adjuster works directly with claimants, insureds, and other involved parties to ensure timely, accurate, and customer-focused claim resolution.

Work Location & Schedule



During Training: IN OFFICE

  • Monday through Friday, 8am-4:45pm

After Training: HYBRID (IN OFFICE & REMOTE)

  • Hours: MondayFriday between 8:00 AM 5:30 PM, with occasional Saturday
  • Work Arrangement: Hybrid schedule 3 days in office (Tuesday-Thursday), 2 days remote (Monday, Friday)

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and company standards throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Investigate minor to moderately complex auto accidents and prepare clear, concise claim summaries.
  • Conduct recorded statements with claimants, insureds, and witnesses.
  • Evaluate auto claims to determine coverage, liability, and damages.
  • Negotiate and settle claims in alignment with established guidelines and best practices.
  • Maintain detailed and well-documented claim files, including notes, summaries, and decision rationale.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support efficient and customer-centric claim handling.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of prior claim handling experience preferred.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a demonstrated commitment to excellent customer service.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and operate in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail with solid critical-thinking and decision-making skills.
  • Comfortable using technology and learning claims-related software and tools.
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Washington, and Hawaii residents.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, you may be expected to obtain an adjusters license in multiple markets.
  • All required licenses must be obtained within 60 days of hire.
  • You must maintain all licensing required for your role. This includes any continuing education and/or other state-affiliated requirements for licensing renewal.

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Inside Auto Claims Adjuster is responsible for investigating basic and occasionally moderately complex auto insurance claims. This role may handle non-represented claims and requires evaluating coverage, determining liability, and negotiating settlements. The adjuster works directly with claimants, insureds, and other involved parties to ensure timely, accurate, and customer-focused claim resolution.

Work Location & Schedule



During Training: IN OFFICE

  • Monday through Friday, 8am-4:45pm

After Training: HYBRID (IN OFFICE & REMOTE)

  • Hours: MondayFriday between 8:00 AM 5:30 PM, with occasional Saturday
  • Work Arrangement: Hybrid schedule 3 days in office (Tuesday-Thursday), 2 days remote (Monday, Friday)

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and company standards throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Investigate minor to moderately complex auto accidents and prepare clear, concise claim summaries.
  • Conduct recorded statements with claimants, insureds, and witnesses.
  • Evaluate auto claims to determine coverage, liability, and damages.
  • Negotiate and settle claims in alignment with established guidelines and best practices.
  • Maintain detailed and well-documented claim files, including notes, summaries, and decision rationale.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support efficient and customer-centric claim handling.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of prior claim handling experience preferred.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a demonstrated commitment to excellent customer service.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and operate in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail with solid critical-thinking and decision-making skills.
  • Comfortable using technology and learning claims-related software and tools.
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Washington, and Hawaii residents.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, you may be expected to obtain an adjusters license in multiple markets.
  • All required licenses must be obtained within 60 days of hire.

  • Current employees and former employees seeking rehire at Allstate or its affiliated companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$68,700.00 - $113,400.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

As a Claim Rep, Auto Liability, you will be responsible for managing and investigating low to moderate complexity injury and/or property damage claims including customer contact, determining coverage, evaluating liability, assessing damages, establishing timely reserves, and issue timely and accurate payments within appropriate authority and oversight. In this fast-paced, detail-oriented and customer-focused role, you will work closely with customers, claimants, attorneys, and other parties to ensure claims are resolved accurately and efficiently while maintaining a high level of professionalism, empathy, and service. You may provide training and coaching to less experienced claim professionals.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage an active caseload of injury and/or property damage claims from first notice of loss through resolution within level of authority. Typically, handles low to moderately complex personal and/or business insurance liability claims which may include coverage disputes and contractual indemnity issues.
  • Gather and thoroughly investigate information by contacting all relevant parties to determine coverage, evaluate liability exposure, assess bodily injury and/or property damage, and establish appropriate reserves in accordance with policy terms and management guidance. Leverage internal resources, as appropriate.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, opposing counsel, third-party vendors, internal stakeholders, and other parties.
  • Negotiate with multiple constituents (e.g., claimants, attorneys, representatives) and convey claim settlements within authority and issue payments timely and accurately.
  • Handle low complexity litigation.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers' requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Two years of bodily injury claim experience.
  • Active adjuster license, where required by state law.
  • Experience with claims management systems, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally to multiple stakeholders.
  • Ability to analyze situations, exercise sound judgement, make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers; ability to manage difficult conversations with empathy and professionalism.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills with the ability to manage a high-volume workload and prioritize effectively.
  • Proven conflict resolution and negotiation skills; ability to handle complex or disputed claims and negotiate settlements.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Strong understanding of insurance principles and terminology, with working knowledge of state insurance regulations, claim handling requirements, and fair claims practices.
  • Demonstrated ability comprehend and analyze policy language.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • One year of bodily injury liability, property damage liability, or comparable claim related experience or successful completion of required Travelers Claim Representative training program.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

  •  Demonstrated skills in relationship building, decision-making, negotiation, and communication.
  •  Ability to understand, interpret, and explain various insurance policies.
  •  Ability to learn and use job-related software to stay current with changes.
  • Remote.
  • Travel and overnight stays are required.
